quiz.q: What happens to the criminal on the Cube?
o: He is dissolved into water by the Machine
quiz.why_uz: Mashina tanani atomlarga ajratib, toza suvga aylantiradi.

quiz.q: Who reads the second poem?
quiz.why_uz: Ikkinchi she'rni R-13 o'qiydi va rangi oqarib ketadi.

chapters.recap_uz: Kub maydonida Adolat bayrami: Homiy Mashinasi bilan qonunbuzar shoir yo'q qilinadi. R-13 ham hukm she'rini o'qiydi. D-503 bu marosimni ulug'vor ibodat deb biladi.

chapters.title: A letter — A manhunt — Hairy I

paras.en: Yesterday was for me a kind of filter-paper which chemists use for filtering their solutions (all suspended and superfluous particles remain on the paper). This morning I went downstairs all purified and distilled, transparent.
paras.uz: Kecha men uchun kimyogarlar eritmalarini filtrlash uchun ishlatadigan filtr qog'oziga o'xshash narsa bo'ldi (barcha muallaq va ortiqcha zarralar qog'ozda qoladi). Bugun ertalab men butunlay tozalangan, distillangan, shaffof holda pastga tushdim.

paras.en: Downstairs in the hall the controller sat at a small table, constantly looking at her watch and recording the Numbers who were leaving. Her name is U-⁠ ⁠… well, I prefer not to give her Number, for I fear I may not write kindly about her. Although, as a matter of fact, she is a very respectable, mature woman. The only thing I do not like in her is that her cheeks fold down a little like gills of a fish (although I do not see anything wrong in this appearance). She scratched with her pen and I saw on the page “D-503”⁠—and suddenly, splash! an inkblot. No sooner did I open my mouth to call her attention to that, than she raised her head and blotted me with an inky smile. “There is a letter for you. You will receive it, dear. Yes, yes, you will.”
paras.uz: Pastda, zalda nazoratchi kichik stol yonida o'tirib, doim soatiga qarar va chiqib ketayotgan Raqamlarni yozib borardi. Uning ismi Yu-... yo'q, uning raqamini aytmaganim ma'qul, chunki u haqida yaxshi yoza olmasligimdan qo'rqaman. Garchi, aslini olganda, u juda hurmatli, yoshi o'tgan ayol bo'lsa ham. Unda menga yoqmaydigan yagona narsa — yonoqlari baliqning jabralaridek biroz pastga osilib turadi (garchi bu ko'rinishda hech qanday yomon narsa ko'rmasam ham). U qalami bilan chizdi va men sahifada «D-503» ni ko'rdim — va to'satdan, shap! — siyoh dog'i. Uning e'tiborini bunga tortish uchun og'iz ochishim bilanoq, u boshini ko'tarib, meni siyohli tabassum bilan bo'yab qo'ydi. «Sizga xat bor. Uni olasiz, azizim. Ha, ha, olasiz».

paras.en: I knew a letter, after she had read it, must go through the Bureau of the Guardians (I think it is unnecessary to explain in detail this natural order of things); I would receive it not later than twelve o’clock. But that tiny smile confused me; the drop of ink clouded the transparency of the distilled solution. At the dock of the Integral I could not concentrate; I even made a mistake in my calculations⁠—that never happened to me before.
paras.uz: Men bilardimki, u o'qib chiqqan xat Qo'riqchilar Idorasidan o'tishi kerak (menimcha, narsalarning bu tabiiy tartibini batafsil tushuntirishga hojat yo'q); men uni soat o'n ikkidan kechiktirmay olaman. Lekin o'sha mitti tabassum meni sarosimaga soldi; siyoh tomchisi distillangan eritmaning shaffofligini xiralashtirdi. Integral stapelida diqqatimni jamlay olmadim; hatto hisoblarimda xato qildim — bu men bilan ilgari hech qachon bo'lmagan.

paras.en: At twelve o’clock, again the rosy-brown fish-gills’ smile, and at last the letter was in my hands. I cannot say why I did not read it right there, but I put it in my pocket and ran into my room. I opened it and glanced it over and⁠ ⁠… and sat down. It was the official notification advising me that Number I-330 had had me assigned to her and that today at twenty-one o’clock, I was to go to her. Her address was given.
paras.uz: Soat o'n ikkida yana pushti-jigarrang baliq jabrali tabassum va nihoyat xat qo'limda edi. Nega uni o'sha yerning o'zida o'qimaganimni ayta olmayman, lekin uni cho'ntagimga solib, xonamga yugurdim. Ochib, ko'z yugurtirdim va... o'tirib qoldim. Bu I-330 raqami meni o'z nomiga yozdirgani va bugun soat yigirma birda uning oldiga borishim kerakligi haqidagi rasmiy xabarnoma edi. Uning manzili berilgan edi.

paras.en: “No! After all that happened! After I showed her frankly my attitude toward her! Besides, how could she know that I did not go to the Bureau of the Guardians? She had no way of knowing that I was ill and could not.⁠ ⁠… And despite all this.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Yo'q! Bo'lib o'tgan hamma narsadan keyin! Unga o'zimning munosabatimni ochiq ko'rsatganimdan keyin! Bundan tashqari, u mening Qo'riqchilar Idorasiga bormaganimni qayerdan bildi? Mening kasal bo'lganimni va bora olmaganimni bilishning hech qanday yo'li yo'q edi... Va bularning hammasiga qaramay...»

paras.en: A dynamo was whirling and buzzing in my head. Buddha⁠ ⁠… yellow⁠ ⁠… lilies-of-the-valley⁠ ⁠… rosy crescent.⁠ ⁠… Besides⁠—besides, O- wanted to come to see me today! I am sure she would not believe (how could one believe), that I had absolutely nothing to do with the matter, that⁠ ⁠… I am sure also that we (O- and I) will have a difficult, foolish and absolutely illogical conversation. No, anything but that! Let the situation solve itself mechanically; I shall send her a copy of this official communication.
paras.uz: Boshimda dinamo aylanib, g'uvillardi. Budda... sariq... marvaridgullar... pushti o'roq... Bundan tashqari — bundan tashqari, O- bugun meni ko'rgani kelmoqchi edi! Ishonchim komilki, u mening bu ishga mutlaqo aloqam yo'qligiga ishonmaydi (qanday ishonish mumkin), ... Ishonchim komilki, biz (O- va men) qiyin, ahmoqona va mutlaqo mantiqsiz suhbat qilamiz. Yo'q, shundan boshqa har narsa! Vaziyat o'z-o'zidan mexanik ravishda hal bo'lsin; unga bu rasmiy xabarnomaning nusxasini yuboraman.

paras.en: While I was hastily putting the paper in my pocket, I noticed my terrible apelike hand. I remembered how that day during our walk, she took my hand and looked at it. Is it possible that she really⁠ ⁠… that she.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Qog'ozni shoshilib cho'ntagimga solayotib, dahshatli maymunnikidek qo'limni payqadim. Esladim, o'sha kuni sayr paytida u qo'limni ushlab, unga qaragan edi. Nahotki u haqiqatan ham... nahotki u...

paras.en: A quarter to twenty-one. A white northern night. Everything was glass⁠—greenish. But it was a different kind of glass, not like ours, not genuine but very breakable⁠—a thin glass shell and within that shell things were flying, whirling, buzzing. I should not have been surprised if suddenly the cupola of the auditorium had risen in slow, rolling clouds of smoke; or if the ripe moon had sent an inky smile⁠—like that one at the little table this morning; or if in all the houses suddenly all the curtains had been lowered and behind the curtains.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Yigirma birga chorak qolgan. Oq shimoliy tun. Hamma narsa shisha edi — yashilroq. Lekin bu boshqa turdagi shisha edi, biznikiga o'xshamaydi, haqiqiy emas, balki juda mo'rt — yupqa shisha qobiq va o'sha qobiq ichida narsalar uchar, aylanar, g'uvillardi. Agar to'satdan auditoriya gumbazi sekin, aylanuvchi tutun bulutlari bilan ko'tarilganida; yoki pishgan oy siyohli tabassum yuborganida — bugun ertalab kichik stol yonidagidek; yoki barcha uylarda to'satdan barcha pardalar tushirilib, pardalar ortida esa... hayron bo'lmagan bo'lardim.

paras.en: I felt something peculiar; my ribs were like iron bars that interfered, decidedly interfered, with my heart, giving it too little space. I stood at a glass door on which were the golden letters I-330; I-330 sat at the table with her back to me; she was writing something. I stepped in.
paras.uz: Men g'alati narsani his qildim; qovurg'alarim temir panjaralardek bo'lib, yuragimga xalaqit berardi, aniq xalaqit berardi, unga juda oz joy qoldirardi. Men oltin harflar bilan I-330 deb yozilgan shisha eshik oldida turdim; I-330 menga orqasini o'girib stol yonida o'tirardi; u nimadir yozardi. Men ichkariga kirdim.

paras.en: “Here.⁠ ⁠…” I held out the pink check, “… I received the notification this noon and here I am!”
paras.uz: «Mana...» — men pushti chiptani uzatdim, — bugun tushda xabarnomani oldim va mana men keldim!»

paras.en: “How punctual you are! Just a minute please, may I? Sit down. I shall finish in a minute.”
paras.uz: «Qanchalik aniqsiz! Bir daqiqa, iltimos, mumkinmi? O'tiring. Bir daqiqada tugataman».

paras.en: She lowered her eyes to the letter. What had she there, behind her lowered curtains? What would she say? What would she do in a second? How to learn it? How to calculate it, since she comes from beyond, from the wild ancient land of dreams? I looked at her in silence. My ribs were iron bars. The space for the heart was too small.⁠ ⁠… When she speaks her face is like a swiftly revolving, glittering wheel; you cannot see the separate bars. But at that moment the wheel was motionless. I saw a strange combination: dark eyebrows running right to the temples⁠—a sharp, mocking triangle; and still another dark triangle with its apex upward⁠—two deep wrinkles from the nose to the angles of the mouth. And these two triangles somehow contradicted each other. They gave the whole face that disagreeable, irritating X, or cross; a face obliquely marked by a cross.
paras.uz: U ko'zlarini xatga tushirdi. Uning tushirilgan pardalari ortida nima bor edi? U nima deydi? Bir soniyadan keyin nima qiladi? Buni qanday bilish mumkin? Qanday hisoblash mumkin, axir u narigi tomondan, qadimiy tushlarning yovvoyi yurtidan kelgan? Men unga jimgina qarab turdim. Qovurg'alarim temir panjaralar edi. Yurak uchun joy juda kichik edi... U gapirganda, uning yuzi tez aylanayotgan, yaltirayotgan g'ildirakka o'xshaydi; alohida kegaylarni ko'rib bo'lmaydi. Lekin o'sha lahzada g'ildirak qimirlamas edi. Men g'alati birikmani ko'rdim: chakkalarga qadar cho'zilgan qora qoshlar — o'tkir, masxaraomuz uchburchak; va uchi yuqoriga qaragan yana bir qora uchburchak — burundan og'iz burchaklarigacha ikki chuqur ajin. Bu ikki uchburchak qandaydir bir-biriga zid edi. Ular butun yuzga o'sha yoqimsiz, g'ashga tegadigan X ni, yoki xochni berardi; xoch bilan qiyshiq belgilangan yuz.

paras.en: The wheel started to turn; its bars blurred.
paras.uz: G'ildirak aylana boshladi; kegaylari xiralashdi.

paras.en: “So you did not go to the Bureau of Guardians after all?”
paras.uz: «Demak, siz baribir Qo'riqchilar Idorasiga bormadingizmi?»

paras.en: “I did⁠ ⁠… I did not feel well⁠ ⁠… I could not.”
paras.uz: «Men... tobim yo'q edi... bora olmadim».

paras.en: “Yes? I thought so; something must have prevented you, matters little what (sharp teeth⁠—a smile). But now you are in my hands. You remember: ‘Any Number who within forty-eight hours fails to report to the Bureau is considered.⁠ ⁠…’ ”
paras.uz: «Shundaymi? Men ham shunday deb o'ylagandim; nimadir sizga xalaqit bergan bo'lishi kerak, nima ekanining farqi yo'q (o'tkir tishlar — tabassum). Lekin endi siz mening qo'limdasiz. Esingizdami: "Qirq sakkiz soat ichida Idoraga xabar bermagan har qanday Raqam ... hisoblanadi"».

paras.en: My heart banged so forcibly that the iron bars bent. If I were not sitting⁠ ⁠… like a little boy, how stupid! I was caught like a little boy and stupidly I kept silent. I felt I was in a net; neither my legs nor my arms.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Yuragim shunchalik kuchli urdiki, temir panjaralar egildi. Agar o'tirmaganimda... kichkina boladek, qanday ahmoqona! Meni kichkina boladek qo'lga tushirishdi va men ahmoqona jim turaverdim. O'zimni to'rga tushgandek his qildim; na oyoqlarim, na qo'llarim...

paras.en: She stood up and stretched herself lazily. She pressed the button and the curtains on all four walls fell with a slight rustle. I was cut off from the rest of the world, alone with her.
paras.uz: U o'rnidan turib, dangasalik bilan kerishdi. Tugmani bosdi va to'rtala devordagi pardalar yengil shitirlash bilan tushdi. Men dunyoning qolgan qismidan uzilib, u bilan yolg'iz qoldim.

paras.en: She was somewhere behind me, near the closet door. The unif was rustling, falling. I was listening, all listening. I remembered⁠—no, it glistened in my mind for one hundredth of a second⁠—I once had to calculate the curve of a street membrane of a new type. (These membranes are handsomely decorated and are placed on all the avenues, registering all street conversations for the Bureau of Guardians.) I remembered a rosy concave, trembling membrane⁠—a strange being consisting of one organ only, an ear. I was at that moment such a membrane.
paras.uz: U orqamda, qayerdadir, shkaf eshigi yonida edi. Yunifa shitirlab tushardi. Men tinglardim, butun vujudim bilan tinglardim. Esladim — yo'q, bu ongimda soniyaning yuzdan bir ulushi davomida yaltirab o'tdi — bir paytlar yangi turdagi ko'cha membranasining egri chizig'ini hisoblashimga to'g'ri kelgan edi. (Bu membranalar chiroyli bezatilgan va barcha xiyobonlarga o'rnatilgan bo'lib, Qo'riqchilar Idorasi uchun barcha ko'cha suhbatlarini yozib oladi.) Pushti, botiq, titrayotgan membranani esladim — faqat bitta a'zodan, quloqdan iborat g'alati mavjudot. Men o'sha lahzada shunday membrana edim.

paras.en: Now the “click” of the snap-button at her collar, at her breast, and⁠ ⁠… lower. The glassy silk rustled over her shoulders and knees, over the floor. I heard⁠—and this was clearer than actual seeing⁠—I heard how one foot stepped out of the grayish-blue heap of silk, then the other.⁠ ⁠… Soon I’d hear the creak of the bed and⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Endi uning yoqasidagi, ko'kragidagi va... pastroqdagi qisqich tugmaning «chiq»i. Shishadek ipak uning yelkalari va tizzalari ustidan, pol ustidan shitirladi. Men eshitdim — va bu haqiqiy ko'rishdan ham aniqroq edi — eshitdimki, bir oyoq kulrang-moviy ipak uyumidan chiqdi, keyin ikkinchisi... Tez orada karavotning g'ichirlashini va... eshitaman.

paras.en: The tensely stretched membrane trembled and registered the silence⁠—no, the sharp hammer-like blows of the heart against the iron bars and endless pauses between beats. And I heard, saw, how she, behind me hesitated for a second, thinking. The door of the closet.⁠ ⁠… It slammed; again silk⁠ ⁠… silk.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Qattiq tortilgan membrana titrab, sukunatni qayd etdi — yo'q, yurakning temir panjaralarga qarshi o'tkir bolg'adek zarbalarini va zarbalar orasidagi cheksiz pauzalarni. Men eshitdim, ko'rdim, u orqamda bir soniya ikkilanib, o'ylaganini. Shkaf eshigi... U tarsilladi; yana ipak... ipak...

paras.en: “Well, all right.”
paras.uz: «Xo'sh, mayli».

paras.en: I turned around. She was dressed in a saffron-yellow dress of an ancient style. This was a thousand times worse than if she had not been dressed at all. Two sharp points, through the thin tissue glowing with rosiness, two burning embers piercing through ashes; two tender, round knees.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men o'girildim. U qadimiy uslubdagi za'faron-sariq ko'ylakda edi. Bu uning umuman kiyinmaganidan ming marta yomonroq edi. Yupqa mato orqali pushti tusda porlab turgan ikkita o'tkir uch, kul orasidan teshib chiqqan ikki yonayotgan cho'g'; ikkita nozik, yumaloq tizza...

paras.en: She was sitting in a low armchair. In front of her on a small square table, I noticed a bottle filled with something poisonously green and two small glasses on thin legs. In the corner of her mouth she had a very thin paper tube; she was ejecting smoke formed by the burning of that ancient smoking substance whose name I do not now remember.
paras.uz: U past kresloda o'tirardi. Uning oldidagi kichik kvadrat stolda men zaharli yashil narsa bilan to'ldirilgan shishani va ingichka oyoqli ikkita kichik qadahni payqadim. Og'zining burchagida juda ingichka qog'oz naycha bor edi; u hozir nomini eslay olmaydigan o'sha qadimiy chekiladigan moddaning yonishidan hosil bo'lgan tutunni chiqarardi.

paras.en: The membrane was still vibrating. Within the sledgehammer was pounding the red-hot iron bars of my chest. I heard distinctly every blow of the hammer, and⁠ ⁠… what if she too heard it?
paras.uz: Membrana hali ham titrardi. Ichkarida bolg'a ko'kragimning qizigan temir panjaralarini urardi. Men bolg'aning har bir zarbasini aniq eshitardim va... agar u ham eshitsa-chi?

paras.en: But she continued to produce smoke very calmly; calmly she looked at me; and nonchalantly she flicked ashes on the pink check!
paras.uz: Lekin u juda xotirjam tutun chiqarishda davom etdi; xotirjam menga qaradi; va beparvolik bilan pushti chipta ustiga kul qoqdi!

paras.en: With as much self-control as possible I asked, “If you still feel that way, why did you have me assigned to you? And why did you make me come here?”
paras.uz: Iloji boricha o'zimni tutib so'radim: «Agar hali ham shunday his qilsangiz, nega meni o'z nomingizga yozdirdingiz? Va nega meni bu yerga kelishga majbur qildingiz?»

paras.en: As if she had not heard at all, she poured some of the green liquid from the bottle into a small glass and sipped it.
paras.uz: Go'yo umuman eshitmagandek, u shishadan kichik qadahga yashil suyuqlikdan quydi va ho'pladi.

paras.en: “Wonderful liqueur! Want some?”
paras.uz: «Ajoyib liker! Xohlaysizmi?»

paras.en: Then I understood; alcohol! Like lightning there came to memory what I saw yesterday: the stony hand of the Well-Doer, the unbearable blade of the electric ray; there on the Cube, the head thrown backward, the stretched-out body! I shivered.
paras.uz: Shunda tushundim; alkogol! Chaqmoqdek kecha ko'rganlarim yodimga tushdi: Homiyning tosh qo'li, elektr nurining chidab bo'lmas tig'i; u yerda, Kub ustida, orqaga tashlangan bosh, cho'zilgan tana! Men titrab ketdim.

paras.en: “Please listen,” I said. “You know, do you not, that anyone who poisons himself with nicotine, more particularly with alcohol, is severely treated by the United State?”
paras.uz: «Iltimos, tinglang, — dedim men. — Bilasiz-ku, shunday emasmi, o'zini nikotin bilan, ayniqsa alkogol bilan zaharlagan har qanday odamga Yagona Davlat qattiq munosabatda bo'ladi?»

paras.en: Dark brows raised high to the temples, the sharp mocking triangle.
paras.uz: Chakkalarga qadar baland ko'tarilgan qora qoshlar, o'tkir masxaraomuz uchburchak.

paras.en: “ ‘It is more reasonable to annihilate a few than to allow many to poison themselves.⁠ ⁠… And degeneration,’⁠ ⁠… etc.⁠ ⁠… This is true to the point of indecency.”
paras.uz: «"Ko'pchilikning o'zini zaharlashiga yo'l qo'ygandan ko'ra, bir nechtasini yo'q qilish oqilonaroq... Va degeneratsiya"... va hokazo... Bu beodoblik darajasida to'g'ri».

paras.en: “Indecency?”
paras.uz: «Beodoblik?»

paras.en: “Yes. To let out into the street such a group of bald-headed naked little truths. Only imagine please. Imagine, say, that persistent admirer of mine, S-, well, you know him. Then imagine: if he should discard the deception of clothes and appear in public in his true form⁠ ⁠… oh!” She laughed. But I clearly saw her lower, sorrowful triangle; two deep grooves from the nose to the mouth. And for some reason these grooves made me think: that double-curved being, half-hunched, with winglike ears⁠—he embraced her? her, such⁠ ⁠… Oh!
paras.uz: «Ha. Ko'chaga bunday kal boshli yalang'och kichkina haqiqatlar to'dasini qo'yib yuborish. Faqat tasavvur qiling-a. Tasavvur qiling, aytaylik, o'sha qat'iyatli muxlisim S- ni, xo'sh, uni bilasiz. Keyin tasavvur qiling: agar u kiyimlar aldovini tashlab, jamoat oldida o'zining haqiqiy qiyofasida paydo bo'lsa... oh!» U kuldi. Lekin men uning pastki, qayg'uli uchburchagini — burundan og'izgacha ikki chuqur ariqchani aniq ko'rdim. Va negadir bu ariqchalar meni o'ylashga majbur qildi: o'sha ikki marta egilgan, yarim bukri, qanotdek quloqli mavjudot — u uni quchoqlagan? Uni, shunday... Oh!

paras.en: Naturally, I try now merely to express my abnormal feelings of that moment. Now, as I write, I understand perfectly that all this is as it should be; that he, S-4711, like any other honest Number has a perfect right to the joys of life and that it would be unjust.⁠ ⁠… But I think the point is quite clear.
paras.uz: Tabiiyki, men hozir o'sha lahzadagi g'ayritabiiy tuyg'ularimni ifodalashga urinyapman, xolos. Hozir, yozayotganimda, bularning hammasi shunday bo'lishi kerakligini mukammal tushunaman; u, S-4711, boshqa har qanday halol Raqam kabi hayot quvonchlariga to'liq haqli va bu adolatsizlik bo'lardi... Lekin menimcha, gap mutlaqo aniq.

paras.en: I-330 laughed a long, strange laugh. Then she cast a look at me, into me.
paras.uz: I-330 uzoq, g'alati kuldi. Keyin menga, ichimga nazar tashladi.

paras.en: “The most curious thing is that I am not in the least afraid of you. You are such a dear, I am sure of it! You would never think of going to the Bureau and reporting that I drink liqueurs and smoke. You will be sick or busy, or I don’t know what.⁠ ⁠… Furthermore, I am sure you will drink this charming poison with me.”
paras.uz: «Eng qizig'i shundaki, men sizdan zarracha ham qo'rqmayman. Siz shunday azizsiz, ishonchim komil! Siz hech qachon Idoraga borib, men liker ichib, chekishimni xabar qilishni xayolingizga ham keltirmaysiz. Siz kasal yoki band bo'lasiz, yoki nima bilmayman... Bundan tashqari, ishonchim komilki, siz bu maftunkor zaharni men bilan ichasiz».

paras.en: What an impertinent, mocking tone! I felt definitely that in a moment I should hate her. (Why in a moment? In fact I hated her all the time.)
paras.uz: Qanday surbet, masxaraomuz ohang! Bir lahzadan keyin undan nafratlanishimni aniq his qildim. (Nega bir lahzadan keyin? Aslida men undan butun vaqt nafratlanardim.)

paras.en: I-330 turned over the little glass of green poison straight into her mouth. Then she stood up, and all rosy through the translucent saffron-yellow tissue, she made a few steps and stopped behind my chair.⁠ ⁠… Suddenly her arms were about my neck⁠ ⁠… her lips grew into mine, no, even somewhere much deeper, much more terribly.⁠ ⁠… I swear all this was very unexpected for me. That is why perhaps⁠ ⁠… for I could not (at this moment I see clearly) I could not myself have the desire to.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: I-330 yashil zahar to'la kichkina qadahni to'g'ri og'ziga ag'dardi. Keyin o'rnidan turdi va shaffof za'faron-sariq mato orqali butunlay pushti tusda bir necha qadam qo'yib, kursim orqasida to'xtadi... To'satdan uning qo'llari bo'ynimda edi... uning lablari meniklarga o'sib kirdi, yo'q, hatto ancha chuqurroq, ancha dahshatliroq joyga... Qasamki, bularning hammasi men uchun juda kutilmagan edi. Shuning uchun, ehtimol... chunki men (shu lahzada aniq ko'ryapman) o'zim ...ni istashim mumkin emasdi...

paras.en: Unbearably sweet lips. (I suppose it was the taste of the liqueur.) It was as though burning poison were being poured into me, and more and more.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Chidab bo'lmas darajada shirin lablar. (O'ylaymanki, bu likerning ta'mi edi.) Go'yo ichimga yonayotgan zahar quyilayotgandek, tobora ko'proq...

paras.en: I tore away from the earth and began revolving as an independent planet⁠—down⁠—down⁠—following an uncalculable curve.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men yerdan uzilib, mustaqil sayyora sifatida aylana boshladim — pastga — pastga — hisoblab bo'lmas egri chiziq bo'ylab...

paras.en: What happened next I am able to describe only in an approximate way, only by way of more or less corresponding analogies.
paras.uz: Keyin nima bo'lganini faqat taxminiy, faqat ozmi-ko'pmi mos keladigan o'xshatishlar orqali tasvirlay olaman.

paras.en: It never occurred to me before but it is true: we who live on the earth, we are always walking over a seething red sea of fire which is hidden in the womb of the earth. We never think of it. But imagine the ground under our feet suddenly transformed into a thin glass shell; suddenly we should behold⁠ ⁠… !
paras.uz: Bu ilgari hech qachon xayolimga kelmagan, lekin bu haqiqat: biz yer yuzida yashaydiganlar doim yerning bag'rida yashiringan qaynab turgan qizil olov dengizi ustida yuramiz. Biz bu haqda hech qachon o'ylamaymiz. Lekin tasavvur qiling, oyoqlarimiz ostidagi yer to'satdan yupqa shisha qobiqqa aylandi; to'satdan biz ko'ramiz...!

paras.en: I became glass-like and saw within myself. There were two selves in me. One, the former D-503, Number D-503; and the other.⁠ ⁠… Before, that other used only to show his hairy paws from time to time, but now the whole other self left his shell. That shell was breaking, and in a moment.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men shishadek bo'lib, o'z ichimni ko'rdim. Menda ikkita men bor edi. Biri — avvalgi D-503, D-503 raqami; ikkinchisi esa... Ilgari o'sha ikkinchisi faqat vaqti-vaqti bilan tukli panjalarini ko'rsatib qo'yardi, endi esa butun ikkinchi men o'z qobig'ini tark etdi. O'sha qobiq sinayotgan edi va bir lahzadan keyin...

paras.en: Grasping with all my strength the last straw (the arms of the chair), I asked loudly (so as to hear my first self), “Where, where did you get this poison?”
paras.uz: Butun kuchim bilan oxirgi xas-cho'pga (kreslo suyanchiqlariga) yopishib, baland ovozda so'radim (birinchi o'zimni eshitish uchun): «Qayerdan, bu zaharni qayerdan oldingiz?»

paras.en: “Oh, this? A physician, one of my.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Oh, buni? Bir shifokor, mening ...laridan biri».

paras.en: “ ‘One of my! one of my’ what?” And my other self jumped up suddenly and yelled: “I won’t allow it! I want no one but me.⁠ ⁠… I shall kill anyone who.⁠ ⁠… Because I.⁠ ⁠… You.”⁠ ⁠… I saw my other self grasp her rudely with his hairy paws, tear the silk, and put his teeth in her flesh!⁠ ⁠… I remember exactly, his teeth!⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: «"Mening ...laridan biri! Mening ...laridan biri" nima?» Va ikkinchi men to'satdan sakrab turib, baqirdi: «Men yo'l qo'ymayman! Mendan boshqa hech kimni istamayman... Har kimni o'ldiraman... Chunki men... Siz...» Men ikkinchi o'zimning uni tukli panjalari bilan qo'pol ushlab olganini, ipakni yirtganini va tishlarini uning etiga botirganini ko'rdim!.. Aniq eslayman, tishlarini!..

paras.en: I do not remember how, but I-330 slipped away and I saw her straightened, her head raised high, her eyes overlain by that cursed impenetrable curtain. She stood leaning with her back against the closet door and listening to me.
paras.uz: Qanday qilib ekanini eslay olmayman, lekin I-330 sirg'alib chiqib ketdi va men uni qaddini rostlagan, boshini baland ko'targan, ko'zlarini o'sha la'nati o'tib bo'lmas parda qoplagan holda ko'rdim. U orqasini shkaf eshigiga suyab, meni tinglab turardi.

paras.en: I remember I was on the floor; I embraced her limbs, kissed her knees and cried supplicatingly, “At once, right away, right away.”
paras.uz: Esimda, men polda edim; uning oyoqlarini quchoqlab, tizzalarini o'pib, iltijo bilan yig'lardim: «Hozir, darhol, darhol».

paras.en: Sharp teeth.⁠ ⁠… The sharp mocking triangle of the brows.⁠ ⁠… She bent over and in silence unbuttoned my badge.
paras.uz: O'tkir tishlar... Qoshlarning o'tkir masxaraomuz uchburchagi... U engashib, jimgina nishonimni yechdi.

paras.en: “Yes, yes, dear⁠—dear.”
paras.uz: «Ha, ha, azizim — azizim».

paras.en: I began hastily to remove my unif. But I-330, silent as before, lifted my badge to my eyes, showing me the clock upon it. It was twenty-two-twenty-five.
paras.uz: Men shoshilib yunifamni yecha boshladim. Lekin I-330 avvalgidek jim, nishonimni ko'zlarimga ko'tarib, undagi soatni ko'rsatdi. Soat yigirma ikki yigirma besh edi.

paras.en: I became cold. I knew what it meant to be out in the street after twenty-two-thirty. My insanity disappeared at once. I was again I. I saw clearly one thing: I hated her, hated her, hated⁠—⁠ ⁠… Without saying goodbye, without looking back, I ran out of the room. Hurriedly trying to fasten the badge back in its place, I ran down the stairs (I was afraid lest someone notice me in the elevator), and jumped out into a deserted street.
paras.uz: Men sovuq qotdim. Yigirma ikki o'ttizdan keyin ko'chada bo'lish nimani anglatishini bilardim. Telbaligim darhol g'oyib bo'ldi. Men yana men edim. Bir narsani aniq ko'rdim: men undan nafratlanardim, nafratlanardim, nafrat-... Xayrlashmasdan, ortimga qaramasdan xonadan yugurib chiqdim. Nishonni shoshilib joyiga qadashga urinib, zinapoyadan yugurib tushdim (liftda kimdir meni payqab qolishidan qo'rqdim) va kimsasiz ko'chaga otilib chiqdim.

paras.en: Everything was in its place; life so simple, ordinary, orderly. Glittering glass houses, pale glass sky, a greenish, motionless night. But under that cool glass something wild, something red and hairy, was silently seething. I was gasping for breath but I continued to run, so as not to be late.
paras.uz: Hamma narsa o'z joyida edi; hayot shunchalik oddiy, odatiy, tartibli. Yaltiroq shisha uylar, oqish shisha osmon, yashilroq, qimirlamas tun. Lekin o'sha salqin shisha ostida qandaydir yovvoyi, qandaydir qizil va tukli narsa jimgina qaynab turardi. Nafasim tiqilardi, lekin kechikmaslik uchun yugurishda davom etdim.

paras.en: Suddenly I felt that my badge which I had hurriedly pinned on, was detaching itself; it came off and fell to the sidewalk. I bent over to pick it up and in the momentary silence I heard somebody’s steps. I turned. Someone small and hunched was disappearing around the corner. At least so it seemed. I started to run as fast as I could. The wind whistled in my ears. At the entrance of my house I stopped and looked at the clock; one minute to twenty-two-thirty! I listened; nobody behind. It was my foolish imagination, the effect of the poison.
paras.uz: To'satdan shoshilib qadagan nishonim ajralayotganini his qildim; u chiqib, yo'lkaga tushdi. Uni olish uchun engashdim va bir lahzalik sukunatda kimningdir qadam tovushlarini eshitdim. O'girildim. Kichkina va bukri kimdir burchakda g'oyib bo'layotgan edi. Hech bo'lmaganda menga shunday tuyuldi. Iloji boricha tez yugura boshladim. Quloqlarimda shamol hushtak chalardi. Uyimning kirish joyida to'xtab, soatga qaradim; yigirma ikki o'ttizga bir daqiqa! Quloq soldim; orqada hech kim yo'q. Bu mening ahmoqona tasavvurim, zaharning ta'siri edi.

paras.en: The night was full of torture. My bed seemed to lift itself under me, then to fall again, then up again! I used autosuggestion: “At night all the Numbers must sleep; sleeping at night is a duty just like working during the day. To sleep at night is necessary for the next day’s work. Not to sleep at night is criminal.” Yet I could not sleep⁠—I could not. I was perishing! I was unable to fulfill my duties to the United State! I.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Tun azob bilan to'la edi. Karavotim ostimda ko'tarilib, keyin yana tushib, keyin yana ko'tarilayotgandek tuyulardi! Men o'z-o'zimni ishontirishni qo'lladim: «Kechasi barcha Raqamlar uxlashi kerak; kechasi uxlash kunduzi ishlash kabi burch. Kechasi uxlash ertangi kun ishi uchun zarur. Kechasi uxlamaslik jinoyat». Shunga qaramay, uxlay olmadim — uxlay olmadim. Men halok bo'layotgan edim! Men Yagona Davlat oldidagi burchlarimni bajara olmasdim! Men...

quiz.q: What does I-330 drink?
quiz.why_uz: U yashil liker ichadi — bu Davlatda qat'iyan man etilgan.

quiz.q: Why does D-503 run home?
quiz.why_uz: 22:30 dan keyin ko'chada bo'lish man etilgan.

chapters.recap_uz: I-330 D-503 ni o'z nomiga yozdiradi. Uning xonasida liker ichib, chekadi va uni o'padi. D-503 ichida «ikkinchi men» uyg'onadi; u yigirma ikki o'ttizgacha zo'rg'a uyga yetib boradi.

chapters.title: No, I can’t; let it be without headings!

paras.en: Evening. It is somewhat foggy. The sky is covered with a milky-golden tissue, and one cannot see what is there, beyond, on the heights. The ancients “knew” that the greatest, bored skeptic⁠—their God, lived there. We know that crystalline, blue, naked, indecent Nothing is there. I do not know any more what is there. I have learned too many things of late. Knowledge, self-confident knowledge which is sure that it is faultless, is faith. I had firm faith in myself; I believed that I knew all about myself. But then.⁠ ⁠… I look in the mirror. And for the first time in my life, yes, for the first time in my life, I see clearly, precisely, consciously and with surprise, I see myself as some “him!” I am “he.” Frowning, black, straight brows; between them like a scar, there is a vertical wrinkle. (Was there that wrinkle before?) Steel gray eyes encircled by the shadow of a sleepless night. And behind that steel⁠ ⁠… I understand; I never before knew what there was behind that steel. From there (this “there” is at once so near and so infinitely distant!) I look at myself⁠—at “him.” And I know surely that “he” with his straight brows is a stranger, that I meet him here for the first time in my life. The real I is not he.
paras.uz: Kechqurun. Biroz tuman. Osmon sutdek-oltin mato bilan qoplangan va u yerda, narida, balandlikda nima borligini ko'rib bo'lmaydi. Qadimgilar u yerda eng buyuk, zerikkan skeptik — ularning Xudosi yashashini «bilishgan». Biz u yerda billur, moviy, yalang'och, beodob Hech Narsa borligini bilamiz. Men endi u yerda nima borligini bilmayman. So'nggi paytlarda haddan tashqari ko'p narsani bilib oldim. Bilim, o'ziga ishongan, beayb ekaniga ishongan bilim — bu iymon. Men o'zimga qat'iy ishonardim; o'zim haqimda hamma narsani bilaman deb ishonardim. Lekin keyin... Ko'zguga qarayman. Va umrimda birinchi marta, ha, umrimda birinchi marta men o'zimni aniq, ravshan, ongli ravishda va hayrat bilan qandaydir «u» sifatida ko'ryapman! Men «u»man. Qovoq solgan, qora, to'g'ri qoshlar; ular orasida chandiqdek tik ajin. (Bu ajin avval ham bormidi?) Uyqusiz tunning soyasi bilan o'ralgan po'latdek kulrang ko'zlar. O'sha po'lat ortida esa... Tushunaman; men ilgari hech qachon o'sha po'lat ortida nima borligini bilmaganman. U yerdan (bu «u yer» bir vaqtning o'zida shunchalik yaqin va shunchalik cheksiz uzoq!) men o'zimga — «u»ga qarayman. Va aniq bilamanki, to'g'ri qoshli «u» begona, men uni bu yerda umrimda birinchi marta uchratyapman. Haqiqiy men u emas.

paras.en: No. Period. All this is nonsense. And all these foolish emotions are only delirium, the result of last night’s poisoning.⁠ ⁠… Poisoning with what? With a sip of that green poison or with her? It matters little. I write all this merely in order to demonstrate how strangely the precise and sharp human reason may become confused. This reason, strong enough to make infinity which the ancients feared so much, understandable by means of.⁠ ⁠… The switch buzzes, “Number R-13.” Well, I am even glad; alone I should.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Yo'q. Nuqta. Bularning hammasi bema'nilik. Bu ahmoqona tuyg'ularning hammasi faqat alahlash, kechagi zaharlanishning natijasi... Nima bilan zaharlanish? O'sha yashil zahardan bir qultum bilanmi yoki u bilanmi? Farqi yo'q. Men bularning hammasini faqat aniq va o'tkir inson aqli qanchalik g'alati chalkashib ketishi mumkinligini ko'rsatish uchun yozyapman. Qadimgilar shunchalik qo'rqqan cheksizlikni tushunarli qila oladigan darajada kuchli bu aql... Kommutator g'uvillaydi: «R-13 raqami». Xo'sh, hatto xursandman; yolg'iz qolsam...

paras.en: Twenty minutes later:
paras.uz: Yigirma daqiqadan keyin:

paras.en: On the plane of this paper, in a world of two dimensions, these lines follow each other, but in another world they.⁠ ⁠… I am losing the sense for figures.⁠ ⁠… Twenty minutes! Perhaps two hundred or two hundred thousand!⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Bu qog'oz tekisligida, ikki o'lchamli dunyoda bu satrlar bir-birining ortidan keladi, lekin boshqa dunyoda ular... Men raqamlarni his qilishni yo'qotyapman... Yigirma daqiqa! Balki ikki yuz yoki ikki yuz ming!..

paras.en: It seems so strange, quietly, deliberately, measuring every word, to write down my adventure with R-. Imagine yourself sitting down at your own bed, crossing your legs, watching curiously how you yourself shrivel in the very same bed. My mental state is similar to that.
paras.uz: R- bilan sarguzashtimni sokin, o'ylab, har bir so'zni o'lchab yozish shunchalik g'alati tuyuladi. Tasavvur qiling, o'z karavotingiz yonida oyoqlaringizni chalishtirib o'tiribsiz va o'sha karavotda o'zingiz qanday burishib qolayotganingizni qiziqish bilan kuzatyapsiz. Mening ruhiy holatim shunga o'xshash.

paras.en: When R-13 came in I was perfectly quiet and normal. I began with sincere admiration to tell him how wonderfully he succeeded in versifying the death sentence of that insane man, and that his poem more than anything else had smothered and annihilated the transgressor of the law.
paras.uz: R-13 kirganda men mutlaqo xotirjam va normal edim. Men unga samimiy hayrat bilan o'sha telbaning o'lim hukmini qanchalik ajoyib she'rga solganini va uning dostoni hamma narsadan ko'proq qonunbuzarni ezib, yo'q qilganini aytib bera boshladim.

paras.en: “More than that,” I said, “if I were ordered to prepare a mathematical draught of the Machine of the Well-Doer, I should undoubtedly⁠—undoubtedly, put on that draught some of your verses!”⁠—Suddenly I saw R-’s eyes becoming more and more opaque, his lips acquiring a gray tint.
paras.uz: «Bundan ham ko'proq, — dedim men, — agar menga Homiy Mashinasining matematik chizmasini tayyorlashni buyurishsa, men shubhasiz — shubhasiz o'sha chizmaga sening she'rlaringdan ba'zilarini qo'ygan bo'lardim!» — To'satdan R- ning ko'zlari tobora xiralashib, lablari kulrang tus olayotganini ko'rdim.

paras.en: “What is the matter?”
paras.uz: «Nima bo'ldi?»

paras.en: “What?⁠—Well.⁠ ⁠… Merely that I am dead sick of it; everybody keeps on: ‘the death-sentence, the death-sentence!’ I want to hear no more of it! You understand? I do not want.⁠ ⁠…” He became serious, rubbing his neck⁠—that little valise filled with luggage which I cannot understand. A silence. There! He found something in that little valise of his, removed it, unwrapped it, spread it out; his eyes became covered with the varnish of laughter. He began:
paras.uz: «Nima? — Xo'sh... Shunchaki bundan o'lgudek bezor bo'ldim; hamma takrorlayveradi: "o'lim hukmi, o'lim hukmi!" Boshqa bu haqda eshitishni istamayman! Tushunyapsanmi? Istamayman...» U jiddiylashdi, ensasini — men tushuna olmaydigan yuk bilan to'ldirilgan o'sha kichkina chamadonni ishqaladi. Sukut. Mana! U kichkina chamadonida nimadir topdi, uni chiqardi, o'ramini ochdi, yoydi; ko'zlarini kulgi laki qopladi. U boshladi:

paras.en: “I am writing something for your Integral. Yes.⁠ ⁠… I am!” He was himself again; bubbling, sprinkling lips; words splashing like a fountain.
paras.uz: «Men sening Integraling uchun nimadir yozyapman. Ha... yozyapman!» U yana o'ziga qaytdi; ko'piklanayotgan, sachrayotgan lablar; favvoradek sachrayotgan so'zlar.

paras.en: “You see, it is the ancient legend of paradise.” (p like a fountain.) “That legend referred to us of today, did it not? Yes. Only think of it, think of it a moment! There were two in paradise and the choice was offered to them: happiness without freedom, or freedom without happiness. No other choice. Tertium non datur. They, fools that they were, chose freedom. Naturally, they longed for centuries afterwards for fetters, for the fetters of yore. This was the meaning of their world-weariness, Weltschmerz. For centuries! And only we found a way to regain happiness.⁠ ⁠… No, listen, follow me! The ancient god and we, side by side at the same table! Yes, we helped god definitely and finally to defeat the devil. It was he, the devil, who lead people to transgression, to taste pernicious freedom, he the cunning serpent? And we came along, planted a boot on his head and⁠ ⁠… squash! Done with him! Paradise again! We returned to the simple-mindedness and innocence of Adam and Eve. No more meddling with good and evil and all that; everything is simple again, heavenly, childishly simple! The Well-Doer, The Machine, The Cube, the giant Gas Bell, The Guardians⁠—all these are good. All this is magnificent, beautiful, noble, lofty, crystalline, pure. For all this preserves our non-freedom, that is, our happiness. In our place those ancients would indulge in discussions, deliberations, etc. They would break their heads trying to make out what was moral or unmoral. But we.⁠ ⁠… Well, in short, these are the highlights of my little paradise poem. What do you think of it? And above all the style is most solemn, pious. Understand me? Nice little idea, is it not? Do you understand?”
paras.uz: «Bilasanmi, bu jannat haqidagi qadimiy afsona». («p» favvoradek.) «O'sha afsona bugungi bizga taalluqli edi, shunday emasmi? Ha. Faqat o'ylab ko'r, bir lahza o'ylab ko'r! Jannatda ikkitasi bor edi va ularga tanlov taklif qilindi: erkinliksiz baxt yoki baxtsiz erkinlik. Boshqa tanlov yo'q. Tertium non datur. Ular, ahmoqlar, erkinlikni tanlashdi. Tabiiyki, ular keyin asrlar davomida kishanlarni, qadimgi kishanlarni sog'inishdi. Ularning dunyo g'ussasi, Weltschmerz'ining ma'nosi shu edi. Asrlar davomida! Faqat biz baxtni qaytarish yo'lini topdik... Yo'q, tingla, menga ergash! Qadimgi xudo va biz, bir stolda yonma-yon! Ha, biz xudoga iblisni aniq va butunlay yengishga yordam berdik. Odamlarni gunohga, zararli erkinlikni tatib ko'rishga undagan u, iblis, makkor ilon edi-ku? Biz esa kelib, uning boshiga etik qo'ydik va... chirt! U bilan ish tamom! Yana jannat! Biz Odam Ato va Momo Havoning soddaligi va beg'uborligiga qaytdik. Endi yaxshilik va yomonlik va shunga o'xshash narsalarga aralashish yo'q; hamma narsa yana oddiy, jannatdek, bolalarcha oddiy! Homiy, Mashina, Kub, ulkan Gaz Qo'ng'irog'i, Qo'riqchilar — bularning hammasi yaxshi. Bularning hammasi ulug'vor, go'zal, olijanob, yuksak, billur, pok. Chunki bularning hammasi bizning erksizligimizni, ya'ni baxtimizni saqlaydi. Bizning o'rnimizda o'sha qadimgilar munozaralar, mulohazalar va hokazolarga berilgan bo'lardi. Ular nima axloqiy, nima axloqsiz ekanini aniqlashga urinib, boshlarini qotirishardi. Biz esa... Xo'sh, qisqasi, bu mening kichkina jannat dostonimning asosiy nuqtalari. Bu haqda nima deb o'ylaysan? Eng muhimi, uslub eng tantanali, taqvodor. Tushunyapsanmi? Yoqimli kichkina g'oya, shunday emasmi? Tushunyapsanmi?»

paras.en: Of course I understood. I remember my thoughts at that moment: “his appearance is nonsensical and lacking in symmetry, yet what an orderly-working mind he has!” This made him dear to me, that is to the real me. (I still insist that I of before is the real one; my I of late is, certainly, only an illness.)
paras.uz: Albatta, tushundim. O'sha lahzadagi fikrlarimni eslayman: «uning tashqi ko'rinishi bema'ni va simmetriyasiz, lekin qanday tartibli ishlaydigan aqli bor!» Bu uni menga, ya'ni haqiqiy menga aziz qildi. (Men hali ham avvalgi men haqiqiysi deb turib olaman; so'nggi paytdagi men, albatta, faqat kasallik.)

paras.en: Apparently R- read my thought in my face; he put his hand on my shoulders and laughed: “Oh you!⁠ ⁠… Adam! By the way, about Eve.⁠ ⁠…” He searched for something in his pockets, took out a little book, turned over a few leaves and said, “For the day-after-tomorrow⁠—oh, no, two days from now⁠—O-90 has a pink check on you. How about it?⁠ ⁠… As before?⁠ ⁠… You want her to?”
paras.uz: Aftidan, R- fikrimni yuzimdan o'qidi; qo'lini yelkamga qo'yib, kuldi: «Oh, sen!.. Odam Ato! Aytgancha, Momo Havo haqida...» U cho'ntaklarida nimadir qidirdi, kichkina daftarcha chiqardi, bir necha varaqni ag'darib dedi: «Indinga — yo'q, ikki kundan keyin — O-90 ning senga pushti chiptasi bor. Bunga nima deysan?.. Avvalgidekmi?.. Uning kelishini xohlaysanmi?»

paras.en: “Of course, of course!”
paras.uz: «Albatta, albatta!»

paras.en: “All right then, I’ll tell her. You see she herself is very bashful.⁠ ⁠… What a funny story! You see, for me she has only a pink-check affection, but for you!⁠ ⁠… And you, you did not even come to tell us how a fourth member sneaked into our triangle! Who is it? Repent, sinner! Come on!”
paras.uz: «Unday bo'lsa, xo'p, unga aytaman. Bilasanmi, uning o'zi juda uyatchan... Qanday kulgili hikoya! Bilasanmi, menga u faqat pushti chipta mehriga ega, senga esa!.. Sen esa uchburchagimizga to'rtinchi a'zo qanday sirg'alib kirganini aytib berish uchun kelmading ham! Kim u? Tavba qil, gunohkor! Qani!»

paras.en: A curtain rose inside me; rustle of silk, green bottle, lips.⁠ ⁠… Without any reason whatever I exclaimed (oh, why didn’t I restrain myself at that moment?), “Tell me, R-, did you ever have the opportunity to try nicotine or alcohol?”
paras.uz: Ichimda parda ko'tarildi; ipak shitirlashi, yashil shisha, lablar... Hech qanday sababsiz xitob qildim (oh, nega o'sha lahzada o'zimni tiymadim?): «Ayt-chi, R-, senga hech nikotin yoki alkogolni tatib ko'rish imkoniyati bo'lganmi?»

paras.en: R- sucked in his lips, looked at me from under his brows. I distinctly heard his thoughts: “Friend though he is, yet.⁠ ⁠…” And he answered:
paras.uz: R- lablarini so'rib, qoshlari ostidan menga qaradi. Men uning fikrlarini aniq eshitdim: «Do'st bo'lsa ham, baribir...» Va u javob berdi:

paras.en: “What shall I say? Strictly speaking, no. But I know a woman.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Nima deyin? Aslini olganda, yo'q. Lekin men bir ayolni bilaman...»

paras.en: “I-330?” I cried.
paras.uz: «I-330 nimi?» — qichqirdim men.

paras.en: “What! You? You too?” R- was full of laughter; he chuckled, ready to splash over.
paras.uz: «Nima! Sen? Sen ham?» R- kulgiga to'lib ketdi; u kuldi, to'lib-toshishga tayyor edi.

paras.en: My mirror was hanging in such a way that in order to see R- clearly I had to turn and look across the table. From my armchair I could see now only my own forehead and eyebrows. Then I, the real I, suddenly saw in the mirror a broken, quivering line of brow; I, the real I, heard suddenly a wild disgusting cry: “What? What does that ‘also’ mean? What does that ‘also’ mean? I demand.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Mening ko'zgum shunday osilgan ediki, R- ni aniq ko'rish uchun stol osha o'girilib qarashim kerak edi. Kreslomdan endi faqat o'z peshonamni va qoshlarimni ko'ra olardim. Keyin men, haqiqiy men, to'satdan ko'zguda qoshning singan, titrayotgan chizig'ini ko'rdim; men, haqiqiy men, to'satdan yovvoyi, jirkanch qichqiriqni eshitdim: «Nima? Bu "ham" nimani anglatadi? Bu "ham" nimani anglatadi? Talab qilaman...»

paras.en: Widely parted negro lips.⁠ ⁠… Eyes bulging. I (the real I) grasped my other wild, hairy, heavily breathing self forcibly. I (the real I) said to him, to R-, “In the name of the Well-Doer, please forgive me. I am very sick; I don’t sleep; I do not know what is the matter with me.”
paras.uz: Keng ochilgan negr lablari... Bo'rtib chiqqan ko'zlar. Men (haqiqiy men) o'zimning boshqa yovvoyi, tukli, og'ir nafas olayotgan o'zimni kuch bilan ushlab oldim. Men (haqiqiy men) unga, R- ga dedim: «Homiy nomi bilan, iltimos, meni kechir. Men juda kasalman; uxlamayman; menga nima bo'layotganini bilmayman».

paras.en: A swiftly passing smile appeared on the thick lips.
paras.uz: Qalin lablarda tez o'tib ketadigan tabassum paydo bo'ldi.

paras.en: “Yes, yes, I understand, I understand. I am familiar with all this, theoretically, of course. Goodbye.”
paras.uz: «Ha, ha, tushunaman, tushunaman. Bularning hammasi menga tanish, nazariy jihatdan, albatta. Xayr».

paras.en: At the door he turned around like a little black ball, came back to the table and put a book upon it. “This is my latest book. I came to bring it to you. Almost forgot. Goodbye.” (b like a splash.) The little ball rolled out.
paras.uz: Eshik oldida u kichkina qora to'pdek o'girildi, stolga qaytib keldi va uning ustiga bir kitob qo'ydi. «Bu mening oxirgi kitobim. Uni senga olib kelgandim. Deyarli unutibman. Xayr». («x» sachrab.) Kichkina to'p dumalab chiqib ketdi.

paras.en: I am alone. Or, to be more exact, I am tête-à-tête with that other self. I sit in the armchair and having crossed my legs, I watch curiously from some indefinite “there,” how I (myself) am shrivelling in my bed!
paras.uz: Men yolg'izman. Aniqrog'i, o'sha ikkinchi o'zim bilan yuzma-yuzman. Kreslomda o'tirib, oyoqlarimni chalishtirib, qandaydir noaniq «u yer»dan qiziqish bilan men (o'zim) karavotimda qanday burishib qolayotganimni kuzatyapman!

paras.en: Why, oh, why is it, that for three years R-, O-, and I were so friendly together and now suddenly⁠—one word only about that other female, about I-330, and.⁠ ⁠… Is it possible that that insanity called love and jealousy does exist not only in the idiotic books of the ancients? What seems most strange is that I, I!⁠ ⁠… Equations, formulae, figures, and suddenly this! I can’t understand it, I can’t! Tomorrow I shall go to R- and tell him.⁠ ⁠… No, it isn’t true; I shall not go; neither tomorrow nor day after tomorrow, nor ever.⁠ ⁠… I can’t, I do not want to see him. This is the end. Our triangle is broken up.
paras.uz: Nega, oh, nega uch yil davomida R-, O- va men shunchalik do'st edik va endi to'satdan — o'sha boshqa ayol, I-330 haqida faqat bir so'z va... Nahotki sevgi va rashk deb ataladigan o'sha telbalik faqat qadimgilarning ahmoqona kitoblarida emas, haqiqatda ham mavjud? Eng g'alatisi shundaki, men, men!.. Tenglamalar, formulalar, raqamlar va to'satdan bu! Tushuna olmayman, tushuna olmayman! Ertaga R- ning oldiga borib, unga aytaman... Yo'q, bu rost emas; bormayman; na ertaga, na indinga, na hech qachon... Bora olmayman, uni ko'rishni istamayman. Bu oxiri. Uchburchagimiz buzildi.

paras.en: I am alone. It is evening. There is a light fog. The sky is covered by a thin milky-golden tissue. If I only knew what is there⁠—higher. If I only knew who I am. Which I am I?
paras.uz: Men yolg'izman. Kechqurun. Yengil tuman. Osmon yupqa sutdek-oltin mato bilan qoplangan. Qaniydi u yerda — yuqorida nima borligini bilsam. Qaniydi kim ekanimni bilsam. Men qaysi menman?

gloss.ex: …edge, self-confident knowledge which is sure that it is faultless, is faith. I had firm faith in myself; I believed that I knew all about myself. But then.⁠ ⁠……
“You see, it is the ancient legend of paradise.” (p like a fountain.) “That legend referred to us of today, did it not? Yes. Onl…
…two in paradise and the choice was offered to them: happiness without freedom, or freedom without happiness. No other choice. Tertium non datur. They, fools tha…
…oment! There were two in paradise and the choice was offered to them: happiness without freedom, or freedom without happiness. No other choice. Tertium non datu…
…out I-330, and.⁠ ⁠… Is it possible that that insanity called love and jealousy does exist not only in the idiotic books of the ancients? What seems most strange…

quiz.q: What choice was offered in paradise, according to R-13?
o: Happiness without freedom or freedom without happiness
quiz.why_uz: Odam Ato va Momo Havo erkinlikni tanlagan, biz esa baxtni qaytardik — deydi R-13.

quiz.q: Why does D-503 shout at R-13?
quiz.why_uz: R-13 ning «sen ham?» degani D-503 da rashk uyg'otadi.

chapters.recap_uz: D-503 ko'zguda o'zini begona «u» sifatida ko'radi. R-13 jannat haqidagi dostonini so'zlab beradi; I-330 haqida gap chiqqach, D-503 rashkdan baqirib yuboradi va uchburchak buziladi deb o'ylaydi.

chapters.title: The delimitation of the infinite — Angel — Meditations on poetry
chapters.title_uz: Cheksizlikni chegaralash — Farishta — She'riyat haqidagi o'ylar

paras.en: I continue to believe that I shall recover, that I may recover. I slept very well. No dreams or any other symptoms of disease. Dear O-90 will come tomorrow. Everything will again be simple, regular and limited like a circle. I am not afraid of this word “limited.” The work of the highest faculty of man, judgment, is always directed toward the constant limiting of the infinite, toward the breaking up of the infinite into comfortably digestible portions⁠—differentials. This is what gives divine beauty to my element, mathematics. And it is exactly this beauty that that other female lacks. But this last thought of mine is only an accidental mental association.
paras.uz: Men tuzalaman, tuzalishim mumkin, deb ishonishda davom etaman. Juda yaxshi uxladim. Na tushlar, na kasallikning boshqa alomatlari. Aziz O-90 ertaga keladi. Hamma narsa yana aylanadek oddiy, muntazam va chegaralangan bo'ladi. Men bu «chegaralangan» so'zidan qo'rqmayman. Insonning eng oliy qobiliyati — aql-idrokning ishi doimo cheksizlikni chegaralashga, cheksizlikni hazm qilish oson bo'laklarga — differensiallarga bo'lishga qaratilgan. Mening sohamga — matematikaga ilohiy go'zallikni beradigan narsa ham shu. Va aynan shu go'zallik o'sha boshqa ayolda yetishmaydi. Lekin bu oxirgi fikrim shunchaki tasodifiy fikriy bog'lanish.

paras.en: These thoughts swarmed in my mind while I was listening to the regular, rhythmic sounds of the underground railway. Silently I followed the rhythm of its wheels and recited to myself R-’s verses (from the book which he gave me yesterday), and I felt that behind me someone was leaning over my shoulder and looking at the open pages. I did not turn around but with the corner of my eye I noticed pink ears, spread like wings, the double-curved⁠ ⁠… like the letter.⁠ ⁠… It was he, but I did not want to disturb him. I feigned not to have noticed him. How he came in, I do not know. I did not see him when I got into the car.
paras.uz: Yer osti temir yo'lining muntazam, ritmik tovushlarini tinglab ketayotganimda shu fikrlar xayolimda g'uj-g'uj aylanardi. Jimgina g'ildiraklar ritmiga ergashib, ichimda R- ning she'rlarini (kecha menga bergan kitobidan) o'qirdim va orqamda kimdir yelkam osha egilib, ochiq sahifalarga qarayotganini his qildim. Men o'girilmadim, lekin ko'zimning qiri bilan qanotdek yoyilgan pushti quloqlarni, ikki marta egilgan... harfga o'xshash... narsani payqadim. Bu u edi, lekin men uni bezovta qilishni istamadim. Uni sezmagandek bo'ldim. U qanday kirganini bilmayman. Vagonga chiqqanimda uni ko'rmagandim.

paras.en: This incident, insignificant in itself, had an especially good effect upon me; it invigorated me, I should say. It is pleasant to feel that somebody’s penetrating eye is watching you from behind your shoulder, lovingly guarding you from making the most minute mistake, from the most minute incorrect step. It may seem to you too sentimental but I see in all this the materialization of the dream of the ancients about a Guardian-Angel. How many things about which the ancients had only dreams, are materialized in our life!
paras.uz: O'z-o'zidan arzimas bu voqea menga ayniqsa yaxshi ta'sir qildi; aytishim mumkinki, meni tetiklashtirdi. Kimningdir o'tkir ko'zi yelkangiz ortidan sizni kuzatib, sizni eng kichik xatodan, eng kichik noto'g'ri qadamdan mehr bilan qo'riqlayotganini his qilish yoqimli. Bu sizga haddan tashqari sentimental tuyulishi mumkin, lekin men bularning hammasida qadimgilarning Farishta-Qo'riqchi haqidagi orzusining moddiylashganini ko'raman. Qadimgilar faqat orzu qilgan qancha narsa bizning hayotimizda moddiylashgan!

paras.en: At the moment when I became aware of the presence of the Guardian-Angel behind me I was enjoying a poem entitled “Happiness.” I think I am not mistaken when I say that it is a piece of rare beauty and depth of thought. Here are the first four lines:
paras.uz: Orqamda Farishta-Qo'riqchi borligini anglagan lahzada men «Baxt» deb nomlangan she'rdan zavqlanayotgandim. Menimcha, uni noyob go'zallik va fikr chuqurligiga ega asar desam, adashmayman. Mana birinchi to'rt satri:

paras.en:
“Two times two⁠—eternal lovers;
Inseparable in passion four⁠ ⁠…
Most flaming lovers in the world,
Eternally welded, two times two.”
paras.uz:
«Ikki karra ikki — abadiy oshiqlar;
Ehtirosda ajralmas to'rt...
Dunyodagi eng otashin oshiqlar,
Abadiy payvandlangan ikki karra ikki».

paras.en: And the rest is in the same vein: on the wisdom and the eternal happiness of the multiplication table. Every poet is inevitably a Columbus. America existed before Columbus for ages, but only Columbus found it. The multiplication table existed before R-13 for ages, but only R-13 could find in the virginal forest of figures a new Eldorado. Is it not true? Is there any happiness more wise and cloudless in this wonderful world? Steel may rust. The ancient god created the ancient man, i.e., the man capable of mistakes, ergo the ancient god himself made a mistake. The multiplication table is more wise and more absolute than the ancient god, for the multiplication table never (do you understand⁠—never) makes mistakes! There are no more fortunate and happy people than those who live according to the correct, eternal laws of the multiplication table. No hesitation! No errors! There is but one truth, and there is but one path to it; and that truth is: four, and that path is: two times two. Would it not seem preposterous for these happily multiplied twos suddenly to begin thinking of some foolish kind of freedom? i.e. (is it not clear?) of a mistake? It seems undeniable, axiomatic, that R-13 knows how to grasp the most fundamental, the most.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Qolgani ham shu ruhda: karra jadvalining donoligi va abadiy baxti haqida. Har bir shoir muqarrar ravishda Kolumbdir. Amerika Kolumbdan oldin asrlar davomida mavjud edi, lekin uni faqat Kolumb topdi. Karra jadvali R-13 dan oldin asrlar davomida mavjud edi, lekin raqamlarning bokira o'rmonida yangi Eldoradoni faqat R-13 topa oldi. Shunday emasmi? Bu ajoyib dunyoda bundan donoroq va bulutsizroq baxt bormi? Po'lat zanglashi mumkin. Qadimgi xudo qadimgi odamni, ya'ni xato qila oladigan odamni yaratdi, demak, qadimgi xudoning o'zi xato qildi. Karra jadvali qadimgi xudodan donoroq va mutlaqroq, chunki karra jadvali hech qachon (tushunyapsizmi — hech qachon) xato qilmaydi! Karra jadvalining to'g'ri, abadiy qonunlari bo'yicha yashaydigan odamlardan ko'ra omadliroq va baxtliroq odamlar yo'q. Ikkilanish yo'q! Xatolar yo'q! Haqiqat faqat bitta va unga olib boradigan yo'l ham faqat bitta; o'sha haqiqat — to'rt, o'sha yo'l esa — ikki karra ikki. Baxtli ko'paytirilgan bu ikkiliklar to'satdan qandaydir ahmoqona erkinlik, ya'ni (aniq emasmi?) xato haqida o'ylay boshlasa, bema'ni tuyulmasmidi? R-13 eng asosiy, eng... narsani ushlay bilishi shubhasiz, aksiomatik ko'rinadi...

paras.en: At that moment again I felt (first near the back of my head, then on my left ear) the warm, tender breath of the Guardian-Angel. He apparently noticed that the book on my lap had long been closed and that my thoughts were somewhere very far.⁠ ⁠… Well, I am ready this minute to spread before him the pages of my brain. This gives one such a feeling of tranquility and joy. I remember I even turned around and gazed long and questioningly into his eyes; but either he did not understand, or he did not want to understand me. He did not ask me anything.⁠ ⁠… The only thing left for me is to relate everything to you, my unknown readers. You are to me now as dear and as near and as far out of reach as he was at that moment.
paras.uz: O'sha lahzada yana (avval ensam yonida, keyin chap qulog'imda) Farishta-Qo'riqchining iliq, mayin nafasini his qildim. Aftidan, u tizzamdagi kitob allaqachon yopilganini va fikrlarim allaqayerda juda uzoqda ekanini payqadi... Xo'sh, men shu daqiqaning o'zida uning oldiga miyamning sahifalarini yoyishga tayyorman. Bu odamga shunday xotirjamlik va quvonch hissini beradi. Esimda, hatto o'girilib, uning ko'zlariga uzoq va savolomuz tikildim; lekin u yo tushunmadi, yo meni tushunishni istamadi. U mendan hech narsa so'ramadi... Menga qolgan yagona narsa — hammasini sizga, noma'lum o'quvchilarim, so'zlab berish. Siz endi men uchun o'sha lahzada u qanday bo'lsa, shunday aziz, yaqin va yetib bo'lmas uzoqsiz.

paras.en: This was my way of thinking: from the part to the whole⁠—R-13 is the part; the whole is our Institution of State Poets and Authors. I thought: how was it that the ancients did not notice the utter absurdity of their prose and poetry? The gigantic, magnificent power of the artistic word was spent by them in vain. It is really droll; anybody wrote whatever happened to come into his head! It was as foolish as the fact that in the days of the ancients the ocean blindly splashed at the shore for twenty-four hours without interruption or use. The millions of kilogram-meters of energy which were hidden in the waves were used only for the stimulation of sweethearts! We obtained electricity from the amorous whisper of the waves! We made a domestic animal out of that sparkling, foaming, rabid one! And in the same manner we domesticated and harnessed the wild element of poetry. Now poetry is no longer the unpardonable whistling of nightingales but a State Service! Poetry is a commodity.
paras.uz: Mening fikrlash yo'lim shunday edi: qismdan butunga — R-13 qism; butun esa bizning Davlat Shoirlari va Yozuvchilari Institutimiz. Men o'yladim: qanday qilib qadimgilar o'z nasri va nazmining mutlaq bema'niligini payqamagan? Badiiy so'zning ulkan, ulug'vor kuchi ular tomonidan behuda sarflangan. Bu chindan ham kulgili; har kim xayoliga nima kelsa, shuni yozgan! Bu qadimgilar zamonida okean qirg'oqqa yigirma to'rt soat to'xtovsiz va foydasiz ko'r-ko'rona urilib turgani kabi ahmoqona edi. To'lqinlarda yashiringan millionlab kilogramm-metr energiya faqat oshiq-ma'shuqlarni hayajonlantirish uchun ishlatilgan! Biz to'lqinlarning oshiqona shivirlashidan elektr oldik! O'sha uchqunlanib, ko'piklanib, quturgan narsani uy hayvoniga aylantirdik! Xuddi shu tarzda biz she'riyatning yovvoyi unsurini ham qo'lga o'rgatib, jilovladik. Endi she'riyat bulbullarning kechirib bo'lmas chah-chahi emas, balki Davlat Xizmati! She'riyat — tovar.

paras.en: Our famous “Mathematical Norms”! Without them in our schools, how could we love so sincerely and dearly our four rules of arithmetic? And “Thorns!” This is a classical image: the Guardians are thorns about a rose; thorns that guard our tender State-Flower from coarse hands. Whose heart could resist, could remain indifferent to see and hear the lips of our children recite like a prayer: “A bad boy caught the rose with his hand but the thorn of steel pricked him like a needle; the bad boy cried and ran home,” etc., etc. And the “Daily Odes to the Well-Doer!” Who, having read them, will not bow piously before the unselfish service of that Number of all Numbers? And the dreadful red “Flowers of Court Sentences!” And the immortal tragedy, “Those Who Come Late to Work!” And the popular book, “Stanzas on Sex-Hygiene!”
paras.uz: Bizning mashhur «Matematik Normalar»imiz! Ularsiz maktablarimizda arifmetikaning to'rt amalini qanday qilib shunchalik samimiy va qadrlab sevardik? Va «Tikanlar»! Bu klassik obraz: Qo'riqchilar — atirgul atrofidagi tikanlar; nozik Davlat-Gulimizni qo'pol qo'llardan qo'riqlaydigan tikanlar. Bolalarimiz lablari duodek: «Yomon bola atirgulni qo'li bilan ushladi, lekin po'lat tikan uni ignadek sanchdi; yomon bola yig'lab uyiga qochdi» va hokazo, va hokazolarni o'qiyotganini ko'rib, eshitib kimning yuragi bardosh bera olardi, befarq qola olardi? Va «Homiyga kundalik qasidalar»! Ularni o'qigan kim barcha Raqamlarning Raqamining fidokorona xizmati oldida ixlos bilan bosh egmaydi? Va qo'rqinchli qizil «Sud hukmlari gullari»! Va o'lmas tragediya — «Ishga kechikib keluvchilar»! Va ommabop kitob — «Jinsiy gigiyena haqida bandlar»!

paras.en: Our whole life in all its complexity and beauty is thus stamped forever in the gold of words. Our poets do not soar any longer in the unknown; they have descended to earth and they march with us, keeping step to the accompaniment of our austere and mechanical March of the musical State Tower. Their lyre is the morning rubbing-sound of the electric toothbrushes, and the threatening crack of the electric sparks coming from the Machine of the Well-Doer, and the magnificent echo of the Hymn of the United State, and the intimate ringing of the crystalline, shining washbasins, and the stimulating rustle of the falling curtains, and the joyous voices of the newest cookbooks, and the almost imperceptible whisper of the street membranes.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Butun hayotimiz o'zining butun murakkabligi va go'zalligi bilan shu tariqa abadiy so'zlarning oltiniga muhrlangan. Shoirlarimiz endi noma'lumlikda parvoz qilmaydi; ular yerga tushib, Musiqa Minorasining qat'iy, mexanik Marshi sadosi ostida biz bilan bir qadamda yurishadi. Ularning lirasi — elektr tish cho'tkalarining ertalabki ishqalanish ovozi, Homiy Mashinasidan chiqayotgan elektr uchqunlarining dahshatli chirsillashi, Yagona Davlat Madhiyasining ulug'vor aks-sadosi, billur, yaltiroq qo'l yuvgichlarning samimiy jaranglashi, tushayotgan pardalarning hayajonli shitirlashi, eng yangi oshpazlik kitoblarining quvnoq ovozlari va ko'cha membranalarining deyarli sezilmas shivirlashi...

paras.en: Our gods are here, below. They are with us in the Bureau, in the kitchen, in the shops, in the restrooms. The gods have become like us, ergo we have become like gods. And we shall come to you, my unknown readers on another planet, we shall come to you to make your life as godlike, as rational and as correct as ours.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Bizning xudolarimiz shu yerda, pastda. Ular biz bilan Idorada, oshxonada, ustaxonalarda, hojatxonalarda. Xudolar bizga o'xshab qoldi, demak, biz xudolarga o'xshab qoldik. Va biz sizning oldingizga, boshqa sayyoradagi noma'lum o'quvchilarim, sizning hayotingizni biznikidek ilohiy, aqlli va to'g'ri qilish uchun kelamiz...
