quiz.why_uz: She'r ikki karra ikki = to'rt haqida — abadiy, xatosiz baxt.

quiz.q: How does D-503 feel about being watched by S-4711?
quiz.why_uz: U kuzatuvni mehribon himoya deb his qiladi.

chapters.recap_uz: D-503 o'zini tuzalgandek his qiladi. Poyezdda orqasida S-4711 ni «Farishta-Qo'riqchi» deb biladi va R-13 ning karra jadvali haqidagi she'ridan zavqlanadi. U Davlat she'riyatini madh etadi.

chapters.title: Fog — Thou — A decidedly absurd adventure

paras.en: I awoke at dawn. The rose-colored firmament looked into my eyes. Everything was beautiful, round. “O-90 is to come tonight. Surely I am healthy again.” I smiled and fell asleep. The Morning Bell! I got up; everything looked different. Through the glass of the ceiling, through the walls, nothing could be seen but fog⁠—fog everywhere, strange clouds, becoming heavier and nearer; the boundary between earth and sky disappeared. Everything seemed to be floating and thawing and falling.⁠ ⁠… Not a thing to hold to. No houses to be seen; they all were dissolved in the fog like crystals of salt in water. On the sidewalks and inside the houses dark figures like suspended particles in a strange milky solution, were hanging, below, above⁠—up to the tenth floor. Everything seemed to be covered with smoke, as though a fire were somewhere raging noiselessly.
paras.uz: Tong saharda uyg'ondim. Pushti osmon ko'zlarimga tikilib turardi. Hamma narsa go'zal, dumaloq edi. «O-90 bugun kechqurun keladi. Aniqki, men yana sog'lomman». Jilmayib, yana uxlab qoldim. Ertalabki Qo'ng'iroq! Turdim; hamma narsa boshqacha ko'rinardi. Ship shishasi, devorlar orqali tumandan boshqa hech narsa ko'rinmasdi — hamma yoqda tuman, g'alati bulutlar, tobora og'irlashib, yaqinlashib kelardi; yer bilan osmon orasidagi chegara yo'qoldi. Hamma narsa suzib, erib, tushayotgandek tuyulardi... Ushlab turadigan biror narsa yo'q. Uylar ko'rinmaydi; ularning hammasi tumanda tuz kristallari suvda erigandek erib ketgan. Trotuarlarda va uylar ichida qora qiyofalar g'alati sutsimon eritmadagi muallaq zarrachalardek osilib turardi — pastda, yuqorida, o'ninchi qavatgacha. Go'yo qayerdadir yong'in shovqinsiz avj olayotgandek, hamma narsa tutun bilan qoplangandek edi.

paras.en: At eleven-forty-five exactly (I looked at the clock particularly at that time to catch the figures, to save at least the figures) at eleven-forty-five, just before leaving, according to our Table of Hours, to go and occupy myself with physical labor, I dropped into my room for a moment. Suddenly the telephone rang. A voice⁠—a long needle slowly penetrating my heart:
paras.uz: Aynan o'n bir qirq beshda (men raqamlarni ushlab qolish, hech bo'lmasa raqamlarni saqlab qolish uchun aynan o'sha paytda soatga qaradim), o'n bir qirq beshda, Soatlar Jadvalimizga ko'ra jismoniy mehnat bilan shug'ullanishga ketishdan sal oldin, bir lahzaga xonamga kirdim. To'satdan telefon jiringladi. Ovoz — yuragimga sekin kirib borayotgan uzun igna:

paras.en: “Oh, you are at home? I am very glad! Wait for me at the corner. We shall go together.⁠ ⁠… Where? Well, you’ll see.”
paras.uz: «Oh, siz uydamisiz? Juda xursandman! Meni muyulishda kuting. Birga boramiz... Qayerga? Xo'sh, ko'rasiz».

paras.en: “You know perfectly well that I am going to work now.”
paras.uz: «Siz men hozir ishga ketayotganimni juda yaxshi bilasiz».

paras.en: “You know perfectly well that you’ll do as I say! Au revoir. In two minutes!⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Siz men aytgandek qilishingizni juda yaxshi bilasiz! Au revoir. Ikki daqiqadan keyin!..»

paras.en: I stood at the corner. I had to wait to try to make clear to her that only the United State directs me, not she. “You’ll do as I say!” How sure she is! One hears it in her voice. And what if⁠ ⁠… ?
paras.uz: Men muyulishda turdim. Unga meni u emas, faqat Yagona Davlat boshqarishini tushuntirishga urinish uchun kutishim kerak edi. «Men aytgandek qilasiz!» Qanchalik ishonchi komil! Buni uning ovozidan eshitish mumkin. Agar... bo'lsa-chi?

paras.en: Unifs, dull gray as if woven of damp fog would appear for a second at my side and then soundlessly redissolve. I was unable to turn my eyes away from the clock.⁠ ⁠… I seemed myself to have become that sharp, quivering hand which marked the seconds. Ten, eight minutes⁠ ⁠… three⁠ ⁠… two minutes to twelve.⁠ ⁠… Of course! I was late! Oh, how I hated her, yet I had to wait to prove that I.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Go'yo nam tumandan to'qilgandek xira kulrang yunifalar bir soniyaga yonimda paydo bo'lib, keyin yana tovushsiz erib ketardi. Ko'zlarimni soatdan uza olmasdim... Go'yo o'zim soniyalarni belgilaydigan o'sha o'tkir, titroq milga aylangandek edim. O'n, sakkiz daqiqa... uch... o'n ikkiga ikki daqiqa... Albatta! Men kechikdim! Oh, men undan qanchalik nafratlandim, lekin baribir men... ekanimni isbotlash uchun kutishim kerak edi...

paras.en: A red line in the milky whiteness of the fog⁠—like blood, like a wound made by a sharp knife⁠—her lips.
paras.uz: Tumanning sutdek oqligida qizil chiziq — qondek, o'tkir pichoq qoldirgan yaradek — uning lablari.

paras.en: “I made you wait, I think? And now you are late for your work anyway?”
paras.uz: «Menimcha, sizni kuttirib qo'ydim-a? Endi baribir ishga kechikdingizmi?»

paras.en: “How⁠ ⁠… ? Well, yes, it is too late now.”
paras.uz: «Qanday...? Xo'sh, ha, endi juda kech».

paras.en: I glanced at her lips in silence. All women are lips, lips only. Some are rosy lips, tense and round, a ring, a tender fence separating one from the world. But these! A second ago they were not here, and suddenly⁠ ⁠… the slash of a knife! I seemed to see even the dripping sweet blood.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men jimgina uning lablariga qaradim. Barcha ayollar — lablar, faqat lablar. Ba'zilari pushti lablar, taranglashgan va dumaloq, halqa, odamni dunyodan ajratib turuvchi nozik devor. Lekin bular! Bir soniya oldin ular bu yerda yo'q edi va to'satdan... pichoq tig'ining tilishi! Go'yo hatto tomayotgan shirin qonni ham ko'rgandek bo'ldim...

paras.en: She came nearer. She leaned gently against my shoulder; we became one. Something streamed from her into me. I felt, I knew, it should be so. Every fibre of my nervous system told me this, every hair on my head, every painfully sweet heartbeat. And what a joy it was to submit to what should be. A fragment of iron-ore probably feels the same joy of submission to precise, inevitable law, when it clings to a loadstone. The same joy is in a stone which thrown aloft, hesitates a little at the height of its flight and then rushes down to the ground. It is the same with a man when in his final convulsion he takes a last deep breath and dies.
paras.uz: U yaqinroq keldi. Yelkamga muloyimgina suyandi; biz bir bo'lib qoldik. Undan menga nimadir oqib o'tdi. His qildim, bildim, shunday bo'lishi kerak. Asab tizimimning har bir tolasi, boshimdagi har bir soch tolasi, har bir og'riqli-shirin yurak urishi menga shuni aytardi. Va bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan narsaga bo'ysunish qanday quvonch edi! Temir rudasining bir bo'lagi magnitga yopishganda aniq, muqarrar qonunga bo'ysunishdan xuddi shunday quvonchni his qilsa kerak. Yuqoriga otilgan tosh parvozining eng baland nuqtasida biroz ikkilanib, keyin yerga otilganda ham xuddi shu quvonch bor. Inson oxirgi titroqda so'nggi chuqur nafasini olib, o'lganda ham xuddi shunday.

paras.en: I remember I smiled vaguely and said for no reason at all, “Fog⁠ ⁠… very.”
paras.uz: Esimda, men noaniq jilmayib, hech qanday sababsiz: «Tuman... juda», dedim.

paras.en: “Thou lovest fog, dost thou?”
paras.uz: «Sen tumanni sevasanmi?»

paras.en: This ancient, long-forgotten thou⁠—the thou of a master to his slave⁠—penetrated me slowly, sharply.⁠ ⁠… Yes, I was a slave.⁠ ⁠… This too was inevitable, was good.
paras.uz: Bu qadimiy, allaqachon unutilgan «sen» — xo'jayinning quliga aytadigan «sen»i — menga sekin, o'tkir kirib bordi... Ha, men qul edim... Bu ham muqarrar, yaxshi edi.

paras.en: “Yes, good⁠ ⁠…” I said aloud to myself, and then to her, “I hate fog. I am afraid of fog.”
paras.uz: «Ha, yaxshi...» — dedim ovoz chiqarib o'zimga, keyin unga: «Men tumandan nafratlanaman. Tumandan qo'rqaman».

paras.en: “Then you love it. For if you fear it because it is stronger than you, hate it because you fear it, you love it. For you cannot subject it to yourself. One loves only the things one cannot conquer.”
paras.uz: «Unda siz uni sevasiz. Chunki agar u sizdan kuchliroq bo'lgani uchun undan qo'rqsangiz, qo'rqqaningiz uchun undan nafratlansangiz, demak, uni sevasiz. Chunki uni o'zingizga bo'ysundira olmaysiz. Odam faqat yenga olmaydigan narsalarnigina sevadi».

paras.en: “Yes, that is so. That is why⁠ ⁠… that is precisely why I.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Ha, shunday. Shuning uchun... aynan shuning uchun men...»

paras.en: We were walking⁠—as one. Somewhere beyond the fog the sun was singing in a faint tone, gradually swelling, filling the air with tension and with pearl and gold and rose and red.⁠ ⁠… The whole world seemed to be one unembraceable woman, and we who were in her body were not yet born; we were ripening in joy. It was clear to me, absolutely clear, that everything existed only for me: the sun, the fog, the gold⁠—for me. I did not ask where we were going; what did it matter? It was pleasure to walk, to ripen, to become stronger and more tense.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Biz yurardik — bir butun bo'lib. Qayerdadir tuman ortida quyosh zaif ohangda kuylardi, asta-sekin kuchayib, havoni taranglik, marvarid, oltin, pushti va qizil rang bilan to'ldirardi... Butun dunyo go'yo quchoqlab bo'lmas bitta ayoldek edi, uning tanasidagi biz esa hali tug'ilmagan edik; biz quvonch ichida yetilardik. Menga aniq, mutlaqo aniq ediki, hamma narsa faqat men uchun mavjud: quyosh, tuman, oltin — men uchun. Qayerga ketayotganimizni so'ramadim; buning nima ahamiyati bor edi? Yurish, yetilish, kuchliroq va tarangroq bo'lish rohat edi...

paras.en: “Here⁠ ⁠…” I-330 stopped at a door. “It so happens that today there is someone on duty who⁠ ⁠… I told you about him in the Ancient House.”
paras.uz: «Mana bu yerda...» I-330 bir eshik oldida to'xtadi. «Shunday bo'ldiki, bugun navbatchilikda shunday odam bor... Qadimiy Uyda sizga u haqda aytgandim».

paras.en: Carefully guarding the forces ripening within me, I read the sign: “Medical Bureau.” Automatically only I understood.
paras.uz: Ichimda yetilayotgan kuchlarni ehtiyotkorlik bilan asrab, lavhani o'qidim: «Tibbiyot Byurosi». Faqat avtomatik tarzda tushundim.

paras.en: … A glass room, filled with golden fog; shelves of glass, colored bottles, jars, electric wires, bluish sparks in tubes; and a male Number⁠—a very thinly flattened man. He might have been cut out of a sheet of paper. Wherever he was, whichever way he turned, he showed only a profile, a sharply pointed, glittering blade of a nose and lips like scissors.
paras.uz: ...Oltin tuman bilan to'lgan shisha xona; shisha javonlar, rangli shishalar, bankalar, elektr simlari, naychalarda moviy uchqunlar; va bir erkak Raqam — juda yupqa yassilangan odam. Uni qog'oz varag'idan qirqib olish mumkin edi. U qayerda bo'lmasin, qaysi tomonga o'girilmasin, faqat profilini — o'tkir uchli, yaltiroq burun tig'ini va qaychidek lablarini ko'rsatardi.

paras.en: I could not hear what I-330 told him; I merely saw her lips when she was talking; and I felt that I was smiling, irrepressibly, blissfully. The scissors-like lips glittered and the doctor said, “Yes, yes, I see. A most dangerous disease. I know of nothing more dangerous.” And he laughed. With his thin, flat, papery hand he wrote something on a piece of paper and gave it to I-330; he wrote on another piece of paper and handed it over to me. He had given us certificates, testifying that we were ill, that we were unable to go to work. Thus I stole my work from the United State; I was a thief; I deserved to be put beneath the Machine of the Well-Doer. Yet I was indifferent to this thought; it was as distant from me as though it were written in a novel. I took the certificate without an instant’s hesitation. I, all my being, my eyes, my lips, my hands⁠ ⁠… knew it was as it should be.
paras.uz: I-330 unga nima deganini eshita olmadim; faqat u gapirayotganda lablarini ko'rdim; va o'zimni to'xtatib bo'lmas darajada, saodat bilan jilmayayotganimni his qildim. Qaychidek lablar yaltiradi va shifokor dedi: «Ha, ha, tushunaman. Eng xavfli kasallik. Bundan xavfliroq narsani bilmayman». Va u kuldi. Yupqa, yassi, qog'ozdek qo'li bilan bir varaq qog'ozga nimadir yozib, I-330 ga berdi; boshqa varaqqa ham yozib, menga uzatdi. U bizga kasal ekanimiz, ishga bora olmasligimiz haqida guvohnoma bergan edi. Shunday qilib, men o'z ishimni Yagona Davlatdan o'g'irladim; men o'g'ri edim; Homiy Mashinasi ostiga qo'yilishga loyiq edim. Lekin bu fikrga befarq edim; u menga go'yo romanda yozilgandek uzoq edi. Guvohnomani bir lahza ham ikkilanmay oldim. Men, butun vujudim, ko'zlarim, lablarim, qo'llarim... bu shunday bo'lishi kerakligini bilardi.

paras.en: At the corner, from a half empty garage we took an aero. I-330 took the wheel as she had done before, pressed the starter and we tore away from the earth. We soared. Behind us the golden haze; the Sun. The thin, blade-like profile of the doctor seemed to me suddenly so dear, so beloved. Formerly I knew everything was revolving around the Sun. Now I knew everything was revolving around me. Slowly, blissfully, with half-closed eyes.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Muyulishda, yarim bo'sh garajdan aero oldik. I-330 avvalgidek rulni oldi, starterni bosdi va biz yerdan uzilib ketdik. Biz parvoz qildik. Orqamizda oltin tuman; Quyosh. Shifokorning yupqa, tig'dek profili menga to'satdan shunchalik aziz, shunchalik sevimli tuyuldi. Ilgari men hamma narsa Quyosh atrofida aylanishini bilardim. Endi hamma narsa mening atrofimda aylanishini bilardim. Sekin, saodat bilan, ko'zlarni yarim yumib...

paras.en: At the gate of the Ancient House we found the same old woman. What a dear mouth, with lips grown together and ray-like wrinkles around it! Probably those lips have remained grown together all these days; but now they parted and smiled:
paras.uz: Qadimiy Uy darvozasida o'sha kampirni uchratdik. Qanday aziz og'iz, bitishib ketgan lablar va atrofida nursimon ajinlar! Ehtimol, o'sha lablar shu kunlar davomida bitishganicha qolgandir; lekin endi ular ochilib, jilmaydi:

paras.en: “Ah! you mischievous girl, you! Work is too much for you? Well, all right, all right. If anything happens I’ll run up and warn you.”
paras.uz: «Voy, sho'x qiz-ey! Ish senga og'irlik qilyaptimi? Xo'p, mayli, mayli. Biror narsa bo'lsa, yugurib chiqib ogohlantiraman».

paras.en: A heavy, squeaky, opaque door. It closed behind us, and at once my heart opened painfully, widely, still wider.⁠ ⁠… My lips⁠ ⁠… hers.⁠ ⁠… I drank and drank from them. I tore myself away; in silence I looked into her widely open eyes, and then again.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Og'ir, g'ichirlaydigan, shaffof bo'lmagan eshik. U orqamizdan yopildi va shu zahoti yuragim og'riq bilan, keng, yana ham kengroq ochildi... Mening lablarim... uning lablari... Men ulardan ichdim va ichdim. O'zimni uzib oldim; jimgina uning keng ochilgan ko'zlariga qaradim, keyin yana...

paras.en: The room in half dusk.⁠ ⁠… Blue and saffron-yellow lights, dark green morocco leather, the golden smile of Buddha, a wide mahogany bed, a glimmer of mirrors.⁠ ⁠… And my dream of a few days before became so comprehensible, so clear to me; everything seemed saturated with the golden prime-juice of life, and it seemed that I was overflowing with it⁠—one second more and it would splash out.⁠ ⁠… Like iron-ore to a loadstone, in sweet submission to the precise and unchangeable law, inevitably, I clung to her.⁠ ⁠… There was no pink check, no counting, no United State; I myself was no more. Only, drawn together, the tenderly-sharp teeth were there, only her golden, widely open eyes, and through them I saw deeper, within.⁠ ⁠… And silence.⁠ ⁠… Only somewhere in a corner, thousands of miles away it seemed, drops of water were dripping from the faucet of the washstand. I was the Universe!
paras.uz: Xona yarim qorong'ilikda... Moviy va za'faron-sariq chiroqlar, to'q yashil saxtiyon teri, Buddaning oltin tabassumi, keng qizil daraxt karavot, ko'zgularning yiltirashi... Va bir necha kun oldingi tushim menga shunchalik tushunarli, shunchalik ravshan bo'lib qoldi; hamma narsa hayotning oltin dastlabki sharbatiga to'yingandek tuyulardi va go'yo men undan to'lib-toshayotgandek edim — yana bir soniya va u sachrab chiqadi... Magnitga temir rudasidek, aniq va o'zgarmas qonunga shirin bo'ysunib, muqarrar ravishda unga yopishdim... Na pushti chipta, na hisob-kitob, na Yagona Davlat bor edi; men o'zim ham yo'q edim. Faqat yaqinlashgan nozik-o'tkir tishlar, faqat uning oltin, keng ochilgan ko'zlari bor edi va ular orqali men chuqurroqqa, ichkariga qarardim... Va sukunat... Faqat qayerdadir burchakda, go'yo minglab chaqirim narida, qo'l yuvgich jo'mragidan suv tomchilari tomardi. Men Koinot edim!

paras.en: … And between drops whole epochs, eras, were elapsing.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: ...Va tomchilar orasida butun davrlar, asrlar o'tib ketardi...

paras.en: I put on my unif and bent over I-330 to draw her into me with my eyes⁠—for the last time.
paras.uz: Yunifamni kiyib, I-330 ustiga egildim — uni ko'zlarim bilan ichimga tortish uchun — oxirgi marta.

paras.en: “I knew it.⁠ ⁠… I knew you,” said I-330 in a very low voice. She passed her hand over her face as though brushing something away; then she arose brusquely, put on her unif and her usual sharp, bite-like smile.
paras.uz: «Men buni bilardim... Men sizni bilardim», — dedi I-330 juda past ovozda. U go'yo nimanidir supurib tashlayotgandek, qo'lini yuzidan o'tkazdi; keyin keskin o'rnidan turib, yunifasini va odatdagi o'tkir, tishlaydigan tabassumini kiydi.

paras.en: “Well, my fallen angel⁠ ⁠… you perished just now, do you know that? No? You are not afraid? Well, au revoir. You shall go home alone. Well?”
paras.uz: «Xo'sh, mening qulagan farishtam... siz hozirgina halok bo'ldingiz, bilasizmi? Yo'qmi? Qo'rqmaysizmi? Xo'p, au revoir. Uyga yolg'iz ketasiz. Xo'sh?»

paras.en: She opened the mirror-door of the cupboard and looking at me over her shoulder, she waited. I left the room obediently. Yet no sooner had I left the room than I felt it was urgent that she touch me with her shoulder⁠—only for one second with her shoulder, nothing more. I ran back into the room, where (I presumed) she was standing before the mirror, busy buttoning up her unif; I rushed in and stopped abruptly. I saw (I remember it clearly), I saw the key in the keyhole of the closet and the ancient ring upon it was still swinging but I-330 was not there. She could not have left the room as there was but one exit.⁠ ⁠… Yet I-330 was not there! I looked around everywhere. I even opened the cupboard and felt of the different ancient dresses; nobody.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U javonning ko'zguli eshigini ochdi va yelkasi osha menga qarab, kutdi. Men itoatkorona xonadan chiqdim. Lekin xonadan chiqishim bilan uning yelkasi menga tegishi — faqat bir soniya yelkasi bilan, boshqa hech narsa — zarurligini his qildim. Men xonaga, u (taxminimcha) ko'zgu oldida yunifasining tugmalarini qadab turgan joyga yugurib qaytdim; ichkariga otilib kirdim-u, keskin to'xtadim. Ko'rdim (buni aniq eslayman), shkaf qulfidagi kalitni ko'rdim va undagi qadimiy halqa hali ham tebranib turardi, lekin I-330 yo'q edi. U xonadan chiqib keta olmasdi, chunki faqat bitta chiqish bor edi... Lekin I-330 yo'q edi! Hamma yoqqa qaradim. Hatto javonni ochib, turli qadimiy liboslarni paypaslab ko'rdim; hech kim...

paras.en: I feel somewhat ridiculous, my dear planetary readers, relating to you this most improbable adventure. But what else can I do since it all happened exactly as I relate it? Was not the whole day from early morning, full of improbable adventures? Does it not all resemble the ancient disease of dream-seeing? If this be so, what does it matter if I relate one absurdity more, or one less? Moreover, I am convinced that sooner or later I shall be able to include all these absurdities in some kind of a logical sequence. This thought comforts me as I hope it will comfort you.
paras.uz: Aziz sayyoraviy o'quvchilarim, sizga bu eng aql bovar qilmas sarguzashtni so'zlab berayotib, o'zimni biroz kulgili his qilyapman. Lekin hammasi men aytayotgandek aynan sodir bo'lgan bo'lsa, yana nima ham qila olaman? Erta tongdan boshlab butun kun aql bovar qilmas sarguzashtlarga to'la emasmidi? Bularning hammasi qadimiy tush ko'rish kasalligiga o'xshamaydimi? Agar shunday bo'lsa, bitta bema'nilikni ko'proq yoki kamroq aytib berishimning nima farqi bor? Bundan tashqari, ertami-kechmi bu bema'niliklarning hammasini qandaydir mantiqiy ketma-ketlikka kiritishga muvaffaq bo'lishimga aminman. Bu fikr menga taskin beradi, umid qilamanki, sizga ham taskin beradi.

paras.en: … How overwhelmed I am! If only you knew how overwhelmed!
paras.uz: ...Qanchalik to'lib-toshganman! Qaniydi qanchalik to'lib-toshganimni bilsangiz!
