quiz.q: Why does D-503 miss work?
o: I-330 gets them false medical certificates
quiz.why_uz: Ozg'in shifokor ikkalasiga kasallik guvohnomasi yozib beradi.

quiz.q: What happens at the end of the chapter?
quiz.why_uz: Xonadan bitta chiqish bor, lekin I-330 g'oyib bo'ladi.

chapters.recap_uz: Tumanli kunda I-330 D-503 ni ishga bormaslikka undaydi. Shifokordan soxta kasallik guvohnomasi olishadi va Qadimiy Uyda birga bo'lishadi. Keyin I-330 javonda sirli g'oyib bo'ladi.

chapters.title: “Mine” — Impossible — A cold floor

paras.en: I shall continue to relate my adventures of yesterday. I was busy during the personal hour before retiring to bed, and thus I was unable to record everything last night. But everything is graven in me; especially, for some reason, and apparently forever, I shall remember that unbearably cold floor.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Kechagi sarguzashtlarimni so'zlab berishda davom etaman. Yotishdan oldingi shaxsiy soatda band edim, shuning uchun kecha hammasini yozib ulgurmadim. Lekin hammasi menda muhrlanib qolgan; ayniqsa, negadir va aftidan abadiy, o'sha chidab bo'lmas darajada sovuq polni eslab qolaman...

paras.en: I was expecting O-90 last evening as it was her regular day. I went downstairs to the controller on duty to get a permit for the lowering of my curtains.
paras.uz: Kecha kechqurun O-90 ni kutayotgandim, chunki bu uning navbatdagi kuni edi. Pardalarimni tushirishga ruxsat olish uchun pastga, navbatchi nazoratchining oldiga tushdim.

paras.en: “What is the matter with you?” asked the controller. “You seem so peculiar tonight.”
paras.uz: «Sizga nima bo'ldi? — so'radi nazoratchi. — Bugun kechqurun juda g'alati ko'rinyapsiz».

paras.en: “I⁠ ⁠… I am sick.”
paras.uz: «Men... men kasalman».

paras.en: Strictly speaking, I told her the truth. I certainly am sick. All this is an illness. Presently I remembered; of course, my certificate! I touched it in my pocket. Yes, there it was, rustling. Then all this did happen! It did actually happen!
paras.uz: Aslini olganda, men unga rostini aytdim. Men albatta kasalman. Bularning hammasi kasallik. Shu zahoti esimga tushdi; albatta, guvohnomam! Cho'ntagimda uni paypaslab ko'rdim. Ha, mana u, shitirlab turibdi. Demak, bularning hammasi sodir bo'lgan! Haqiqatan ham sodir bo'lgan!

paras.en: I held out the paper to the controller. As I did so, I felt the blood rushing to my cheeks. Without looking directly at her, I noticed with what an expression of surprise she gazed at me.
paras.uz: Qog'ozni nazoratchiga uzatdim. Shunday qilayotib, yonoqlarimga qon yugurganini his qildim. Unga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qaramay, u menga qanday hayrat bilan tikilganini payqadim.

paras.en: Then at twenty-one-thirty o’clock.⁠ ⁠… In the room to the left the curtains were lowered, and in the room to the right my neighbor was sitting over a book. His head is bald and covered with bulging lumps. His forehead is enormous⁠—a yellow parabola. I was walking up and down the room⁠—suffering. How could I meet her, after all that happened! O-90, I mean. I felt plainly to my right, how the eyes of my neighbor were staring at me. I clearly saw the wrinkles on his forehead like a row of yellow, illegible lines; and for some reason I was certain that those lines dealt with me.
paras.uz: Keyin yigirma bir o'ttizda... Chap tomondagi xonada pardalar tushirilgan, o'ng tomondagi xonada qo'shnim kitob ustida o'tirardi. Uning boshi taqir va bo'rtiq do'mboqlar bilan qoplangan. Peshonasi ulkan — sariq parabola. Men xonada u yoqdan bu yoqqa yurardim — azob chekib. Bo'lib o'tgan shuncha narsadan keyin uni qanday kutib olaman! O-90 ni demoqchiman. O'ng tomonimda qo'shnimning ko'zlari menga qanday tikilib turganini aniq his qildim. Uning peshonasidagi ajinlarni bir qator sariq, o'qib bo'lmas satrlardek aniq ko'rdim; va negadir o'sha satrlar men haqimda ekaniga amin edim.

paras.en: A quarter of an hour before twenty-two, the cheerful, rosy whirlwind was in my room; the firm ring of her rosy arms closed about my neck. Then I felt how that ring grew weaker and weaker, and then it broke and her arms dropped.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Yigirma ikkiga chorak qolganda xonamda quvnoq, pushti quyun paydo bo'ldi; uning pushti qo'llarining mustahkam halqasi bo'ynimga o'ralib yopildi. Keyin o'sha halqa tobora zaiflashib borayotganini his qildim, so'ng u uzildi va qo'llari tushib ketdi...

paras.en: “You are not the same, not the same man! You are no longer mine!”
paras.uz: «Siz o'sha emassiz, o'sha odam emassiz! Siz endi meniki emassiz!»

paras.en: “What curious terminology: ‘mine.’ I never belonged⁠—” I faltered. It suddenly occurred to me: true, I belonged to no one before, but now⁠—Is it not clear that now I do not live any more in our rational world but in the ancient delirious world, in a world of square-root of minus one?
paras.uz: «Qanday qiziq atama: "meniki". Men hech qachon hech kimga tegishli...» — gapim bo'g'zimda qoldi. To'satdan xayolimga keldi: to'g'ri, men ilgari hech kimga tegishli emas edim, lekin endi — Endi men bizning aqlli dunyomizda emas, balki qadimiy alahsirash dunyosida, minus birning kvadrat ildizi dunyosida yashayotganim aniq emasmi?

paras.en: The curtains fell. There to my right my neighbor let his book drop at that moment from the table to the floor. And through the last narrow space between the curtain and the floor I saw a yellow hand pick up the book. Within I felt: “Only to seize that hand with all my power.”
paras.uz: Pardalar tushdi. O'sha yerda, o'ng tomonda qo'shnim o'sha lahzada kitobini stoldan polga tushirib yubordi. Parda bilan pol orasidagi oxirgi tor oraliqdan sariq qo'l kitobni ko'targanini ko'rdim. Ichimda his qildim: «Faqat o'sha qo'lni butun kuchim bilan ushlab olsam».

paras.en: “I thought⁠ ⁠… I wanted to meet you during the hour for the walk. I wanted⁠ ⁠… I must talk to you about so many things, so many.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Men o'ylagandim... sizni sayr soatida uchratmoqchi edim. Men... siz bilan juda ko'p narsalar haqida, juda ko'p narsalar haqida gaplashishim kerak...»

paras.en: Poor, dear, O-90. Her rosy mouth was a crescent with its horns downward. But I could not tell her everything, could I, if for no other reason than that it would make her an accomplice of my crimes? I knew that she would not have the courage to report me to the Bureau of Guardians, consequently.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Bechora, aziz O-90. Uning pushti og'zi shoxlari pastga qaragan yarim oy edi. Lekin men unga hamma narsani aytib bera olmasdim-ku, boshqa sabab bo'lmasa ham, bu uni jinoyatlarimga sherik qilib qo'yardi-ku? Bilardimki, u meni Qo'riqchilar Idorasiga xabar berishga jur'at etmaydi, demak...

paras.en: “My dear O-, I am sick, I am exhausted. I went again today to the Medical Bureau; but it is nothing, it will pass. But let us not talk about it;⁠—let us forget it.”
paras.uz: «Azizim O-, men kasalman, holdan toyganman. Bugun yana Tibbiyot Byurosiga bordim; lekin bu hech narsa emas, o'tib ketadi. Lekin bu haqda gaplashmaylik; — unutaylik».

paras.en: O-90 was lying down. I kissed her gently. I kissed that childish, fluffy fold at her wrist. Her blue eyes were closed. The pink crescent of her lips was slowly blooming, more and more like a flower. I kissed her.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: O-90 yotgan edi. Men uni muloyimgina o'pdim. Bilagidagi o'sha bolalarcha, momiqdek burmani o'pdim. Uning moviy ko'zlari yumuq edi. Lablarining pushti yarim oyi sekin-asta, tobora ko'proq gulga o'xshab ochilardi. Men uni o'pdim...

paras.en: Suddenly I clearly realized how empty I was, how I had given away.⁠ ⁠… No, I could not⁠—impossible! I knew I must⁠ ⁠… but no⁠—impossible! I ought⁠ ⁠… but no⁠—impossible! My lips cooled at once. The rosy crescent trembled, darkened, drew together. O-90 covered herself with the bedspread, her face hidden in the pillow.
paras.uz: To'satdan qanchalik bo'm-bo'sh ekanimni, qanchalik berib qo'yganimni aniq angladim... Yo'q, qila olmasdim — imkonsiz! Bilardim, kerak... lekin yo'q — imkonsiz! Men kerak edi... lekin yo'q — imkonsiz! Lablarim shu zahoti sovib qoldi. Pushti yarim oy titrab, qoraydi, qisildi. O-90 choyshabga o'ranib, yuzini yostiqqa yashirdi.

paras.en: I was sitting near the bed, on the floor. What a desperately cold floor! I sat there in silence. The terrible cold from the floor rose higher and higher. There in the blue, silent space among the planets, there probably it is as cold.
paras.uz: Men karavot yonida, polda o'tirardim. Qanday umidsiz darajada sovuq pol! Men u yerda jimgina o'tirdim. Poldan dahshatli sovuq tobora yuqoriga ko'tarilardi. U yerda, sayyoralar orasidagi moviy, sokin fazoda, ehtimol, xuddi shunday sovuqdir.

paras.en: “Please understand, dear; I did not mean⁠ ⁠…” I muttered, “With all my heart, I⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Iltimos, tushun, azizim; men demoqchi emasdim... — g'o'ldiradim men. — Butun qalbim bilan men...»

paras.en: It was the truth. I, my real self did not mean.⁠—⁠ ⁠… Yet how could I express it in words? How could I explain to her that the piece of iron did not want to.⁠ ⁠… But that the law is precise, inevitable!
paras.uz: Bu rost edi. Men, haqiqiy men demoqchi emasdim... Lekin buni qanday so'z bilan ifodalay olardim? Unga temir bo'lagi istamaganini... lekin qonun aniq, muqarrar ekanini qanday tushuntira olardim!

paras.en: O-90 lifted her face from the pillow and without opening her eyes she said, “Go away.” But because she was crying she pronounced it “Oo aaa-ay.” For some reason this absurd detail will not leave my memory.
paras.uz: O-90 yuzini yostiqdan ko'tardi va ko'zlarini ochmay: «Keting», dedi. Lekin u yig'layotgani uchun buni «Ke-e-ti-i-ng» deb aytdi. Negadir bu bema'ni tafsilot xotiramdan ketmaydi.

paras.en: Penetrated by the cold and torpid, I went out into the hall. I pressed my forehead against the cold glass. Outside a thin, almost imperceptible film of haze was spread. “Towards night,” I thought, “it will descend again and drown the world. How sad a night it will be!”
paras.uz: Sovuq butun vujudimga singib, karaxt holda yo'lakka chiqdim. Peshonamni sovuq shishaga bosdim. Tashqarida yupqa, deyarli sezilmas tuman pardasi yoyilgan edi. «Tunga yaqin, — o'yladim men, — u yana tushib, dunyoni g'arq qiladi. Qanday g'amgin tun bo'ladi!»

paras.en: O-90 passed swiftly by, going toward the elevator. The door slammed.
paras.uz: O-90 liftga qarab tezgina o'tib ketdi. Eshik qarsillab yopildi.

paras.en: “Wait a minute!” I screamed. I was frightened.
paras.uz: «Bir daqiqa to'xtang!» — qichqirdim men. Qo'rqib ketdim.

paras.en: But the elevator was already groaning, going down⁠—down⁠—down.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Lekin lift allaqachon ingrab, pastga — pastga — pastga tushib borardi...

paras.en: “She robbed me of R-, she robbed me of O-90, yet, yet⁠ ⁠… nevertheless.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «U mendan R- ni tortib oldi, O-90 ni tortib oldi, lekin, lekin... baribir...»

gloss.ex: …O-90 last evening as it was her regular day. I went downstairs to the controller on duty to get a permit for the lowering of my curtains.
Poor, dear, O-90. Her rosy mouth was a crescent with its horns downward. But I could not tell her everything, could I, if for no…
…thing, could I, if for no other reason than that it would make her an accomplice of my crimes? I knew that she would not have the courage to report me to the Bu…
…realized how empty I was, how I had given away.⁠ ⁠… No, I could not⁠—impossible! I knew I must⁠ ⁠… but no⁠—impossible! I ought⁠ ⁠… but no⁠—impossible! My lips…
O-90 passed swiftly by, going toward the elevator. The door slammed.

quiz.q: What does O-90 say when she arrives?
quiz.why_uz: U D-503 o'zgarganini darhol sezadi.

quiz.q: What does D-503 remember most from that night?
quiz.why_uz: Bo'lim nomida ham «sovuq pol» bor.

chapters.recap_uz: O-90 keladi, lekin D-503 endi uni seva olmaydi. U sovuq polda o'tirib qoladi, O-90 yig'lab ketadi. D-503 «uchburchak» buzilganini his qiladi.

chapters.title: The bell — The mirror-like sea — I am to burn eternally
chapters.title_uz: Qo'ng'iroq — Ko'zgudek dengiz — Men abadiy yonaman

paras.en: I was walking upon the dock where the Integral is being built, when the Second Builder came to meet me. His face as usual was round and white⁠—a porcelain plate. When he speaks it seems as though he serves you a plate of something unbearably tasty.
paras.uz: Integral qurilayotgan stapel bo'ylab yurganimda Ikkinchi Quruvchi meni kutib oldi. Uning yuzi odatdagidek dumaloq va oq edi — chinni likopcha. U gapirganda go'yo sizga chidab bo'lmas darajada mazali narsa solingan likopchani tortayotgandek tuyuladi.

paras.en: “You chose to be ill, and without the Chief we had an accident, as it were, yesterday.”
paras.uz: «Siz kasal bo'lishni ma'qul ko'rdingiz, Boshliqsiz esa kecha bizda, aytish mumkinki, hodisa yuz berdi».

paras.en: “An accident?”
paras.uz: «Hodisa?»

paras.en: “Yes, sir. We finished the bell and started to let it down, and imagine! the men caught a male without a number. How he got in, I cannot make out. They took him to the Operation Department. Oh, they’ll draw the mystery out of the fellow there; ‘why’ and ‘how,’ etc.⁠ ⁠…” He smiled delightedly.
paras.uz: «Ha, janob. Qo'ng'iroqni tugatib, uni tushira boshladik va tasavvur qiling! Ishchilar raqamsiz bir erkakni tutib olishdi. U qanday kirib qolgan, tushuna olmayman. Uni Operatsiya Bo'limiga olib ketishdi. Oh, u yerda bu odamdan sirni sug'urib olishadi; "nega" va "qanday" va hokazo...» U zavq bilan jilmaydi.

paras.en: Our best and most experienced physicians work in the Operation Department under the direct supervision of the Well-Doer himself. They have all kinds of instruments, but the best of all is the Gas Bell. The procedure is taken from an ancient experiment of elementary physics: they used to put a rat under a gas bell and gradually pump out the air; the air becomes more and more rarified, and⁠ ⁠… you know the rest.
paras.uz: Operatsiya Bo'limida eng yaxshi va eng tajribali shifokorlarimiz bevosita Homiyning o'zi nazorati ostida ishlaydi. Ularda turli xil asboblar bor, lekin eng yaxshisi — Gaz Qo'ng'irog'i. Bu usul elementar fizikaning qadimiy tajribasidan olingan: ular kalamushni gaz qo'ng'irog'i ostiga qo'yib, havoni asta-sekin so'rib olishgan; havo tobora siyraklashadi va... qolganini bilasiz.

paras.en: But our Gas Bell is certainly a more perfect apparatus and it is used in combination with different gasses. Furthermore, we don’t torture a defenseless animal as the ancients did; we use it for a higher purpose: to guard the security of the United State, in other words, the happiness of millions. About five centuries ago when the work of the Operation Department was only beginning, there were yet to be found some fools who compared our Operation Department with the ancient Inquisition. But this is as absurd as to compare a surgeon performing a tracheotomy with a highway cutthroat. Both use a knife, perhaps the same kind of a knife, both do the same thing, viz., cut the throat of a living man, yet one is a well-doer, the other is a murderer; one is marked plus, the other minus.⁠ ⁠… All this becomes perfectly clear in one second, in one turn of our logical wheel, the teeth of which engage that minus, turn it upward and thus change its aspect. That other matter is somewhat different; the ring in the door was still oscillating, apparently the door had just closed, yet she, I-330, had disappeared; she was not there! The logical wheel could not turn this fact. A dream? But even now I feel still in my right shoulder that incomprehensible sweet pain of I-330 near me in the fog, pressing herself against me. “Thou lovest fog?” Yes, I love the fog too. I love everything and everything appears to me wonderful, new, tense; everything is so good!⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Lekin bizning Gaz Qo'ng'irog'imiz albatta mukammalroq apparat va u turli gazlar bilan birga qo'llaniladi. Bundan tashqari, biz qadimgilar kabi himoyasiz hayvonni qiynamaymiz; biz undan oliyroq maqsadda foydalanamiz: Yagona Davlat xavfsizligini, boshqacha aytganda, millionlarning baxtini qo'riqlash uchun. Taxminan besh asr oldin, Operatsiya Bo'limining ishi endigina boshlanganda, bizning Operatsiya Bo'limimizni qadimiy Inkvizitsiya bilan solishtiradigan ba'zi ahmoqlar hali topilardi. Lekin bu traxeotomiya qilayotgan jarrohni katta yo'l qaroqchisi bilan solishtirgandek bema'nilik. Ikkalasi ham pichoq ishlatadi, balki bir xil pichoqni, ikkalasi ham bir xil ishni qiladi, ya'ni tirik odamning bo'g'zini kesadi, lekin biri xayrixoh, ikkinchisi qotil; biri plyus bilan belgilangan, ikkinchisi minus bilan... Bularning hammasi bir soniyada, mantiq g'ildiragimizning bir aylanishida mutlaqo ravshan bo'ladi; uning tishlari o'sha minusni ilib, yuqoriga burib, ko'rinishini o'zgartiradi. Boshqa masala esa biroz boshqacha; eshikdagi halqa hali tebranib turardi, aftidan eshik hozirgina yopilgan edi, lekin u, I-330, g'oyib bo'lgan edi; u yo'q edi! Mantiq g'ildiragi bu faktni bura olmadi. Tushmi? Lekin hozir ham o'ng yelkamda tumanda yonimdagi, menga suyangan I-330 ning o'sha tushunib bo'lmas shirin og'rig'ini his qilyapman. «Sen tumanni sevasanmi?» Ha, men tumanni ham sevaman. Men hamma narsani sevaman va hamma narsa menga ajoyib, yangi, tarang tuyuladi; hamma narsa shunchalik yaxshi!..

paras.en: “So good,” I said aloud.
paras.uz: «Shunchalik yaxshi», — dedim ovoz chiqarib.

paras.en: “Good?” The porcelain eyes bulged out. “What good do you find in that? If that man without a number contrived to sneak in, it means that there are others around here, everywhere, all the time, here around the Integral, they⁠—”
paras.uz: «Yaxshi? — Chinni ko'zlar bo'rtib chiqdi. — Bunda nimani yaxshi deb bilyapsiz? Agar o'sha raqamsiz odam sirg'alib kirishga muyassar bo'lgan bo'lsa, demak, bu yerda boshqalar ham bor, hamma joyda, doimo, shu yerda, Integral atrofida, ular —»

paras.en: “Whom do you mean by ‘they’?”
paras.uz: «"Ular" deganda kimni nazarda tutyapsiz?»

paras.en: “How do I know who? But I sense them, all the time.”
paras.uz: «Kimligini qayerdan bilay? Lekin ularni doimo sezib turaman».

paras.en: “Have you heard about the new operation which has been invented? I mean the surgical removal of fancy?” (There really were rumors of late about something of the sort.)
paras.uz: «Ixtiro qilingan yangi operatsiya haqida eshitganmisiz? Xayolni jarrohlik yo'li bilan olib tashlashni nazarda tutyapman?» (So'nggi paytlarda chindan ham shunga o'xshash narsa haqida mish-mishlar yurardi.)

paras.en: “No, I haven’t. What has that to do with it?”
paras.uz: «Yo'q, eshitmaganman. Buning nima aloqasi bor?»

paras.en: “Merely this: if I were you, I should go and ask to have this operation performed upon me.”
paras.uz: «Faqat shu: agar men siz bo'lganimda, borib o'zimga shu operatsiyani qilishlarini so'ragan bo'lardim».

paras.en: The plate expressed distinctly something lemon-like, sour. Poor fellow! He took offence if one even hinted that he might possess imagination. Well, a week ago I too should have taken offence at such a hint. Not so now, for I know that I have imagination, that is what my illness consists in, and more than that: I know that it is a wonderful illness⁠—one does not want to be cured, simply does not want to!
paras.uz: Likopcha aniq qandaydir limondek, nordon ifoda bildirdi. Bechora! Unda xayol bo'lishi mumkinligiga hatto ishora qilinsa ham, u xafa bo'lardi. Xo'sh, bir hafta oldin men ham bunday ishoradan xafa bo'lgan bo'lardim. Hozir unday emas, chunki menda xayol borligini bilaman, mening kasalligim aynan shunda, bundan ham ko'proq: bu ajoyib kasallik ekanini bilaman — odam tuzalishni istamaydi, shunchaki istamaydi!

paras.en: We ascended the glass steps; the world spread itself below us like the palm of a hand.
paras.uz: Biz shisha zinapoyalardan ko'tarildik; dunyo ostimizda kaftdek yoyilib yotardi.

paras.en: You, readers of these records, whoever you be, you have the sun above you. And if you ever were ill, as I am now, then you know what kind of a sun there is or may be in the morning; you know that pinkish, lucid, warm gold; the air itself looks a little pinkish; everything seems permeated by the tender blood of the sun; everything is alive; the stones seem soft and living; iron living and warm; people all full of life and smiles. It may be that in a short while all this will disappear, that in an hour the pinkish blood of the sun will be drained out, but in the meantime everything is alive. And I see how something flows and pulsates in the sides of the Integral; I see the Integral think of its great and lofty future, of the heavy load of inevitable happiness which it is to carry up there into the heights, to you, unseen ones, to you who seek eternally and who never find. You shall find! You shall be happy! You must be happy, and you have now not very long to wait!
paras.uz: Siz, bu qaydlarning o'quvchilari, kim bo'lishingizdan qat'i nazar, sizning tepangizda quyosh bor. Va agar siz hech qachon hozir men kabi kasal bo'lgan bo'lsangiz, ertalab qanday quyosh bo'lishi yoki bo'lishi mumkinligini bilasiz; o'sha pushtiroq, tiniq, iliq oltinni bilasiz; havoning o'zi biroz pushti ko'rinadi; hamma narsa quyoshning nozik qoniga singgandek tuyuladi; hamma narsa tirik; toshlar yumshoq va tirikdek; temir tirik va iliq; odamlar hayot va tabassumga to'la. Balki ko'p o'tmay bularning hammasi yo'qolar, bir soatdan keyin quyoshning pushti qoni oqib tugar, lekin hozircha hamma narsa tirik. Va men Integralning yon tomonlarida nimadir oqib, urib turganini ko'raman; Integral o'zining buyuk va yuksak kelajagi haqida, u yerga, balandlikka, sizga, ko'rinmaslarga, abadiy izlab, hech qachon topa olmaydiganlarga olib borishi kerak bo'lgan muqarrar baxtning og'ir yuki haqida o'ylayotganini ko'raman. Siz topasiz! Siz baxtli bo'lasiz! Siz baxtli bo'lishingiz kerak va endi uzoq kutishingizga to'g'ri kelmaydi!

paras.en: The body of the Integral is almost ready; it is an exquisite, oblong ellipsoid, made of our glass, which is everlasting like gold and flexible like steel. I watched them within, fixing its transverse ribs and its longitudinal stringers; in the stern they were erecting the base of the gigantic motor. Every three seconds the powerful tail of the Integral will eject flame and gasses into the universal space, and the Integral will soar forward and higher⁠—like a flaming Tamerlane of happiness! I watched how the workers, true to the Taylor system, would bend down, then unbend and turn around swiftly and rhythmically like levers of an enormous engine. In their hands they held glittering glass pipes which emitted bluish streaks of flame; the glass walls were being cut into with flame; with flame there were being welded the angles, the ribs, the bars. I watched the monstrous glass cranes easily rolling over the glass rails; like the workers themselves they would obediently turn, bend down and bring their loads inward into the bowels of the Integral. All seemed one, humanized machine and mechanized humans. It was the most magnificent, the most stirring beauty, harmony, music!
paras.uz: Integralning tanasi deyarli tayyor; bu bizning oltindek abadiy va po'latdek egiluvchan shishamizdan yasalgan nafis, cho'zinchoq ellipsoid. Men ichkarida ular ko'ndalang qovurg'alari va bo'ylama stringerlarini o'rnatayotganini kuzatdim; quyruq qismida ulkan dvigatelning asosini qurishardi. Har uch soniyada Integralning qudratli quyrug'i olam fazosiga olov va gazlar otib chiqaradi va Integral oldinga va yuqoriga — baxtning otashin Temurlangidek — parvoz qiladi! Men ishchilar Teylor tizimiga sodiq qolib, ulkan mashinaning richaglari kabi egilib, keyin qaddini rostlab, tez va ritmik aylanishlarini kuzatdim. Qo'llarida moviy olov tillari chiqarayotgan yaltiroq shisha quvurlar bor edi; shisha devorlar olov bilan kesilardi; olov bilan burchaklar, qovurg'alar, to'sinlar payvandlanardi. Men dahshatli shisha kranlar shisha relslar ustida qanday oson dumalab yurganini kuzatdim; ular ham ishchilarning o'zlari kabi itoatkorona burilib, egilib, yuklarini ichkariga, Integralning qorniga olib kirardi. Hammasi bir butun edi: insonlashgan mashina va mexanizatsiyalashgan odamlar. Bu eng ulug'vor, eng hayajonli go'zallik, uyg'unlik, musiqa edi!

paras.en: Quick! Down! To them, and with them! And I descended and mingled with them, fused with their mass, caught in the rhythm of steel and glass. Their movements were measured, tense and round. Their cheeks were colored with health, their mirror-like foreheads not clouded by the insanity of thinking. I was floating upon a mirror-like sea. I was reposing.⁠ ⁠… Suddenly one of them turned toward me his carefree face.
paras.uz: Tezroq! Pastga! Ularning oldiga va ular bilan birga! Men pastga tushib, ular bilan aralashdim, ularning massasiga qo'shilib ketdim, po'lat va shisha ritmiga ilindim. Ularning harakatlari o'lchovli, tarang va dumaloq edi. Yonoqlari sog'liqdan qizargan, ko'zgudek peshonalari fikrlash telbaligi bilan xiralashmagan edi. Men ko'zgudek dengiz ustida suzib yurardim. Men orom olardim... To'satdan ulardan biri tashvishsiz yuzini menga o'girdi.

paras.en: “Well, better today?”
paras.uz: «Xo'sh, bugun yaxshiroqmisiz?»

paras.en: “What better?”
paras.uz: «Nima yaxshiroq?»

paras.en: “You were not here yesterday. And we thought something serious.⁠ ⁠…” His forehead was shining; a childish and innocent smile.
paras.uz: «Kecha bu yerda yo'q edingiz. Biz esa jiddiy biror narsa bo'ldi deb o'yladik...» Uning peshonasi yaltirardi; bolalarcha va beg'ubor tabassum.

paras.en: My blood rushed to my face. No, I could not lie, facing those eyes. I remained silent; I was drowning.⁠ ⁠… Above, the shiny round white porcelain face appeared in the hatchway.
paras.uz: Qonim yuzimga yugurdi. Yo'q, o'sha ko'zlarga qarab yolg'on gapira olmasdim. Jim qoldim; men cho'kayotgan edim... Tepada, lyukda yaltiroq, dumaloq, oq chinni yuz paydo bo'ldi.

paras.en: “Eh! D-503! Come up here! Something is wrong with a frame and brackets here, and⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Hoy! D-503! Bu yoqqa chiqing! Bu yerda rama va kronshteynlarda nimadir noto'g'ri, va...»

paras.en: Not waiting until he had finished, I rushed to him, upstairs; I was shamefully saving myself by flight. I had not the power to raise my eyes. I was dazed by the sparkling glass steps under my feet, and with every step I made I felt more and more hopeless. I, a corrupted man, a criminal, was out of place here. No, I shall probably never again be able to fuse myself into this mechanical rhythm, nor to float over this mirror-like, untroubled sea. I am to burn eternally from now on, running from place to place, seeking a nook where I may hide my eyes, eternally, until I.⁠ ⁠… A spark cold as ice pierced me: “I myself, I matter little, but is it necessary that she also⁠ ⁠… ? I must see that she⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Uning gapini tugatishini kutmay, yuqoriga, uning oldiga yugurdim; men sharmandalarcha qochib o'zimni qutqarayotgan edim. Ko'zlarimni ko'tarishga kuchim yo'q edi. Oyoqlarim ostidagi yaltiroq shisha zinapoyalardan ko'zim tindi va har bir qadamim bilan o'zimni tobora umidsizroq his qilardim. Men, buzilgan odam, jinoyatchi, bu yerga mos emas edim. Yo'q, men endi hech qachon bu mexanik ritmga qo'shila olmasam kerak, bu ko'zgudek, tinch dengiz ustida suza olmasam kerak. Bundan buyon men abadiy yonishim kerak, u yerdan bu yerga yugurib, ko'zlarimni yashiradigan burchak izlab, abadiy, toki men... Muzdek sovuq uchqun meni teshib o'tdi: «Men o'zim, mening ahamiyatim kam, lekin u ham... kerakmi? Men u... ekanini ko'rishim kerak».

paras.en: I crawled through the hatchway to the deck and stood there; where was I to go now? I did not know what I had come for! I looked aloft. The midday sun exhausted by its march, was fuming dimly. Below was the Integral, a gray mass of glass⁠—dead. The pink blood was drained out! It was clear to me that all this was my imagination and that everything remained as before, yet it was also clear to me that⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Lyukdan palubaga emaklab chiqdim va u yerda turdim; endi qayerga borishim kerak edi? Nima uchun kelganimni bilmasdim! Yuqoriga qaradim. Yurishdan holdan toygan peshin quyoshi xira tutunlanardi. Pastda Integral, shishaning kulrang massasi — o'lik. Pushti qon oqib tugagan edi! Menga aniq ediki, bularning hammasi mening xayolim va hamma narsa avvalgidek qolgan, lekin shu bilan birga menga aniq ediki...

paras.en: “What is the matter with you, D-503? Are you deaf? I call you and call.⁠ ⁠… What is the matter with you?” It was the Second Builder yelling directly into my ear; he must have been yelling that way for quite a while.
paras.uz: «Sizga nima bo'ldi, D-503? Kar bo'lib qoldingizmi? Chaqiraman, chaqiraman... Sizga nima bo'ldi?» Bu Ikkinchi Quruvchi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qulog'imga qichqirayotgan edi; u ancha vaqtdan beri shunday qichqirayotgan bo'lsa kerak.

paras.en: What was the matter with me? I had lost my rudder, the motor was groaning as before, the aero was quivering and rushing on but it had no rudder. I did not even know where I was rushing, down to the earth or up to the sun, to its flame.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Menga nima bo'ldi? Men rulimni yo'qotgandim, dvigatel avvalgidek ingrardi, aero titrab, oldinga otilardi, lekin uning ruli yo'q edi. Hatto qayerga otilayotganimni ham bilmasdim — pastga, yergami yoki yuqoriga, quyoshga, uning olovigami...

gloss.ex: …hout a number. How he got in, I cannot make out. They took him to the Operation Department. Oh, they’ll draw the mystery out of the fellow there; ‘why’ and ‘how…
…mself. They have all kinds of instruments, but the best of all is the Gas Bell. The procedure is taken from an ancient experiment of elementary physics: they us…
…und some fools who compared our Operation Department with the ancient Inquisition. But this is as absurd as to compare a surgeon performing a tracheotomy with a…
…laming Tamerlane of happiness! I watched how the workers, true to the Taylor system, would bend down, then unbend and turn around swiftly and rhythmically like…
…new operation which has been invented? I mean the surgical removal of fancy?” (There really were rumors of late about something of the sort.)

quiz.q: Who was caught on the dock?
quiz.why_uz: Integral yonida raqamsiz erkak ushlangan.

quiz.q: Why can't D-503 face the workers?
o: He feels like a criminal and cannot lie to them
quiz.why_uz: U ularning beg'ubor ko'zlariga yolg'on gapira olmaydi.

chapters.recap_uz: Stapelda raqamsiz odam tutilgani aytiladi. D-503 Gaz Qo'ng'irog'ini tushuntiradi, ishchilar ritmiga qo'shilmoqchi bo'ladi, lekin o'zini jinoyatchi his qilib, «abadiy yonishim kerak» deydi.

chapters.title: Yellow — A two-dimensional shadow — An incurable soul
chapters.title_uz: Sariq — Ikki o'lchamli soya — Bedavo ruh

paras.en: I have not written for several days, for I don’t know how many. All my days are alike. All are of one color⁠—yellow like dry, overheated sand. Not a patch of shade, not a drop of water, only an infinity of yellow sand. I cannot live without her, but she, since she disappeared that day so mysteriously in the Ancient House.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Bir necha kundan beri, qancha ekanini bilmayman, yozmadim. Barcha kunlarim bir-biriga o'xshaydi. Hammasi bir rangda — quruq, qizib ketgan qumdek sariq. Na bir parcha soya, na bir tomchi suv, faqat sariq qumning cheksizligi. Men usiz yashay olmayman, u esa o'sha kuni Qadimiy Uyda shunchalik sirli g'oyib bo'lganidan beri...

paras.en: Since that time I have seen her only once, during the hour for the Walk, two, three, four days ago, I do not remember exactly. All my days are alike. She only passed swiftly by and for a second filled up the yellow, empty world. With her, arm in arm, reaching not higher than her shoulder, were the double-curved S- and the thin papery doctor, and a fourth person whose fingers only I remember well; they streamed out, those fingers, from the sleeve of the unif like a bundle of rays, uncommonly thin, white, long. I-330 raised her hand and waved to me, then she bent toward the one with the ray-like fingers, over the head of S-. I overheard the word Integral. All four turned around to look at me⁠—and then they disappeared in the bluish-gray sea and my road was once more dry and yellow.
paras.uz: O'shandan beri uni faqat bir marta, Sayr soatida ko'rdim, ikki, uch, to'rt kun oldin, aniq eslolmayman. Barcha kunlarim bir-biriga o'xshaydi. U faqat tezgina o'tib ketdi va bir soniyaga sariq, bo'm-bo'sh dunyoni to'ldirdi. U bilan qo'ltiqlashib, yelkasidan baland bo'lmagan ikki marta egilgan S-, yupqa qog'ozdek shifokor va to'rtinchi bir kishi bor edi, uning faqat barmoqlarini yaxshi eslayman; o'sha barmoqlar yunifa yengidan nurlar dastasidek, g'ayrioddiy yupqa, oq, uzun bo'lib oqib chiqardi. I-330 qo'lini ko'tarib, menga silkitdi, keyin S- ning boshi osha nurdek barmoqli odamga egildi. Men «Integral» so'zini eshitib qoldim. To'rttalasi ham menga qarash uchun o'girildi — keyin ular ko'kimtir-kulrang dengizda g'oyib bo'lishdi va mening yo'lim yana quruq va sariq bo'lib qoldi.

paras.en: That same evening she had a pink check on me. I stood before the switchboard and with hatred and tenderness I implored it to click and soon to show the number I-330. I would jump out into the hall at every sound of the elevator. The door of the latter would open heavily. Pale, tall, blonde and dark they would come out of the elevator, and here and there curtains were falling.⁠ ⁠… But she was not there. She did not come. And it is quite possible that now, at this minute, as I write these lines, at twenty-two o’clock exactly, with her eyes closed, she is pressing her shoulder against somebody else in the same way and in the same way she may be asking someone: “Do you love me?” Whom? Who is he? That one with ray-like fingers or that thick-lipped, sprinkling R-? Or S-? S-! Why is it that I have heard his steps splashing behind me as though in a ditch all these days? Why has he been following me all these days like a shadow? Ahead of me, to my side, behind me, a grayish-blue, two-dimensional shadow; people cross it, people step on it but it remains nearby, attached to me by unseen ties. Perhaps that tie is I-330. I do not know. Or perhaps they, the Guardians I mean, already know that I⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: O'sha kuni kechqurun uning menga pushti chiptasi bor edi. Men kommutator oldida turib, nafrat va mehr bilan uning chiqillashini va tezroq I-330 raqamini ko'rsatishini yolvorib so'rardim. Liftning har bir tovushida yo'lakka otilib chiqardim. Liftning eshigi og'ir ochilardi. Rangpar, baland bo'yli, sarg'ish va qora sochlilar liftdan chiqishardi va u yer-bu yerda pardalar tushardi... Lekin u yo'q edi. U kelmadi. Va ehtimol, hozir, shu daqiqada, men bu satrlarni aynan yigirma ikkida yozayotganimda, u ko'zlarini yumib, xuddi shunday yelkasini boshqa birovga bosib turgandir va xuddi shunday kimdandir so'rayotgandir: «Meni sevasanmi?» Kimdan? U kim? O'sha nurdek barmoqlimi yoki o'sha qalin labli, sachratadigan R- mi? Yoki S- mi? S-! Nega shu kunlar davomida uning qadamlarini orqamda go'yo ariqda shalpillayotgandek eshitib yurdim? Nega u shu kunlar davomida meni soyadek kuzatib yurdi? Oldimda, yonimda, orqamda ko'kimtir-kulrang, ikki o'lchamli soya; odamlar uni kesib o'tishadi, ustidan bosib o'tishadi, lekin u yaqinda qoladi, menga ko'rinmas iplar bilan bog'langan. Balki o'sha ip I-330 dir. Bilmayman. Yoki ehtimol ular, Qo'riqchilarni nazarda tutyapman, allaqachon men... ekanimni bilishar...

paras.en: If someone should tell you your shadow sees you, sees you all the time, would you understand? All at once peculiar sensations arise in you; your arms seem to belong to someone else, they are in the way. That is how I feel; very frequently now I notice how absurdly I wave my hands without any rhythm. I have an irresistible desire to glance behind me but I am unable to do so, my neck might as well be forged of iron. I flee, I run faster and faster, and even with my back I feel that shadow following me as fast as I can run, and there is no place to hide myself, no place!
paras.uz: Agar kimdir sizga soyangiz sizni ko'radi, doimo ko'rib turadi desa, tushunarmidingiz? Birdaniga sizda g'alati tuyg'ular paydo bo'ladi; qo'llaringiz boshqa birovnikidek tuyuladi, ular xalaqit beradi. Men shunday his qilyapman; endi juda tez-tez qo'llarimni hech qanday ritmsiz qanchalik bema'ni silkitayotganimni payqayman. Orqamga qarashga chidab bo'lmas istak bor, lekin buni qila olmayman, bo'ynim go'yo temirdan quyilgandek. Men qochaman, tobora tezroq yuguraman va hatto orqam bilan o'sha soya men yugura olganimdek tez ergashib kelayotganini his qilaman va yashirinadigan joy yo'q, hech qayerda!

paras.en: At length I reach my room. Alone at last! But here I find another thing, the telephone. I pick up the receiver. “Yes, I-330 please.” And again I hear a light noise through the receiver; someone’s step in the hall there, passing the door of her room, and⁠—silence.⁠ ⁠… I drop the receiver. I cannot, cannot bear it any longer, and I run to see her!
paras.uz: Nihoyat xonamga yetib kelaman. Nihoyat yolg'izman! Lekin bu yerda boshqa narsani topaman — telefon. Go'shakni ko'taraman. «Ha, I-330, iltimos». Va yana go'shak orqali yengil shovqinni eshitaman; u yerda yo'lakda kimningdir qadami, uning xonasi eshigi yonidan o'tib ketadi va — sukunat... Go'shakni tashlayman. Men endi chiday olmayman, chiday olmayman va uni ko'rish uchun yuguraman!

paras.en: This happened yesterday. I ran there and for a whole hour from sixteen to seventeen I wandered near the house in which she lives. Numbers were passing by in rows. Thousands of feet were beating the time like a behemoth with a million legs passing by. I was alone, thrown out by a storm on an uninhabited island, and my eyes were seeking and seeking among the grayish-blue waves. “There soon,” I thought, “will appear from somewhere the sharp mocking angles of the brows lifted to the temples, and the dark window-eyes, and there behind them a flaming fireplace and someone’s shadow.⁠ ⁠… And I will rush straight in behind those windows and say to her, ‘Thou’ (yes, ‘thou’ without fail), ‘Thou knowest I cannot live without thee any longer, then why⁠—⁠ ⁠… ?’ ” But silence reigned.
paras.uz: Bu kecha sodir bo'ldi. Men u yerga yugurdim va o'n oltidan o'n yettigacha butun bir soat u yashaydigan uy yonida aylanib yurdim. Raqamlar qator-qator o'tib borardi. Minglab oyoqlar go'yo million oyoqli begemot o'tib ketayotgandek taktni urardi. Men yolg'iz edim, bo'ron odam yashamaydigan orolga uloqtirgan edi va ko'zlarim ko'kimtir-kulrang to'lqinlar orasidan izlardi va izlardi. «Mana hozir, — o'yladim men, — qayerdandir chakkalarigacha ko'tarilgan qoshlarning o'tkir, masxaraomuz burchaklari va qorong'i deraza-ko'zlar, ularning ortida esa yonayotgan kamin va kimningdir soyasi paydo bo'ladi... Va men to'g'ri o'sha derazalar ortiga otilib kirib, unga aytaman: "Sen" (ha, albatta "sen"), "Sen bilasanki, men endi sensiz yashay olmayman, unda nega —...?"» Lekin sukunat hukm surardi.

paras.en: Suddenly I heard the silence; suddenly I heard the Musical Tower silenced, and I understood! It was after seventeen already; everyone had already left. I was alone. It was too late to return home. Around me⁠—a desert made of glass and bathed with yellow sunshine. I saw, as if in water, the reflection of the walls in the glass smoothness of the street, sparkling walls, hanging upside down. Myself also upside down, hanging absurdly in the glass.
paras.uz: To'satdan sukunatni eshitdim; to'satdan Musiqa Minorasi jim bo'lib qolganini eshitdim va tushundim! Allaqachon o'n yettidan o'tgan edi; hamma allaqachon ketib bo'lgan edi. Men yolg'iz edim. Uyga qaytish uchun juda kech edi. Atrofimda — shishadan yasalgan va sariq quyosh nuriga cho'milgan cho'l. Men go'yo suvda ko'chaning shisha silliqligida devorlarning aksini, teskari osilib turgan yaltiroq devorlarni ko'rdim. O'zim ham teskari, shishada bema'ni osilib turardim.

paras.en: “I must go at once, this very second, to the Medical Bureau or else⁠ ⁠… or perhaps this would be best: to remain here, to wait quietly until they see me and come and take me into the Operation Department and put an end to everything at once, redeem everything.⁠ ⁠…” A slight rustle! and the double-curved S- was before me. Without looking I felt his two gray steel-drill eyes bore quickly into me. I plucked up all my strength to show a smile and to say (I had to say something), “I, I must go to the Medical Bureau.”
paras.uz: «Men darhol, shu soniyaning o'zida Tibbiyot Byurosiga borishim kerak, aks holda... yoki ehtimol eng yaxshisi shu bo'lar: shu yerda qolish, ular meni ko'rib, kelib, Operatsiya Bo'limiga olib ketib, hamma narsaga birdaniga chek qo'yishini, hamma narsani yuvib tashlashini jimgina kutish...» Yengil shitirlash! Va ikki marta egilgan S- ro'paramda turardi. Qaramasdan ham uning ikki kulrang po'lat parma ko'zlari menga tezgina burg'ilab kirganini his qildim. Jilmayish va aytish uchun (biror narsa deyishim kerak edi) butun kuchimni yig'dim: «Men, men Tibbiyot Byurosiga borishim kerak».

paras.en: “Who is detaining you? What are you standing here for?”
paras.uz: «Sizni kim ushlab turibdi? Bu yerda nima uchun turibsiz?»

paras.en: I was silent, absurdly hanging upside down.
paras.uz: Men jim edim, bema'ni teskari osilib turardim.

paras.en: “Follow me,” said S- austerely.
paras.uz: «Mening orqamdan yuring», — dedi S- qat'iy ohangda.

paras.en: I followed obediently, waving my unnecessary, foreign arms. I could not raise my eyes. I walked through a strange world turned upside down, where people had their feet pasted to the ceilings, and where engines stood with their bases upward, and where, still lower, the sky merged in the heavy glass of the pavement. I remember what pained me most was the fact that looking at the world for the last time in my life, I should see it upside down rather than in its natural state; but I could not raise my eyes.
paras.uz: Men itoatkorona ergashdim, keraksiz, begona qo'llarimni silkitib. Ko'zlarimni ko'tara olmasdim. Men odamlarning oyoqlari shiftga yopishtirilgan, mashinalar asoslari yuqoriga qaragan holda turgan va yana ham pastroqda osmon trotuarning og'ir shishasiga qo'shilib ketgan g'alati, teskari dunyo bo'ylab yurardim. Esimda, meni eng ko'p og'ritgan narsa — hayotimda oxirgi marta dunyoga qarab, uni tabiiy holatida emas, teskari ko'rishim edi; lekin ko'zlarimni ko'tara olmasdim.

paras.en: We stopped. Steps. One step⁠ ⁠… and I should see the figures of the doctors in their white aprons and the enormous dumb Bell.
paras.uz: Biz to'xtadik. Zinapoyalar. Bir qadam... va men oq xalatli shifokorlar qiyofalarini va ulkan, soqov Qo'ng'iroqni ko'raman.

paras.en: With force, with some sort of an inner screw, at length I succeeded in tearing my eyes away from the glass beneath my feet, and I noticed the golden letters, “Medical Bureau.” Why did he bring me here rather than to the Operation Department? Why did he spare me?⁠—about this I did not even think at that moment. I made one jump over all the steps, firmly closed the door behind me and took a very deep breath, as if I had not breathed since morning and as if my heart had not beaten for the same length of time, as if only now I started to breathe and only now there opened a sluice in my chest.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Kuch bilan, qandaydir ichki vint bilan nihoyat ko'zlarimni oyoqlarim ostidagi shishadan uzishga muvaffaq bo'ldim va oltin harflarni payqadim: «Tibbiyot Byurosi». Nega u meni Operatsiya Bo'limiga emas, bu yerga olib keldi? Nega meni ayadi? — o'sha lahzada bu haqda o'ylamadim ham. Barcha zinapoyalardan bir sakrab o'tdim, eshikni orqamdan mahkam yopdim va juda chuqur nafas oldim, go'yo ertalabdan beri nafas olmagandek va yuragim ham shuncha vaqt urmagandek, go'yo faqat endi nafas ola boshlagandek va faqat endi ko'kragimda shlyuz ochilgandek...

paras.en: Inside there were two of them, one a short specimen with heavy legs, his eyes like the horns of a bull tossing the patients up, the other extremely thin with lips like sparkling scissors, a nose like a blade⁠—it was the same man who⁠ ⁠… I ran to him as to a dear friend, straight over close to the blade, and muttered something about insomnia, dreams, shadows, yellow sand. The scissors-lips sparkled and smiled.
paras.uz: Ichkarida ular ikkita edi, biri og'ir oyoqli pakana nusxa, ko'zlari bemorlarni otib yuboradigan buqa shoxlaridek, ikkinchisi juda ozg'in, lablari yaltiroq qaychidek, burni tig'dek — bu o'sha odam edi... Men unga aziz do'stimga yugurgandek yugurdim, to'g'ri tig'ning yoniga borib, uyqusizlik, tushlar, soyalar, sariq qum haqida nimadir deb g'o'ldiradim. Qaychi-lablar yaltirab, jilmaydi.

paras.en: “Yes, it is too bad. Apparently a soul has formed in you.”
paras.uz: «Ha, bu juda yomon. Aftidan, sizda ruh paydo bo'libdi».

paras.en: A soul?⁠—that strange ancient word that was forgotten long ago.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Ruh? — allaqachon unutilgan o'sha g'alati qadimiy so'z...

paras.en: “Is it⁠ ⁠… v-very dangerous?” I stuttered.
paras.uz: «Bu... j-juda xavflimi?» — duduqlandim men.

paras.en: “Incurable,” was the cut of the scissors.
paras.uz: «Davosiz», — qaychi kesdi.

paras.en: “But more specifically, what is it? Somehow I cannot imagine⁠—”
paras.uz: «Lekin aniqrog'i, bu nima? Negadir tasavvur qila olmayapman —»

paras.en: “You see⁠ ⁠… how shall I put it? Are you a mathematician?”
paras.uz: «Ko'ryapsizmi... qanday aytsam ekan? Siz matematikmisiz?»

paras.en: “Yes.”
paras.uz: «Ha».

paras.en: “Then you see⁠ ⁠… imagine a plane, let us say this mirror. You and I are on its surface. You see? there we are, squinting our eyes to protect ourselves from the sunlight, or here is the bluish electric spark in that tube, there the shadow of that aero that just passed. All this is on the surface, is momentary only. Now imagine this very same surface softened by a flame so that nothing can any longer glide over it, so everything instead will penetrate into that mirror world which excites such curiosity in children. I assure you, children are not so foolish as we think they are! The surface becomes a volume, a body, a world; and inside the mirror⁠—within you, there is the sunshine, and the whirlwind caused by the aero propeller, and your trembling lips and someone else’s lips also. You see, the cold mirror reflects, throws out, while this one absorbs; it keeps forever a trace of everything that touches it. Once you saw an imperceptible wrinkle on someone’s face, and this wrinkle is forever preserved within you; you may happen to hear in the silence a drop of water falling⁠—and you will hear it forever!”
paras.uz: «Unda ko'ryapsizmi... bir tekislikni tasavvur qiling, aytaylik, mana shu ko'zguni. Siz va men uning yuzasidamiz. Ko'ryapsizmi? Mana biz, quyosh nuridan himoyalanish uchun ko'zlarimizni qisib turibmiz, yoki mana o'sha naychadagi ko'kimtir elektr uchquni, u yerda hozirgina o'tib ketgan aeroning soyasi. Bularning hammasi yuzada, faqat bir lahzalik. Endi xuddi shu yuzani olov bilan yumshatilgan deb tasavvur qiling, shunda uning ustidan hech narsa sirpanib o'ta olmaydi, aksincha hamma narsa bolalarda shunchalik qiziqish uyg'otadigan o'sha ko'zgu dunyosiga singib kiradi. Ishontirib aytamanki, bolalar biz o'ylagandek ahmoq emas! Yuza hajmga, jismga, dunyoga aylanadi; va ko'zgu ichida — sizning ichingizda quyosh nuri, aero parragidan paydo bo'lgan quyun, sizning titrayotgan lablaringiz va yana kimningdir lablari bor. Ko'ryapsizmi, sovuq ko'zgu aks ettiradi, tashqariga qaytaradi, bunisi esa yutib oladi; unga tegib o'tgan har bir narsaning izini abadiy saqlaydi. Bir marta kimningdir yuzida sezilmas ajinni ko'rdingiz va bu ajin sizning ichingizda abadiy saqlanadi; sukunatda tomayotgan suv tomchisini eshitib qolishingiz mumkin — va uni abadiy eshitasiz!»

paras.en: “Yes, yes, that is it!” I grasped his hand. I could hear drops of water dripping in the silence from the faucet of a washstand and at once I knew it was forever.
paras.uz: «Ha, ha, aynan shunday!» Men uning qo'lini ushlab oldim. Sukunatda qo'l yuvgich jo'mragidan suv tomchilari tomayotganini eshita olardim va shu zahoti bu abadiy ekanini bildim.

paras.en: “But tell me please, why suddenly⁠ ⁠… suddenly a soul? There was none, yet suddenly.⁠ ⁠… Why is it that no one has it, yet I.⁠ ⁠…” I pressed the thin hand; I was afraid to loosen the safety belt.
paras.uz: «Lekin ayting-chi, iltimos, nega to'satdan... to'satdan ruh? U yo'q edi, lekin to'satdan... Nega hech kimda yo'q, lekin menda...» Men yupqa qo'lni siqdim; xavfsizlik kamarini bo'shatishdan qo'rqardim.

paras.en: “Why? Well, why don’t we grow feathers or wings, but only shoulder blades, bases for wings? We have aeros; wings would only be in the way. Wings are needed in order to fly, but we don’t need to fly anywhere. We have arrived at the terminus. We have found what we wanted. Is that not so?”
paras.uz: «Nega? Xo'sh, nega bizda pat yoki qanotlar emas, faqat kurak suyaklari, qanotlar uchun asoslar o'sadi? Bizda aerolar bor; qanotlar faqat xalaqit berardi. Qanotlar uchish uchun kerak, lekin bizga hech qayerga uchish kerak emas. Biz oxirgi bekatga yetib keldik. Biz istagan narsamizni topdik. Shunday emasmi?»

paras.en: I nodded vaguely. He glanced at me and laughed a scalpel-like metallic laugh. The other doctor overheard us and stamped out of his room on his heavy legs. He picked up the thin doctor with his horn-eyes, then picked me up.
paras.uz: Men noaniq bosh irg'adim. U menga qarab, skalpeldek metall kulgi bilan kuldi. Boshqa shifokor bizni eshitib qolib, og'ir oyoqlarida xonasidan do'pillab chiqdi. U shox-ko'zlari bilan ozg'in shifokorni ilib oldi, keyin meni ilib oldi.

paras.en: “What is the matter, a soul? You say a soul? Oh, damn it! We may soon retrogress even to the cholera epidemics. I told you,” he tossed the thin one on the horns, “I told you the only thing to do is to operate on them all, wholesale! simply extirpate the centre for fancy. Only surgery can help here, only surgery.” He put on a pair of enormous X-ray spectacles and remained thus for a long while, looking into my skull, through the bones into my brain and making notes.
paras.uz: «Nima gap, ruhmi? Ruh deyapsizmi? Oh, la'nati! Tez orada hatto vabo epidemiyalarigacha orqaga qaytishimiz mumkin. Men sizga aytgandim, — u ozg'inni shoxlariga ilib otdi, — aytgandim, qiladigan yagona ish — hammasiga operatsiya qilish, ommaviy ravishda! Shunchaki xayol markazini olib tashlash. Bu yerda faqat jarrohlik yordam beradi, faqat jarrohlik». U ulkan rentgen ko'zoynagini taqib, uzoq vaqt shu holda qoldi, bosh suyagimga, suyaklar orqali miyamga qarab, yozib olardi.

paras.en: “Very, very curious! Listen.” He looked firmly into my eyes. “Would you not consent to have me perform an extirpation on you? It would be invaluable to the United State; it might help us to prevent an epidemic. If you have no special reasons, of course.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Juda, juda qiziq! Quloq soling». U ko'zlarimga qat'iy tikildi. «Sizga ekstirpatsiya qilishimga rozi bo'lmaysizmi? Bu Yagona Davlat uchun bebaho bo'lardi; bu bizga epidemiyaning oldini olishga yordam berishi mumkin. Albatta, agar alohida sabablaringiz bo'lmasa...»

paras.en: Some time ago I should probably have said without hesitation, “I am willing,” but now⁠—I was silent. I caught the profile of the thin doctor; I implored him!
paras.uz: Bir muncha vaqt oldin men ehtimol ikkilanmay: «Roziman», degan bo'lardim, lekin endi — jim qoldim. Ozg'in shifokorning profilini ushlab oldim; men undan yolvordim!

paras.en: “You see,” he said at last, “Number D-530 is building the Integral and I am sure the operation would interfere.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Ko'ryapsizmi, — dedi u nihoyat, — D-503 raqami Integralni quryapti va ishonamanki, operatsiya xalaqit beradi...»

paras.en: “Ah-h!” grumbled the other and stamped back into his room.
paras.uz: «A-a-a!» — g'udrandi ikkinchisi va do'pillab xonasiga qaytib ketdi.

paras.en: We remained alone. The paper-like hand was put lightly and caressingly upon mine, the profile-like face came nearer and he said in a very low voice: “I shall tell you a secret. You are not the only one. My colleague is right when he speaks of an epidemic. Try to remember, have you not noticed yourself, someone with something similar, very similar, identical?”
paras.uz: Biz yolg'iz qoldik. Qog'ozdek qo'l yengil va erkalab mening qo'lim ustiga qo'yildi, profildek yuz yaqinlashdi va u juda past ovozda dedi: «Sizga bir sirni aytaman. Siz yagona emassiz. Hamkasbim epidemiya haqida gapirganda haq. Eslashga harakat qiling, o'zingiz kimdadir shunga o'xshash, juda o'xshash, aynan bir xil narsani payqamaganmisiz?»

paras.en: He looked at me closely. What was he alluding to? To whom?⁠ ⁠… Is it possible?⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U menga diqqat bilan qaradi. U nimaga ishora qilyapti? Kimga?.. Nahotki?..

paras.en: “Listen,” I jumped up from my seat. But he had already changed the subject. In a loud metallic tone:
paras.uz: «Quloq soling», — men o'rnimdan sakrab turdim. Lekin u allaqachon mavzuni o'zgartirgan edi. Baland metall ohangda:

paras.en: “… As to the insomnia and for the dreams you complain of, I advise you to walk a great deal. Tomorrow morning you must begin taking long walks⁠ ⁠… say as far as the Ancient House.”
paras.uz: «...Shikoyat qilayotgan uyqusizlik va tushlaringizga kelsak, ko'p yurishni maslahat beraman. Ertaga ertalab uzoq sayrlarni boshlashingiz kerak... aytaylik, Qadimiy Uygacha».

paras.en: Again he pierced me with his eyes and he smiled thinly. It seemed to me that I saw enveloped in the tender tissue of that smile a word, a letter, a name, the only name.⁠ ⁠… Or was it only my imagination? I waited impatiently while he wrote a certificate of illness for today and tomorrow. Once more I gently and firmly pressed his hand, then I ran out.
paras.uz: U yana ko'zlari bilan meni teshib o'tdi va yupqa jilmaydi. Menga go'yo o'sha tabassumning nozik matosiga o'ralgan bir so'z, bir harf, bir ism, yagona ismni ko'rgandek tuyuldi... Yoki bu faqat mening xayolimmidi? U bugun va ertaga uchun kasallik guvohnomasini yozayotganda sabrsizlik bilan kutdim. Yana bir bor uning qo'lini muloyim va mahkam siqdim, keyin yugurib chiqdim.

paras.en: My heart now feels light and swift like an aero; it carries me higher and higher.⁠ ⁠… I know joy will come tomorrow. What joy?⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Yuragim endi aerodek yengil va tez; u meni tobora yuqoriga ko'taradi... Bilaman, ertaga quvonch keladi. Qanday quvonch?..

gloss.ex: …ch all these days? Why has he been following me all these days like a shadow? Ahead of me, to my side, behind me, a grayish-blue, two-dimensional shadow; people…
“Yes, it is too bad. Apparently a soul has formed in you.”
“Incurable,” was the cut of the scissors.
…u say a soul? Oh, damn it! We may soon retrogress even to the cholera epidemics. I told you,” he tossed the thin one on the horns, “I told you the only thing to…
…ked firmly into my eyes. “Would you not consent to have me perform an extirpation on you? It would be invaluable to the United State; it might help us to preven…

quiz.q: What does the doctor say D-503 has?
quiz.why_uz: «Sizda ruh paydo bo'libdi» — bu Yagona Davlatda kasallik.

quiz.q: Where does the doctor advise him to walk?
quiz.why_uz: Bu I-330 ga ishora.

chapters.recap_uz: D-503 I-330 ni kutib, azob chekadi; S- uni soyadek kuzatadi. Tibbiyot Byurosida shifokor unga «ruh paydo bo'libdi, bu davosiz» deydi va Qadimiy Uyga borishni maslahat beradi.

chapters.title: Through glass — I died — The corridor

paras.en: I am puzzled. Yesterday, at the very moment when I thought everything was untangled, and that all the X’s were at last found, new unknowns appeared in my equation. The origin of the coordinates of the whole story is of course the Ancient Home. From this centre the axes of all the X’s, Y’s, and Z’s radiate, and recently they have entered into the formation of my whole life.
paras.uz: Men dovdirab qoldim. Kecha, hamma narsa yechildi va barcha X lar nihoyat topildi deb o'ylagan lahzada, tenglamamda yangi noma'lumlar paydo bo'ldi. Butun voqeaning koordinatalar boshi, albatta, Qadimiy Uy. Barcha X, Y va Z o'qlari shu markazdan tarqaladi va yaqinda ular butun hayotimning tuzilishiga kirib keldi.

paras.en: I walked along the X-axis (Avenue 59) towards the centre. The whirlwind of yesterday still raged within me; houses and people upside down; my own hands torturingly foreign to me; glimmering scissors; the sharp sound of drops dripping from the faucet;⁠—all this existed, all this existed once! All these things were revolving wildly, tearing my flesh, rotating wildly beneath the molten surface, there where the “soul” is located.
paras.uz: Men X o'qi (59-prospekt) bo'ylab markazga qarab yurdim. Kechagi quyun hali ham ichimda g'azab bilan aylanardi; teskari uylar va odamlar; o'zimning qiynoqli darajada begona qo'llarim; yiltirayotgan qaychilar; jo'mrakdan tomayotgan tomchilarning o'tkir tovushi; — bularning hammasi bo'lgan, bularning hammasi bir marta bo'lgan! Bu narsalarning hammasi yovvoyi aylanib, etimni yirtib, erigan yuza ostida, «ruh» joylashgan o'sha yerda yovvoyi aylanardi.

paras.en: In order to follow the instructions of the doctor I chose the road which followed not the hypotenuse but the two legs of a triangle. Soon I reached the road running along the Green Wall. From beyond the Wall, from the infinite ocean of green there rose toward me an immense wave of roots, branches, flowers, leaves. It rose higher and higher; it seemed as though it would splash over me and that from a man, from the finest and most precise mechanism which I am, I would be transformed into.⁠ ⁠… But fortunately there was the Green Wall between me and that wild green sea. Oh, how great and divinely limiting is the wisdom of walls and bars! This Green Wall is I think the greatest invention ever conceived. Man ceased to be a wild animal the day he built the first wall; man ceased to be a wild man only on the day when the Green Wall was completed, when by this wall we isolated our machine-like, perfect world from the irrational, ugly world of trees, birds and beasts.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Shifokorning ko'rsatmalariga amal qilish uchun gipotenuza emas, uchburchakning ikki kateti bo'ylab o'tadigan yo'lni tanladim. Tez orada Yashil Devor bo'ylab o'tadigan yo'lga yetib keldim. Devor ortidan, cheksiz yashil okeandan menga qarab ildizlar, novdalar, gullar, barglarning ulkan to'lqini ko'tarildi. U tobora balandlashdi; go'yo u ustimdan sachrab o'tadi va men odamdan, men bo'lgan eng nozik va eng aniq mexanizmdan... ga aylanadigandek tuyuldi. Lekin baxtimga, men bilan o'sha yovvoyi yashil dengiz orasida Yashil Devor bor edi. Oh, devorlar va panjaralarning donoligi qanchalik buyuk va ilohiy chegaralovchi! Menimcha, bu Yashil Devor hozirgacha o'ylab topilgan eng buyuk ixtiro. Inson birinchi devorni qurgan kuni yovvoyi hayvon bo'lishdan to'xtadi; inson faqat Yashil Devor qurib bitkazilgan kuni, biz bu devor bilan o'zimizning mashinadek, mukammal dunyomizni daraxtlar, qushlar va hayvonlarning irratsional, xunuk dunyosidan ajratgan kuni yovvoyi odam bo'lishdan to'xtadi...

paras.en: The blunt snout of some unknown beast was to be seen dimly through the glass of the Wall; its yellow eyes kept repeating the same thought which remained incomprehensible to me. We looked into each other’s eyes for a long while. Eyes are shafts which lead from the superficial world into a world which is beneath the surface. A thought awoke in me: “what if that yellow-eyed one, sitting there on that absurd dirty heap of leaves, is happier than I, in his life which cannot be calculated in figures!” I waved my hand. The yellow eyes twinkled, moved back and disappeared in the foliage. What a pitiful being! How absurd the idea that he might be happier! Happier than I he may be, but I am an exception, am I not? I am sick.
paras.uz: Devor shishasi orqali qandaydir noma'lum hayvonning to'mtoq tumshug'i xira ko'rinardi; uning sariq ko'zlari menga tushunarsiz qolgan bir xil fikrni takrorlab turardi. Biz uzoq vaqt bir-birimizning ko'zlarimizga qaradik. Ko'zlar — yuzaki dunyodan yuza ostidagi dunyoga olib boradigan shaxtalar. Ichimda bir fikr uyg'ondi: «agar o'sha yerda, o'sha bema'ni iflos barglar uyumida o'tirgan o'sha sariq ko'z raqamlar bilan hisoblab bo'lmaydigan hayotida mendan baxtliroq bo'lsa-chi!» Men qo'limni silkitdim. Sariq ko'zlar pirpiradi, orqaga chekinib, barglar orasida g'oyib bo'ldi. Qanday ayanchli mavjudot! U baxtliroq bo'lishi mumkin degan g'oya qanchalik bema'ni! Mendan baxtliroq bo'lishi mumkin, lekin men istisno-ku, shunday emasmi? Men kasalman.

paras.en: I noticed that I was approaching the dark red walls of the Ancient House and I saw the grown-together lips of the old woman. I ran to her with all speed.
paras.uz: Qadimiy Uyning to'q qizil devorlariga yaqinlashayotganimni payqadim va kampirning bitishib ketgan lablarini ko'rdim. Men unga butun tezligim bilan yugurdim.

paras.en: “Is she here?”
paras.uz: «U shu yerdami?»

paras.en: The grown-together lips opened slowly:
paras.uz: Bitishgan lablar sekin ochildi:

paras.en: “Who is ‘she’?”
paras.uz: «"U" kim?»

paras.en: “Who? I-330, of course. You remember we came together, she and I, in an aero the other day.”
paras.uz: «Kim? I-330, albatta. Esingizdami, o'tgan kuni u va men birga aeroda kelgan edik».

paras.en: “Oh, yes, yes, yes⁠—yes.”
paras.uz: «Ha, ha, ha — ha».

paras.en: Ray-wrinkles around the lips, artful rays radiating from the eyes. They were making their way deeper and deeper into me.
paras.uz: Lablar atrofida nur-ajinlar, ko'zlardan tarqalayotgan ayyor nurlar. Ular tobora chuqurroq ichimga kirib borardi.

paras.en: “Well, she is here, all right. Came in a while ago.”
paras.uz: «Xo'sh, u shu yerda, xotirjam bo'ling. Hozirgina kirdi».

paras.en: “Here!” I noticed at the feet of the old woman a bush of silver⁠—bitter wormwood. (The court of the Ancient House, being a part of the museum is carefully kept in its prehistoric state.) A branch of the bush touched the old woman, she caressed that branch; upon her knees lay stripes of sunshine. For a second I myself, the sun, the old woman, the wormwood, those yellow eyes, all seemed to be one; we were firmly united by common veins and one common blood, boisterous, magnificent blood, was running through those veins.
paras.uz: «Shu yerda!» Kampirning oyoqlari ostida kumushrang butani — achchiq shuvoqni payqadim. (Qadimiy Uy hovlisi muzeyning bir qismi bo'lgani uchun tarixdan oldingi holatida ehtiyotkorlik bilan saqlanadi.) Butaning bir novdasi kampirga tegib turardi, u o'sha novdani silardi; tizzalarida quyosh nuri chiziqlari yotardi. Bir soniyaga men o'zim, quyosh, kampir, shuvoq, o'sha sariq ko'zlar — hammasi bir butundek tuyuldi; biz umumiy tomirlar bilan mahkam birlashgan edik va o'sha tomirlar bo'ylab bitta umumiy qon, shiddatli, ulug'vor qon oqardi.

paras.en: I am ashamed now to write down all this, but I promised to be frank to the end of these records: yes, I bent over and kissed that soft, grown-together mouth of the old woman. She wiped it with her hand and laughed.
paras.uz: Endi bularning hammasini yozishdan uyalaman, lekin men bu qaydlarning oxirigacha ochiq bo'lishga va'da berganman: ha, men egilib, kampirning o'sha yumshoq, bitishgan og'zini o'pdim. U og'zini qo'li bilan artib, kuldi.

paras.en: Running, I passed through familiar, half-dark, echoing rooms, and for some reason I ran straight to the bedroom. When I had reached the door, a thought flashed: “And if she is there⁠ ⁠… not alone?” I stopped and listened. But all I heard was the tick-tock of my heart, not within me, but somewhere near, outside me.
paras.uz: Yugurib tanish, yarim qorong'i, aks-sado beruvchi xonalardan o'tdim va negadir to'g'ri yotoqxonaga yugurdim. Eshikka yetganimda xayolimdan bir fikr chaqnab o'tdi: «Agar u u yerda... yolg'iz bo'lmasa-chi?» To'xtab, quloq soldim. Lekin eshitganim faqat yuragimning tiq-tiqi edi, ichimda emas, qayerdadir yaqinda, tashqarimda.

paras.en: I entered. The large bed⁠—untouched. A mirror⁠ ⁠… another mirror in the door of the cupboard, and in the keyhole an ancient key upon an ancient ring. No one was there. I called softly: “I-330, are you here?”⁠—and then in a still lower voice with closed eyes, holding my breath⁠—in a voice as though I were kneeling before her, “I-, dear.” Silence. Only the water was dripping fast into the white basin of the washstand. I cannot now explain why, but I disliked that sound. I turned the faucet hard and went out. She was not there, so much was clear. She must be in another “apartment.”
paras.uz: Ichkariga kirdim. Katta karavot — tegilmagan. Ko'zgu... javon eshigidagi yana bir ko'zgu va qulf teshigida qadimiy halqadagi qadimiy kalit. U yerda hech kim yo'q edi. Sekin chaqirdim: «I-330, shu yerdamisiz?» — keyin yana ham pastroq ovozda, ko'zlarimni yumib, nafasimni ichimga yutib — go'yo uning oldida tiz cho'kkandek ovozda: «I-, azizim». Sukunat. Faqat suv qo'l yuvgichning oq tosiga tez-tez tomardi. Hozir nega ekanini tushuntira olmayman, lekin bu tovush menga yoqmadi. Jo'mrakni mahkam burab, chiqdim. U yo'q edi, bu aniq edi. U boshqa «kvartira»da bo'lsa kerak.

paras.en: I ran down a wide, sombre stairway, pulled one door, another, a third⁠—locked. Every room was locked save that of “our” apartment. And she was not there. I went back again to the same apartment without knowing why. I walked slowly, with difficulty; my shoe-soles suddenly became as heavy as cast-iron. I remember distinctly my thought, “It is a mistake that the force of gravity is a constant; consequently all my formulae.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Keng, qorong'i zinapoyadan pastga yugurdim, bir eshikni, ikkinchisini, uchinchisini tortdim — qulflangan. «Bizning» kvartiramizdan boshqa har bir xona qulflangan edi. U esa u yerda yo'q edi. Nega ekanini bilmay, yana o'sha kvartiraga qaytdim. Sekin, qiyinchilik bilan yurardim; tuflim tagi to'satdan cho'yandek og'ir bo'lib qoldi. O'sha paytdagi fikrimni aniq eslayman: «Tortishish kuchi doimiy deyish xato; demak, mening barcha formulalarim...»

paras.en: Suddenly⁠—an explosion! A door slammed down below; someone stamped quickly over the flagstones. I again became lightfooted, extremely light! I dashed to the railing to bend over, and in one word, one exclamation, expressed everything: “You!”
paras.uz: To'satdan — portlash! Pastda eshik qarsillab yopildi; kimdir tosh plitalar ustidan tez do'pillab o'tdi. Men yana yengil oyoq bo'lib qoldim, nihoyatda yengil! Egilib qarash uchun panjaraga otildim va bir so'z, bir xitob bilan hamma narsani ifodaladim: «Siz!»

paras.en: I became cold. Below in the square shadow of the window-frame, flapping its pink wing-ears, the head of S- passed by!
paras.uz: Men muzlab qoldim. Pastda, deraza romining to'rtburchak soyasida, pushti qanot-quloqlarini pirpiratib, S- ning boshi o'tib ketdi!

paras.en: Like lightning I saw only the naked conclusion. Without any premises (I don’t recall any premises even now) the conclusion: he must not see me here! And on the tips of my toes, pressing myself against the wall, I sneaked upstairs into the unlocked apartment.
paras.uz: Chaqmoqdek faqat yalang'och xulosani ko'rdim. Hech qanday asoslarsiz (hozir ham hech qanday asosni eslay olmayman) xulosa: u meni bu yerda ko'rmasligi kerak! Va oyoq uchida, devorga yopishib, yuqoriga, qulflanmagan kvartiraga sirg'alib kirdim.

paras.en: I stopped for a second at the door. He was stamping upward, here. If only the door.⁠ ⁠… I prayed to the door but it was a wooden one⁠—It squeaked, it squealed. Like a wind something red passed my eyes, something green, and the yellow Buddha. In front of the mirror-door of the cupboard, my pale face; my ears still following those steps, my lips.⁠ ⁠… Now he was already passing the green and yellow, now he was passing Buddha, now at the doorsill of the bedroom.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Eshik oldida bir soniya to'xtadim. U do'pillab yuqoriga, bu yerga chiqib kelardi. Qaniydi eshik... Men eshikka yolvordim, lekin u yog'och edi — g'ichirladi, chiyilladi. Shamoldek ko'z oldimdan nimadir qizil, nimadir yashil va sariq Budda o'tdi. Javonning ko'zguli eshigi oldida — mening rangpar yuzim; quloqlarim hali ham o'sha qadamlarni kuzatardi, lablarim... Mana u allaqachon yashil va sariqdan o'tyapti, mana Buddadan o'tyapti, mana yotoqxona ostonasida...

paras.en: I grasped the key of the cupboard; the ring oscillated. This oscillation reminded me of something. Again a conclusion, a naked conclusion without premises; a conclusion, or to be more exact, a fragment of one: “Now I-330 is.⁠ ⁠…” I brusquely opened the cupboard and when inside in the darkness shut the door firmly. One step! The floor shook under my feet. Slowly and softly I floated somewhere downward; my eyes were dimmed⁠—I died!
paras.uz: Javon kalitini ushladim; halqa tebrandi. Bu tebranish menga nimanidir eslatdi. Yana xulosa, asoslarsiz yalang'och xulosa; xulosa, aniqrog'i, uning bir parchasi: «Hozir I-330...» Javonni keskin ochdim va ichkarida, qorong'ilikda eshikni mahkam yopdim. Bir qadam! Oyoqlarim ostida pol chayqaldi. Sekin va muloyim qayergadir pastga suzib ketdim; ko'zlarim xiralashdi — men o'ldim!

paras.en: Later when I sat down to describe all these adventures, I sought in my memory and consulted some books; and now I understand, of course! I was in a state of temporary death. This state was known to the ancients, but as far as I am informed it is unknown to us. I have no conception of how long I was dead, probably not longer than five or ten seconds, but after awhile I arose from the dead and opened my eyes. It was dark. But I felt I was falling down⁠—down⁠—down. I stretched out my hand to attach myself to something but the rough wall scratched my fingers; it was running away from me, upward. I felt blood on my fingers. It was clear that all this was not merely a play of my sick imagination. But what was it? What?
paras.uz: Keyinroq bu sarguzashtlarning hammasini tasvirlash uchun o'tirganimda, xotiramni titkiladim va ba'zi kitoblarni varaqladim; va endi tushunaman, albatta! Men vaqtinchalik o'lim holatida edim. Bu holat qadimgilarga ma'lum bo'lgan, lekin men bilishimcha, bizga noma'lum. Qancha vaqt o'lik bo'lganimni tasavvur qila olmayman, ehtimol besh yoki o'n soniyadan ko'p emas, lekin bir muncha vaqtdan keyin men o'likdan tirildim va ko'zlarimni ochdim. Qorong'i edi. Lekin pastga — pastga — pastga tushayotganimni his qildim. Biror narsaga yopishish uchun qo'limni cho'zdim, lekin g'adir-budur devor barmoqlarimni tirnadi; u mendan qochib, yuqoriga ketardi. Barmoqlarimda qonni his qildim. Bularning hammasi shunchaki kasal xayolimning o'yini emasligi aniq edi. Lekin bu nima edi? Nima?

paras.en: I heard my own frequent, trembling breaths. (I am not ashamed to confess this, it was all unexpected and incomprehensible.) A minute, two, three passed; I was still going down. Then a soft bump. The thing that had been falling away from under my feet was motionless. I found in the darkness a knob, and turned it; a door opened; there was a dim light. I now noticed behind me a square platform, travelling upward. I tried to run back to it but it was too late. “I am cut off here,” I thought. Where “here” might be, I did not know.
paras.uz: Men o'zimning tez-tez, titroq nafaslarimni eshitdim. (Buni tan olishdan uyalmayman, hammasi kutilmagan va tushunarsiz edi.) Bir daqiqa, ikki, uch o'tdi; men hali ham pastga tushib borardim. Keyin yumshoq turtki. Oyoqlarim ostidan tushib ketayotgan narsa harakatsiz qoldi. Qorong'ida bir tutqichni topib, burdim; eshik ochildi; xira yorug'lik bor edi. Endi orqamda yuqoriga ketayotgan to'rtburchak maydonchani payqadim. Unga qaytib yugurmoqchi bo'ldim, lekin juda kech edi. «Men bu yerda uzilib qoldim», — o'yladim. «Bu yer» qayer ekanini bilmasdim.

paras.en: A corridor. A heavy silence. The small lamps on the vaulted ceiling resembled an endless, twinkling, dotted line. The corridor was similar to the “tube” of our underground railways but it was much narrower, and made not of our glass but of some other, very ancient material. For a moment I thought of the underground caves where they say many tried to save themselves during the Two Hundred Years’ War. There was nothing to do but to walk ahead.
paras.uz: Yo'lak. Og'ir sukunat. Gumbazsimon shiftdagi kichkina chiroqlar cheksiz, miltillovchi nuqtali chiziqqa o'xshardi. Yo'lak yer osti temir yo'llarimizning «quvuri»ga o'xshardi, lekin ancha torroq edi va bizning shishamizdan emas, boshqa, juda qadimiy materialdan yasalgan edi. Bir lahzaga Ikki Yuz Yillik Urush paytida ko'plar jon saqlashga uringan deyiladigan yer osti g'orlari haqida o'yladim. Oldinga yurishdan boshqa chora yo'q edi.

paras.en: I walked, I think, for about twenty minutes. A turn to the right, the corridor became wider, the small lamps brighter. There was a dim droning somewhere.⁠ ⁠… Was it a machine or voices? I did not know. I stood before a heavy, opaque door, from behind which came the noise. I knocked. Then I knocked again, louder. Now there was silence behind the door. Something clanked; the door opened slowly and heavily.
paras.uz: Menimcha, taxminan yigirma daqiqa yurdim. O'ngga burilish, yo'lak kengaydi, kichkina chiroqlar yorqinroq bo'ldi. Qayerdadir xira g'uvillash bor edi... Bu mashinami yoki ovozlarmi? Bilmasdim. Men og'ir, shaffof bo'lmagan eshik oldida turardim, uning ortidan shovqin kelardi. Taqillatdim. Keyin yana, balandroq taqillatdim. Endi eshik ortida sukunat edi. Nimadir shaqilladi; eshik sekin va og'ir ochildi.

paras.en: I don’t know which of us was the more dumbfounded; the thin blade-like doctor stood before me!
paras.uz: Qaysi birimiz ko'proq hayratdan qotib qolganimizni bilmayman; ro'paramda yupqa, tig'dek shifokor turardi!

paras.en: “You here!” his scissors opened and remained open.
paras.uz: «Siz bu yerda!» — uning qaychilari ochildi va ochiq qoldi.

paras.en: And I, as if I did not know a human word, stood silent, merely stared, without comprehending that he was talking to me. He must have told me to leave, for with his thin paper stomach he slowly pressed me to the side, to the more brightly lighted end of the corridor and poked me in the back.
paras.uz: Men esa go'yo inson so'zini bilmagandek, jim turdim, faqat tikilib qoldim, u menga gapirayotganini tushunmasdan. U menga ketishni aytgan bo'lsa kerak, chunki yupqa qog'oz qorni bilan meni sekin chetga, yo'lakning yorqinroq yoritilgan oxiriga itarib, orqamga turtdi.

paras.en: “Beg your pardon⁠ ⁠… I wanted⁠ ⁠… I thought that she, I-330⁠ ⁠… but behind me.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Kechirasiz... men istagandim... men u, I-330... deb o'yladim, lekin orqamda...»

paras.en: “Stay where you are,” said the doctor brusquely, and he disappeared.
paras.uz: «Turgan joyingizda turing», — dedi shifokor keskin va g'oyib bo'ldi.

paras.en: At last! At last she was nearby, here, and what did it matter where “here” was? I saw the familiar saffron-yellow silk, the smile-bite, the eyes with their curtains drawn.⁠ ⁠… My lips quivered, so did my hands and knees, and I had a most stupid thought: “Vibrations make sounds. Shivering must make a sound. Why then don’t I hear it?”
paras.uz: Nihoyat! Nihoyat u yaqinda, shu yerda edi, «bu yer» qayer ekanining nima ahamiyati bor edi? Men tanish za'faron-sariq ipakni, tabassum-tishlashni, pardalari tushirilgan ko'zlarni ko'rdim... Lablarim titradi, qo'llarim va tizzalarim ham, va xayolimga eng ahmoqona fikr keldi: «Tebranishlar tovush hosil qiladi. Titrash tovush chiqarishi kerak. Unda nega men uni eshitmayapman?»

paras.en: Her eyes opened for me widely. I entered into them.
paras.uz: Uning ko'zlari men uchun keng ochildi. Men ularning ichiga kirdim.

paras.en: “I could not⁠ ⁠… any longer!⁠ ⁠… Where have you been?⁠ ⁠… Why?⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Men endi... chiday olmadim!.. Qayerda edingiz?.. Nega?..»

paras.en: I was unable to tear my eyes away from her for a second, and I talked as if in a delirium, fast and incoherently, or perhaps I only thought without speaking out: “A shadow⁠ ⁠… behind me. I died. And from the cupboard.⁠ ⁠… Because that doctor of yours⁠ ⁠… speaks with his scissors.⁠ ⁠… I have a soul⁠ ⁠… incurable⁠ ⁠… and I must walk.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Ko'zlarimni undan bir soniya ham uza olmasdim va go'yo alahsirab, tez va bog'liqsiz gapirardim, yoki ehtimol faqat ovoz chiqarmay o'ylardim: «Soya... orqamda. Men o'ldim. Va javondan... Chunki sizning o'sha shifokoringiz... qaychilari bilan gapiradi... Menda ruh bor... davosiz... va men yurishim kerak...»

paras.en: “An incurable soul? My poor boy!” I-330 laughed. She covered me with the sparkles of her laughter; my delirium left me. Everywhere around her little laughs were sparkling! How good it was!
paras.uz: «Davosiz ruhmi? Bechora bolam!» I-330 kuldi. U meni kulgisining uchqunlari bilan qopladi; alahsirashim mendan ketdi. Uning atrofida hamma yoqda kichkina kulgilar uchqunlanardi! Qanday yaxshi edi!

paras.en: The doctor reappeared from around the turn, the wonderful, magnificent, thinnest doctor.
paras.uz: Shifokor muyulish ortidan yana paydo bo'ldi — ajoyib, ulug'vor, eng ozg'in shifokor.

paras.en: “Well?” He was already beside her.
paras.uz: «Xo'sh?» U allaqachon uning yonida edi.

paras.en: “Oh, nothing, nothing. I shall tell you later. He got here by accident. Tell them that I shall be back in about a quarter of an hour.”
paras.uz: «Oh, hech narsa, hech narsa. Keyinroq aytib beraman. U bu yerga tasodifan tushib qoldi. Ularga taxminan chorak soatdan keyin qaytishimni ayting».

paras.en: The doctor slid around the corner. She lingered. The door closed with a heavy thud. Then slowly, very slowly, piercing my heart with a sharp sweet needle, I-330 pressed against me with her shoulder and then with her arm, with her whole body, and we walked away as if fused into one.
paras.uz: Shifokor muyulish ortiga sirg'alib ketdi. U kutib turdi. Eshik og'ir gursillab yopildi. Keyin sekin, juda sekin, yuragimni o'tkir shirin igna bilan teshib, I-330 menga yelkasi bilan, keyin qo'li bilan, butun tanasi bilan suyandi va biz go'yo bir butunga qo'shilgandek yurib ketdik.

paras.en: I do not remember now where we turned into darkness; in the darkness we walked up some endless stairway in silence. I did not see but I knew, I knew that she walked as I did, with closed eyes, blind, her head thrown a little backward, biting her lips and listening to the music, that is to say, to my almost audible tremor.
paras.uz: Hozir qayerda qorong'ilikka burilganimizni eslay olmayman; qorong'ilikda jimgina qandaydir cheksiz zinapoyadan yuqoriga ko'tarildik. Ko'rmasdim, lekin bilardim, bilardimki, u ham men kabi yurardi — ko'zlarini yumib, ko'r, boshini biroz orqaga tashlab, lablarini tishlab va musiqani, ya'ni mening deyarli eshitiladigan titrashimni tinglab.

paras.en: I returned to consciousness in one of the innumerable nooks in the courtyard of the Ancient House. There was a fence of earth with naked stone ribs and yellow teeth of walls half fallen to pieces. She opened her eyes and said, “Day-after-tomorrow at sixteen.” She was gone.
paras.uz: Men Qadimiy Uy hovlisidagi son-sanoqsiz burchaklardan birida o'zimga keldim. Yalang'och tosh qovurg'alari va yarmi qulab tushgan devorlarning sariq tishlari bilan tuproq devor bor edi. U ko'zlarini ochib: «Indinga o'n oltida», dedi. U ketdi.

paras.en: Did all this really happen? I do not know. I shall learn day-after-tomorrow. One real sign remains: on my right hand the skin has been rubbed from the tips of three fingers. But today, on the Integral the Second Builder assured me that he saw me touch the polishing wheel with those very same fingers. Perhaps I did. It is quite probable. I don’t know. I don’t know anything.
paras.uz: Bularning hammasi haqiqatan ham sodir bo'ldimi? Bilmayman. Indinga bilib olaman. Bitta haqiqiy belgi qoldi: o'ng qo'limda uchta barmoq uchining terisi shilingan. Lekin bugun Integralda Ikkinchi Quruvchi meni xuddi shu barmoqlarim bilan silliqlash charxiga tegayotganimni ko'rganiga ishontirdi. Balki shundaydir. Bu juda ehtimol. Bilmayman. Hech narsani bilmayman.
