quiz.q: How does D-503 get under the Ancient House?
o: Through a door in the closet that descends
quiz.why_uz: Javon ichidagi pol pastga tushib ketadi.

quiz.q: Whom does he meet in the tunnel first?
quiz.why_uz: Eshikni ozg'in shifokor ochadi.

chapters.recap_uz: D-503 Qadimiy Uyga boradi, S- dan qochib javonga kiradi va pastga, yer osti yo'lagiga tushib qoladi. U yerda shifokor va I-330 ni topadi.

chapters.title: Logical debris — Wounds and plaster — Never again
chapters.title_uz: Mantiq vayronalari — Yaralar va malham — Endi hech qachon

paras.en: Last night as soon as I had gone to bed, I fell momentarily to the bottom of the ocean of sleep like an overloaded ship which has been wrecked. The heavy thicket of wavy green water enveloped me. Then slowly I floated from the bottom upward, and somewhere in the middle of that course, I opened my eyes⁠—my room! The morning was still green and motionless. A fragment of sunshine coming from the mirror on my closet door shone into my eyes. This fragment does not permit me to sleep, being thus an obstacle in the way of exactly fulfilling the rules of the Tables which prescribe so many hours of sleep. I should have opened the closet but I felt as though I were in a spider web, and cobweb covered my eyes; I had no power to sit up.
paras.uz: Kecha yotishim bilan, ortiqcha yuklangan va halokatga uchragan kemadek, bir zumda uyqu okeanining tubiga cho'kib ketdim. To'lqinsimon yashil suvning og'ir changalzori meni o'rab oldi. Keyin sekin-asta tubdan yuqoriga suzib chiqdim va o'sha yo'lning qayerdadir o'rtasida ko'zlarimni ochdim — xonam! Tong hali yashil va harakatsiz edi. Javonim eshigidagi ko'zgudan kelayotgan quyosh nurining bir parchasi ko'zlarimga tushib turardi. Bu parcha uxlashimga yo'l qo'ymaydi va shu bilan shuncha soat uyquni belgilaydigan Jadval qoidalarini aniq bajarishga to'siq bo'ladi. Javonni ochishim kerak edi, lekin o'zimni o'rgimchak to'ri ichidagidek his qildim, ko'zlarimni o'rgimchak uyasi qoplagan edi; o'tirishga kuchim yo'q edi.

paras.en: Yet I got up and opened the closet door; suddenly, there behind that door, making her way through the mass of garments which hung there, was I-330! I have become so accustomed of late to most improbable things, that as far as I remember I was not even surprised; I did not even ask a question. I jumped into the closet, slammed the mirror-door behind me and breathlessly, brusquely, blindly, avidly I clung to her. I remember clearly even now:⁠—through the narrow crack of the door a sharp sun-ray like lightning broke into the darkness and played on the floor and walls of the closet, and a little higher the cruel ray-blade fell upon the naked neck of I-330, and this for some reason seemed to me so terrible that I could not bear it, and I screamed;⁠—and again I opened my eyes. My room!
paras.uz: Shunga qaramay, o'rnimdan turib, javon eshigini ochdim; to'satdan o'sha eshik ortida, u yerda osilib turgan kiyimlar orasidan yo'l ochib, I-330 turardi! So'nggi paytlarda eng aql bovar qilmas narsalarga shunchalik o'rganib qolganmanki, esimda qolishicha, hatto hayron ham bo'lmadim; hatto savol ham bermadim. Javonga sakrab kirdim, ko'zguli eshikni orqamdan qarsillatib yopdim va nafasim tiqilib, keskin, ko'r-ko'rona, ochko'zlik bilan unga yopishdim. Hozir ham aniq eslayman: — eshikning tor tirqishidan o'tkir quyosh nuri chaqmoqdek qorong'ilikka yorib kirdi va javonning poli va devorlarida o'ynadi, biroz yuqoriroqda esa shafqatsiz nur-tig' I-330 ning yalang'och bo'yniga tushdi va bu negadir menga shunchalik dahshatli tuyuldiki, chiday olmadim va qichqirib yubordim; — va yana ko'zlarimni ochdim. Xonam!

paras.en: The morning was still green and motionless. On the door of my closet was a fragment of the sunshine. I was in bed. A dream? Yet my heart was still wildly beating, quivering and twitching; there was a dull pain in the tips of my fingers and in my knees. This undoubtedly did happen! And now I am unable any more to distinguish what is dream from what is actuality; irrational numbers grow through my solid, habitual, tri-dimensional life; and instead of firm, polished surfaces⁠—there is something shaggy and rough.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Tong hali yashil va harakatsiz edi. Javonim eshigida quyosh nurining parchasi. Men karavotda edim. Tushmi? Lekin yuragim hali ham yovvoyi urib, titrab, pirpirab turardi; barmoqlarim uchida va tizzalarimda xira og'riq bor edi. Bu shubhasiz sodir bo'lgan! Va endi men nima tush va nima haqiqat ekanini ajrata olmayman; irratsional sonlar mening mustahkam, odatiy, uch o'lchamli hayotim orqali o'sib chiqyapti; mustahkam, silliqlangan yuzalar o'rniga esa — qandaydir tukli va g'adir-budur narsa...

paras.en: I waited long for the Bell to ring. I was lying thinking, untangling a very strange logical chain. In our superficial life, every formula, every equation, corresponds to a curve or a solid. We have never seen any curve or solid corresponding to my square-root of minus one. The horrifying part of the situation is that there exist such curves or solids; unseen by us they do exist, they must, inevitably; for in mathematics as on a screen, strange sharp shadows appear before us. One must remember that mathematics like death, never makes mistakes, never plays tricks. If we are unable to see those irrational curves or solids, it only means that they inevitably possess a whole immense world somewhere beneath the surface of our life.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Qo'ng'iroq chalinishini uzoq kutdim. Men yotib, juda g'alati mantiqiy zanjirni yechayotgan edim. Bizning yuzaki hayotimizda har bir formula, har bir tenglama biror egri chiziq yoki jismga mos keladi. Biz hech qachon mening minus birning kvadrat ildizimga mos keladigan biror egri chiziq yoki jismni ko'rmaganmiz. Vaziyatning dahshatli tomoni shundaki, bunday egri chiziqlar yoki jismlar mavjud; biz ko'rmasak ham, ular mavjud, mavjud bo'lishi kerak, muqarrar ravishda; chunki matematikada, xuddi ekrandagidek, oldimizda g'alati o'tkir soyalar paydo bo'ladi. Shuni yodda tutish kerakki, matematika, xuddi o'lim kabi, hech qachon xato qilmaydi, hech qachon hiyla ishlatmaydi. Agar biz o'sha irratsional egri chiziqlar yoki jismlarni ko'ra olmasak, bu faqat ular muqarrar ravishda hayotimiz yuzasi ostida qayerdadir butun ulkan dunyoga ega ekanini anglatadi...

paras.en: I jumped up without waiting for the waking Bell and began to pace up and down the room. My mathematics, the only firm and immovable island of my shaken life, this too was torn from its anchor and was floating, whirling. Then it means that that absurd thing, the “soul,” is as real as my unif, as my boots, although I do not see them since they are behind the door of the closet. If boots are not a sickness, why should the “soul” be one? I sought, but I could not find, a way out of the logical confusion. It looked to me like that strange and sad debris beyond the Green Wall; my logical debris too, is filled with extraordinary, incomprehensible, wordless but speaking beings. It occurred to me for a moment that through some strange, thick glass I saw it; I saw it at once infinitely large and infinitely small, scorpion-like with hidden but ever perceptible sting; I saw the square-root of minus one. Perhaps it was nothing else but my “soul,” which like the legendary scorpion of the ancients, was voluntarily stinging itself with.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Uyg'otuvchi Qo'ng'iroqni kutmay, sakrab turdim va xonada u yoqdan bu yoqqa yura boshladim. Mening matematikam, larzaga kelgan hayotimning yagona mustahkam va qo'zg'almas oroli — u ham langaridan uzilib, suzib, aylanib ketayotgan edi. Demak, o'sha bema'ni narsa — «ruh» xuddi yunifam kabi, etiklarim kabi haqiqiy ekan, garchi ularni ko'rmasam ham, chunki ular javon eshigi ortida. Agar etiklar kasallik bo'lmasa, nega «ruh» kasallik bo'lishi kerak? Men mantiqiy chalkashlikdan chiqish yo'lini izladim, lekin topa olmadim. U menga Yashil Devor ortidagi o'sha g'alati va g'amgin vayronalarga o'xshab ko'rindi; mening mantiqiy vayronalarim ham g'ayrioddiy, tushunarsiz, so'zsiz, lekin gapiradigan mavjudotlarga to'la. Bir lahzaga xayolimga keldiki, qandaydir g'alati, qalin shisha orqali uni ko'rdim; uni bir vaqtning o'zida cheksiz katta va cheksiz kichik, yashirin, lekin doimo sezilib turadigan nayzali chayondek ko'rdim; minus birning kvadrat ildizini ko'rdim. Balki bu mening «ruhim»dan boshqa narsa emasdir, u qadimgilarning afsonaviy chayoni kabi o'z ixtiyori bilan o'zini... bilan chaqayotgandir...

paras.en: The Bell! The day began. All I saw and felt neither died, nor disappeared, it merely became covered with daylight, as our visible world does not die or disappear at the end of the day but merely becomes covered with the darkness of night. My head was filled by a light, thin haze. Through that haze I perceived the long glass tables and the globe-like heads busy chewing, slowly, silently, in unison. At a distance, through the haze, the metronome was slowly beating its tick-tock, and to the accompaniment of this customary and caressing music I joined with the others in counting automatically to fifty: fifty is the number of chewing movements required by the law of the State for every piece of food. And automatically then, keeping time, I went downstairs and put my name down in the book for the outgoing Numbers⁠—as everyone did. But I felt I lived separately from everybody; I lived by myself separated by a soft wall which absorbs noises; beyond that wall there was my world.
paras.uz: Qo'ng'iroq! Kun boshlandi. Ko'rgan va his qilgan narsalarimning hammasi na o'ldi, na yo'qoldi, ular faqat kunduzgi yorug'lik bilan qoplandi, xuddi bizning ko'rinadigan dunyomiz kun oxirida o'lmagani yoki yo'qolmagani, balki faqat tun zulmati bilan qoplangani kabi. Boshim yengil, yupqa tuman bilan to'lgan edi. O'sha tuman orqali uzun shisha stollarni va sekin, jimgina, hamohang chaynash bilan band bo'lgan sharsimon boshlarni ko'rdim. Uzoqda, tuman orqali metronom sekin tiq-taqini urardi va bu odatiy va erkalovchi musiqa sadosi ostida boshqalar bilan birga avtomatik ravishda ellikkacha sanadim: ellik — Davlat qonuni bo'yicha har bir luqma ovqat uchun talab qilinadigan chaynash harakatlari soni. Keyin yana avtomatik ravishda, taktni saqlab, pastga tushdim va chiqib ketayotgan Raqamlar daftariga ismimni yozdim — hamma kabi. Lekin o'zimni hammadan alohida yashayotgandek his qildim; men o'zim alohida, shovqinlarni yutadigan yumshoq devor bilan ajratilgan holda yashardim; o'sha devor ortida mening dunyom bor edi.

paras.en: Here a thought occurred to me. If that world is only my own, why should I tell about it in these records? Why should I recount all these absurd “dreams” about closets, endless corridors? With great sorrow I notice that instead of a correct and strictly mathematical poem in honor of the United State, I am writing a fantastic novel. Oh! if only it were a novel and not my actual life, full of X’s, square-roots of minus one and down-fallings! Yet all may be for the best. Probably you, my unknown readers, are children still as compared with us. We are brought up by the United State; consequently we have reached the highest summits attainable by man. And you, being children, may swallow without crying all the bitter things I am to give you only if they be coated with the syrup of adventures.
paras.uz: Shu yerda xayolimga bir fikr keldi. Agar o'sha dunyo faqat o'zimniki bo'lsa, nega u haqida bu qaydlarda aytib berishim kerak? Nega javonlar, cheksiz yo'laklar haqidagi bu bema'ni «tushlar»ning hammasini so'zlab berishim kerak? Katta qayg'u bilan payqaymanki, Yagona Davlat sharafiga to'g'ri va qat'iy matematik doston o'rniga men fantastik roman yozyapman. Oh! Qaniydi bu roman bo'lsa-yu, X lar, minus birning kvadrat ildizlari va qulashlarga to'la haqiqiy hayotim bo'lmasa! Lekin balki hammasi yaxshilik uchundir. Ehtimol siz, noma'lum o'quvchilarim, biz bilan solishtirganda hali bolasiz. Bizni Yagona Davlat tarbiyalagan; demak, biz inson erisha oladigan eng yuksak cho'qqilarga erishganmiz. Siz esa, bola bo'lganingiz uchun, men sizga beradigan barcha achchiq narsalarni faqat sarguzashtlar sharbati bilan qoplangan bo'lsagina yig'lamay yutishingiz mumkin.

paras.en: The Same Evening
paras.uz: O'sha kuni kechqurun

paras.en: Are you familiar with the following sensation? You are in an aero and you dash upward along a blue spiral line; the window is open and the wind rushes past your face, whistling. There is no earth. The earth is forgotten. The earth is as far from you as Venus, Saturn or Jupiter. That is how I live now. A hurricane wind beats into my face; I forget the earth, forget rosy, dear O-90. Yet the earth does exist and sooner or later I must plane down to that earth; only I close my eyes to avoid seeing the date at which there is the name O-90 written on my Tables.
paras.uz: Quyidagi tuyg'u sizga tanishmi? Siz aerodasiz va moviy spiral chiziq bo'ylab yuqoriga otilasiz; deraza ochiq va shamol yuzingiz yonidan hushtak chalib o'tadi. Yer yo'q. Yer unutilgan. Yer sizdan Venera, Saturn yoki Yupiterdek uzoq. Men hozir shunday yashayapman. Bo'ron shamoli yuzimga uriladi; men yerni unutaman, pushti, aziz O-90 ni unutaman. Lekin yer mavjud va ertami-kechmi o'sha yerga qo'nishim kerak; faqat Jadvalimda O-90 ismi yozilgan sanani ko'rmaslik uchun ko'zlarimni yumaman.

paras.en: This evening the distant earth reminded me of itself. In order to fulfill the recommendation of the doctor (I desire sincerely, most sincerely I desire to be cured), I wandered for two hours and eight minutes over the straight lines of the deserted avenues. Everybody was in the auditoriums, in accordance with the Table. Only I, cut off from the rest, I was alone. Strictly speaking, it was a very unnatural situation. Imagine a finger cut off from the whole, from the hand; a separate human finger, somewhat hunched, running over the glass sidewalk. I was such a finger. What seemed most strange and unnatural was that the finger had no desire to be with its hand, with its fellows. I want either to be alone or with her; to transfuse my whole being into hers through a contact with her shoulder or through our interwoven fingers.
paras.uz: Bugun kechqurun uzoqdagi yer o'zini eslatdi. Shifokorning tavsiyasini bajarish uchun (men samimiy, eng samimiy ravishda tuzalishni istayman) huvillab qolgan prospektlarning to'g'ri chiziqlari bo'ylab ikki soat sakkiz daqiqa kezdim. Jadvalga ko'ra hamma auditoriyalarda edi. Faqat men, qolganlardan uzilgan holda, yolg'iz edim. Aslini olganda, bu juda g'ayritabiiy vaziyat edi. Butundan, qo'ldan kesib olingan barmoqni tasavvur qiling; shisha trotuar ustida yugurib ketayotgan, biroz bukchaygan alohida inson barmog'i. Men shunday barmoq edim. Eng g'alati va g'ayritabiiy tuyulgani shu ediki, barmoq o'z qo'li bilan, o'z hamrohlari bilan bo'lishni istamasdi. Men yo yolg'iz bo'lishni, yo u bilan bo'lishni istayman; butun vujudimni uning yelkasiga tegish yoki chirmashgan barmoqlarimiz orqali uning vujudiga quyishni istayman.

paras.en: I came home as the sun was setting. The pink dust of evening was covering the glass of the walls, the golden peak of the Accumulating Tower, the voices and smiles of the Numbers. Is it not strange: the passing rays of the evening sun fall to the earth at the same angle as the awakening rays of the morning, yet they make everything seem so different; the pink tinge is different. At sunset it is so quiet, somewhat melancholy; at sunrise it is resounding, boisterous.
paras.uz: Quyosh botayotganda uyga keldim. Kechki pushti chang devorlar shishasini, Jamg'arma Minorasining oltin cho'qqisini, Raqamlarning ovozlari va tabassumlarini qoplardi. G'alati emasmi: kechki quyoshning o'tib ketayotgan nurlari yerga ertalabki uyg'otuvchi nurlar bilan bir xil burchak ostida tushadi, lekin hamma narsani shunchalik boshqacha ko'rsatadi; pushti tus boshqacha. Quyosh botganda shunchalik sokin, biroz g'amgin; quyosh chiqqanda esa jarangdor, shovqinli.

paras.en: In the hall downstairs when I entered, I saw U-, the controller. She took a letter from the heaps of envelopes covered with pink dust and handed it to me. I repeat: she is a very respectable woman and I am sure she has only the very best feelings towards me.⁠ ⁠… Yet, every time I see those cheeks hanging down, which look like the gills of a fish, I.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Kirganimda pastdagi zalda nazoratchi Yu- ni ko'rdim. U pushti chang bilan qoplangan konvertlar uyumidan bir xatni olib, menga uzatdi. Takrorlayman: u juda hurmatli ayol va ishonamanki, menga nisbatan faqat eng yaxshi tuyg'ularga ega... Lekin har safar baliqning jabralariga o'xshab osilib turgan o'sha yonoqlarni ko'rganimda men...

paras.en: Holding out her dry hand with the letter, U- sighed. But that sigh only very slightly moved in me the curtains which separate me from the rest of the world. I was completely projected upon the envelope which trembled in my hand. I had no doubt but that it was a letter from I-330.
paras.uz: Xatni quruq qo'lida uzatarkan, Yu- xo'rsindi. Lekin o'sha xo'rsinish meni dunyoning qolgan qismidan ajratib turuvchi pardalarni juda oz qimirlatdi. Men butunlay qo'limda titrayotgan konvertga qaratilgan edim. Bu I-330 dan kelgan xat ekaniga shubham yo'q edi.

paras.en: At that moment I heard another sigh, such a deliberate one, underscored with two lines, that I raised my eyes from the envelope and saw a tender, cloudy smile coming from between the gills, through the bashful jalousies of lowered eyes. And then:
paras.uz: O'sha lahzada yana bir xo'rsinishni eshitdim, shunchalik qasddan, ikki chiziq bilan tagiga chizilgan xo'rsinishki, ko'zlarimni konvertdan ko'tardim va jabralar orasidan, tushirilgan ko'zlarning uyatchan jalyuzilari orqali chiqayotgan mayin, bulutli tabassumni ko'rdim. Keyin esa:

paras.en: “You poor, poor, dear!⁠ ⁠…” a sigh underscored with three lines, and a glance at the letter, an imperceptible glance. (What was in the letter she naturally knew, ex officio.)
paras.uz: «Bechora, bechora, azizim!..» — uch chiziq bilan tagiga chizilgan xo'rsinish va xatga bir qarash, sezilmas qarash. (Xatda nima borligini u, tabiiyki, ex officio bilardi.)

paras.en: “No, really?⁠ ⁠… Why?”
paras.uz: «Yo'q, rostdanmi?.. Nega?»

paras.en: “No, no, dear, I know better than you. For a long time I have watched you and I see that you need someone with years of experience of life to accompany you.”
paras.uz: «Yo'q, yo'q, azizim, men sizdan yaxshiroq bilaman. Ancha vaqtdan beri sizni kuzatib yuraman va sizga hamroh bo'ladigan, yillar davomida hayot tajribasiga ega biror kishi kerakligini ko'ryapman».

paras.en: I felt all pasted around by her smile. It was like a plaster upon the wounds which were to be inflicted upon me by the letter I held in my hand. Finally, through the bashful jalousies of her eyes, she said in a very low voice: “I shall think about it, dear. I shall think it over. And be sure that if I feel myself strong enough⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Uning tabassumi bilan butun atrofim yopishtirilgandek his qildim. Bu qo'limdagi xat menga yetkazadigan yaralar ustiga qo'yilgan plastirga o'xshardi. Nihoyat, ko'zlarining uyatchan jalyuzilari orqali u juda past ovozda dedi: «Men bu haqda o'ylab ko'raman, azizim. O'ylab ko'raman. Va ishonchingiz komil bo'lsinki, agar o'zimni yetarlicha kuchli his qilsam...»

paras.en: “Great Well-Doer! Is it possible that my lot is?⁠ ⁠… Is it possible that she means to say, that she?⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Buyuk Homiy! Nahotki mening qismatim?.. Nahotki u aytmoqchi bo'lsa, u?..»

paras.en: My eyes were dimmed and filled with thousands of sinusoids; the letter was trembling. I went near the light, to the wall. There the light of the sun was going out; from the sun was falling thicker and thicker the dark, sad, pink dust, covering the floor, my hands, the letter. I opened the envelope and found the signature as fast as I could⁠—the first wound! It was not I-330; it was O-90! And another wound: in the right-hand corner a slovenly splash⁠—a blot! I cannot bear blots. It matters little whether they are made by ink or by⁠ ⁠… well, it matters not by what. Heretofore, such a blot would have had only a disagreeable effect, disagreeable to the eyes; but now⁠—why did that small gray blot seem to be like a cloud and seem to spread about me a leaden, bluish darkness? Or was it again the “soul” at work? Here is a transcript of the letter:
paras.uz: Ko'zlarim xiralashib, minglab sinusoidalar bilan to'ldi; xat titrardi. Yorug'likka, devor yoniga bordim. U yerda quyosh nuri so'nib borardi; quyoshdan tobora qalinroq qorong'i, g'amgin, pushti chang tushib, polni, qo'llarimni, xatni qoplardi. Konvertni ochdim va imzoni iloji boricha tez topdim — birinchi yara! Bu I-330 emas edi; bu O-90 edi! Va yana bir yara: o'ng burchakda shalaqi sachragan dog' — siyoh dog'i! Men dog'larga chiday olmayman. Ular siyoh bilanmi yoki... xo'sh, nima bilan bo'lishining ahamiyati yo'q. Ilgari bunday dog' faqat yoqimsiz ta'sir qilgan bo'lardi, ko'zga yoqimsiz; lekin endi — nega o'sha kichkina kulrang dog' bulutdek tuyulib, atrofimga qo'rg'oshindek, ko'kimtir zulmat yoydi? Yoki bu yana «ruh»ning ishimidi? Mana xatning nusxasi:

paras.en: “You know, or perhaps you don’t⁠ ⁠… I cannot write well. Little it matters! Now you know that without you there is for me not a single day, a single morning, a single spring, for R- is only⁠ ⁠… well, that is of no importance to you. At any rate, I am very grateful to him, for without him, alone all these days, I don’t know what would.⁠ ⁠… During these last few days and nights I have lived through ten years, or perhaps twenty years. My room seemed to me not square but round; I walk around without end, round after round, always the same thing, not a door to escape through. I cannot live without you because I love you; and I should not, I cannot be with you any more⁠—because I love you! Because I see and I understand that you need no one now, no one in the world save that other, and you must realize that it is precisely because I love you I must⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: «Bilasizmi, yoki balki bilmassiz... Men yaxshi yoza olmayman. Ahamiyati yo'q! Endi bilasizki, sizsiz men uchun bironta kun, bironta tong, bironta bahor yo'q, chunki R- faqat... xo'sh, bu siz uchun muhim emas. Har holda, men undan juda minnatdorman, chunki usiz, shu kunlar davomida yolg'iz qolganimda nima bo'lardi, bilmayman... So'nggi bir necha kun va tunlarda men o'n yil, balki yigirma yilni boshdan kechirdim. Xonam menga to'rtburchak emas, dumaloq tuyuldi; men oxirsiz aylanib yuraman, aylana ortidan aylana, doim bir xil narsa, qochib chiqadigan bironta eshik yo'q. Men sizsiz yashay olmayman, chunki sizni sevaman; va men siz bilan endi bo'lmasligim kerak, bo'la olmayman — chunki sizni sevaman! Chunki ko'ryapman va tushunyapmanki, sizga endi hech kim, dunyoda o'sha boshqasidan boshqa hech kim kerak emas, va siz tushunishingiz kerakki, aynan sizni sevganim uchun men...

paras.en: “I need another two or three days in order to paste together the fragments of myself and thus restore at least something similar to the O-90 of old. Then I shall go myself, and myself I shall state that I take your name from my list, and this will be better for you; you must feel happy now. I shall never again.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «O'zimning parchalarimni yopishtirib, avvalgi O-90 ga o'xshash hech bo'lmasa biror narsani tiklash uchun menga yana ikki-uch kun kerak. Keyin o'zim boraman va o'zim sizning ismingizni ro'yxatimdan o'chirishimni bildiraman, bu siz uchun yaxshiroq bo'ladi; siz endi baxtli bo'lishingiz kerak. Men endi hech qachon...»

paras.en: “Goodbye, O-.”
paras.uz: «Xayr, O-».

paras.en: Never again. Yes, that is better. She is right. But, why then?⁠ ⁠… Why then?⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Endi hech qachon. Ha, bu yaxshiroq. U haq. Lekin unda nega?.. Unda nega?..

gloss.ex: …unable any more to distinguish what is dream from what is actuality; irrational numbers grow through my solid, habitual, tri-dimensional life; and instead of f…
…t of the logical confusion. It looked to me like that strange and sad debris beyond the Green Wall; my logical debris too, is filled with extraordinary, incompr…
…-90! And another wound: in the right-hand corner a slovenly splash⁠—a blot! I cannot bear blots. It matters little whether they are made by ink or by⁠ ⁠… well,…
…ll the bitter things I am to give you only if they be coated with the syrup of adventures.
…st, and this will be better for you; you must feel happy now. I shall never again.⁠ ⁠…”

quiz.q: Who wrote the letter D-503 received?
quiz.why_uz: U I-330 dan deb o'ylaydi, lekin xat O-90 dan.

quiz.q: What does O-90 decide in the letter?
o: To take his name off her list
quiz.why_uz: U ortiq u bilan bo'lmaslikka qaror qiladi.

chapters.recap_uz: D-503 tush va haqiqatni ajrata olmaydi; √-1 va «ruh» haqida o'ylaydi. Kechqurun Yu- unga O-90 dan xat beradi: O-90 uni ro'yxatidan o'chirishini yozadi.

chapters.title: The infinitesimal of the third order — From under the forehead — Over the railing
chapters.title_uz: Uchinchi tartibli cheksiz kichik miqdor — Peshona ostidan — Panjaradan oshib

paras.en: There in the strange corridor lighted by the dotted line of dim little electric lamps⁠ ⁠… or no, no, later, when we had already reached one of the nooks in the courtyard of the Ancient House, she said, “Day-after-tomorrow.” That “day-after-tomorrow” is today. And everything seems to have wings and to fly; the day flies; and our Integral too already has wings. We finished placing the motor and tried it out today, without switching it in. What magnificent, powerful salvos! Each of them sounded for me like a salute in honor of her, the only one⁠—in honor of today!
paras.uz: O'sha yerda, xira kichkina elektr chiroqlarining nuqtali chizig'i bilan yoritilgan g'alati yo'lakda... yoki yo'q, yo'q, keyinroq, biz allaqachon Qadimiy Uy hovlisidagi burchaklardan biriga yetib kelganimizda, u: «Indinga», degan edi. O'sha «indinga» — bugun. Va hamma narsaning qanotlari bordek, uchayotgandek tuyuladi; kun uchadi; bizning Integralimizning ham allaqachon qanotlari bor. Biz dvigatelni o'rnatishni tugatdik va bugun uni ulamasdan sinab ko'rdik. Qanday ulug'vor, qudratli zarbalar! Ularning har biri men uchun uning, yagonasining sharafiga — bugungi kun sharafiga otilgan salyutdek yangradi!

paras.en: At the time of the first explosion about a dozen loafing Numbers from the docks stood near the main tube⁠—and nothing was left of them save a few crumbs and a little soot. With pride I write down now that this occurrence did not disturb the rhythm of our work even for a second. Not a man shrank. We and our lathes continued our rectilinear or curved motions with the same sparkling and polished precision as before, as if nothing had happened. As a matter of fact, what did happen? A dozen Numbers represent hardly one hundred millionth part of the United State. For practical consideration, that is but an infinitesimal of the third order. That pity, a result of arithmetical ignorance, was known to the ancients; to us it seems absurd.
paras.uz: Birinchi portlash paytida stapeldagi o'nga yaqin bekorchi Raqam asosiy quvur yonida turgan edi — ulardan bir necha uvoq va ozgina qurumdan boshqa hech narsa qolmadi. Endi faxr bilan yozamanki, bu voqea ishimiz ritmini bir soniyaga ham buzmadi. Hech kim cho'chimadi. Biz va dastgohlarimiz to'g'ri chiziqli yoki egri harakatlarimizni avvalgidek yaltiroq va silliqlangan aniqlik bilan, go'yo hech narsa bo'lmagandek davom ettirdik. Aslini olganda, nima bo'ldi o'zi? O'nta Raqam Yagona Davlatning yuz milliondan bir qismini zo'rg'a tashkil qiladi. Amaliy jihatdan bu uchinchi tartibli cheksiz kichik miqdor, xolos. Arifmetik johillik natijasi bo'lgan o'sha achinish qadimgilarga ma'lum edi; bizga esa u bema'ni tuyuladi.

paras.en: It seems droll to me also, that yesterday I was thinking, even relating in these pages about a gray blot! All that was only the “softening of the surface” which is normally as hard as diamond, like our walls. (There is an ancient saying: “Shooting beans at a stone wall⁠—”)
paras.uz: Kecha men kulrang dog' haqida o'ylab, hatto bu sahifalarda aytib bergan bo'lganim ham menga kulgili tuyuladi! Bularning hammasi odatda bizning devorlarimiz kabi olmosdek qattiq bo'lgan «yuzaning yumshashi» edi, xolos. (Qadimiy maqol bor: «Tosh devorga no'xat otish —»)

paras.en: Sixteen o’clock. I did not go for the supplementary walk; who knows, she might come now, when the sun is so noisily bright.
paras.uz: Soat o'n olti. Qo'shimcha sayrga bormadim; kim biladi, quyosh shunchalik shovqinli yorqin bo'lgan hozir u kelib qolishi mumkin.

paras.en: I am almost the only one in his room. Through the walls full of sunshine I see for a distance to the right and to the left and below strings of other rooms, repeating each other as if in a mirror, hanging in the air and empty. Only on the bluish stairway, striped by the golden ink of the sun, is seen rising a thin, gray shadow. Already I hear steps, and I see through the door and I feel a smile pasted to my face like a plaster. But it passed to another stairway and down. The click of the switchboard! I threw myself to that little white slit and⁠ ⁠… an unfamiliar male Number! (A consonant means a male Number.)
paras.uz: Men o'z xonasidagi deyarli yagona odamman. Quyoshga to'la devorlar orqali o'ngga, chapga va pastga uzoqqa qarab, havoda osilib turgan, bir-birini go'yo ko'zguda takrorlayotgan bo'm-bo'sh boshqa xonalar qatorlarini ko'raman. Faqat quyoshning oltin siyohi bilan chiziqlangan ko'kimtir zinapoyada yupqa, kulrang soya ko'tarilayotgani ko'rinadi. Allaqachon qadamlarni eshitaman va eshik orqali ko'raman va yuzimga plastirdek yopishgan tabassumni his qilaman. Lekin u boshqa zinapoyaga o'tib, pastga tushib ketdi. Kommutatorning chiqillashi! O'sha kichkina oq tirqishga o'zimni otdim va... notanish erkak Raqam! (Undosh harf erkak Raqamni bildiradi.)

paras.en: The elevator groaned and stopped. A big, slovenly, slanting forehead stood before me, and the eyes⁠ ⁠… They impressed me strangely; it seemed as if the man talked with his eyes which were deep under the forehead.
paras.uz: Lift ingrab, to'xtadi. Ro'paramda katta, shalaqi, qiya peshona turardi, ko'zlari esa... Ular menga g'alati ta'sir qildi; go'yo bu odam peshonasi ostida chuqur joylashgan ko'zlari bilan gapirayotgandek edi.

paras.en: “Here is a letter from her, for you.” (From under the awning of that forehead.) “She asked that everything⁠ ⁠… as requested in the letter⁠ ⁠… without fail.” This too, from under the forehead, from under the awning, and he turned, looked about.
paras.uz: «Mana sizga undan xat». (O'sha peshona soyaboni ostidan.) «U hamma narsani... xatda so'ralgandek... albatta bajarishingizni so'radi». Buni ham peshona ostidan, soyabon ostidan aytdi va o'girilib, atrofga qaradi.

paras.en: “No, there is nobody, nobody. Quickly! the letter!”
paras.uz: «Yo'q, hech kim yo'q, hech kim. Tezroq! Xatni!»

paras.en: He put the letter in my hand and went out without a word.
paras.uz: U xatni qo'limga qo'ydi va indamay chiqib ketdi.

paras.en: A pink check fell out of the envelope. It was hers, her check! Her tender perfume! I felt like running to catch up with that wonderful under-the-forehead one. A tiny note followed the check from the envelope; three lines: “The check⁠ ⁠… Lower the curtains without fail, as if I were actually with you. It is necessary that they should think that I⁠ ⁠… I am very, very sorry.”
paras.uz: Konvertdan pushti chipta tushdi. Bu uniki, uning chiptasi edi! Uning nozik atiri! O'sha ajoyib peshona-ostiga yetib olish uchun yugurgim keldi. Chiptadan keyin konvertdan kichkina yozuv chiqdi; uch satr: «Chipta... Pardalarni albatta tushiring, go'yo men haqiqatan siz bilan birga bo'lgandek. Ular meni... deb o'ylashlari zarur. Juda, juda afsusdaman».

paras.en: I tore the note into small bits. A glance at the mirror revealed my distorted, broken eyebrows. I took the check and was ready to do with it as I had done with the note. “She asked that everything⁠ ⁠… as requested in the letter⁠ ⁠… without fail.” My arms weakened and the hands loosened. The check was back on the table. She is stronger than I, stronger than I. It seemed as though I were going to act as she wished. Besides⁠ ⁠… however, it is a long time before evening.
paras.uz: Yozuvni mayda bo'laklarga yirtib tashladim. Ko'zguga bir qarash buzilgan, singan qoshlarimni ko'rsatdi. Chiptani olib, unga ham yozuvga qilganimdek qilishga tayyor edim. «U hamma narsani... xatda so'ralgandek... albatta bajarishingizni so'radi». Qo'llarim bo'shashib, barmoqlarim yozildi. Chipta yana stolda edi. U mendan kuchliroq, mendan kuchliroq. Go'yo men u istagandek harakat qiladigandek edim. Bundan tashqari... ammo kechgacha hali uzoq.

paras.en: The check remained on the table. In the mirror⁠—my distorted, broken eyebrows. Oh, why did I not have a doctor’s certificate for today? I should like to go and walk, walk without end around the Green Wall and then to fall on my bed⁠ ⁠… to the bottom of.⁠ ⁠… Yet I had to go to Auditorium No. 13, and I should have to grip myself, so as to bear up for two hours! Two hours without motion, at a time when I wanted to scream and stamp my feet!
paras.uz: Chipta stolda qoldi. Ko'zguda — buzilgan, singan qoshlarim. Oh, nega bugun uchun shifokor guvohnomam yo'q edi? Borib yurgim, Yashil Devor atrofida oxirsiz yurgim, keyin karavotimga yiqilgim keldi... tubiga... Lekin men 13-Auditoriyaga borishim kerak edi va ikki soat bardosh berish uchun o'zimni mahkam ushlashim kerak edi! Qichqirgim va oyoqlarimni tepingim kelgan paytda ikki soat qimirlamay!

paras.en: The lecture was on. It was very strange to hear from the sparkling tube of the phono-lecturer not the usual metallic voice but a soft, velvety, mossy one. It was a woman’s voice and I seemed to have a vision of the woman: a little hook-like old woman, like the one of the Ancient House.
paras.uz: Ma'ruza boshlandi. Fono-ma'ruzachining yaltiroq quvuridan odatdagi metall ovoz emas, yumshoq, baxmaldek, moxdek ovozni eshitish juda g'alati edi. Bu ayol ovozi edi va men go'yo o'sha ayolni ko'rgandek bo'ldim: Qadimiy Uydagi kampirga o'xshash kichkina, ilmoqdek kampir.

paras.en: The Ancient House! Suddenly from within me a powerful fountain of.⁠ ⁠… I had to use all my strength to control myself, so as not to fill the auditorium with screams. The soft mossy words were piercing me, yet only empty words about children and child-production reached my ear. I was like a photographic plate: everything was making its imprint with a strange, senseless precision on me; the golden scythe which was nothing more than the reflection of light from the megaphone of the lecture apparatus, under the megaphone a child, a living illustration. It was leaning toward the megaphone, the angle of its infinitesimal unif in its mouth, its little fist clenched firmly, its thumb squeezed into the fist, a light fluffy pleat of skin at the wrist. Like a photographic plate I was taking the impression of all this. Now I saw how its naked leg hung over the edge of the platform, the pink fan of its finger waved in the air.⁠ ⁠… One minute more, one second and the child would be on the floor!
paras.uz: Qadimiy Uy! To'satdan ichimdan qudratli bir favvora... Auditoriyani qichqiriqlarga to'ldirib yubormaslik uchun o'zimni tutishga butun kuchimni ishlatishim kerak edi. Yumshoq moxdek so'zlar meni teshib o'tardi, lekin qulog'imga faqat bolalar va bola tug'ish haqidagi quruq so'zlar yetib kelardi. Men fotoplastinkaga o'xshardim: hamma narsa menda g'alati, ma'nosiz aniqlik bilan iz qoldirardi; ma'ruza apparatining karnayidan tushayotgan nur aksidan boshqa narsa bo'lmagan oltin o'roq, karnay ostida bola, tirik illyustratsiya. U karnayga engashgan edi, cheksiz kichik yunifasining burchagi og'zida, kichkina mushtini mahkam qisgan, bosh barmog'i mushtiga qisilgan, bilagida terining yengil momiq burmasi. Men fotoplastinkadek bularning hammasini muhrlab olardim. Endi uning yalang'och oyog'i minbar chetidan osilib turganini, barmoqlarining pushti yelpig'ichi havoda silkinayotganini ko'rdim... Yana bir daqiqa, bir soniya va bola polga tushadi!

paras.en: A female’s scream, a wave of translucent wings, her unif on the platform! She caught the child, her lips clung to the fluffy pleat of the baby’s wrist; she moved the child to the middle of the table and left the platform. The imprints were registering in me: a pink crescent of a mouth, the horns downward! Eyes like small blue saucers filled with liquid! It was O-90. And as if reading a consequential formula, I suddenly felt the necessity, the naturalness of that insignificant occurrence.
paras.uz: Ayolning qichqirig'i, shaffof qanotlarning bir silkinishi, uning yunifasi minbarda! U bolani ushlab oldi, lablari chaqaloq bilagining momiq burmasiga yopishdi; bolani stolning o'rtasiga surib qo'yib, minbardan tushdi. Izlar menda qayd etilardi: og'izning pushti yarim oyi, shoxlari pastga qaragan! Suyuqlik bilan to'ldirilgan kichkina moviy likopchalardek ko'zlar! Bu O-90 edi. Va go'yo mantiqiy formulani o'qiyotgandek, men to'satdan o'sha arzimas voqeaning zarurligini, tabiiyligini his qildim.

paras.en: She sat down behind me, somewhat to my left. I looked back. She quietly removed her gaze from the table and the child and looked straight into me. Within again: She, I, the table on the platform⁠—three points: and through those three points lines were drawn, a projection of some as yet unforeseen events!
paras.uz: U mening orqamga, biroz chap tomonimga o'tirdi. Men orqaga qaradim. U jimgina nigohini stol va boladan olib, to'g'ri menga qaradi. Ichimda yana: U, men, minbardagi stol — uch nuqta: va o'sha uch nuqta orqali chiziqlar o'tkazildi, hali oldindan ko'rilmagan qandaydir voqealarning proyeksiyasi!

paras.en: Then I went home through the green dusky street which seemed many-eyed because of the electric lights. I heard myself tick-tocking like a clock. And the hands of that clock seemed to be about to pass a figure: I was going to do something, something that would cut off every way of retreat. She wants somebody, whom I do not know, to think she is with me. I want her; what do I care what she wants? I do not want to be alone behind the curtains and that is all there is to it!
paras.uz: Keyin elektr chiroqlari tufayli ko'p ko'zli tuyulgan yashil, g'ira-shira ko'cha bo'ylab uyga ketdim. O'zimning soatdek tiq-tiqlayotganimni eshitardim. Va o'sha soatning millari bir raqamdan o'tib ketmoqchi bo'lgandek edi: men nimadir qilmoqchi edim, chekinishning barcha yo'llarini kesib tashlaydigan nimadir. U men bilmaydigan kimdir uni men bilan birga deb o'ylashini istaydi. Men uni istayman; u nimani istashining menga nima ahamiyati bor? Men pardalar ortida yolg'iz qolishni istamayman, gap shunda!

paras.en: From behind came sounds of a familiar gait, like splashing in a ditch. I did not need to look back, I knew it was S-. He would follow me to the very door, probably. Then he would stay below on the sidewalk, and he would try to drill upward into my room with his boring eyes, until the curtains would fall, concealing something criminal.
paras.uz: Orqadan go'yo ariqda shalpillayotgandek tanish yurish tovushlari keldi. Orqaga qarashim shart emas edi, bu S- ekanini bilardim. Ehtimol, u meni eshikkacha kuzatib boradi. Keyin pastda, trotuarda qoladi va pardalar tushib, nimadir jinoiy narsani yashirmaguncha, parma ko'zlari bilan xonamga yuqoriga burg'ilab kirishga urinadi.

paras.en: Was he my Guardian-Angel? No! My decision was made.
paras.uz: U mening Farishta-Qo'riqchimmidi? Yo'q! Mening qarorim qabul qilingan edi.

paras.en: When I came into my room and turned on the light, I could not believe my eyes! O-90 stood at my table, or to be more exact, she was hanging like a creased empty dress. She seemed to have no tensity, no spring beneath the dress; her arms and legs were springless, her voice was hanging and springless.
paras.uz: Xonamga kirib, chiroqni yoqqanimda ko'zlarimga ishonmadim! Stolim yonida O-90 turardi, aniqrog'i, burishgan bo'sh ko'ylakdek osilib turardi. Ko'ylagi ostida hech qanday taranglik, hech qanday prujina yo'qdek edi; qo'llari va oyoqlari prujinasiz, ovozi osilib qolgan va prujinasiz edi.

paras.en: “About my letter, did you receive it? Yes? I must know your answer, I must⁠—today.”
paras.uz: «Xatim haqida, oldingizmi? Ha? Men javobingizni bilishim kerak, bilishim kerak — bugun».

paras.en: I shrugged my shoulders. I enjoyed looking into her blue eyes which were filled with tears as if she were the guilty one. I lingered over my answer. With pleasure I pricked her:
paras.uz: Men yelka qisdim. Go'yo u aybdordek yoshlarga to'lgan uning moviy ko'zlariga qarashdan rohatlanardim. Javobimni cho'zdim. Rohat bilan uni sanchidim:

paras.en: “Answer? Well.⁠ ⁠… You are right. Undoubtedly. In everything.”
paras.uz: «Javob? Xo'sh... Siz haqsiz. Shubhasiz. Hamma narsada».

paras.en: “Then⁠ ⁠…” (She tried to cover the minute tremor with a smile but it did not escape me.) “Well, all right. I shall⁠ ⁠… I shall leave you at once.”
paras.uz: «Unda...» (U kichkina titroqni tabassum bilan yashirmoqchi bo'ldi, lekin bu mendan qochib qutulmadi.) «Xo'p, mayli. Men... men sizni hoziroq tark etaman».

paras.en: Yet she remained drooping over the table. Drooping eyelids, drooping arms and legs. The pink check of the other was still on the table. I quickly opened this manuscript, We, and with its pages I covered the check, trying to hide it from myself, rather than from O-.
paras.uz: Lekin u stol ustiga osilganicha qoldi. Osilgan qovoqlar, osilgan qo'llar va oyoqlar. Boshqasining pushti chiptasi hali stolda edi. Men tezda bu qo'lyozmani — «Biz»ni ochdim va uning sahifalari bilan chiptani yopdim, uni O- dan emas, ko'proq o'zimdan yashirishga urinib.

paras.en: “See, here, I am still busy writing. Already 101 pages! Something quite unexpected comes out in this writing.”
paras.uz: «Mana, ko'ryapsizmi, men hali ham yozish bilan bandman. Allaqachon 101 sahifa! Bu yozuvda mutlaqo kutilmagan narsa chiqyapti».

paras.en: In a voice, in a shadow of a voice, “And do you remember⁠ ⁠… how the other day I⁠ ⁠… on the seventh page⁠ ⁠… and it dropped.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Ovozda, ovozning soyasida: «Esingizdami... o'tgan kuni men... yettinchi sahifada... va u tomchilab tushdi...»

paras.en: The tiny blue saucers filled to the borders; silently and rapidly the tears ran down her cheeks. And suddenly, like the dropping of the tears⁠—rushing forth⁠—words:
paras.uz: Kichkina moviy likopchalar to'lib-toshdi; ko'z yoshlar jimgina va tez yonoqlaridan oqib tushdi. Va to'satdan, ko'z yoshlarining tomchilashi kabi — otilib chiqib — so'zlar:

paras.en: “I cannot⁠ ⁠… I shall leave you in a moment. I shall never again⁠ ⁠… and I don’t care.⁠ ⁠… Only I want, I must have a child! From you! Give me a child and I will leave. I will!”
paras.uz: «Men qila olmayman... Bir lahzada sizni tark etaman. Men endi hech qachon... va menga baribir... Faqat men istayman, menga bola kerak! Sizdan! Menga bola bering va men ketaman. Ketaman!»

paras.en: I saw she was trembling all over beneath her unif, and I felt⁠ ⁠… I too, would soon⁠ ⁠… would.⁠ ⁠… I put my hands behind my back and smiled.
paras.uz: Uning yunifasi ostida butun vujudi titrayotganini ko'rdim va his qildim... men ham tez orada... o'zimni...' Qo'llarimni orqamga qo'yib, jilmaydim.

paras.en: “What? You desire to go under the Machine of the Well-Doer?”
paras.uz: «Nima? Homiy Mashinasi ostiga tushishni istaysizmi?»

paras.en: Like a stream her words ran over the dam.
paras.uz: Uning so'zlari oqimdek to'g'on osha oqib o'tdi.

paras.en: “I don’t care. I shall feel it for a while within me. I want to see, to see only once the little fold of skin here at the wrist, like that one on the table in the Auditorium. Only for one day!”
paras.uz: «Menga baribir. Men uni bir muddat ichimda his qilaman. Men ko'rishni, faqat bir marta bu yerda, bilakdagi terining kichkina burmasini ko'rishni istayman, xuddi Auditoriyadagi stol ustidagisidek. Faqat bir kunga!»

paras.en: Three points: she, I and a little fist with a fluffy fold of skin there on the table!
paras.uz: Uch nuqta: u, men va u yerda stol ustidagi momiq teri burmali kichkina musht!

paras.en: I remember how once when I was a child they took me up on the Accumulating Tower. At the very top I bent over the glass railing of an opening in the Tower. Below people seemed like dots; my heart contracted sweetly. “What if.⁠ ⁠…” On that occasion I only clenched my hands around the railing; now I jumped over.
paras.uz: Esimda, bir marta bolaligimda meni Jamg'arma Minorasiga olib chiqishgan edi. Eng tepasida Minoradagi bir tuynukning shisha panjarasiga engashdim. Pastda odamlar nuqtalardek ko'rinardi; yuragim shirin siqildi. «Agar...» O'shanda men faqat panjarani qo'llarim bilan mahkam ushlagan edim; endi esa sakrab o'tdim.

paras.en: “So you desire⁠ ⁠… being perfectly aware that⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Demak, siz istaysiz... ... ekanini to'liq bila turib...»

paras.en: Her eyes were closed as if the sun were beating straight into her face. A wet, shining smile!
paras.uz: Uning ko'zlari go'yo quyosh to'g'ri yuziga urilayotgandek yumuq edi. Nam, yaltiroq tabassum!

paras.en: “Yes, yes! I want it!”
paras.uz: «Ha, ha! Men buni istayman!»

paras.en: Quickly I took out the pink check of the other from under the manuscript and down I went to the controller on duty. O-90 caught my hand, screamed out something, but what it was I understood only later, when I returned.
paras.uz: Tezda qo'lyozma ostidan boshqasining pushti chiptasini olib, navbatchi nazoratchining oldiga pastga tushdim. O-90 qo'limni ushlab, nimadir deb qichqirdi, lekin bu nima ekanini faqat keyinroq, qaytib kelganimda tushundim.

paras.en: She was sitting on the edge of the bed, hands firmly clasped about the knees.
paras.uz: U karavot chetida, qo'llarini tizzalari atrofida mahkam qovushtirib o'tirardi.

paras.en: “Is it, is it her check?”
paras.uz: «Bu, bu uning chiptasimi?»

paras.en: “What does it matter? Well, it is hers, yes.”
paras.uz: «Buning nima ahamiyati bor? Xo'sh, uniki, ha».

paras.en: Something cracked. It must have been the springs of the bed, for O-90 made a slight motion only. She remained sitting, her hands upon her knees.
paras.uz: Nimadir qirsilladi. Bu karavotning prujinalari bo'lsa kerak, chunki O-90 faqat ozgina qimirladi. U qo'llarini tizzalariga qo'yganicha o'tirib qoldi.

paras.en: “Well, quick.⁠ ⁠…” I roughly pressed her hand. A red spot was left on her wrist (tomorrow it would become purple), where the fluffy, infantile fold.⁠ ⁠… It was the last.⁠ ⁠… I turned the switch, my thoughts went out with the light. Darkness, a spark! and I had jumped over the railing, down.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: «Xo'sh, tezroq...» Men uning qo'lini qo'pol siqdim. Bilagida qizil dog' qoldi (ertaga u binafsha rangga kiradi), o'sha yerda momiq, bolalarcha burma... Bu oxirgisi edi... Kalitni burdim, fikrlarim yorug'lik bilan birga o'chdi. Zulmat, uchqun! Va men panjara osha sakrab, pastga tushib ketgan edim...

quiz.q: What does O-90 ask D-503 for?
quiz.why_uz: U Normadan past bo'lgani uchun bola tug'ishi man etilgan.

quiz.q: How does D-503 react when ten Numbers die in the motor test?
o: He says it is an infinitesimal of the third order
quiz.why_uz: U ularni Davlat uchun arzimas miqdor deb hisoblaydi.

chapters.recap_uz: Integral dvigateli sinaladi. I-330 xabarchi orqali pushti chipta yuborib, pardalarni tushirishni so'raydi. O-90 keladi va D-503 dan bola so'raydi; u rozi bo'ladi — bu qonunbuzarlik.

chapters.title: Discharge — The material of an idea — The zero rock

paras.en: Discharge is the best word for it. Now I see that it was actually like an electric discharge. The pulse of my last few days had been becoming dryer and dryer, more and more frequent, more intense. The opposite poles had been drawing nearer and nearer and already I could hear the dry crackling; one millimeter more, and⁠—an explosion! Then silence.
paras.uz: Razryad — buning uchun eng yaxshi so'z. Endi ko'ryapmanki, bu haqiqatan ham elektr razryadiga o'xshardi. So'nggi bir necha kunimning pulsi tobora quruqroq, tobora tezroq, tobora shiddatliroq bo'lib borardi. Qarama-qarshi qutblar tobora yaqinlashib kelardi va men allaqachon quruq chirsillashni eshitardim; yana bir millimetr va — portlash! Keyin sukunat.

paras.en: Within me there is quiet now and emptiness like that of a house after everybody has left, when one lies ill, all alone and hears so clearly the distinct, metallic, tick-tock of thoughts.
paras.uz: Ichimda endi sokinlik va bo'shliq, xuddi hamma ketib bo'lgandan keyingi uydagidek, odam kasal bo'lib, yolg'iz yotib, fikrlarning aniq, metall tiq-taqini shunchalik ravshan eshitganidagidek.

paras.en: Perhaps that “discharge” cured me at last of my torturing “soul.” Again I am like all of us. At least at this moment as I write, I can see as it were, without any pain in my mental eye, how O-90 is brought to the steps of the Cube; or I see her in the Gas Bell. And if there in the Operation Department she should give my name⁠—I do not care. Piously and gratefully I should kiss the punishing hand of the Well-Doer at the last moment. I have this right in regard to the United State: to receive my punishment. And I shall not give up this right. No Number ought, or dares, to refuse this only personal, and therefore, most precious, privilege.
paras.uz: Balki o'sha «razryad» meni nihoyat qiynoqli «ruhim»dan davoladi. Men yana hammamiz kabiman. Hech bo'lmasa shu daqiqada, yozayotganimda, ichki ko'zim bilan hech qanday og'riqsiz O-90 ni Kub zinapoyalariga olib kelishayotganini ko'ra olaman; yoki uni Gaz Qo'ng'irog'ida ko'raman. Va agar u yerda, Operatsiya Bo'limida u mening ismimni aytsa — menga baribir. Oxirgi lahzada Homiyning jazolovchi qo'lini ixlos va minnatdorlik bilan o'pardim. Yagona Davlatga nisbatan menda shu huquq bor: jazomni olish. Va men bu huquqdan voz kechmayman. Hech bir Raqam bu yagona shaxsiy va shuning uchun eng qimmatli imtiyozdan voz kechmasligi kerak, voz kechishga jur'at etmaydi.

paras.en: … Quickly, metallically, distinctly, do the thoughts rap in the head. An invisible aero carries me into the blue height of my beloved abstractions. And I see how there in the height, in the purest rarified air, my judgment about the only “right” bursts with a crack, like a pneumatic tire. I see clearly that only an atavism, the absurd superstition of the ancients, gives me this idea of “right.”
paras.uz: ...Fikrlar boshda tez, metalldek, aniq taqillaydi. Ko'rinmas aero meni sevimli abstraksiyalarimning moviy balandligiga olib chiqadi. Va men u yerda, balandlikda, eng toza siyrak havoda yagona «huquq» haqidagi mulohazam pnevmatik shinadek qarsillab yorilib ketganini ko'raman. Men aniq ko'ryapmanki, menga bu «huquq» g'oyasini faqat atavizm, qadimgilarning bema'ni xurofoti beradi.

paras.en: There are ideas of clay and ideas moulded of gold, or of our precious glass. In order to know the material of which an idea is made, one needs only to let fall upon it a drop of strong acid. One of these acids was known to the ancients under the name of reductio ad absurdum. This was the name of it, I think. But they were afraid of this poison; they preferred to believe that they saw heaven, even though it was a toy made of clay, rather than confess to themselves that it was only a blue nothing. We on the other hand (Glory to the Well-Doer!), we are adults and we have no need of toys. Now if we put a drop of acid on the idea of “right.”⁠ ⁠… Even the ancients (the most mature of them) knew that the source of right was⁠—might! Right is a function of might. Here we have our scale: on the one side an ounce, on the other a ton. On one side “I,” on the other “we,” the United State. Is it not clear? To assume that I may have any “right” as far as the State is concerned, is like assuming that an ounce may equilibrate a ton in a scale! Hence the natural distribution: tons⁠—rights, grams⁠—duties. And the natural road from nothingness to greatness, is to forget that one is a gram and to feel that one is one-millionth of a ton!
paras.uz: Loydan yasalgan g'oyalar va oltindan yoki bizning qimmatbaho shishamizdan quyilgan g'oyalar bor. G'oya qanday materialdan yasalganini bilish uchun uning ustiga bir tomchi kuchli kislota tomizish kifoya. Bu kislotalardan biri qadimgilarga reductio ad absurdum nomi bilan ma'lum edi. Menimcha, uning nomi shunday edi. Lekin ular bu zahardan qo'rqishgan; ular bu shunchaki moviy hech narsa ekanini o'zlariga tan olishdan ko'ra, garchi loydan yasalgan o'yinchoq bo'lsa ham, osmonni ko'ryapmiz deb ishonishni afzal ko'rishgan. Biz esa (Homiyga shon-sharaf!) kattalarmiz va bizga o'yinchoqlar kerak emas. Endi agar «huquq» g'oyasiga bir tomchi kislota tomizsak... Hatto qadimgilar (ularning eng yetuklari) huquqning manbai — kuch ekanini bilishgan! Huquq — kuchning funksiyasi. Mana bizning tarozimiz: bir tomonida bir unsiya, boshqa tomonida bir tonna. Bir tomonida «men», boshqa tomonida «biz», Yagona Davlat. Aniq emasmi? Davlatga nisbatan menda qandaydir «huquq» bo'lishi mumkin deb faraz qilish — tarozida bir unsiya bir tonnani muvozanatlashi mumkin deb faraz qilish bilan barobar! Shundan tabiiy taqsimot: tonnalar — huquqlar, grammlar — majburiyatlar. Hech narsalikdan buyuklikka tabiiy yo'l esa — o'zing gramm ekaningni unutish va o'zingni tonnaning milliondan biri deb his qilishdir!

paras.en: You ripe-bodied, bright Venerians; you sooty, blacksmith-like Uranians, I almost hear your protests in this silence. But only think, everything that is great is simple. Remember, only the four rules of arithmetic are unshakeable and eternal! And only that mortality will be unshakeable and eternal which is built upon those four rules. This is the superior wisdom, this is the summit of that pyramid around which people red with sweat, fought and battled for centuries trying to crawl up!
paras.uz: Siz, to'la tanali, yorqin Veneraliklar; siz, qurumli, temirchidek Uranliklar, men bu sukunatda sizning e'tirozlaringizni deyarli eshitaman. Lekin o'ylab ko'ring, buyuk narsaning hammasi oddiy. Yodda tuting, faqat arifmetikaning to'rt amali qo'zg'almas va abadiy! Va faqat o'sha to'rt amal ustiga qurilgan axloq qo'zg'almas va abadiy bo'ladi. Bu oliy donolik, bu odamlar terga botib, asrlar davomida tirmashib chiqishga urinib, kurashgan va jang qilgan o'sha piramidaning cho'qqisi!

paras.en: Looking from this summit down to the bottom, where something is still left swarming like worms, from this summit all that is left over in us from the ancients seems alike. Alike are the unlawful coming motherhood of O-90, a murder, and the insanity of that Number who dared to throw verses into the face of the United State; and alike is the judgment for them⁠—premature death. This is that divine justice of which those stone-housed ancients dreamed, lit by the naive pink rays of the dawn of history. Their “God” punished sacrilege as a capital crime.
paras.uz: Bu cho'qqidan pastga, tubga, hali ham nimadir qurtlardek g'imirlab qolgan joyga qaraganda, bu cho'qqidan bizda qadimgilardan qolgan hamma narsa bir xil ko'rinadi. O-90 ning qonunsiz bo'lajak onaligi, qotillik va Yagona Davlatning yuziga she'r otishga jur'at etgan o'sha Raqamning telbaligi bir xil; ular uchun hukm ham bir xil — muddatidan oldin o'lim. Bu tarixning tongidagi sodda pushti nurlar bilan yoritilgan o'sha tosh uylardagi qadimgilar orzu qilgan ilohiy adolatdir. Ularning «Xudosi» kufrni o'lim jazosiga loyiq jinoyat sifatida jazolagan.

paras.en: You Uranians, morose and as black as the ancient Spaniards, who were wise in knowing so well how to burn at the stake, you are silent; I think you agree with me. But I hear you, pink Venerians, saying something about “tortures, executions, return to barbarism.” My dear Venerians, I pity you! You are incapable of philosophical, mathematical thinking. Human history moves upward in circles, like an aero. The circles are at times golden, sometimes they are bloody, but all have 360 degrees. They go from 0° to 10°, 20°, 200°, 360°⁠—and then again 0°. Yes, we have returned to zero. But for a mathematically working mind it is clear that this zero is different; it is a perfectly new zero. We started from zero to the right and came to zero on the left. Hence instead of plus zero, we are at minus zero. Do you understand?
paras.uz: Siz, Uranliklar, gulxanda yoqishni shunchalik yaxshi bilganlari uchun dono bo'lgan qadimgi ispanlardek ma'yus va qora, siz jimsiz; menimcha, siz men bilan rozisiz. Lekin men sizni, pushti Veneraliklar, «qiynoqlar, qatllar, vahshiylikka qaytish» haqida nimadir deyayotganingizni eshitaman. Aziz Veneraliklarim, sizga achinaman! Siz falsafiy, matematik fikrlashga qodir emassiz. Insoniyat tarixi aerodek doiralar bo'ylab yuqoriga ko'tariladi. Doiralar ba'zan oltin, ba'zan qonli, lekin hammasida 360 daraja bor. Ular 0° dan 10° ga, 20° ga, 200° ga, 360° ga boradi — va keyin yana 0°. Ha, biz nolga qaytdik. Lekin matematik ishlaydigan aql uchun bu nol boshqacha ekani aniq; bu mutlaqo yangi nol. Biz noldan o'ngga qarab yo'lga chiqdik va chap tomondagi nolga keldik. Shuning uchun plyus nol o'rniga biz minus noldamiz. Tushunyapsizmi?

paras.en: This zero appears to me now as a silent, immense, narrow rock, sharp as a blade. In cruel darkness, holding our breath, we set sail from the black night-side of the zero rock. For centuries we, Columbuses, floated and floated; we made the circuit of the whole world and at last! Hurrah! Salute! We climbed up the masts; before us now was a new side of the zero rock, hitherto unknown, bathed in the Polar light of the United State; a blue mass covered with rainbow sparkles! Suns!⁠—a hundred suns! A million rainbows! What does it matter if we are separated from the other, black side of the zero rock only by the thickness of a blade? A knife is the most solid, the most immortal, the most inspired invention of man. The knife served on the guillotine. The knife is the universal tool for cutting knots. The way of paradoxes follows its sharp edge, the only way becoming to a fearless mind.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Bu nol menga endi sokin, ulkan, tor, tig'dek o'tkir qoya bo'lib ko'rinadi. Shafqatsiz zulmatda, nafasimizni ichimizga yutib, biz nol qoyasining qora tungi tomonidan suzib ketdik. Asrlar davomida biz, Kolumblar, suzdik va suzdik; butun dunyoni aylanib chiqdik va nihoyat! Ura! Salyut! Biz machtalarga tirmashib chiqdik; oldimizda endi nol qoyasining shu paytgacha noma'lum bo'lgan, Yagona Davlatning Qutb nuriga cho'milgan yangi tomoni turardi; kamalak uchqunlari bilan qoplangan moviy massa! Quyoshlar! — yuzta quyosh! Million kamalak! Bizni nol qoyasining boshqa, qora tomonidan faqat tig' qalinligi ajratib tursa, buning nima ahamiyati bor? Pichoq — insonning eng mustahkam, eng o'lmas, eng ilhomli ixtirosi. Pichoq gilyotinda xizmat qilgan. Pichoq — tugunlarni kesishning universal quroli. Paradokslar yo'li uning o'tkir tig'i bo'ylab o'tadi, qo'rqmas aqlga munosib yagona yo'l...

…ton in a scale! Hence the natural distribution: tons⁠—rights, grams⁠—duties. And the natural road from nothingness to greatness, is to forget that one is a gra…
