…zero appears to me now as a silent, immense, narrow rock, sharp as a blade. In cruel darkness, holding our breath, we set sail from the black night-side of the…

quiz.q: According to D-503, where does 'right' come from?
quiz.why_uz: «Huquq — kuchning funksiyasi».

quiz.q: What does he compare the individual to?
quiz.why_uz: Men — gramm, Davlat — tonna.

chapters.recap_uz: D-503 o'zini «razryad»dan keyin tuzalgan deb his qiladi. U huquq va kuch, plyus va minus nol haqida mulohaza yuritadi: Davlat — tonna, men — gramm.

chapters.title: The duty of an author — The ice-swells — The most difficult love
chapters.title_uz: Muallifning burchi — Muzning bo'rtishi — Eng qiyin muhabbat

paras.en: Yesterday was her day and again she did not come. Again there came her incoherent note, explaining nothing. But I am tranquil, perfectly tranquil. If I do act as I am told to in the note, if I do go to the controller on duty, produce the pink check and then, having lowered the curtains if I do sit alone in my room, I do all this of course not because I have no power to act contrary to her desire. It seems funny? Decidedly not! It is quite simple: separated from all curative, plaster-like smiles I am enabled quietly to write these very lines. This first. And second: I am afraid to lose in her, in I-330, perhaps the only clue I shall ever have to the understanding of all the unknowns, like the story of the cupboard, or my temporary death, for instance. To understand, to discover these unknowns as the author of these records, I feel it simply my duty. Moreover, the unknown is naturally the enemy of man. And Homo Sapiens only then becomes Man in the complete sense of the word, when his punctuation includes no question marks, only exclamation points, commas and periods.
paras.uz: Kecha uning kuni edi va u yana kelmadi. Yana uning hech narsani tushuntirmaydigan bog'liqsiz yozuvi keldi. Lekin men xotirjamman, mutlaqo xotirjamman. Agar men yozuvda aytilgandek harakat qilsam, navbatchi nazoratchining oldiga borib, pushti chiptani ko'rsatsam va keyin pardalarni tushirib, xonamda yolg'iz o'tirsam, bularning hammasini, albatta, uning istagiga qarshi harakat qilishga kuchim yo'qligi uchun qilmayman. Kulgili tuyuladimi? Aslo yo'q! Bu juda oddiy: barcha davolovchi, plastirdek tabassumlardan ajralgan holda men aynan shu satrlarni xotirjam yoza olaman. Bu birinchidan. Ikkinchidan: men unda, I-330 da, barcha noma'lumlarni, masalan, javon voqeasini yoki vaqtinchalik o'limimni tushunish uchun ega bo'ladigan, ehtimol, yagona kalitni yo'qotishdan qo'rqaman. Bu qaydlarning muallifi sifatida bu noma'lumlarni tushunish, ochish men uchun shunchaki burch deb his qilaman. Bundan tashqari, noma'lum narsa tabiiyki insonning dushmani. Va Homo Sapiens faqat uning tinish belgilarida so'roq belgilari bo'lmay, faqat undov belgilari, vergullar va nuqtalar bo'lgandagina so'zning to'liq ma'nosida Inson bo'ladi.

paras.en: Thus, guided by what seems to me simply my duty as an author, I took an aero today at sixteen o’clock and went to the Ancient House. A strong wind was blowing against me. The aero advanced with difficulty through the thicket of air, its transparent branches whistling and whipping. The city below seemed a heap of blue blocks of ice. Suddenly⁠—a cloud, a swift, oblique shadow. The ice became leaden; it swelled. As in springtime when you happen to stand at the shore and wait; in one more minute everything will move and pull and crack! But the minute passes and the ice remains motionless; you feel as though you yourself are swelling, your heart beats more restlessly, more frequently.⁠ ⁠… But why do I write about all this? And whence all these strange sensations? For is there such an iceberg as could ever break the most lucid, solid crystal of our life?
paras.uz: Shunday qilib, menga shunchaki muallif sifatidagi burchim bo'lib tuyulgan narsaga amal qilib, bugun soat o'n oltida aero oldim va Qadimiy Uyga bordim. Menga qarshi kuchli shamol esardi. Aero havo changalzori orqali qiyinchilik bilan oldinga siljirdi, uning shaffof shoxlari hushtak chalib, qamchilardi. Pastdagi shahar moviy muz bo'laklari uyumidek ko'rinardi. To'satdan — bulut, tez, qiya soya. Muz qo'rg'oshindek bo'lib qoldi; u ko'pchidi. Xuddi bahorda qirg'oqda turib kutayotganingizdagidek; yana bir daqiqa va hamma narsa qo'zg'alib, tortilib, yorilib ketadi! Lekin daqiqa o'tadi va muz qimirlamay qoladi; siz o'zingiz ko'pchiyotgandek his qilasiz, yuragingiz yanada bezovta, yanada tez uradi... Lekin nega men bularning hammasi haqida yozyapman? Va bu g'alati tuyg'ularning hammasi qayerdan? Axir hayotimizning eng tiniq, mustahkam billurini sindira oladigan aysberg bormi?

paras.en: At the entrance of the Ancient House I found no one. I went around it and found the old janitress near the Green Wall. She held her hand above her eyes, looking upward. Beyond the Wall, sharp black triangles of some birds; they would rush, cawing, in onslaught on the invisible fence of electric waves, and as they felt the electricity against their breasts, they would recoil and soar once more beyond the Wall.
paras.uz: Qadimiy Uy kirish joyida hech kimni topmadim. Uni aylanib o'tdim va keksa darvozabon ayolni Yashil Devor yonida topdim. U qo'lini ko'zlari ustiga qo'yib, yuqoriga qarardi. Devor ortida qandaydir qushlarning o'tkir qora uchburchaklari; ular qag'illab, elektr to'lqinlarining ko'rinmas to'sig'iga hujum qilib otilishardi va ko'kraklari bilan elektrni his qilib, orqaga qaytib, yana Devor ortiga ko'tarilishardi.

paras.en: I noticed oblique, swift shadows on the dark, wrinkled face, a quick glance at me.
paras.uz: Qorong'i, ajinli yuzda qiya, tez soyalarni, menga bir tez nigohni payqadim.

paras.en: “Nobody here, nobody, nobody! No! And no use coming here.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Hech kim yo'q, hech kim, hech kim! Yo'q! Bu yerga kelishning foydasi yo'q...»

paras.en: In what respect is it “no use” and what a strange idea, to consider me somebody’s shadow. Perhaps all of you are only my shadows. Did I not populate these pages which only recently were white quadrangular deserts, with you? Without me would they whom I shall guide over the narrow paths of my lines, could they ever see you?
paras.uz: Qanday ma'noda «foydasi yo'q» va meni kimningdir soyasi deb hisoblash qanday g'alati fikr. Balki hammangiz faqat mening soyalarimsiz. Yaqindagina oq to'rtburchak cho'llar bo'lgan bu sahifalarni men sizlar bilan to'ldirmadimmi? Mensiz, men satrlarimning tor yo'llari bo'ylab boshlab boradiganlar sizni hech qachon ko'ra olarmidi?

paras.en: Of course I did not say all this to the old woman. From experience I know that the most torturing thing is to inoculate someone with a doubt as to the fact that he or she is a three-dimensional reality and not some other reality. I remarked only, quite drily, that her business was to open the gate, and she let me into the courtyard.
paras.uz: Albatta, bularning hammasini kampirga aytmadim. Tajribamdan bilamanki, eng qiynoqli narsa — kimgadir u uch o'lchamli haqiqat ekanligi va boshqa haqiqat emasligi haqidagi shubhani yuqtirishdir. Men faqat, juda quruq qilib, uning ishi darvozani ochish ekanini aytdim va u meni hovliga kiritdi.

paras.en: It was empty. Quiet. The wind remained beyond the walls, distant as on that day, when shoulder to shoulder, two like one, we came out from beneath, from the corridors⁠—if it ever really happened. I walked under stone arches, my steps resounded against the damp vaults and fell behind me, sounding as though someone were continually following me. The yellow walls with patches of red brick were watching me through their square spectacles, windows⁠—watching me open the squeaky doors of a barn, look into corners, nooks and hidden places.⁠ ⁠… A gate in the fence and a lonely spot. The monument of the Two Hundred Years’ War. From the ground naked, stone ribs were sticking out. The yellow jaws of the wall. An ancient oven with a chimney like a ship petrified forever among redbrick waves.
paras.uz: U bo'm-bo'sh edi. Sokin. Shamol devorlar ortida qoldi, o'sha kundagidek uzoqda, biz yelkama-yelka, ikkimiz birdek, pastdan, yo'laklardan chiqqan kundagidek — agar bu haqiqatan ham bo'lgan bo'lsa. Tosh ravoqlar ostida yurdim, qadamlarim nam gumbazlarga urilib, orqamga tushardi, go'yo kimdir doimo orqamdan ergashib kelayotgandek yangrardi. Qizil g'isht yamoqli sariq devorlar o'zlarining to'rtburchak ko'zoynaklari — derazalari orqali meni kuzatardi — saroyning g'ichirlaydigan eshiklarini ochayotganimni, burchaklarga, xilvatlarga va yashirin joylarga qarayotganimni kuzatardi... Devordagi darvoza va xilvat joy. Ikki Yuz Yillik Urush yodgorligi. Yerdan yalang'och tosh qovurg'alar chiqib turardi. Devorning sariq jag'lari. Qizil g'isht to'lqinlari orasida abadiy toshga aylangan kemadek mo'rili qadimiy pech.

paras.en: It seemed to me that I had seen those yellow teeth once before. I saw them still dimly in my mind, as at the bottom of a barrel, through water. And I began to search. I fell into caves occasionally; I stumbled over stones; rusty jaws caught my unif a few times; salt drops of sweat ran from my forehead into my eyes.
paras.uz: Menga o'sha sariq tishlarni bir marta ko'rgandek tuyuldi. Ularni hali ham xayolimda xira, go'yo bochkaning tubida, suv orqali ko'rgandek ko'rardim. Va men qidira boshladim. Ba'zan chuqurlarga tushib ketardim; toshlarga qoqilardim; zanglagan jag'lar bir necha marta yunifamni ilib oldi; peshonamdan sho'r ter tomchilari ko'zlarimga oqardi.

paras.en: Nowhere! I could find that exit from below, from the corridors, nowhere! There was none. Well, perhaps it was better that it happened so. Probably that all was only one of my absurd “dreams.”
paras.uz: Hech qayerda! Pastdan, yo'laklardan chiqadigan o'sha chiqish joyini hech qayerdan topa olmadim! U yo'q edi. Xo'sh, balki shunday bo'lgani yaxshiroqdir. Ehtimol, bularning hammasi mening bema'ni «tushlarim»dan biri edi.

paras.en: Tired out, covered with cobweb and dust, I opened the gate to return to the main yard, when suddenly⁠ ⁠… a rustle behind me, splashing steps, and there before me were the pink winglike ears and the double-curved smile of S-. Half closing his eyes, he bored his little drills into me and asked:
paras.uz: Charchab, o'rgimchak to'ri va changga belanib, asosiy hovliga qaytish uchun darvozani ochdim, to'satdan... orqamda shitirlash, shalpillagan qadamlar va ro'paramda S- ning pushti qanotdek quloqlari va ikki marta egilgan tabassumi turardi. Ko'zlarini yarim qisib, kichkina parmalarini menga burg'iladi va so'radi:

paras.en: “Taking a walk?”
paras.uz: «Sayr qilyapsizmi?»

paras.en: I was silent. My arms were heavy.
paras.uz: Men jim edim. Qo'llarim og'ir edi.

paras.en: “Well, do you feel better now?”
paras.uz: «Xo'sh, endi o'zingizni yaxshiroq his qilyapsizmi?»

paras.en: “Yes, thank you. I think I am getting normal again.”
paras.uz: «Ha, rahmat. Menimcha, yana normal holatga qaytyapman».

paras.en: He let me go. He lifted his eyes, looked upward, and I noticed his Adam’s apple for the first time; it resembles a broken spring, sticking out from beneath the upholstery of a divan.
paras.uz: U meni qo'yib yubordi. Ko'zlarini ko'tarib, yuqoriga qaradi va men birinchi marta uning kekirdagini payqadim; u divan qoplamasi ostidan chiqib turgan singan prujinaga o'xshaydi.

paras.en: Above us, not very high (about 50 meters) aeros were buzzing. By their low, slow flight and by the observation tubes which hung down, I recognized them. They were the aeros of the Guardians. But there were not two or three, as usual, there were about ten or twelve (I regret to have to confine myself to an approximate figure).
paras.uz: Tepamizda, unchalik baland emas (taxminan 50 metr), aerolar g'uvillardi. Ularning past, sekin uchishidan va osilib turgan kuzatuv naychalaridan ularni tanidim. Bular Qo'riqchilarning aerolari edi. Lekin ular odatdagidek ikki yoki uchta emas, o'n-o'n ikkitacha edi (taxminiy raqam bilan cheklanishga majburligimdan afsusdaman).

paras.en: “Why are there so many today?” I dared to ask S-.
paras.uz: «Nega bugun ular shunchalik ko'p?» — S- dan so'rashga jur'at etdim.

paras.en: “Why? Hm.⁠ ⁠… A real physician begins to treat a patient when he is still well but on the way to becoming sick tomorrow, day-after-tomorrow or within a week. Prophylaxis! Yes!”
paras.uz: «Nega? Hm... Haqiqiy shifokor bemorni u hali sog'lom, lekin ertaga, indinga yoki bir hafta ichida kasal bo'lish yo'lida bo'lganida davolashni boshlaydi. Profilaktika! Ha!»

paras.en: He nodded and went splashing over the stones of the yard. Then he turned his head and said over his shoulder, “Be careful!”
paras.uz: U bosh irg'ab, hovli toshlari ustidan shalpillab ketdi. Keyin boshini burib, yelkasi osha dedi: «Ehtiyot bo'ling!»

paras.en: Again I was alone. Silence. Emptiness. Far beyond the Green Wall the birds and the wind. What did he mean? My aero ran very fast with the wind. Light and heavy shadows from the clouds. Below blue cupolas, cubes of glass-ice were becoming leaden and swelling.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Yana yolg'iz qoldim. Sukunat. Bo'shliq. Yashil Devor ortida uzoqda qushlar va shamol. U nima demoqchi edi? Aeroim shamol bilan juda tez yugurdi. Bulutlardan yengil va og'ir soyalar. Pastda moviy gumbazlar, shisha-muz kublari qo'rg'oshindek bo'lib, ko'pchib borardi...

paras.en: The Same Evening
paras.uz: O'sha kuni kechqurun

paras.en: I took up my pen just now in order to write upon these pages a few thoughts which, it seems to me, will prove useful for you, my readers. These thoughts are concerned with the great Day of Unanimity which is now not far away. But as I sat down, I discovered that I cannot write at present; instead I sit and listen to the wind beating the glass with its dark wings; all the while I am busy looking about and I am waiting, expecting.⁠ ⁠… What? I do not know. So I was very glad when I saw the brownish-pink gills enter my room, heartily glad I may say. She sat down and innocently smoothed a fold of her unif that fell between her knees, and very soon she pasted upon me, all over me, a host of smiles⁠—a bit of a smile on each crack of my face and this gave me pleasant sensations, as if I were tightly bound like an infant of the ancients in a swaddling-cloth.
paras.uz: Hozirgina bu sahifalarga menimcha sizga, o'quvchilarim, foydali bo'ladigan bir necha fikrni yozish uchun qalam oldim. Bu fikrlar endi uzoq bo'lmagan buyuk Bir Ovozlilik Kuni haqida. Lekin o'tirganimda hozir yoza olmasligimni angladim; buning o'rniga o'tirib, shamol qorong'i qanotlari bilan shishaga urilayotganini tinglayman; doimo atrofga qarash bilan bandman va kutyapman, kutyapman... Nimani? Bilmayman. Shuning uchun jigarrang-pushti jabralar xonamga kirganini ko'rganimda juda xursand bo'ldim, aytishim mumkinki, chin dildan xursand bo'ldim. U o'tirdi va tizzalari orasiga tushgan yunifasining burmasini beg'uborlik bilan tekisladi va tez orada menga, butun vujudimga ko'plab tabassumlarni yopishtirdi — yuzimning har bir yorig'iga bir parcha tabassum — va bu menda yoqimli tuyg'ular uyg'otdi, go'yo men qadimgilarning chaqalog'idek yo'rgakka mahkam o'ralgandek edim.

paras.en: “Imagine! Today, when I entered the classroom” (she works in the Child-Educational Refinery), “I suddenly noticed a caricature upon the blackboard. Indeed! I assure you! They had pictured me in the form of a fish! Perhaps I really⁠—”
paras.uz: «Tasavvur qiling! Bugun sinfga kirganimda (u Bolalar Tarbiyasi Zavodida ishlaydi) to'satdan doskada karikaturani payqadim. Haqiqatan! Ishontirib aytaman! Ular meni baliq qiyofasida chizishgan edi! Balki men chindan ham —»

paras.en: “No, no! Why do you say that?” I hastily exclaimed. When one was near her, it was clear indeed that she had nothing resembling gills. No. When I referred to gills in these pages I was certainly irreverent.
paras.uz: «Yo'q, yo'q! Nega bunday deyapsiz?» — shoshib xitob qildim. Uning yonida bo'lganda, unda jabralarga o'xshash hech narsa yo'qligi chindan ham aniq edi. Yo'q. Bu sahifalarda jabralar haqida gapirganimda, albatta, hurmatsizlik qilgandim.

paras.en: “Oh, after all it does not matter. But the act as such, think of it! Of course I called the Guardians at once. I love children very much and I think that the most difficult and the most exalted love is⁠—cruelty. You understand me, of course.”
paras.uz: «Oh, oxir-oqibat, bu muhim emas. Lekin harakatning o'zi, o'ylab ko'ring! Albatta, men darhol Qo'riqchilarni chaqirdim. Men bolalarni juda yaxshi ko'raman va menimcha, eng qiyin va eng yuksak muhabbat — shafqatsizlik. Siz meni tushunasiz, albatta».

paras.en: “Certainly!” Her sentence so closely resembled my thoughts! I could not refrain from reading to her a passage from my Record No. 20, beginning “Quietly, metallically, distinctly, do the thoughts”⁠ ⁠… etc. I felt her brownish-pink cheeks twitching and coming closer and closer to me. Suddenly I felt in my hands her firm, dry, even slightly prickling fingers.
paras.uz: «Albatta!» Uning jumlasi mening fikrlarimga shunchalik o'xshardi! Unga 20-qaydimdan «Fikrlar boshda tez, metalldek, aniq...» va hokazo bilan boshlanadigan parchani o'qib berishdan o'zimni tiya olmadim. Uning jigarrang-pushti yonoqlari pirpirab, menga tobora yaqinlashayotganini his qildim. To'satdan qo'llarimda uning qattiq, quruq, hatto biroz sanchiladigan barmoqlarini his qildim.

paras.en: “Give, give this to me please. I shall have it phonographed and make the children learn it by heart. Not only your Venerians need all this, but we ourselves right now, tomorrow, day-after-tomorrow.”
paras.uz: «Bering, iltimos, buni menga bering. Men uni fonografga yozdirib, bolalarga yod oldiraman. Bularning hammasi faqat sizning Veneraliklaringizga emas, balki bizning o'zimizga ham hozir, ertaga, indinga kerak».

paras.en: She glanced around and said in a very low voice:
paras.uz: U atrofga qarab, juda past ovozda dedi:

paras.en: “Have you heard, they say that on the Day of Unanimity⁠—”
paras.uz: «Eshitdingizmi, aytishlaricha, Bir Ovozlilik Kunida —»

paras.en: I sprang to my feet.
paras.uz: Men sakrab turdim.

paras.en: “What? What do they say? What⁠—on the Day of Unanimity?”
paras.uz: «Nima? Nima deyishyapti? Nima — Bir Ovozlilik Kunida?»

paras.en: The coziness of my room, its very walls, seemed to have vanished. I felt myself thrown outside, where the tremendous, shaggy wind was tossing about and where the slanting clouds of dusk were descending lower and lower.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Xonamning shinamligi, hatto uning devorlari ham g'oyib bo'lgandek tuyuldi. O'zimni tashqariga, ulkan, tukli shamol uloqtirib yurgan va g'ira-shiraning qiya bulutlari tobora pastga tushayotgan joyga uloqtirilgandek his qildim...

paras.en: U- boldly and firmly grasped me by the shoulders. I even noticed how her fingers, responding to my emotion, trembled slightly.
paras.uz: Yu- dadil va mahkam yelkamdan ushladi. Hatto uning barmoqlari mening hayajonimga javoban biroz titrayotganini payqadim.

paras.en: “Sit down, dear, and don’t be upset. They say many things; must we believe them all? Moreover, if only you need me, I shall be near you on that day. I shall leave the schoolchildren with someone else and I shall stay with you, for you, dear, you too are a child and you need.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «O'tiring, azizim, va xafa bo'lmang. Ular ko'p narsa deyishadi; hammasiga ishonishimiz kerakmi? Bundan tashqari, agar men sizga kerak bo'lsam, o'sha kuni yoningizda bo'laman. Maktab bolalarini boshqa birovga qoldirib, siz bilan qolaman, chunki siz, azizim, siz ham bolasiz va sizga kerak...»

paras.en: “No, no!” (I raised my hands in protest). “Not for anything! You really think then that I am a child and that I cannot do without a.⁠ ⁠… Oh, no! Not for anything in the world.” (I must confess I had other plans for that day!)
paras.uz: «Yo'q, yo'q! (Qo'llarimni e'tiroz bildirib ko'tardim.) Hech qachon! Demak, siz rostdan ham men bolaman va enagasiz... qola olmayman deb o'ylaysizmi... Oh, yo'q! Dunyoda hech narsa evaziga». (Tan olishim kerak, o'sha kun uchun boshqa rejalarim bor edi!)

paras.en: She smiled. The wording of that smile apparently was: “Oh, what a stubborn, what a stubborn boy!” She sat down, eyelids lowered. Her hands modestly busied themselves with fixing the fold of the unif which fell again between her knees, and suddenly, about something entirely different, she said:
paras.uz: U jilmaydi. O'sha tabassumning mazmuni, aftidan: «Oh, qanday o'jar, qanday o'jar bola!» edi. U ko'zlarini tushirib o'tirdi. Qo'llari kamtarlik bilan yana tizzalari orasiga tushgan yunifa burmasini to'g'rilash bilan band edi va to'satdan, mutlaqo boshqa narsa haqida dedi:

paras.en: “I think I must decide⁠ ⁠… for your sake.⁠ ⁠… But I implore you, do not hurry me. I must think it over.”
paras.uz: «Menimcha, men qaror qilishim kerak... siz uchun... Lekin yolvoraman, meni shoshirmang. Men o'ylab ko'rishim kerak».

paras.en: I did not hurry her, although I realized that I ought to have been delighted, as there is no greater honor than to crown someone’s evening years.
paras.uz: Men uni shoshirmadim, garchi xursand bo'lishim kerakligini anglasam ham, chunki kimningdir keksalik yillarini toj bilan bezashdan katta sharaf yo'q.

paras.en: … All night strange wings were about. I walked and protected my head with my hands from those wings. And a chair, not like ours, but an ancient chair, came in with a horse-like gait: first the right fore- and left hind-leg, then the left fore- and right hind-leg. It rushed to my bed and crawled into it, and I liked that wooden chair, although it made me uncomfortable and caused me some pain.
paras.uz: ...Tun bo'yi g'alati qanotlar atrofda aylanib yurdi. Men yurib, boshimni qo'llarim bilan o'sha qanotlardan himoya qilardim. Va bir stul, biznikiga o'xshamagan, qadimiy stul ot yurishi bilan kirib keldi: avval o'ng oldingi va chap orqa oyoq, keyin chap oldingi va o'ng orqa oyoq. U karavotimga yugurib kelib, unga emaklab chiqdi va menga o'sha yog'och stul yoqdi, garchi u meni noqulay qilib, biroz og'riq bersa ham.

paras.en: It is very strange; is it really impossible to find any cure for this dream-sickness, or to make it rational, perhaps even useful?
paras.uz: Juda g'alati; nahotki bu tush ko'rish kasalligiga biror davo topish yoki uni aqlli, hatto foydali qilish mumkin bo'lmasa?

gloss.ex: …death, for instance. To understand, to discover these unknowns as the author of these records, I feel it simply my duty. Moreover, the unknown is naturally the…
…histling and whipping. The city below seemed a heap of blue blocks of ice. Suddenly⁠—a cloud, a swift, oblique shadow. The ice became leaden; it swelled. As in…
…uch and I think that the most difficult and the most exalted love is⁠—cruelty. You understand me, of course.”

chapters.recap_uz: D-503 Qadimiy Uy hovlisida yer osti chiqishini topa olmaydi. S- unga «ehtiyot bo'ling» deydi. Kechqurun Yu- uni bolalar haqida gapirib, unga g'amxo'rlik qilmoqchi bo'ladi.

chapters.title: The benumbed waves — Everything is improving — I am a microbe
chapters.title_uz: Karaxt to'lqinlar — Ishlar yaxshilanmoqda — Men mikrobman

paras.en: Please imagine that you stand at the seashore. The waves go rhythmically up, down, up.⁠ ⁠… Suddenly when they have risen they remain in that position, benumbed, torpid! It was just as weird and unnatural when everything became confused and our regular walk which is prescribed by the Tables, suddenly came to an end. The last time such a thing happened was 119 years ago, when according to our historians a meteorite fell hissing and fuming into the very midst of the marchers. We were walking yesterday as usual, that is like warriors on the Assyrian monuments, a thousand heads and two composite, integrated legs and two swinging integrated arms. At the end of the avenue where the Accumulating Tower was formidably resounding, a quadrangle appeared: on the sides, in front and behind⁠—guards; in the centre three Numbers. Their unifs were already stripped of the golden State badges; everything was painfully clear. The enormous dial on the top of the Tower looked like a face; it bent down from the clouds and spitting down its seconds, it waited with indifference. It showed six minutes past thirteen exactly. There was some confusion in the quadrangle. I was very close and I saw the most minute details. I clearly remember a thin, long neck and on the temple a confused net of small blue veins like rivers on the map of a small unfamiliar world, and that unknown world was apparently still a very young man. He evidently noticed someone in our ranks; he stopped, rose upon his tiptoes and stretched his neck. One of the guards snapped his back with the bluish spark of the electric whip⁠—he squealed in a thin voice like a puppy. The distinct snaps followed each other at intervals of approximately two seconds; a snap and a squeal, a snap and a squeal.⁠ ⁠… We continued to walk as usual, rhythmically, in our Assyrian manner. I watched the graceful zigzags of the electric sparks and thought: “Human society is constantly improving, as it should. How ugly a tool was the ancient whip and how much beauty there is⁠—”
paras.uz: Iltimos, dengiz qirg'og'ida turganingizni tasavvur qiling. To'lqinlar ritmik ravishda yuqoriga, pastga, yuqoriga ko'tariladi... To'satdan ular ko'tarilganda o'sha holatda qotib, karaxt bo'lib qoladi! Hamma narsa chalkashib, Jadvalda belgilangan muntazam sayrimiz to'satdan to'xtab qolganida ham xuddi shunday g'ayritabiiy va g'alati edi. Bunday narsa oxirgi marta 119 yil oldin, tarixchilarimizga ko'ra, meteorit vishillab, tutab, marsh qiluvchilarning qoq o'rtasiga tushganda sodir bo'lgan. Kecha biz odatdagidek, ya'ni Ossuriya yodgorliklaridagi jangchilardek, ming bosh va ikkita yaxlit, integrallashgan oyoq va ikkita silkinayotgan integrallashgan qo'l bo'lib yurardik. Jamg'arma Minorasi dahshatli jaranglab turgan prospekt oxirida to'rtburchak paydo bo'ldi: yon tomonlarda, oldinda va orqada — soqchilar; markazda uchta Raqam. Ularning yunifalaridan oltin Davlat nishonlari allaqachon yulib olingan edi; hamma narsa og'riqli darajada aniq edi. Minora tepasidagi ulkan siferblat yuzga o'xshardi; u bulutlardan engashib, soniyalarini pastga tupurib, befarqlik bilan kutardi. U aynan o'n uch-u olti daqiqani ko'rsatardi. To'rtburchakda qandaydir sarosima bor edi. Men juda yaqin edim va eng mayda tafsilotlarni ko'rdim. Ingichka, uzun bo'yinni va chakkada kichkina, notanish dunyo xaritasidagi daryolardek mayda moviy tomirlarning chalkash to'rini aniq eslayman, o'sha noma'lum dunyo esa, aftidan, hali juda yosh yigit edi. U aftidan bizning saflarimizda kimnidir payqadi; to'xtab, oyoq uchida ko'tarilib, bo'ynini cho'zdi. Soqchilardan biri elektr qamchining ko'kimtir uchquni bilan uning orqasiga chirt urdi — u kuchukchadek ingichka ovozda chiyilladi. Aniq chirtlashlar taxminan ikki soniyalik oraliqlarda bir-birining ortidan kelardi; chirt va chiyillash, chirt va chiyillash... Biz odatdagidek, ritmik ravishda, Ossuriya uslubida yurishda davom etdik. Men elektr uchqunlarining nafis ziqzaglarini kuzatib, o'yladim: «Insoniyat jamiyati, bo'lishi kerakdek, doimo takomillashib boradi. Qadimiy qamchi qanchalik xunuk qurol edi va qanchalik go'zallik bor —»

paras.en: At that moment, like a nut flying from a wheel revolving at full speed, a female Number, thin, flexible and tense, tore herself from our rows, and with a cry, “Enough! Don’t you dare!” she threw herself straight into the quadrangle. It was like the meteorite of 119 years ago; our march came to a standstill and our rows appeared like the gray crests of waves frozen by sudden cold. For a second I looked at that woman’s figure with the eye of a stranger as all the others did. She was no Number any longer; she was only a human being and she existed for us only as a substantiation of the insult which she cast upon the United State. But a motion of hers, her bending while twisting to the left upon her hips, revealed to me clearly who she was. I knew, I knew that body, flexible as a whip! My eyes, my lips, my hands knew it; at that moment I was absolutely certain.⁠ ⁠… Two of the guards dashed to catch her. One more moment and that limpid mirror-like point on the pavement would have become the point of meeting of their trajectories, and she would have been caught! My heart fell, stopped. Without thinking whether it was permissible or not, whether it was reasonable or absurd, I threw myself straight to that point.
paras.uz: O'sha lahzada, to'liq tezlikda aylanayotgan g'ildirakdan uchib chiqqan gaykadek, ozg'in, egiluvchan va tarang bir ayol Raqam saflarimizdan uzilib chiqdi va «Yetadi! Jur'at etmanglar!» deb qichqirib, to'g'ri to'rtburchakka o'zini otdi. Bu 119 yil oldingi meteoritga o'xshardi; marshimiz to'xtab qoldi va saflarimiz to'satdan sovuqdan muzlab qolgan to'lqinlarning kulrang cho'qqilariga o'xshab qoldi. Bir soniyaga men ham boshqalar kabi o'sha ayol qiyofasiga begona ko'z bilan qaradim. U endi Raqam emas edi; u faqat inson edi va biz uchun faqat Yagona Davlatga qilgan haqoratining isboti sifatida mavjud edi. Lekin uning bir harakati, chap tomonga sonlari ustida burilib egilishi menga uning kimligini aniq ko'rsatdi. Men bilardim, men o'sha qamchidek egiluvchan tanani bilardim! Ko'zlarim, lablarim, qo'llarim uni bilardi; o'sha lahzada men mutlaqo amin edim... Ikki soqchi uni ushlash uchun otildi. Yana bir lahza va trotuardagi o'sha tiniq ko'zgudek nuqta ularning traektoriyalari uchrashadigan nuqtaga aylanardi va u tutilardi! Yuragim tushib ketdi, to'xtadi. Bu mumkinmi yoki yo'qmi, aqllimi yoki bema'nimi, o'ylamay, to'g'ri o'sha nuqtaga o'zimni otdim.

paras.en: I felt thousands of eyes bulging with horror fixed upon me but that only added a sort of desperately joyful power to that wild being with hairy paws which arose in me and ran faster and faster. Two more steps⁠—she turned around⁠—
paras.uz: Dahshatdan bo'rtib chiqqan minglab ko'zlar menga qadalganini his qildim, lekin bu ichimda paydo bo'lgan va tobora tezroq yugurayotgan tukli panjali o'sha yovvoyi mavjudotga qandaydir umidsiz-quvonchli kuch qo'shdi, xolos. Yana ikki qadam — u o'girildi —

paras.en: I saw a quivering face covered with freckles, red eyebrows.⁠ ⁠… It was not she! Not I-330!
paras.uz: Men sepkil bilan qoplangan titroq yuzni, qizil qoshlarni ko'rdim... Bu u emas edi! I-330 emas!

paras.en: A rabid, quivering joy took hold of me. I wanted to shout something like: “Catch her! Get her, that⁠—” But I heard only my whisper. A heavy hand was already upon my shoulder; I was caught and led away. I tried to explain to them:
paras.uz: Quturgan, titroq quvonch meni chulg'ab oldi. «Ushlang uni! Tuting uni, o'sha —» kabi nimadir deb qichqirgim keldi. Lekin faqat o'z shivirlashimni eshitdim. Yelkamda allaqachon og'ir qo'l bor edi; meni ushlab, olib ketishdi. Ularga tushuntirishga urindim:

paras.en: “But listen, you must understand that I thought that.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Lekin quloq soling, tushunishingiz kerak, men... deb o'ylagandim...»

paras.en: But could I explain even to myself all the sickness which I have described in these pages? My light went out; I waited obediently. As a leaf that is torn from its branch by a sudden gust of wind falls humbly, but on its way down turns and tries to catch every little branch, every fork, every knot; so I tried to catch every one of the silent, globe-like heads, or the transparent ice of the walls, or the blue needle of the Accumulating Tower which seemed to pierce the clouds.
paras.uz: Lekin bu sahifalarda tasvirlagan barcha kasalligimni hatto o'zimga ham tushuntira olarmidim? Mening chirog'im o'chdi; men itoatkorona kutdim. To'satdan esgan shamol shoxidan uzib olgan barg muloyimgina tushadi, lekin pastga tushayotib aylanib, har bir kichkina shoxchaga, har bir ayriga, har bir tugunga ilinishga urinadi; xuddi shunday men ham har bir jim, sharsimon boshga, yoki devorlarning shaffof muziga, yoki bulutlarni teshib o'tayotgandek tuyulgan Jamg'arma Minorasining moviy ignasiga ilinishga urinardim.

paras.en: At that moment, when a heavy curtain was about to separate from me this beautiful world, I noticed not far away a familiar, enormous head gliding over the mirror surface of the pavement and wagging its winglike ears. I heard a familiar, flat voice:
paras.uz: Og'ir parda mendan bu go'zal dunyoni ajratmoqchi bo'lgan o'sha lahzada, uzoq bo'lmagan joyda trotuarning ko'zgudek yuzasi ustida sirpanib kelayotgan va qanotdek quloqlarini qimirlatayotgan tanish, ulkan boshni payqadim. Tanish, yassi ovozni eshitdim:

paras.en: “I deem it my duty to testify that Number D-503 is ill and is unable to regulate his emotions. Moreover, I am sure that he was led by natural indignation⁠—”
paras.uz: «D-503 raqami kasal ekanligi va o'z his-tuyg'ularini boshqara olmasligi haqida guvohlik berishni o'z burchim deb bilaman. Bundan tashqari, ishonamanki, uni tabiiy g'azab yetaklagan —»

paras.en: “Yes! Yes!” I exclaimed, “I even shouted ‘catch her!’ ”
paras.uz: «Ha! Ha! — xitob qildim men. — Men hatto "ushlang uni!" deb qichqirdim!»

paras.en: From behind me: “You did not shout anything.”
paras.uz: Orqamdan: «Siz hech narsa deb qichqirmadingiz».

paras.en: “No, but I wanted to. I swear by the Well-Doer, I wanted to!”
paras.uz: «Yo'q, lekin qichqirmoqchi edim. Homiy nomiga qasamki, qichqirmoqchi edim!»

paras.en: For a second I was bored through by the gray, cold, drill-eyes. I don’t know whether he believed that what I said was the truth (almost!), or whether he had some secret reason for sparing me for a while, but he wrote a short note, handed it to one of those who had held me and again I was free. That is, I was again included in the orderly, endless, Assyrian rows of Numbers.
paras.uz: Bir soniyaga kulrang, sovuq parma-ko'zlar meni teshib o'tdi. Bilmayman, u aytganim rost (deyarli!) ekaniga ishondimi, yoki meni bir muddat ayash uchun qandaydir yashirin sababi bormidi, lekin u qisqa yozuv yozib, meni ushlab turganlardan biriga uzatdi va men yana ozod edim. Ya'ni men yana Raqamlarning tartibli, cheksiz, Ossuriya saflariga qo'shildim.

paras.en: The quadrangle, the freckled face and the temple with the map of blue veinlets disappeared forever around the corner. We walked again⁠—a million-headed body; and in each one of us resided that humble joyfulness with which in all probability molecules, atoms and phagocytes live.
paras.uz: To'rtburchak, sepkilli yuz va moviy tomirchalar xaritasi tushgan chakka muyulish ortida abadiy g'oyib bo'ldi. Biz yana yurdik — million boshli tana; va har birimizda, ehtimol, molekulalar, atomlar va fagotsitlar yashaydigan o'sha kamtarona quvonch yashardi.

paras.en: In the ancient days the Christians understood this feeling; they are our only (though very imperfect) direct forerunners. The greatness of the “Church of the United Flock” was known to them. They knew that resignation is virtue, and pride⁠—a vice; that “We” is from God, “I” from the devil.
paras.uz: Qadim zamonlarda nasroniylar bu tuyg'uni tushunishgan; ular bizning yagona (garchi juda nomukammal bo'lsa ham) to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'tmishdoshlarimiz. «Yagona Suruv Cherkovi»ning buyukligi ularga ma'lum edi. Ular kamtarlik — fazilat, g'urur esa — illat ekanini; «Biz» — Xudodan, «Men» — iblisdan ekanini bilishgan.

paras.en: I was walking, keeping step with the others yet separated from them. I was still trembling from the emotion just felt, like a bridge over which a thundering ancient steel train has passed a moment before. I felt myself. To feel one’s self, to be conscious of one’s personality, is the lot of an eye inflamed by a cinder, or an infected finger, or a bad tooth. A healthy eye, or finger, or tooth is not felt; it is nonexistent as it were. Is it not clear then, that consciousness of oneself is a sickness?
paras.uz: Men boshqalar bilan bir qadamda, lekin ulardan ajralgan holda yurardim. Hozirgina boshdan kechirgan hayajondan hali ham titrardim, xuddi bir lahza oldin ustidan gumburlagan qadimiy po'lat poyezd o'tgan ko'prikdek. Men o'zimni his qildim. O'zini his qilish, o'z shaxsini anglash — cho'g' tushib yallig'langan ko'zning, yoki yiringlagan barmoqning, yoki og'riyotgan tishning qismati. Sog'lom ko'z, barmoq yoki tish sezilmaydi; u go'yo mavjud emasdek. Demak, o'zini anglash kasallik ekani aniq emasmi?

paras.en: Apparently I am no longer a phagocyte which quietly, in a businesslike way devours microbes (microbes with freckled faces and blue temples); apparently I am myself a microbe, and she too, I-330, is a microbe, a wonderful, diabolic microbe! It is quite possible that there are already thousands of such microbes among us, still pretending to be phagocytes, as I pretend. What if today’s accident, although in itself not important, is only a beginning, only the first meteorite of a shower of burning and thundering stones which the infinite may have poured out upon our glass paradise?
paras.uz: Aftidan, men endi mikroblarni (sepkilli yuzli va moviy chakkali mikroblarni) jimgina, ishchanlik bilan yutadigan fagotsit emasman; aftidan, men o'zim mikrobman va u ham, I-330 ham mikrob, ajoyib, iblisona mikrob! Ehtimol, oramizda allaqachon minglab shunday mikroblar bor va ular hali ham, men kabi, o'zlarini fagotsit qilib ko'rsatishyapti. Agar bugungi hodisa, garchi o'z-o'zidan muhim bo'lmasa ham, faqat boshlanish, cheksizlik bizning shisha jannatimizga yog'dirgan bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan yonayotgan va gumburlayotgan toshlar yomg'irining faqat birinchi meteoriti bo'lsa-chi?

…neck. One of the guards snapped his back with the bluish spark of the electric whip⁠—he squealed in a thin voice like a puppy. The distinct snaps followed each…
…humble joyfulness with which in all probability molecules, atoms and phagocytes live.
…am no longer a phagocyte which quietly, in a businesslike way devours microbes (microbes with freckled faces and blue temples); apparently I am myself a microbe…
…thing happened was 119 years ago, when according to our historians a meteorite fell hissing and fuming into the very midst of the marchers. We were walking yes…

quiz.q: Why does D-503 run into the square?
o: He thinks the woman is I-330
quiz.why_uz: Uning harakati I-330 nikiga o'xshab tuyuladi.

quiz.q: Who saves D-503 from arrest?
quiz.why_uz: S- uni kasal deb guvohlik beradi.

chapters.recap_uz: Sayr paytida hibsga olinganlarni ko'rgan bir ayol saflardan otilib chiqadi. D-503 uni I-330 deb o'ylab, unga yuguradi. S- uni qutqaradi. D-503 o'zini «mikrob» deb his qiladi.

chapters.title: Flowers — The dissolution of a crystal — If only (?)

paras.en: They say there are flowers that bloom only once in a hundred years. Why not suppose the existence of flowers that bloom only once a thousand years? We may have known nothing about them until now only because today is the “once in a thousand years”?
paras.uz: Aytishlaricha, yuz yilda faqat bir marta ochiladigan gullar bor ekan. Nega ming yilda faqat bir marta ochiladigan gullar mavjudligini faraz qilmaslik kerak? Balki biz ular haqida shu paytgacha hech narsa bilmaganmiz, chunki faqat bugun o'sha «ming yilda bir marta»dir?

paras.en: Happy and dizzy I walked downstairs to the controller on duty and quickly under my gaze all around me and silently the thousand-year-old buds burst, and everything was blooming: armchairs, shoes, golden badges, electric bulbs, someone’s dark heavy eyes, the polished columns of the banisters, the handkerchief which someone lost on the stairs, the small, inkblotted desk of the controller and the tender brown, somewhat freckled cheeks of U-. Everything seemed not ordinary, new, tender, rosy, moist. U- took the pink stub from me while the blue, aromatic moon, hanging from an unseen branch, shone through the glass of the wall and over the head of U-. With a solemn gesture I pointed my finger and said:
paras.uz: Baxtiyor va boshim aylanib, navbatchi nazoratchining oldiga pastga tushdim va nigohim ostida atrofimda tez va jimgina ming yillik g'unchalar yorilib, hamma narsa gullardi: kreslolar, tuflilar, oltin nishonlar, elektr lampochkalar, kimningdir qorong'i og'ir ko'zlari, panjaralarning silliqlangan ustunlari, kimdir zinapoyada tushirib qoldirgan ro'molcha, nazoratchining siyoh dog'li kichkina stoli va Yu- ning nozik jigarrang, biroz sepkilli yonoqlari. Hamma narsa g'ayrioddiy, yangi, nozik, pushti, nam tuyulardi. Yu- mendan pushti talonni oldi, ko'rinmas shoxdan osilib turgan moviy, xushbo'y oy esa devor shishasi orqali Yu- ning boshi ustida porlardi. Tantanali ishora bilan barmog'im bilan ko'rsatib, dedim:

paras.en: “The moon. You see?”
paras.uz: «Oy. Ko'ryapsizmi?»

paras.en: U- glanced at me, then at the number of the stub and again made that familiar, charmingly innocent movement with which she fixes the fold of the unif between her knees.
paras.uz: Yu- menga, keyin talon raqamiga qaradi va yana tizzalari orasidagi yunifa burmasini to'g'rilaydigan o'sha tanish, maftunkor darajada beg'ubor harakatini qildi.

paras.en: “You look abnormal and ill, dear. Abnormality and illness are the same thing. You are killing yourself. And no one would tell you that, no one!”
paras.uz: «Siz g'ayritabiiy va kasal ko'rinyapsiz, azizim. G'ayritabiiylik va kasallik — bir xil narsa. Siz o'zingizni o'ldiryapsiz. Va buni sizga hech kim aytmaydi, hech kim!»

paras.en: That “No one” was certainly equivalent to the number on the stub⁠—I-330. This thought was confirmed by an inkblot which fell close to the figure 330. Dear, wonderful U-! You are right, of course. I am not reasonable. I am sick. I have a soul. I am a microbe. But is blooming⁠—not a sickness? Is it not painful when the buds are bursting? And don’t you think that spermatozoa are the most terrible of all microbes?
paras.uz: O'sha «Hech kim» albatta talondagi raqamga — I-330 ga teng edi. Bu fikrni 330 raqami yoniga tushgan siyoh dog'i tasdiqladi. Aziz, ajoyib Yu-! Siz haqsiz, albatta. Men aqlli emasman. Men kasalman. Menda ruh bor. Men mikrobman. Lekin gullash — kasallik emasmi? G'unchalar yorilganda og'riqli emasmi? Va spermatozoidlar barcha mikroblarning eng dahshatlisi deb o'ylamaysizmi?

paras.en: Back upstairs to my room. In the widely open cup of the armchair was I-330. I, on the floor, embracing her limbs, my head on her lap. We were silent. Everything was silent. Only the pulse was audible. Like a crystal I was dissolving in her, in I-330. I felt most distinctly how the polished facets which limited me in space were slowly thawing, melting away. I was dissolving in her lap, in her, and I became at once smaller and larger and larger, unembraceable. For she was not she but the whole universe. For a second I and that armchair near the bed, transfixed with joy, we were one. And the wonderfully smiling old woman at the gate of the Ancient House, and the wild debris beyond the Green Wall, and some strange silver wreckage on a black background, dozing like the old woman and the slam of a door in the distance⁠—all this was within me, was listening to my pulse and soaring through the happiest of seconds.
paras.uz: Yana yuqoriga, xonamga. Kreslonining keng ochilgan kosasida I-330. Men polda, uning oyoqlarini quchoqlab, boshim uning tizzasida. Biz jim edik. Hamma narsa jim edi. Faqat puls eshitilardi. Men billurdek unda, I-330 da erib borardim. Meni fazoda chegaralab turgan silliqlangan qirralar sekin-asta erib, eriyotganini juda aniq his qildim. Men uning tizzasida, unda erib borardim va bir vaqtning o'zida kichrayib va kattayib, kattayib, quchoqlab bo'lmas bo'lib borardim. Chunki u u emas, butun koinot edi. Bir soniyaga men va karavot yonidagi o'sha kreslo, quvonchdan qotib qolgan holda, bir butun edik. Va Qadimiy Uy darvozasidagi ajoyib jilmayuvchi kampir, Yashil Devor ortidagi yovvoyi vayronalar, qora fonda kampirdek mudrayotgan qandaydir g'alati kumush qoldiqlar va uzoqda eshikning qarsillashi — bularning hammasi mening ichimda edi, pulsimni tinglardi va eng baxtli soniyalar bo'ylab parvoz qilardi.

paras.en: In absurd, confused, overflowing words I attempted to tell her that I was a crystal and that there was a door in me, and that I felt how happy the armchair was. But something nonsensical came out of the attempt and I stopped. I was ashamed. And suddenly:
paras.uz: Bema'ni, chalkash, to'lib-toshgan so'zlar bilan unga men billur ekanimni, menda eshik borligini va kreslo qanchalik baxtli ekanini his qilayotganimni aytishga urindim. Lekin urinishdan qandaydir bema'ni narsa chiqdi va men to'xtadim. Uyalib ketdim. Va to'satdan:

paras.en: “Dear I-! Forgive me! I understand nothing. I talk so foolishly!”
paras.uz: «Aziz I-! Meni kechiring! Men hech narsani tushunmayman. Shunchalik ahmoqona gapiraman!»

paras.en: “And why should you think that foolishness is not fine? If we had taken pains to educate human foolishness through centuries, as we have done with our intelligence, it might perhaps have been transformed into something very precious.”
paras.uz: «Nega ahmoqlik yaxshi emas deb o'ylashingiz kerak? Agar biz asrlar davomida aql-idrokimizni tarbiyalagandek inson ahmoqligini ham tarbiyalashga zahmat chekkanimizda, ehtimol u juda qimmatli narsaga aylangan bo'lardi».

paras.en: Yes, I think she is right! How could she be wrong at that moment?
paras.uz: Ha, menimcha, u haq! O'sha lahzada u qanday qilib nohaq bo'lishi mumkin edi?

paras.en: “… And for this foolishness of yours and for what you did yesterday during the walk, I love you the more, much more.”
paras.uz: «...Va sizning shu ahmoqligingiz uchun va kecha sayr paytida qilgan ishingiz uchun men sizni yanada ko'proq, ancha ko'proq sevaman».

paras.en: “Then why did you torture me? Why would you not come? Why did you send me the pink check and make me⁠—?”
paras.uz: «Unda nega meni qiynadingiz? Nega kelmadingiz? Nega menga pushti chiptani yuborib, meni majbur qildingiz —?»

paras.en: “Perhaps I wanted to test you. Perhaps I must be sure that you will do anything I wish, that you are completely mine.”
paras.uz: «Balki sizni sinamoqchi bo'lgandirman. Balki siz men istagan har qanday narsani qilishingizga, butunlay meniki ekaningizga ishonch hosil qilishim kerakdir».

paras.en: “Yes, completely.”
paras.uz: «Ha, butunlay».

paras.en: She took my face, my whole self, between her palms, lifted my head:
paras.uz: U yuzimni, butun vujudimni kaftlari orasiga olib, boshimni ko'tardi:

paras.en: “And how about ‘It is the duty of every honest Number’? Eh?”
paras.uz: «"Har bir halol Raqamning burchi" haqida-chi? A?»

paras.en: Sweet, sharp, white teeth⁠—a smile. In the open cup of the armchair she was like a bee⁠—sting and honey combined.
paras.uz: Shirin, o'tkir, oq tishlar — tabassum. Kreslonining ochiq kosasida u asalari kabi edi — nayza va asal birgalikda.

paras.en: Yes, duty.⁠ ⁠… I turned over in my mind the pages of my records; indeed there is not a thought about the fact that strictly speaking I should.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Ha, burch... Xayolimda qaydlarimning sahifalarini varaqladim; haqiqatan ham, aslini olganda men... kerakligi haqida birorta fikr yo'q...

paras.en: I was silent. Exaltedly (and probably stupidly) I smiled, looking into the pupils of her eyes. I followed first one eye and then the other and in each of them I saw myself, a millimetric self imprisoned in those tiny rainbow cells. Then again the lips and the sweet pain of blooming.
paras.uz: Men jim edim. Hayajon bilan (va ehtimol ahmoqona) uning ko'z qorachiqlariga qarab jilmaydim. Avval bir ko'ziga, keyin ikkinchisiga ergashdim va har birida o'zimni, o'sha kichkina kamalak katakchalarida qamalgan millimetrlik o'zimni ko'rdim. Keyin yana lablar va gullashning shirin og'rig'i.

paras.en: In each Number of the United State there is an unseen metronome which tick-tocks silently; without looking at the clock we know exactly the time of day within five minutes. But now my metronome had stopped and I did not know how much time had passed. In fright I grasped my badge with its clock from under the pillow. Glory be to the Well-Doer! I had twenty minutes more! But those minutes were such tiny, short ones! They ran! And I wanted to tell her so many things. I wanted to tell her all about myself; about the letter from O- and about that terrible evening when I gave her a child; and for some reason also about my childhood, about our mathematician Plappa and about the square-root of minus one; and how, when I attended the glorification on the Day of Unanimity for the first time in my life, I wept bitterly because there was an ink-stain on my unif⁠—on such a holy day!
paras.uz: Yagona Davlatning har bir Raqamida jimgina tiq-tiqlaydigan ko'rinmas metronom bor; soatga qaramay ham besh daqiqa aniqlik bilan kunning vaqtini bilamiz. Lekin endi metronomim to'xtab qolgan edi va qancha vaqt o'tganini bilmasdim. Qo'rquv bilan yostiq ostidan soatli nishonimni oldim. Homiyga shon-sharaf! Yana yigirma daqiqam bor edi! Lekin o'sha daqiqalar shunchalik kichkina, qisqa edi! Ular yugurardi! Men esa unga juda ko'p narsalarni aytmoqchi edim. Unga o'zim haqimda hamma narsani aytmoqchi edim; O- dan kelgan xat va unga bola bergan o'sha dahshatli kech haqida; va negadir bolaligim haqida ham, matematik o'qituvchimiz Plyappa va minus birning kvadrat ildizi haqida; va hayotimda birinchi marta Bir Ovozlilik Kunidagi ulug'lash marosimiga borganimda yunifamda siyoh dog'i borligi uchun — shunday muqaddas kunda! — qanday achchiq yig'laganim haqida.

paras.en: I-330 lifted her head. She leaned on her elbow. In the corners of her lips two long, sharp lines and the dark angle of lifted eyebrows⁠—a cross.
paras.uz: I-330 boshini ko'tardi. U tirsagiga suyandi. Lablarining burchaklarida ikki uzun, o'tkir chiziq va ko'tarilgan qoshlarining qorong'i burchagi — xoch.

paras.en: “Perhaps on that day⁠ ⁠…” her brow grew darker; she took my hand and pressed it hard. “Tell me, will you ever forget me? Will you always remember me?”
paras.uz: «Balki o'sha kuni...» — uning qoshlari yanada qoraydi; u qo'limni olib, qattiq siqdi. «Ayting-chi, meni hech qachon unutasizmi? Meni doim eslaysizmi?»

paras.en: “But why such talk? What is it, I-, dear?”
paras.uz: «Lekin nega bunday gaplar? Nima gap, I-, azizim?»

paras.en: She was silent. And her eyes were already sliding past me, through me, away into the distance. I suddenly heard the wind beating the glass with its enormous wings. Of course it had been blowing all the while but I had not noticed it until then. And for some reason those cawing birds over the Green Wall came to my mind.
paras.uz: U jim edi. Va uning ko'zlari allaqachon mendan o'tib, men orqali uzoqlarga sirpanib ketayotgan edi. To'satdan shamol ulkan qanotlari bilan shishaga urilayotganini eshitdim. Albatta, u doimo esib turgan edi, lekin men shu paytgacha uni payqamagandim. Va negadir Yashil Devor ustidagi o'sha qag'illagan qushlar esimga tushdi.

paras.en: I-330 shook her head with a gesture of throwing something off. Once more she touched me for a second with her whole body, as an aero before landing touches the ground for a second with all the tension of a recoiling spring.
paras.uz: I-330 nimanidir silkib tashlayotgandek boshini silkitdi. Yana bir bor u bir soniyaga butun tanasi bilan menga tegdi, xuddi aero qo'nishdan oldin orqaga qaytayotgan prujinaning butun tarangligi bilan bir soniyaga yerga tekkani kabi.

paras.en: “Well, give me my stockings, quick!”
paras.uz: «Xo'sh, paypoqlarimni bering, tezroq!»

paras.en: The stockings were on the desk, on the open manuscript, on page 124. Being in haste I caught some of the pages and they were scattered over the floor so that it was hard to put them back in the proper order. Moreover, even if I put them in that order there will be no real order; there are obstacles to that anyway, some undiscoverable unknowns.
paras.uz: Paypoqlar stol ustida, ochiq qo'lyozmaning 124-sahifasida edi. Shoshib, ba'zi sahifalarni ilib oldim va ular polga sochilib ketdi, shuning uchun ularni to'g'ri tartibda qaytarib qo'yish qiyin bo'ldi. Bundan tashqari, ularni o'sha tartibda qo'ysam ham, haqiqiy tartib bo'lmaydi; har holda bunga to'siqlar, qandaydir ochib bo'lmas noma'lumlar bor.

paras.en: “I can’t bear it,” I said. “You are here, near me, yet you seem to be behind an opaque ancient wall; through that wall I hear a rustle and voices; I cannot make out the words, I don’t know what is there. I cannot bear it. You seem always to withhold something from me; you have never told me what kind of a place it was where I found myself that day beneath the Ancient House. Where did those corridors lead? Why was the doctor there⁠—or perhaps all that never happened?”
paras.uz: «Men chiday olmayman, — dedim men. — Siz shu yerda, yonimdasiz, lekin go'yo shaffof bo'lmagan qadimiy devor ortidadek tuyulasiz; o'sha devor orqali shitirlash va ovozlarni eshitaman; so'zlarni ajrata olmayman, u yerda nima borligini bilmayman. Men chiday olmayman. Siz doimo mendan nimanidir yashirayotgandek tuyulasiz; o'sha kuni Qadimiy Uy ostida o'zimni qanday joyda topganimni hech qachon aytmadingiz. O'sha yo'laklar qayerga olib borardi? Nega shifokor u yerda edi — yoki balki bularning hammasi hech qachon bo'lmaganmi?»

paras.en: I-330 put her hands on my shoulders and slowly entered deeply into my eyes.
paras.uz: I-330 qo'llarini yelkalarimga qo'yib, sekin ko'zlarimga chuqur kirib bordi.

paras.en: “You want to know all?”
paras.uz: «Hamma narsani bilishni istaysizmi?»

paras.en: “Yes, I do.”
paras.uz: «Ha, istayman».

paras.en: “And you would not be afraid to follow me anywhere? Wherever I should lead you?”
paras.uz: «Va men bilan har qayerga borishdan qo'rqmaysizmi? Men sizni qayerga boshlasam ham?»

paras.en: “Anywhere!”
paras.uz: «Har qayerga!»

paras.en: “All right then. I promise you, after the holiday, if only.⁠ ⁠… Oh yes, there is your Integral. I always forget to ask; will it soon be completed?”
paras.uz: «Unday bo'lsa, xo'p. Sizga va'da beraman, bayramdan keyin, agar faqat... Oh, ha, sizning Integralingiz bor-ku. Doim so'rashni unutaman; u tez orada tugaydimi?»

paras.en: “No. ‘If only’ what? Again! ‘If only’ what?”
paras.uz: «Yo'q. "Agar faqat" nima? Yana! "Agar faqat" nima?»

paras.en: She, already at the door: “You shall see.”
paras.uz: U, allaqachon eshik oldida: «Ko'rasiz».

paras.en: I was again alone. All that she left behind her was a barely perceptible scent, similar to that of a sweet, dry, yellow dust of flowers from behind the Green Wall; also, sunk deeply within me, question marks like small hooks similar to those the ancients used for fishing (vide the Prehistoric Museum).
paras.uz: Men yana yolg'iz qoldim. Undan qolgan narsa faqat Yashil Devor ortidan keladigan gullarning shirin, quruq, sariq changiga o'xshash zo'rg'a seziladigan hid edi; yana ichimga chuqur cho'kib ketgan, qadimgilar baliq tutish uchun ishlatgan qarmoqlarga o'xshash kichkina ilmoqlardek so'roq belgilari (qarang: Tarixdan oldingi davr muzeyi).

paras.en: … Why did she suddenly ask about the Integral?
paras.uz: ...Nega u to'satdan Integral haqida so'radi?

quiz.q: What does I-330 suddenly ask about?
quiz.why_uz: Uning Integralga qiziqishi D-503 ni hayron qoldiradi.

quiz.q: What does D-503 compare himself to?
quiz.why_uz: U I-330 bilan birga billurdek eriydi.

chapters.recap_uz: I-330 D-503 ning xonasiga keladi. U «billurdek erib ketadi». I-330 undan Integral qachon tayyor bo'lishini so'raydi va «bayramdan keyin hamma narsani bilasiz» deydi.

chapters.title: The limit of the function — Easter — To cross out everything
chapters.title_uz: Funksiyaning limiti — Pasxa — Hammasining ustidan chiziq tortish

paras.en: I am like a motor set in motion at a speed of too many revolutions per second, the bearings have become too hot and in one more minute the molten metal will begin to drip and everything will go to the devil. Cold water! Quick! Some logic! I pour pailfuls of it, but my logic merely sizzles on the hot metal and disappears in the air in the form of vapor.
paras.uz: Men soniyasiga haddan tashqari ko'p aylanish tezligida ishga tushirilgan dvigatelga o'xshayman, podshipniklar haddan tashqari qizib ketgan va yana bir daqiqadan keyin erigan metall tomchilay boshlaydi va hamma narsa jahannamga ketadi. Sovuq suv! Tezroq! Bir oz mantiq! Men uni chelaklab quyaman, lekin mantiqim qizigan metall ustida faqat vishillaydi va bug' shaklida havoda g'oyib bo'ladi.

paras.en: Of course it is clear that in order to establish the true meaning of a function, one must establish its limit. It is also clear that yesterday’s “dissolution in the universe” taken to its limit is death. For death is exactly the most complete dissolution of the self in the universe. Hence: L = f(D), love is the function of death.
paras.uz: Albatta, funksiyaning haqiqiy ma'nosini aniqlash uchun uning limitini aniqlash kerakligi aniq. Kechagi «koinotda erib ketish» limitiga yetkazilganda o'lim ekani ham aniq. Chunki o'lim aynan o'zlikning koinotda eng to'liq erib ketishidir. Demak: S = f(O), sevgi — o'limning funksiyasi.

paras.en: Yes, exactly, exactly! That is why I am afraid of I-330; I struggle against her, I don’t want.⁠ ⁠… But why is it that within me “I don’t want to” and “I want to” stand side by side? That is the chief horror of the matter; I continue to long for that happy death of yesterday. The horror of it is that even now, when I have integrated the logical function, when it becomes evident that the latter contains death hidden in it, nevertheless I long for it with my lips, arms, breast, with every millimeter.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Ha, aynan, aynan! Shuning uchun men I-330 dan qo'rqaman; men unga qarshi kurashaman, men istamayman... Lekin nega ichimda «istamayman» va «istayman» yonma-yon turadi? Masalaning asosiy dahshati shunda; men kechagi o'sha baxtli o'limni sog'inishda davom etaman. Dahshati shundaki, hatto hozir ham, mantiqiy funksiyani integrallaganimda, uning ichida o'lim yashiringani ayon bo'lganda ham, baribir men uni lablarim, qo'llarim, ko'kragim bilan, har bir millimetr bilan sog'inaman...

paras.en: Tomorrow is the Day of Unanimity. She will certainly be there and I shall see her, though from a distance. That distance will be painful to me, for I must be, I am inevitably drawn, close to her, so that her hands, her shoulder, her hair.⁠ ⁠… I long for even that pain.⁠ ⁠… Let it come.⁠ ⁠… Great Well-Doer! How absurd to desire pain! Who is ignorant of the simple fact that pains are negative items which reduce that sum total we call happiness? Consequently⁠ ⁠… Well, no “consequently”⁠ ⁠… Emptiness.⁠ ⁠… Nakedness!
paras.uz: Ertaga Bir Ovozlilik Kuni. U albatta u yerda bo'ladi va men uni, garchi uzoqdan bo'lsa ham, ko'raman. O'sha masofa menga og'riqli bo'ladi, chunki men uning yonida bo'lishim kerak, muqarrar ravishda unga tortilaman, toki uning qo'llari, yelkasi, sochlari... Men hatto o'sha og'riqni ham sog'inaman... Kelaversin... Buyuk Homiy! Og'riqni istash qanchalik bema'ni! Og'riqlar biz baxt deb ataydigan o'sha umumiy yig'indini kamaytiradigan manfiy qo'shiluvchilar ekanligi haqidagi oddiy haqiqatni kim bilmaydi? Demak... Xo'sh, hech qanday «demak» yo'q... Bo'shliq... Yalang'ochlik!

paras.en: The Same Evening.
paras.uz: O'sha kuni kechqurun.

paras.en: Through the glass wall of the house I see a disquieting, windy, feverishly pink, sunset. I move my armchair to avoid that pinkness and turn over these pages, and I find I am forgetting that I write this not for myself but for you unknown people whom I love and pity, for you who still lag centuries behind, below. Let me tell you about the Day of Unanimity, about that Great Day. I think that day for us is what Easter was for the ancients. I remember I used to prepare an hour-calendar the eve of that day; solemnly I would cross out every time the figure of the hour elapsed; nearer by one hour! one hour less to wait!⁠ ⁠… If I were certain that nobody would discover it, I assure you I should now too, make out such a calendar and carry it with me, and I should watch how many hours remain until tomorrow, when I shall see, at least from a distance.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Uyning shisha devori orqali bezovta, shamolli, isitmadek pushti quyosh botishini ko'raman. O'sha pushtilikdan qochish uchun kreslomni surib, bu sahifalarni varaqlayman va buni o'zim uchun emas, siz uchun, men sevadigan va achinadigan noma'lum odamlar uchun, hali asrlar ortda, pastda qolib ketayotganlar uchun yozayotganimni unutayotganimni payqayman. Sizga Bir Ovozlilik Kuni haqida, o'sha Buyuk Kun haqida aytib beray. Menimcha, o'sha kun biz uchun qadimgilar uchun Pasxa qanday bo'lgan bo'lsa, shunday. Esimda, men o'sha kun arafasida soatlar kalendari tayyorlardim; o'tgan har bir soat raqamini tantanali ravishda o'chirib qo'yardim; bir soat yaqinroq! kutish uchun bir soat kamroq!.. Agar buni hech kim bilmasligiga amin bo'lganimda, ishontirib aytamanki, hozir ham shunday kalendar tayyorlab, o'zim bilan olib yurardim va ertagacha, hech bo'lmasa uzoqdan ko'radigan paytimgacha qancha soat qolganini kuzatardim...

paras.en: (I was interrupted. They brought me a new unif from the shop. As is customary, new unifs are given to us for tomorrow’s celebration. Steps in the hall, exclamations of joy, noises.)
paras.uz: (Gapim bo'lindi. Ustaxonadan menga yangi yunifa olib kelishdi. Odatga ko'ra, ertangi bayram uchun bizga yangi yunifalar beriladi. Yo'lakda qadamlar, quvonch xitoblari, shovqinlar.)

paras.en: I shall continue; tomorrow I shall see the same spectacle which we see year after year and which always awakes in us fresh emotions, as though we saw it for the first time: an impressive throng of piously lifted arms. Tomorrow is the day of the yearly election of the Well-Doer. Tomorrow we shall again hand over to our Well-Doer the keys to the impregnable fortress of our happiness. Certainly this in no way resembles the disorderly, unorganized election-days of the ancients, on which (it seems so funny!) they did not even know in advance the result of the election. To build a state on some non-discountable contingencies, to build blindly⁠—what could be more nonsensical? Yet centuries were required to pass before this was understood!
paras.uz: Davom etaman; ertaga men yildan-yilga ko'radigan va har doim go'yo birinchi marta ko'rayotgandek yangi his-tuyg'ular uyg'otadigan o'sha tomoshani ko'raman: ixlos bilan ko'tarilgan qo'llarning ta'sirli olomoni. Ertaga Homiyni yillik saylash kuni. Ertaga biz yana Homiyimizga baxtimizning yengilmas qal'asi kalitlarini topshiramiz. Albatta, bu qadimgilarning tartibsiz, uyushmagan saylov kunlariga hech qanday o'xshamaydi, o'shanda (bu qanchalik kulgili!) ular hatto saylov natijasini oldindan bilishmagan. Davlatni hisobga olib bo'lmaydigan tasodiflar ustiga qurish, ko'r-ko'rona qurish — bundan bema'niroq nima bo'lishi mumkin? Lekin buni tushunish uchun asrlar o'tishi kerak edi!

paras.en: Needless to say, we in this respect as in all others have no place for contingencies; nothing unexpected can happen. The elections themselves have rather a symbolic meaning. They remind us that we are a united, powerful organism of millions of cells, that⁠—, to use the language of the “gospel” of the ancients, we are a united church. The history of the United State knows not a single case in which upon this solemn day even a solitary voice has dared to violate the magnificent unison.
paras.uz: Aytish shart emaski, bizda bu borada, boshqa barcha borada bo'lgani kabi, tasodiflarga o'rin yo'q; hech qanday kutilmagan narsa yuz bera olmaydi. Saylovlarning o'zi ko'proq ramziy ma'noga ega. Ular bizga millionlab hujayralardan iborat yagona, qudratli organizm ekanimizni, — qadimgilarning «Injil» tili bilan aytganda, yagona cherkov ekanimizni eslatadi. Yagona Davlat tarixi bu tantanali kunda hatto yolg'iz bir ovoz ulug'vor hamohanglikni buzishga jur'at etgan birorta holatni bilmaydi.

paras.en: They say that the ancients used to conduct their elections secretly, stealthily like thieves. Some of our historians assert even that they would come to the electoral celebrations completely masked. Imagine the weird, fantastic spectacle! Night. A plaza. Along the walls the stealthily creeping figures covered with mantles. The red flame of torches dancing in the wind.⁠ ⁠… Why was such secrecy necessary? It has never been satisfactorily explained. Probably it resulted from the fact that elections were associated with some mystic and superstitious, perhaps even criminal ceremonies. We have nothing to conceal or to be ashamed of; we celebrate our election openly, honestly, in daylight. I see them all vote for the Well-Doer and everybody sees me vote for the Well-Doer. How could it be otherwise, since “all” and “I” are one “we”? How ennobling, sincere, lofty, is this compared with the cowardly, thievish “secrecy” of the ancients! Moreover, how much more expedient! For even admitting for a moment the impossible, that is the outbreak of some dissonance in our customary unity, in that case our unseen Guardians are always right there among us, are they not, to register the Numbers who would fall into error and save them from any further false steps? The United State is theirs, the Numbers’! And besides.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Aytishlaricha, qadimgilar saylovlarini yashirincha, o'g'rilardek pinhona o'tkazishgan. Ba'zi tarixchilarimiz hatto ular saylov tantanalariga butunlay niqob kiyib kelishgan deb ta'kidlashadi. Tasavvur qiling, qanday g'alati, fantastik tomosha! Tun. Maydon. Devorlar bo'ylab plashlarga o'ralgan, pusib sudralayotgan qiyofalar. Shamolda raqsga tushayotgan mash'alalarning qizil alangasi... Nega bunday sir saqlash kerak edi? Bu hech qachon qoniqarli tushuntirilmagan. Ehtimol, bu saylovlar qandaydir sirli va xurofiy, balki hatto jinoiy marosimlar bilan bog'liq bo'lganidan kelib chiqqandir. Bizda yashiradigan yoki uyaladigan hech narsa yo'q; biz saylovimizni ochiq, halol, kunduzi nishonlaymiz. Men hammaning Homiyga ovoz berayotganini ko'raman va hamma mening Homiyga ovoz berayotganimni ko'radi. Boshqacha qanday bo'lishi mumkin, axir «hamma» va «men» bitta «biz»-ku? Qadimgilarning qo'rqoq, o'g'rilarcha «yashirinligi» bilan solishtirganda bu qanchalik ulug'lovchi, samimiy, yuksak! Bundan tashqari, qanchalik maqsadga muvofiqroq! Chunki bir lahzaga imkonsiz narsani, ya'ni odatiy birligimizda qandaydir disonansning paydo bo'lishini faraz qilganimizda ham, o'sha holda bizning ko'rinmas Qo'riqchilarimiz doimo shu yerda, oramizda bo'ladi-ku, adashgan Raqamlarni ro'yxatga olib, ularni keyingi noto'g'ri qadamlardan qutqarish uchun? Yagona Davlat ularniki, Raqamlarniki! Va bundan tashqari...

paras.en: Through the wall to my left a she-number before the mirror-door of the closet; she is hastily unbuttoning her unif. For a second, swiftly⁠—eyes, lips, two sharp, pink⁠ ⁠… the curtains fell. Within me instantly awoke all that happened yesterday and now I no longer know what I meant to say by “besides.⁠ ⁠…” I no longer wish to;⁠—I cannot. I want one thing. I want I-330. I want her every minute, every second, to be with me, with no one else. All that I wrote about Unanimity is of no value; it is not what I want; I have a desire to cross it out, to tear it to pieces and throw it away. For I know (be it a sacrilege, yet it is the truth), that a glorious Day is possible only with her and only then when we are side by side, shoulder to shoulder. Without her the Sun of tomorrow will appear to me only as a little circle cut out of a tin sheet, and the sky a sheet of tin painted blue, and I myself⁠ ⁠… I snatched the telephone receiver.
paras.uz: Chap tomondagi devor orqali javonning ko'zguli eshigi oldida ayol raqam; u shoshilib yunifasining tugmalarini yechyapti. Bir soniyaga, tezgina — ko'zlar, lablar, ikkita o'tkir, pushti... pardalar tushdi. Ichimda bir zumda kecha bo'lib o'tgan hamma narsa uyg'ondi va endi «bundan tashqari...» deb nima demoqchi bo'lganimni bilmayman. Endi istamayman; — qila olmayman. Men bir narsani istayman. Men I-330 ni istayman. Men uning har daqiqa, har soniya men bilan, boshqa hech kim bilan emas, bo'lishini istayman. Bir Ovozlilik haqida yozganlarimning hammasi hech qanday qimmatga ega emas; bu men istagan narsa emas; men uni o'chirib, parcha-parcha qilib yirtib, tashlab yuborgim keladi. Chunki bilaman (kufr bo'lsa ham, lekin bu haqiqat), shonli Kun faqat u bilan va faqat biz yonma-yon, yelkama-yelka bo'lgandagina mumkin. Usiz ertangi Quyosh menga faqat tunuka varag'idan qirqib olingan kichkina doira, osmon esa moviyga bo'yalgan tunuka varag'i bo'lib ko'rinadi, men o'zim esa... Telefon go'shagini yulqib oldim.

paras.en: “I-330, are you there?”
paras.uz: «I-330, shu yerdamisiz?»

paras.en: “Yes, it is I. Why so late?”
paras.uz: «Ha, menman. Nega bunchalik kech?»

paras.en: “Perhaps not too late yet. I want to ask you⁠ ⁠… I want you to be with me tomorrow⁠—dear!”
paras.uz: «Balki hali juda kech emasdir. Sizdan so'ramoqchiman... Ertaga men bilan bo'lishingizni istayman — azizim!»

paras.en: “Dear” I said in a very low voice. And for some reason a thing I saw this morning at the docks flashed through my mind: just for fun someone put a watch under the hundred-ton sledgehammer.⁠ ⁠… A swing, a breath of wind in the face and the silent hundred-ton, knife-like weight on the breakable watch.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: «Azizim», — dedim juda past ovozda. Va negadir bugun ertalab stapelda ko'rgan bir narsa xayolimdan chaqnab o'tdi: kimdir shunchaki hazil uchun yuz tonnalik bolg'a ostiga soat qo'ygan edi... Bir silkinish, yuzga shamol urilishi va sinuvchan soat ustida jimgina yuz tonnalik, pichoqdek og'irlik...

paras.en: A silence. I thought I heard someone’s whisper in I-330’s room. Then her voice:
paras.uz: Sukut. I-330 ning xonasida kimningdir shivirlashini eshitgandek bo'ldim. Keyin uning ovozi:

paras.en: “No, I cannot. Of course you understand that I myself.⁠ ⁠… No, I cannot. ‘Why?’ You shall see tomorrow.”
paras.uz: «Yo'q, qila olmayman. Albatta, tushunasizki, men o'zim... Yo'q, qila olmayman. "Nega?" Ertaga ko'rasiz».

paras.en: Night.
paras.uz: Tun.

gloss.ex: …f course it is clear that in order to establish the true meaning of a function, one must establish its limit. It is also clear that yesterday’s “dissolution in…
…y of Unanimity, about that Great Day. I think that day for us is what Easter was for the ancients. I remember I used to prepare an hour-calendar the eve of that…
…sive throng of piously lifted arms. Tomorrow is the day of the yearly election of the Well-Doer. Tomorrow we shall again hand over to our Well-Doer the keys to…
They say that the ancients used to conduct their elections secretly, stealthily like thieves. Some of our historians assert even that they would come…
…solemn day even a solitary voice has dared to violate the magnificent unison.

quiz.q: How are elections held in the United State?
quiz.why_uz: Hamma ochiq ovoz beradi, Qo'riqchilar kuzatadi.

quiz.q: What is love the function of, according to D-503?
quiz.why_uz: «Sevgi — o'limning funksiyasi».

chapters.recap_uz: Bir Ovozlilik Kuni arafasi. D-503 qadimgilarning yashirin saylovlarini masxara qiladi. I-330 ertaga u bilan bo'la olmasligini aytadi: «Ertaga ko'rasiz».

chapters.title: The descent from heaven — The greatest catastrophe in history — The known ⸻ is ended
chapters.title_uz: Osmondan tushish — Tarixdagi eng katta falokat — Ma'lum ⸻ tugadi

paras.en: At the beginning all arose, and the hymn, like a solemn mantle, slowly waved above our heads. Hundreds of tubes of the Musical Tower and millions of human voices. For a second I forgot everything; I forgot that alarming something at which I-330 hinted in connection with today’s celebration; I think I even forgot about her. At that moment I was the very same little boy who once wept because of a tiny ink-stain on his unif, which no one else could see. Even if it be so, if nobody sees that I am covered with black, ineffaceable stains, I know it, do I not? I know that there should be no place for a criminal like me among these frank open faces. What if I should rush forward and shout out all at once everything about myself! The end might follow. Let it! At least for a second I would feel myself clear and clean and senseless like that innocent blue sky.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Avvaliga hamma o'rnidan turdi va madhiya tantanali plashdek boshimiz ustida sekin hilpiradi. Musiqa Minorasining yuzlab quvurlari va millionlab inson ovozlari. Bir soniyaga hamma narsani unutdim; I-330 bugungi bayram munosabati bilan ishora qilgan o'sha xavotirli nimanidir unutdim; menimcha, hatto uni ham unutdim. O'sha lahzada men bir paytlar yunifasidagi hech kim ko'ra olmaydigan kichkina siyoh dog'i uchun yig'lagan o'sha kichkina bola edim. Agar shunday bo'lsa ham, mening qora, o'chmas dog'lar bilan qoplanganimni hech kim ko'rmasa ham, men buni bilaman-ku, shunday emasmi? Bilamanki, bu ochiq, samimiy yuzlar orasida men kabi jinoyatchiga o'rin bo'lmasligi kerak. Agar oldinga otilib, birdaniga o'zim haqimda hamma narsani qichqirib aytib yuborsam-chi! Oxiri kelishi mumkin. Kelaversin! Hech bo'lmasa bir soniyaga o'zimni o'sha beg'ubor moviy osmondek tiniq, pok va ma'nosiz his qilgan bo'lardim...

paras.en: All eyes were directed upward; in the pure morning blue, still moist with the tears of night, a small dark spot appeared. Now it was dark, now bathed in the rays of the sun. It was He, descending to us from the sky, He⁠—the new Jehovah⁠—in an aero, He, as wise and as lovingly cruel as the Jehovah of the ancients. Nearer and nearer, and higher toward him were drawn millions of hearts. Already he saw us. And in my mind with Him I looked over everything from the heights: concentric circles of stands marked with dotted blue lines of unifs⁠—like circles of a spiderweb strewn with microscopic suns (the shining of the badges). And in the centre there soon the wise white spider would occupy his place⁠—the Well-Doer clad in white, the Well-Doer who wisely tangled our hands and feet in the salutary net of happiness.
paras.uz: Barcha ko'zlar yuqoriga qaratilgan edi; tunning ko'z yoshlaridan hali nam bo'lgan toza ertalabki moviylikda kichkina qora dog' paydo bo'ldi. U goh qora, goh quyosh nurlariga cho'milgan edi. Bu U edi, osmondan bizga tushib kelayotgan, U — yangi Yahova — aeroda, U, qadimgilarning Yahovasidek dono va mehr bilan shafqatsiz. Yaqinroq va yaqinroq, va unga qarab yuqoriga millionlab yuraklar tortilardi. U allaqachon bizni ko'rardi. Va men xayolimda U bilan birga balandlikdan hamma narsani ko'zdan kechirdim: yunifalarning nuqtali moviy chiziqlari bilan belgilangan tribunalarning konsentrik doiralari — mikroskopik quyoshlar (nishonlarning yaltirashi) sochilgan o'rgimchak to'ri doiralaridek. Va markazda tez orada dono oq o'rgimchak o'z o'rnini egallaydi — oqqa burkangan Homiy, qo'l-oyoqlarimizni baxtning najotbaxsh to'riga donolik bilan chirmagan Homiy.

paras.en: His magnificent descent from the sky was accomplished. The brassy Hymn came to silence; all sat down. At once I perceived that everything was really a very thin spiderweb, the threads of which were stretched tense and trembling, and it seemed that in a moment those threads might break and something improbable.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Uning osmondan ulug'vor tushishi yakunlandi. Jarangdor Madhiya tindi; hamma o'tirdi. Shu zahoti hamma narsa haqiqatan ham juda yupqa o'rgimchak to'ri ekanini, uning iplari tarang tortilib, titrab turganini va go'yo bir lahzada o'sha iplar uzilib, nimadir aql bovar qilmas narsa... bo'lishi mumkinligini his qildim...

paras.en: I half rose and looked around, and I met many lovingly-worried eyes which passed from one face to another. I saw someone lifting his hand and almost imperceptibly waving his fingers⁠—he was making signs to another. The latter replied with a similar finger-sign. And a third.⁠ ⁠… I understood; they were the Guardians. I understood; they were alarmed by something⁠—the spiderweb was stretched and trembling. And within me as if tuned to the same wavelength of a radio, within me there was a corresponding quiver.
paras.uz: Yarim turib, atrofga qaradim va bir yuzdan boshqasiga o'tib turgan ko'plab mehr bilan xavotirlangan ko'zlarga duch keldim. Kimdir qo'lini ko'tarib, barmoqlarini deyarli sezilmas silkitayotganini ko'rdim — u boshqasiga ishora qilayotgan edi. Ikkinchisi xuddi shunday barmoq ishorasi bilan javob berdi. Va uchinchisi... Tushundim; ular Qo'riqchilar edi. Tushundim; ularni nimadir xavotirga solgan edi — o'rgimchak to'ri tarang tortilib, titrab turardi. Va ichimda, go'yo radioning o'sha to'lqin uzunligiga sozlangandek, ichimda unga mos titroq bor edi.

paras.en: On the platform a poet was reciting his pre-electoral ode. I could not hear a single word; I only felt the rhythmic swing of the hexametric pendulum, and with its every motion I felt how nearer and nearer there was approaching some hour set for.⁠ ⁠… I continued to turn over face after face like pages but I could not find the one, the only one, I was seeking, the one I needed to find at once, as soon as possible, for one more swing of the pendulum and.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Minbarda bir shoir saylov oldi qasidasini o'qirdi. Men bironta so'zni eshita olmadim; faqat geksametr mayatnigining ritmik tebranishini his qildim va uning har bir harakati bilan qandaydir belgilangan soat tobora yaqinlashib kelayotganini his qildim... Men sahifalardek yuz ortidan yuzni ag'darishda davom etdim, lekin izlayotganim — yagonasini, darhol, iloji boricha tezroq topishim kerak bo'lganini topa olmadim, chunki mayatnikning yana bir tebranishi va...

paras.en: It was he, certainly it was he! Below, past the main platform, gliding over the sparkling glass, the ear-wings flapped by, the running body gave a reflection of a double-curved S-, like a noose which was rolling toward some of the intricate passages among the stands. S-, I-330⁠—there is some thread between them. I have always felt some thread between them. I don’t know yet what that thread is but some day I shall untangle it. I planted my gaze on him; he was rushing farther away, behind him that invisible thread.⁠ ⁠… There he stopped⁠ ⁠… there.⁠ ⁠… I was pierced, twisted together into a knot as if by a lightning-like, many-volted electric discharge; in my row, not more than 40° from me, S- stopped and bowed. I saw I-330 and beside her the smiling, repellent, negro-lipped R-13.
paras.uz: Bu u edi, albatta, bu u edi! Pastda, asosiy minbar yonidan, yaltiroq shisha ustida sirpanib, quloq-qanotlar pirpirab o'tdi, yugurayotgan tana tribunalar orasidagi chigal yo'laklardan biriga qarab dumalab ketayotgan sirtmoqdek ikki marta egilgan S- ning aksini berdi. S-, I-330 — ular orasida qandaydir ip bor. Men doimo ular orasida qandaydir ip borligini his qilganman. O'sha ip nima ekanini hali bilmayman, lekin bir kun kelib uni yechaman. Nigohimni unga qadadim; u tobora uzoqlashib borardi, ortidan o'sha ko'rinmas ip... Mana u to'xtadi... mana... Meni go'yo chaqmoqdek, ko'p voltli elektr razryadi teshib o'tib, tugunga chirmab tashladi; mening qatorimda, mendan 40° dan uzoq bo'lmagan joyda S- to'xtab, ta'zim qildi. Men I-330 ni va uning yonida jilmayib turgan, jirkanch, negr labli R-13 ni ko'rdim.

paras.en: My first thought was to rush to her and cry, “Why with him? Why did you not want⁠ ⁠… ?” But the salutary invisible spiderweb bound fast my hands and feet; so, gritting my teeth together I sat stiff as iron, my gaze fixed upon them. A sharp physical pain at my heart. I remember my thought: “if nonphysical causes effect physical pain, then it is clear that.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Birinchi fikrim unga otilib, «Nega u bilan? Nega siz istamadingiz...?» deb qichqirish edi. Lekin najotbaxsh ko'rinmas o'rgimchak to'ri qo'l-oyoqlarimni mahkam bog'lab qo'ygan edi; shuning uchun tishlarimni g'ijirlatib, temirdek qotib o'tirdim, nigohim ularga qadalgan edi. Yuragimda o'tkir jismoniy og'riq. Fikrimni eslayman: «agar jismoniy bo'lmagan sabablar jismoniy og'riq keltirib chiqarsa, demak, aniqki...»

paras.en: I regret that I did not come to any conclusion. I remember only that something about “soul” flashed through my mind, a purely nonsensical ancient expression, “His soul fell into his boots” passed through my head. My heart sank. The hexameter came to an end. It was about to start. What “It”?
