paras.uz: Afsuski, hech qanday xulosaga kelmadim. Faqat xayolimdan «ruh» haqida nimadir chaqnab o'tganini eslayman, mutlaqo bema'ni qadimiy ibora — «yuragi tovoniga tushib ketdi» boshimdan o'tdi. Yuragim tushib ketdi. Geksametr tugadi. U boshlanmoqchi edi. Qanday «U»?

paras.en: The five minute pre-election recess established by custom. The custom-established pre-electional silence. But now it was not that pious, really prayer-like silence that it usually was. Now it was as in the ancient days when there were no Accumulating Towers, when the sky, still untamed in those days, would roar from time to time with its “storms.” It was like the “lull before the storm” of the ancient days. The air seemed to be made of transparent, vaporized cast-iron. One wanted to breathe with one’s mouth wide open. My hearing, intense to painfulness, registered from behind a mouse-like, gnawing, worried whisper. Without lifting my eyes I saw those two, I-330 and R-13, side by side, shoulder to shoulder⁠—and on my knees my trembling, foreign, hateful, hairy hands.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Odat bo'yicha belgilangan besh daqiqalik saylov oldi tanaffusi. Odat bo'yicha belgilangan saylov oldi sukunati. Lekin endi bu odatdagidek o'sha taqvodor, chinakam ibodatdek sukunat emas edi. Endi go'yo hali Jamg'arma Minoralari bo'lmagan, o'sha paytlarda hali qo'lga o'rgatilmagan osmon vaqti-vaqti bilan o'zining «bo'ronlari» bilan gumburlagan qadim zamonlardagidek edi. Bu qadim zamonlarning «bo'ron oldidagi sukunat»iga o'xshardi. Havo go'yo shaffof, bug'ga aylangan cho'yandan iborat edi. Og'izni katta ochib nafas olgisi kelardi. Og'riq darajasida tarang eshitishim orqadan sichqondek, kemiruvchi, xavotirli shivirlashni qayd etdi. Ko'zlarimni ko'tarmay ham o'sha ikkisini, I-330 va R-13 ni yonma-yon, yelkama-yelka ko'rdim — tizzalarimda esa titrayotgan, begona, nafratli, tukli qo'llarim...

paras.en: Everybody was holding a badge with a clock in his hands. One.⁠ ⁠… Two.⁠ ⁠… Three.⁠ ⁠… Five minutes. From the main platform a cast-iron, slow voice:
paras.uz: Hamma qo'lida soatli nishonni ushlab turardi. Bir... Ikki... Uch... Besh daqiqa. Asosiy minbardan cho'yandek, sekin ovoz:

paras.en: “Those in favor shall lift their hands.”
paras.uz: «Kim yoqlaydi, qo'lini ko'tarsin».

paras.en: If only I dared to look straight into his eyes as formerly! Straight and devotedly, and think: “Here I am, my whole self! Take me!” But now I did not dare. I had to make an effort to raise my hand, as if my joints were rusty.
paras.uz: Qaniydi avvalgidek to'g'ri uning ko'zlariga qarashga jur'at etsam! To'g'ri va sadoqat bilan qarab, o'ylasam: «Mana men, butun vujudim! Meni ol!» Lekin endi jur'at etmadim. Go'yo bo'g'imlarim zanglagandek qo'limni ko'tarish uchun kuch sarflashim kerak edi.

paras.en: A whisper of millions of hands. Someone’s subdued “Ah!” and I felt something was coming, falling heavily, but I could not understand what it was, and I did not have the strength or courage to take a look.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Millionlab qo'llarning shivirlashi. Kimningdir bo'g'iq «Oh!»i va nimadir kelayotganini, og'ir tushayotganini his qildim, lekin bu nima ekanini tushuna olmadim va qarashga kuchim ham, jur'atim ham yo'q edi...

paras.en: “Those opposed?”⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: «Kim qarshi?»...

paras.en: This was always the most magnificent moment of our celebration: all would remain sitting motionless, joyfully bowing their heads under the salutary yoke of that Number of Numbers. But now, to my horror again I heard a rustle; light as a sigh, yet it was more distinct even than the brass tube of the Hymn. Thus the last sigh in a man’s life, around him people with their faces pale and with drops of cold sweat upon their foreheads.⁠ ⁠… I lifted my eyes and.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Bu har doim bayramimizning eng ulug'vor lahzasi edi: hamma qimirlamay o'tirib qolar, o'sha Raqamlarning Raqamining najotbaxsh bo'yinturug'i ostida quvonch bilan bosh egardi. Lekin endi, dahshatimga, yana shitirlashni eshitdim; xo'rsinishdek yengil, lekin u hatto Madhiyaning jarangdor quvuridan ham aniqroq edi. Inson hayotidagi so'nggi xo'rsinish shunday bo'ladi, atrofida yuzlari oqarib ketgan, peshonalarida sovuq ter tomchilari bo'lgan odamlar... Ko'zlarimni ko'tardim va...

paras.en: It took one hundredth of a second only; I saw thousands of hands arise “opposed” and fall back. I saw the pale cross-marked face of I-330 and her lifted hand. Darkness came upon my eyes.
paras.uz: Bu faqat soniyaning yuzdan bir qismini oldi; minglab qo'llar «qarshi» ko'tarilib, qaytib tushganini ko'rdim. I-330 ning xoch belgili rangpar yuzini va uning ko'tarilgan qo'lini ko'rdim. Ko'zlarim qorong'ilashdi.

paras.en: Another hundredth of a second, silence. Quiet. The pulse. Then, as if at the sign of some mad conductor, from all the stands rattling, shouting, a whirlwind of unifs lifted by the rush, the perplexed figures of the Guardians running to and fro. Someone’s heels in the air near my eyes and close to those heels someone’s wide-open mouth tearing itself by an inaudible scream. For some reason this picture remains particularly distinct in my memory: thousands of mouths noiselessly yelling as if on the screen of a monstrous cinema. Also as if on a screen, somewhere below at a distance, for a second⁠—O-90, pressed against the wall in a passage, her lips white, defending her abdomen with her crossed arms. She disappeared as if washed away by a wave, or else I simply forgot her because.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Yana soniyaning yuzdan bir qismi, sukunat. Jimlik. Puls. Keyin, go'yo qandaydir telba dirijyorning ishorasi bilan, barcha tribunalardan taraqlash, qichqiriqlar, shiddat bilan ko'tarilgan yunifalar quyuni, u yoqdan bu yoqqa yugurayotgan Qo'riqchilarning sarosimaga tushgan qiyofalari. Ko'zlarim yonida havoda kimningdir tovonlari va o'sha tovonlar yonida eshitilmas qichqiriqdan yirtilayotgan kimningdir keng ochilgan og'zi. Negadir bu manzara xotiramda ayniqsa aniq qolgan: go'yo dahshatli kinoning ekranidagidek tovushsiz baqirayotgan minglab og'izlar. Yana go'yo ekrandagidek, qayerdadir pastda, uzoqda, bir soniyaga — O-90, yo'lakda devorga qisilgan, lablari oppoq, qorinini chalishtirilgan qo'llari bilan himoya qilib turardi. U go'yo to'lqin yuvib ketgandek g'oyib bo'ldi, yoki shunchaki men uni unutdim, chunki...

paras.en: This not on the screen any more but within me, within my compressed heart, within the rapidly pulsating temples; over my head, somewhat to the left, R-13 suddenly jumped upon a bench, all sprinkling, red, rabid. In his arms was I-330, pale, her unif torn from shoulder to breast, red blood on white. She firmly held him round the neck, and he with huge leaps from bench to bench, repellent and agile, like a gorilla, was carrying her away upward.
paras.uz: Bu endi ekranda emas, balki ichimda, siqilgan yuragimda, tez urayotgan chakkalarimda edi; boshim ustida, biroz chaproqda, R-13 to'satdan skameykaga sakrab chiqdi, butunlay sachragan, qizargan, quturgan. Uning qo'llarida I-330 bor edi, rangpar, yunifasi yelkasidan ko'kragigacha yirtilgan, oq ustida qizil qon. U R- ni bo'ynidan mahkam quchoqlab olgan edi va u skameykadan skameykaga ulkan sakrashlar bilan, jirkanch va epchil, gorilladek, uni yuqoriga olib ketayotgan edi.

paras.en: As if it were in a fire of ancient days, everything became red around me. Only one thing in my head: to jump after them, to catch them. At this moment I cannot explain to myself the source of that strength within me, but like a battering-ram I broke through the crowd, over somebody’s shoulders, over a bench and I was there in a moment and caught R-13 by the collar:
paras.uz: Go'yo qadim zamonlardagi yong'indagidek, atrofimda hamma narsa qizarib ketdi. Boshimda faqat bitta narsa: ularning ortidan sakrash, ularni ushlab olish. Hozir o'sha kuch ichimda qayerdan kelganini o'zimga tushuntira olmayman, lekin men taran kabi olomonni yorib, kimningdir yelkalari ustidan, skameyka ustidan o'tib, bir lahzada u yerda edim va R-13 ning yoqasidan ushladim:

paras.en: “Don’t you dare! Don’t you dare, I say! Immediately⁠—”
paras.uz: «Jur'at etma! Jur'at etma, deyapman! Darhol —»

paras.en: Fortunately no one could hear my voice, as everyone was shouting and running.
paras.uz: Baxtimga, ovozimni hech kim eshita olmadi, chunki hamma qichqirib, yugurayotgan edi.

paras.en: “Who is it? What is the matter? What⁠—” R-13 turned around; his sprinkling lips were trembling. He apparently thought it was one of the Guardians.
paras.uz: «Kim bu? Nima gap? Nima —» R-13 o'girildi; uning sachratuvchi lablari titrardi. U aftidan bu Qo'riqchilardan biri deb o'yladi.

paras.en: “What? I do not want⁠—I won’t allow⁠—Put her down at once!”
paras.uz: «Nima? Men istamayman — ruxsat bermayman — Uni darhol qo'yib yubor!»

paras.en: But he only sprinkled angrily with his lips, shook his head and ran on. Then I⁠ ⁠… I am terribly ashamed to write all this down but I believe I must, so that you, my unknown readers, may make a complete study of my disease.⁠ ⁠… Then I hit him over the head with all my might. You understand? I hit him. This I remember distinctly. I remember also a feeling of liberation that followed my action, a feeling of lightness in my whole body.
paras.uz: Lekin u faqat lablari bilan jahl bilan sachratib, boshini silkitdi va yugurishda davom etdi. Keyin men... Bularning hammasini yozishdan juda uyalaman, lekin ishonamanki, yozishim kerak, toki siz, noma'lum o'quvchilarim, kasalligimni to'liq o'rgana olasiz... Keyin men butun kuchim bilan uning boshiga urdim. Tushunyapsizmi? Men uni urdim. Buni aniq eslayman. Harakatimdan keyin kelgan ozodlik tuyg'usini, butun tanamdagi yengillik tuyg'usini ham eslayman.

paras.en: I-330 slid quickly out of his arms.
paras.uz: I-330 uning qo'llaridan tezgina sirg'alib tushdi.

paras.en: “Go away!” she shouted to R-, “Don’t you see that he⁠—? Go!”
paras.uz: «Ket! — u R- ga qichqirdi. — Ko'rmayapsanmi, u —? Ket!»

paras.en: R-13 showed his white negro teeth, sprinkled into my face some word, dived down and disappeared. And I picked up I-330, pressed her firmly to myself and carried her away.
paras.uz: R-13 oq negr tishlarini ko'rsatdi, yuzimga qandaydir so'zni sachratdi, pastga sho'ng'ib, g'oyib bo'ldi. Men esa I-330 ni ko'tarib, o'zimga mahkam bosib, olib ketdim.

paras.en: My heart was beating forcibly. It seemed enormous. And with every beat it would splash out such a thundering, such a hot, such a joyful wave! A flash: “Let them, below there, let them toss and rush and yell and fall; what matter if something has fallen, if something has been shattered to dust?⁠—Little matter! Only to remain this way and carry her, carry and carry.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Yuragim kuchli urardi. U ulkan tuyulardi. Va har bir urishida shunday gumburlagan, shunday issiq, shunday quvonchli to'lqinni sachratib chiqarardi! Chaqnash: «Mayli, ular u yerda, pastda, uloqib, otilib, baqirib, yiqilaversin; nimadir qulagan bo'lsa, nimadir chang-to'zonga aylangan bo'lsa nima bo'pti? — Ahamiyati yo'q! Faqat shunday qolsam va uni ko'tarib ketsam, ko'tarib ketsam, ko'tarib ketsam...»

paras.en: The Same Evening, Twenty-Two O’Clock.
paras.uz: O'sha kuni kechqurun, soat yigirma ikki.

paras.en: I hold my pen with great difficulty. Such an extraordinary fatigue after all the dizzying events of this morning. Is it possible that the strong, salutary, centuries-old walls of the United State have fallen? Is it possible that we are again without a roof over our heads, back in the wild state of freedom like our remote ancestors? Is it possible that we have lost our Well-Doer? “Opposed!” On the Day of Unanimity⁠—opposed! I am ashamed of them, painfully, fearfully ashamed.⁠ ⁠… But who are “they”? And who am I? “They,” “We”⁠ ⁠… ? Do I know?
paras.uz: Qalamni juda qiyinchilik bilan ushlab turibman. Bugun ertalabki barcha bosh aylantiruvchi voqealardan keyin shunday g'ayrioddiy charchoq. Nahotki Yagona Davlatning kuchli, najotbaxsh, asrlik devorlari qulagan bo'lsa? Nahotki biz yana boshimiz ustida tomsiz, uzoq ajdodlarimiz kabi yovvoyi erkinlik holatiga qaytgan bo'lsak? Nahotki biz Homiyimizni yo'qotgan bo'lsak? «Qarshi!» Bir Ovozlilik Kunida — qarshi! Men ulardan uyalaman, og'riqli, qo'rqinchli darajada uyalaman... Lekin «ular» kim? Men esa kimman? «Ular», «Biz»...? Bilamanmi?

paras.en: I shall continue.
paras.uz: Davom etaman.

paras.en: She was sitting where I had brought her on the uppermost glass bench which was hot from the sun. Her right shoulder and the beginning of the wonderful and incalculable curve were uncovered⁠—an exceedingly thin serpent of blood. She seemed not to be aware of the blood, or that her breast was uncovered. No, I will say rather: she seemed to see all that and seemed to feel that it was essential to her, that if her unif were buttoned she would have torn it, she would have.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U men olib kelgan joyda, quyoshdan qizigan eng yuqori shisha skameykada o'tirardi. Uning o'ng yelkasi va ajoyib, hisoblab bo'lmas egri chiziqning boshlanishi ochiq edi — juda ingichka qon iloni. U qonni ham, ko'kragi ochiqligini ham sezmayotgandek edi. Yo'q, yaxshisi shunday deyman: u bularning hammasini ko'rayotgandek va bu unga zarur ekanini his qilayotgandek edi, agar yunifasi tugmalangan bo'lganida u uni yirtib tashlagan bo'lardi, u...

paras.en: “And tomorrow!” She breathed the words through sparkling white clenched teeth, “Tomorrow, nobody knows what⁠ ⁠… do you understand? Neither I nor anyone else knows; it is unknown! Do you realize what a joy it is? Do you realize that all that was certain has come to an end? Now⁠ ⁠… things will be new, improbable, unforeseen!”
paras.uz: «Ertaga esa! — U so'zlarni yaltiroq oq qisilgan tishlari orasidan nafas bilan chiqardi. — Ertaga nima bo'lishini hech kim bilmaydi... tushunyapsizmi? Na men, na boshqa birov biladi; bu noma'lum! Bu qanday quvonch ekanini anglayapsizmi? Aniq bo'lgan hamma narsa nihoyasiga yetganini anglayapsizmi? Endi... hamma narsa yangi, aql bovar qilmas, kutilmagan bo'ladi!»

paras.en: Below the human waves were still foaming, tossing, roaring, but they seemed to be very far away, and to be growing more and more distant. For she was looking at me. She slowly drew me into herself through the narrow, golden windows of her pupils. We thus remained silent for a long while. And for some reason I recalled how once I watched some queer yellow pupils through the Green Wall, while above the Wall birds were soaring (or was this another time?).
paras.uz: Pastda inson to'lqinlari hali ham ko'piklanib, uloqib, gumburlardi, lekin ular juda uzoqda tuyulardi va tobora uzoqlashib borardi. Chunki u menga qarab turardi. U meni ko'z qorachiqlarining tor, oltin derazalari orqali sekin o'ziga tortdi. Biz shu tariqa uzoq vaqt jim qoldik. Va negadir bir marta Yashil Devor orqali qandaydir g'alati sariq qorachiqlarni kuzatganim, Devor ustida esa qushlar parvoz qilib yurgani esimga tushdi (yoki bu boshqa safar edimi?).

paras.en: “Listen, if nothing particular happens tomorrow, I shall take you there; do you understand?”
paras.uz: «Quloq soling, agar ertaga alohida hech narsa bo'lmasa, sizni u yerga olib boraman; tushunyapsizmi?»

paras.en: No, I did not understand but I nodded in silence. I was dissolved, I became infinitesimal, a geometrical point.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Yo'q, tushunmadim, lekin jimgina bosh irg'adim. Men erib ketgandim, cheksiz kichik, geometrik nuqtaga aylangandim...

paras.en: After all, there is some logic⁠—a peculiar logic of today, in this state of being a point. A point has more unknowns than any other entity. If a point should start to move, it might become thousands of curves, or hundreds of solids.
paras.uz: Oxir-oqibat, bu nuqta bo'lish holatida qandaydir mantiq — bugungi kunning o'ziga xos mantig'i bor. Nuqtada boshqa har qanday narsadan ko'ra ko'proq noma'lumlar bor. Agar nuqta harakatlana boshlasa, u minglab egri chiziqlarga yoki yuzlab jismlarga aylanishi mumkin.

paras.en: I was afraid to budge. What might I have become if I had moved? It seemed to me that everybody like myself was afraid now of even the most minute of motions.
paras.uz: Qimirlashdan qo'rqardim. Agar qimirlasam, nimaga aylangan bo'lardim? Menga hamma ham men kabi endi eng kichik harakatdan ham qo'rqayotgandek tuyuldi.

paras.en: At this moment, for instance, as I sit and write, everyone is sitting hidden in his glass cell, expecting something. I do not hear the buzzing of the elevators, usual at this hour, or laughter or steps, from time to time Numbers pass in couples through the hall, whispering, on tiptoe.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Masalan, hozir, men o'tirib yozayotganimda, hamma o'zining shisha katagiga yashirinib o'tirib, nimanidir kutyapti. Bu soatda odatiy bo'lgan liftlar g'uvillashini, kulgi yoki qadamlarni eshitmayapman, vaqti-vaqti bilan Raqamlar juft-juft bo'lib yo'lakdan shivirlashib, oyoq uchida o'tib ketishadi...

paras.en: What will happen tomorrow? What will become of me tomorrow?
paras.uz: Ertaga nima bo'ladi? Ertaga menga nima bo'ladi?

gloss.ex: …ays of the sun. It was He, descending to us from the sky, He⁠—the new Jehovah⁠—in an aero, He, as wise and as lovingly cruel as the Jehovah of the ancients. Nea…
…a screen, somewhere below at a distance, for a second⁠—O-90, pressed against the wall in a passage, her lips white, defending her abdomen with her crossed arms…
“Those opposed?”⁠ ⁠…
…d he with huge leaps from bench to bench, repellent and agile, like a gorilla, was carrying her away upward.
…ashamed to write all this down but I believe I must, so that you, my unknown readers, may make a complete study of my disease.⁠ ⁠… Then I hit him over the head…

quiz.q: What happens during the vote?
quiz.why_uz: Tarixda birinchi marta «qarshi» ovoz beriladi.

quiz.q: What does I-330 say is joyful about tomorrow?
quiz.why_uz: Noma'lumlik — uning uchun quvonch.

chapters.recap_uz: Saylovda minglab odamlar, jumladan I-330, Homiyga «qarshi» qo'l ko'taradi. Tartibsizlik boshlanadi; D-503 R-13 ni urib, yarador I-330 ni olib ketadi.

chapters.title: The world does exist — Rash — Forty-one degrees centigrade
chapters.title_uz: Dunyo mavjud — Toshma — Qirq bir daraja issiq

paras.en: Morning. Through the ceiling the sky is as usual firm, round, red-cheeked. I think I should have been less surprised had I found above some extraordinary quadrangular sun, or people clad in many-colored dresses made of the skins of animals, or opaque walls of stone. Then the world, our world, does still exist? Or is it only inertia? Is the generator already switched out, while the armature is still roaring and revolving;⁠—two more revolutions, or three, and at the fourth will it die away?
paras.uz: Tong. Ship orqali osmon odatdagidek mustahkam, dumaloq, qizil yonoqli. Menimcha, agar tepada qandaydir g'ayrioddiy to'rtburchak quyoshni, yoki hayvon terisidan tikilgan rang-barang liboslar kiygan odamlarni, yoki shaffof bo'lmagan tosh devorlarni topganimda kamroq hayron bo'lgan bo'lardim. Demak, dunyo, bizning dunyomiz hali ham mavjudmi? Yoki bu faqat inersiyami? Generator allaqachon o'chirilgan-u, yakor hali ham gumburlab aylanayaptimi; — yana ikki yoki uch aylanish va to'rtinchisida u so'nib qoladimi?

paras.en: Are you familiar with that strange state in which you wake up in the middle of the night, open your eyes into the darkness and then suddenly feel you are lost in the dark; you quickly, quickly begin to feel around, to seek something familiar and solid, a wall, a lamp, a chair? In exactly the same way I felt around, seeking in the Journal of the United State; quickly, quickly⁠—I found this:
paras.uz: Yarim tunda uyg'onib, ko'zlaringizni zulmatga ochib, keyin to'satdan qorong'ilikda adashib qolganingizni his qiladigan va tez, tez atrofni paypaslab, tanish va mustahkam biror narsani — devor, chiroq, stulni izlay boshlaydigan o'sha g'alati holat sizga tanishmi? Men ham xuddi shunday paypaslab, Yagona Davlat Gazetasidan izladim; tez, tez — mana buni topdim:

paras.en: “The celebration of the Day of Unanimity, long awaited by all, took place yesterday. The same Well-Doer who so often proved his unshakeable wisdom, was unanimously reelected for the forty-eighth time. The celebration was clouded by a little confusion, created by the enemies of happiness, who by their action naturally lost the right to be the bricks for the foundation of the renovated United State. It is clear to everybody that to take into consideration their votes would mean to consider as a part of a magnificent, heroic symphony the accidental cough of a sick person who happened to be in a concert hall.”
paras.uz: «Hamma uzoq kutgan Bir Ovozlilik Kuni bayrami kecha bo'lib o'tdi. O'zining qo'zg'almas donoligini ko'p marta isbotlagan o'sha Homiy qirq sakkizinchi marta bir ovozdan qayta saylandi. Bayramga baxt dushmanlari tomonidan yaratilgan ozgina sarosima soya soldi, ular o'z harakatlari bilan, tabiiyki, yangilangan Yagona Davlat poydevori uchun g'isht bo'lish huquqini yo'qotdilar. Hammaga ayonki, ularning ovozlarini hisobga olish — kontsert zalida tasodifan bo'lib qolgan kasal odamning tasodifiy yo'talini ulug'vor, qahramonona simfoniyaning bir qismi deb hisoblash demakdir».

paras.en: Oh, great Sage! Is it really true that despite everything we are saved? What objection indeed can one find to this most crystalline syllogism? And further on a few more lines:
paras.uz: Oh, buyuk Donishmand! Nahotki hamma narsaga qaramay biz najot topgan bo'lsak? Haqiqatan ham, bu eng billurdek sillogizmga qanday e'tiroz topish mumkin? Va yana bir necha satr:

paras.en: “Today at twelve o’clock a joint meeting of the Administrative Bureau, Medical Bureau, and Bureau of Guardians will take place. An important State decree is to be expected shortly.”
paras.uz: «Bugun soat o'n ikkida Ma'muriy Byuro, Tibbiyot Byurosi va Qo'riqchilar Idorasining qo'shma yig'ilishi bo'lib o'tadi. Tez orada muhim Davlat farmoni kutilmoqda».

paras.en: No, the Walls still stand erect. Here they are! I can feel them. And that strange feeling of being lost somewhere, of not knowing where I am⁠—that feeling is gone. I am not surprised any longer to see the sky blue and the sun round and all the Numbers going to work as usual.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Yo'q, Devorlar hali ham tik turibdi. Mana ular! Men ularni his qila olaman. Va qayerdadir adashib qolish, qayerda ekanimni bilmaslik haqidagi o'sha g'alati tuyg'u — u ketdi. Endi osmonning moviy, quyoshning dumaloq ekanini va barcha Raqamlar odatdagidek ishga ketayotganini ko'rib hayron bo'lmayman...

paras.en: I walked along the avenue with a particularly firm resounding step. It seemed to me that everyone else walked exactly like me. But at the crossing, on turning the corner, I noticed people strangely shying away, going around the corner of a building sidewise, as if a pipe had burst in the wall, as if cold water were spurting like a fountain on the sidewalk and it was impossible to cross it.
paras.uz: Men prospekt bo'ylab ayniqsa qat'iy, jarangdor qadam bilan yurdim. Menga hamma ham xuddi men kabi yurayotgandek tuyuldi. Lekin chorrahada, muyulishdan burilayotganimda, odamlar g'alati tarzda chetlanib, binoning burchagini yon tomondan aylanib o'tayotganini payqadim, go'yo devorda quvur yorilib, trotuarga sovuq suv favvoradek otilayotgan va uni kesib o'tish imkonsizdek.

paras.en: Another five or ten steps and I too felt a spurt of cold water that struck me and threw me from the sidewalk; at a height of approximately two meters a quadrangular piece of paper was pasted to the wall and on that sheet of paper⁠—unintelligible, poisonously green letters:
paras.uz: Yana besh yoki o'n qadam va men ham meni urib, trotuardan uloqtirib tashlagan sovuq suv oqimini his qildim; taxminan ikki metr balandlikda devorga to'rtburchak qog'oz parchasi yopishtirilgan edi va o'sha qog'oz varag'ida — tushunarsiz, zaharli yashil harflar:

paras.en: Mephi
paras.uz: MEFI

paras.en: And under the paper⁠—an S-like curved back and wing-ears shaking with anger or emotion. His right arm lifted as high as possible, his left arm hopelessly stretched out backward like a hurt wing, he was trying to jump high enough to reach the paper and tear it off but he was unable to do so. He was a fraction of an inch too short.
paras.uz: Qog'oz ostida esa — S- shaklida egilgan orqa va g'azab yoki hayajondan titrayotgan qanot-quloqlar. O'ng qo'lini iloji boricha baland ko'tarib, chap qo'lini jarohatlangan qanotdek umidsiz orqaga cho'zib, u qog'ozga yetib, uni yirtib olish uchun yetarlicha baland sakrashga urinardi, lekin qila olmasdi. Unga bir dyuymning bir qismi yetmasdi.

paras.en: Probably every one of the passersby had the same thought: “If I go to help him, I, only one of the many, will he not think that I am guilty of something and that I am therefore anxious to.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Ehtimol, o'tib ketayotganlarning har biri bir xil fikrda edi: «Agar men, ko'plardan faqat biri, unga yordam berishga borsam, u meni nimadadir aybdor va shuning uchun ... ga intilyapti deb o'ylamaydimi...»

paras.en: I must confess, I had that thought. But remembering how many times he had proved my real Guardian-angel and how often he had saved me, I stepped towards him and with courage and warm assurance I stretched out my hand and tore off the sheet. S- turned around. The little drills sank quickly into me to the bottom and found something there. Then he lifted his left brow, winked toward the wall where “Mephi” had been hanging a minute ago. The tail of his little smile twinkled even with a certain pleasure which greatly surprised me. But why should I be surprised? A doctor always prefers a temperature of 40° C and a rash to the slow, languid rise of the temperature during the period of incubation of a disease; it enables him to determine the character of the disease. Mephi broke out today on the walls like a rash. I understood his smile.
paras.uz: Tan olishim kerak, menda ham shu fikr bor edi. Lekin u necha marta mening haqiqiy Farishta-Qo'riqchim ekanini isbotlaganini va meni necha marta qutqarganini eslab, unga qarab qadam tashladim va jasorat va iliq ishonch bilan qo'limni cho'zib, varaqni yirtib oldim. S- o'girildi. Kichkina parmalar tezda menga tubigacha kirib, u yerda nimanidir topdi. Keyin u chap qoshini ko'tarib, bir daqiqa oldin «Mefi» osilib turgan devorga qarab ko'z qisdi. Uning kichkina tabassumining dumi hatto qandaydir mamnuniyat bilan yiltiradi, bu meni juda hayron qoldirdi. Lekin nega hayron bo'lishim kerak? Shifokor har doim kasallikning inkubatsiya davridagi haroratning sekin, sust ko'tarilishidan ko'ra 40° C haroratni va toshmani afzal ko'radi; bu unga kasallikning xususiyatini aniqlash imkonini beradi. Mefi bugun devorlarda toshmadek toshib chiqdi. Men uning tabassumini tushundim.

paras.en: In the passage to the underground railway, under our feet on the clean glass of the steps again a white sheet: Mephi. And also on the walls of the tunnel and on the benches and on the mirror of the car. (Apparently pasted on in haste as some were hanging on a slant.) Everywhere the same white gruesome rash.
paras.uz: Yer osti temir yo'liga o'tish joyida, oyoqlarimiz ostida zinapoyalarning toza shishasida yana oq varaq: Mefi. Yana tunnel devorlarida, skameykalarda va vagon ko'zgusida. (Aftidan, shoshilib yopishtirilgan, chunki ba'zilari qiyshiq osilib turardi.) Hamma joyda bir xil oq, dahshatli toshma.

paras.en: I must confess that the exact meaning of that smile became clear to me only after many days which were overfilled with the strangest and most unexpected events.
paras.uz: Tan olishim kerakki, o'sha tabassumning aniq ma'nosi menga faqat eng g'alati va eng kutilmagan voqealarga to'la ko'p kunlardan keyin ayon bo'ldi.

paras.en: The roaring of the wheels, distinct in the general silence, seemed to be the noise of infected streams of blood. Some Number was inadvertently touched on the shoulder and he started so that a package of papers fell out of his hands. To my left another Number was reading a paper, his eyes fixed always on the same line; the paper perceptibly trembled in his hands. I felt that everywhere, in the wheels, in the hands, in the newspapers, even in the eyelashes, the pulse was becoming more and more rapid and I thought it probable that today when I-330 and I should find ourselves there, the temperature would rise to 39°, 40°, perhaps 41° and.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Umumiy sukunatda aniq eshitilayotgan g'ildiraklarning gumburlashi zararlangan qon oqimlarining shovqiniga o'xshardi. Qandaydir Raqamning yelkasiga beixtiyor tegib ketishdi va u shunday cho'chidiki, qo'lidan bir dasta qog'oz tushib ketdi. Chap tomonimda boshqa bir Raqam gazeta o'qirdi, ko'zlari doimo bir satrga qadalgan edi; gazeta uning qo'llarida sezilarli titrardi. Men hamma joyda, g'ildiraklarda, qo'llarda, gazetalarda, hatto kipriklarda ham puls tobora tezlashayotganini his qildim va bugun I-330 va men u yerda bo'lganimizda harorat 39°, 40°, balki 41° gacha ko'tarilishi ehtimoli bor deb o'yladim va...

paras.en: At the docks⁠—the same silence filled with the buzzing of an invisible propeller. The lathes were silent as if brooding. Only the cranes were moving almost inaudibly as if on tiptoe, gliding, bending over, picking up with their tentacles the lumps of frozen air and loading the tanks of the Integral. We are already preparing the Integral for a trial flight.
paras.uz: Stapelda — ko'rinmas parrakning g'uvillashi bilan to'lgan o'sha sukunat. Dastgohlar go'yo o'ylanib qolgandek jim edi. Faqat kranlar deyarli eshitilmas, go'yo oyoq uchida harakatlanib, sirpanib, egilib, paypaslagichlari bilan muzlagan havo bo'laklarini ilib, Integral baklariga yuklardi. Biz allaqachon Integralni sinov parvoziga tayyorlayapmiz.

paras.en: “Well, shall we have her up in a week?” This was my question addressed to the Second Builder. His face is like porcelain, painted with sweet blue and tender pink little flowers (eyes and lips), but today those little flowers looked faded and washed-out. We were counting aloud when suddenly I broke off in the midst of a word and stopped, my mouth wide open; above the cupola, above the blue lump lifted by the crane, there was a scarcely noticeable small white square. I felt my whole body trembling⁠—perhaps with laughter. Yes! I myself heard my own laughter. (Did you ever hear your own laughter?)
paras.uz: «Xo'sh, uni bir haftada uchiramizmi?» Bu Ikkinchi Quruvchiga bergan savolim edi. Uning yuzi shirin moviy va nozik pushti gulchalar (ko'zlar va lablar) chizilgan chinniga o'xshaydi, lekin bugun o'sha gulchalar so'lgan va rangi o'chgandek ko'rinardi. Biz ovoz chiqarib hisoblayotgandik, to'satdan men so'zning o'rtasida uzilib, og'zimni katta ochganimcha to'xtab qoldim; gumbaz ustida, kran ko'targan moviy bo'lak ustida zo'rg'a seziladigan kichkina oq to'rtburchak bor edi. Butun tanam titrayotganini his qildim — balki kulgidandir. Ha! Men o'zim o'z kulgimni eshitdim. (Siz hech o'z kulgingizni eshitganmisiz?)

paras.en: “No, listen,” I said. “Imagine you are in an ancient aeroplane. The altimeter shows 5,000 meters. A wing breaks; you are dashing down like.⁠ ⁠… And on the way you calculate: ‘Tomorrow from twelve to two⁠ ⁠… from two to six⁠ ⁠… and dinner at five!’ Would it not be absurd?”
paras.uz: «Yo'q, quloq soling, — dedim men. — Tasavvur qiling, siz qadimiy samolyotdasiz. Altimetr 5000 metrni ko'rsatyapti. Qanot sinadi; siz ... kabi pastga otilasiz... Va yo'lda hisoblaysiz: "Ertaga o'n ikkidan ikkigacha... ikkidan oltigacha... va beshda tushlik!" Bu bema'ni bo'lmasmidi?»

paras.en: The little blue flowers began to move and bulge out. What if I were made of glass and he could have seen what was going on within me at that moment? If he knew that some three or four hours later.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Kichkina moviy gulchalar qimirlab, bo'rtib chiqa boshladi. Agar men shishadan yasalgan bo'lsam-u, u o'sha lahzada ichimda nima bo'layotganini ko'ra olsa-chi? Agar u uch-to'rt soatdan keyin... ekanini bilsa...

gloss.ex: …I be surprised? A doctor always prefers a temperature of 40° C and a rash to the slow, languid rise of the temperature during the period of incubation of a dis…
…re saved? What objection indeed can one find to this most crystalline syllogism? And further on a few more lines:
…ash to the slow, languid rise of the temperature during the period of incubation of a disease; it enables him to determine the character of the disease. Mephi b…
Mephi
…he tanks of the Integral. We are already preparing the Integral for a trial flight.

quiz.q: What word appears on walls all over the city?
quiz.why_uz: MEFI — isyonchilarning nomi.

quiz.q: What does the newspaper say about the 'against' votes?
o: They are like a cough in a symphony
quiz.why_uz: Gazeta ularni hisobga olmaydi.

chapters.recap_uz: Gazeta Homiy bir ovozdan qayta saylanganini yozadi. Devorlarda «MEFI» yozuvlari paydo bo'ladi. D-503 S- ning yozuvni yirtishiga yordam beradi.

chapters.title: No headings. It is impossible!

paras.en: I was alone in the endless corridors. In those same corridors.⁠ ⁠… A mute, concrete sky. Water was dripping somewhere upon a stone. The familiar heavy opaque door⁠—and the subdued noise from behind it.
paras.uz: Men cheksiz yo'laklarda yolg'iz edim. O'sha yo'laklarda... Soqov, beton osmon. Qayerdadir toshga suv tomardi. Tanish og'ir, shaffof bo'lmagan eshik — va uning ortidan bo'g'iq shovqin.

paras.en: She said she would come out at sixteen sharp. It was already five minutes, then ten, then fifteen past sixteen. No one appeared. For a second I was my former self, horrified at the thought that the door might open.
paras.uz: U aynan o'n oltida chiqaman degan edi. Allaqachon o'n oltidan besh daqiqa, keyin o'n, keyin o'n besh daqiqa o'tdi. Hech kim ko'rinmadi. Bir soniyaga men avvalgi o'zim bo'ldim, eshik ochilishi mumkinligi haqidagi fikrdan dahshatga tushgan.

paras.en: “Five minutes more, and if she does not come out.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Yana besh daqiqa va agar u chiqmasa...»

paras.en: Water was dripping somewhere upon a stone. No one about. With melancholy pleasure I felt: “saved,” and slowly I turned and walked back along the corridor. The trembling dots of the small lamps on the ceiling became dimmer and dimmer. Suddenly a quick rattle of a door behind me. Quick steps, softly echoing from the ceiling and the walls. It was she, light as a bird, panting somewhat from running.
paras.uz: Qayerdadir toshga suv tomardi. Atrofda hech kim yo'q. G'amgin rohat bilan his qildim: «qutuldim» va sekin o'girilib, yo'lak bo'ylab orqaga yurdim. Shiftdagi kichkina chiroqlarning titroq nuqtalari tobora xiralashib borardi. To'satdan orqamda eshikning tez shaqillashi. Tez qadamlar, shift va devorlardan muloyim aks-sado beradi. Bu u edi, qushdek yengil, yugurganidan biroz hansirab.

paras.en: “I knew you would be here, you would come! I knew you⁠—you.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Bilardim, siz shu yerda bo'lasiz, kelasiz! Bilardim, siz — siz...»

paras.en: The spears of her eyelashes moved apart to let me in and⁠ ⁠… how can I describe what effect that ancient, absurd and wonderful rite has upon me when her lips touch mine? Can I find a formula to express that whirlwind which sweeps out of my soul everything, everything save her? Yes, yes from my soul. You may laugh at me if you will.
paras.uz: Kipriklarining nayzalari meni ichkariga kiritish uchun ajraldi va... uning lablari menikiga tekkanda o'sha qadimiy, bema'ni va ajoyib marosim menga qanday ta'sir qilishini qanday tasvirlay olaman? Qalbimdan hamma narsani, undan boshqa hamma narsani supurib tashlaydigan o'sha quyunni ifodalash uchun formula topa olamanmi? Ha, ha, qalbimdan. Xohlasangiz, ustimdan kulishingiz mumkin.

paras.en: She made an effort to raise her eyelids and her slow words too came with an effort:
paras.uz: U qovoqlarini ko'tarish uchun kuch sarfladi va uning sekin so'zlari ham kuch bilan chiqdi:

paras.en: “No. Now we must go.”
paras.uz: «Yo'q. Endi borishimiz kerak».

paras.en: The door opened. Old, worn steps. An unbearably multicolored noise, whistling and light.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Eshik ochildi. Eski, yemirilgan zinapoyalar. Chidab bo'lmas darajada rang-barang shovqin, hushtak va yorug'lik...

paras.en: Twenty-four hours have passed since then and everything seems to have settled in me, yet it is most difficult for me to find words for even an approximate description.⁠ ⁠… It is as though a bomb had exploded in my head.⁠ ⁠… Open mouths, wings, shouts, leaves, words, stones, all these one after another in a heap.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: O'shandan beri yigirma to'rt soat o'tdi va ichimda hamma narsa joyiga tushgandek tuyuladi, lekin hatto taxminiy tasvirlash uchun so'z topish ham men uchun nihoyatda qiyin... Go'yo boshimda bomba portlagandek... Ochiq og'izlar, qanotlar, qichqiriqlar, barglar, so'zlar, toshlar, bularning hammasi birin-ketin uyum bo'lib...

paras.en: I remember my first thought was: “Fast⁠—back!” For it was clear to me that while I was waiting there in the corridors, they somehow had blasted and destroyed the Green Wall, and from behind it everything rushed in and splashed over our city which until then had been kept clean of that lower world. I must have said something of this sort to I-330. She laughed.
paras.uz: Esimda, birinchi fikrim: «Tezroq — orqaga!» edi. Chunki menga aniq ediki, men u yerda, yo'laklarda kutib turganimda, ular qandaydir yo'l bilan Yashil Devorni portlatib, vayron qilishgan va uning ortidan hamma narsa bostirib kirib, shu paytgacha o'sha quyi dunyodan toza saqlangan shahrimiz ustiga yopirilib kelgan. Men I-330 ga shunga o'xshash nimadir degan bo'lsam kerak. U kuldi.

paras.en: “No, we have simply come out beyond the Green Wall.”
paras.uz: «Yo'q, biz shunchaki Yashil Devor ortiga chiqdik».

paras.en: Then I opened my eyes, and close to me, actually, I saw those very things which until then not a single living Number had ever seen otherwise than depreciated a thousand times, dimmed and hazy through the cloudy glass of the Wall.
paras.uz: Shunda ko'zlarimni ochdim va yonimda, haqiqatan ham, shu paytgacha bironta tirik Raqam Devorning xira shishasi orqali ming marta qadrsizlangan, xiralashgan va tumanli holda ko'rmagan o'sha narsalarni ko'rdim.

paras.en: The Sun⁠—it was no longer our light, evenly diffused over the mirror surface of the pavements; it seemed an accumulation of living fragments, of incessantly oscillating, dizzy spots which blinded the eyes. And the trees! Like candles rising into the very sky, or like spiders which squatted upon the earth, supported by their clumsy paws, or like mute green fountains. And all this was moving, jumping, rustling. Under my feet some strange little ball was crawling.⁠ ⁠… I stood as though rooted to the ground. I was unable to take a step because under my foot there was not an even plane, but (imagine!), something disgustingly soft, yielding, living, springy, green!⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Quyosh — u endi trotuarlarning ko'zgudek yuzasiga bir tekis tarqalgan bizning yorug'ligimiz emas edi; u tirik parchalarning, ko'zlarni qamashtiradigan, to'xtovsiz tebranadigan, bosh aylantiruvchi dog'larning to'plamidek tuyulardi. Daraxtlar esa! Go'yo osmonning o'zigacha ko'tarilayotgan shamlardek, yoki qo'pol panjalariga tayanib yerga cho'kkalagan o'rgimchaklardek, yoki soqov yashil favvoralardek. Va bularning hammasi harakatlanardi, sakrardi, shitirlardi. Oyoqlarim ostida qandaydir g'alati kichkina koptok emaklardi... Men go'yo yerga ildiz otgandek turib qoldim. Bir qadam ham bosa olmasdim, chunki oyog'im ostida tekis yuza emas, balki (tasavvur qiling!) nimadir jirkanch darajada yumshoq, egiluvchan, tirik, prujinali, yashil narsa bor edi!..

paras.en: I was dazed; I was strangled⁠—yes, strangled; it is the best word to express my state. I stood holding fast with both hands to a swinging branch.
paras.uz: Men esankirab qoldim; bo'g'ildim — ha, bo'g'ildim; bu mening holatimni ifodalash uchun eng yaxshi so'z. Men tebranayotgan shoxni ikki qo'lim bilan mahkam ushlab turardim.

paras.en: “It is nothing. It is all right. It is natural⁠—for the first time. It will pass. Courage!”
paras.uz: «Hech narsa emas. Hammasi joyida. Bu tabiiy — birinchi marta. O'tib ketadi. Jasorat!»

paras.en: At I-330’s side bouncing dizzily on a green net⁠—someone’s thinnest profile, cut out of paper. No, not “someone’s.” I recognized him. I remembered. It was the doctor. I understood everything very clearly. I realized that they both caught me beneath the arms and laughingly dragged me forward. My legs twisted and glided.⁠ ⁠… Terrible noise, cawing, stumps, yelling, branches, tree-trunks, wings, leaves, whistling.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: I-330 ning yonida yashil to'r ustida boshi aylanib sakrab turgan — qog'ozdan qirqib olingan kimningdir eng ingichka profili. Yo'q, «kimningdir» emas. Men uni tanidim. Esladim. Bu shifokor edi. Men hamma narsani juda aniq tushundim. Ikkalasi meni qo'ltig'imdan ushlab, kulib oldinga sudrab ketayotganini angladim. Oyoqlarim chalkashib, sirpanardi... Dahshatli shovqin, qag'illash, to'nkalar, baqiriq, shoxlar, daraxt tanalari, qanotlar, barglar, hushtak...

paras.en: The trees ran apart. A bright clearing. In the clearing, people, or perhaps to be more exact, beings. Now comes the most difficult part to describe for this was beyond any bounds of probability. It is clear to me now why I-330 was stubbornly silent about it before; I should not have believed it, should not have believed even her. It is even possible that tomorrow I shall not believe myself, shall not believe my own description in these pages.
paras.uz: Daraxtlar ikki tomonga yugurib ketdi. Yorqin o'tloq. O'tloqda odamlar, yoki aniqrog'i, mavjudotlar. Endi tasvirlash eng qiyin qism keladi, chunki bu har qanday ehtimol chegarasidan tashqarida edi. Endi menga I-330 nega ilgari bu haqda o'jarlik bilan jim turgani aniq; men ishonmagan bo'lardim, hatto unga ham ishonmagan bo'lardim. Hatto ertaga men o'zimga ishonmasligim, bu sahifalardagi o'z tasvirimga ishonmasligim ham mumkin.

paras.en: In the clearing, around a naked, skull-like rock⁠—a noisy crowd of three or four hundred⁠ ⁠… people. Well, let’s call them people. I find it difficult to coin new words. Just as on the stands you recognize in the general accumulation of faces only those which are familiar to you, so at first I recognized only our grayish-blue unifs. But one second later and I saw distinctly and clearly among the unifs dark, red, golden, black, brown and white humans⁠—apparently they were humans. None of them had any clothes on, and their bodies were covered with short, glistening hair, like that which may be seen on the stuffed horse in the Prehistoric Museum. But their females had faces exactly, yes exactly, like the faces of our women: tender, rosy and not overgrown with hair. Also their breasts were free of hair, firm breasts of wonderful geometrical form. As to the males, only a part of their faces were free from hair, like our ancestors’, and the organs of reproduction, similar to ours.
paras.uz: O'tloqda, yalang'och, bosh suyagiga o'xshash qoya atrofida — uch-to'rt yuzta... odamlardan iborat shovqinli olomon. Xo'sh, ularni odamlar deb ataylik. Yangi so'zlar yasash menga qiyin. Xuddi tribunalarda umumiy yuzlar to'plamida faqat o'zingizga tanish bo'lganlarini taniganingiz kabi, men ham avvaliga faqat bizning kulrang-ko'k yunifalarimizni tanidim. Lekin bir soniyadan keyin yunifalar orasida qora, qizil, oltinrang, qora, jigarrang va oq odamlarni — aftidan ular odamlar edi — aniq va ravshan ko'rdim. Ularning hech birida kiyim yo'q edi va tanalari Tarixdan oldingi davr muzeyidagi to'ldirilgan otda ko'rish mumkin bo'lganidek qisqa, yaltiroq tuk bilan qoplangan edi. Lekin ularning ayollarining yuzlari xuddi, ha, xuddi bizning ayollarimiznikidek edi: nozik, pushti va tuk bosmagan. Ularning ko'kraklari ham tuksiz, ajoyib geometrik shakldagi qattiq ko'kraklar edi. Erkaklarga kelsak, ularning yuzlarining faqat bir qismi, ajdodlarimiznikidek, tuksiz edi, ko'payish a'zolari ham biznikiga o'xshash edi.

paras.en: All this was so unbelievable, so unexpected, that I stood there quietly (I assert positively that I stood quietly), and looked around. Like a scale: overload one side sufficiently and then you may gently put on the other as much as you will; the arrow will not move.
paras.uz: Bularning hammasi shunchalik aql bovar qilmas, shunchalik kutilmagan ediki, men u yerda xotirjam turib (men xotirjam turganimni qat'iy ta'kidlayman), atrofga qaradim. Xuddi tarozidek: bir tomonini yetarlicha ortiqcha yuklang, keyin ikkinchi tomoniga xohlagancha muloyim qo'yaverishingiz mumkin; mil qimirlamaydi.

paras.en: Suddenly I felt alone. I-330 was no longer with me. I don’t know how nor where she disappeared. Around me were only those, with their hair glistening like silk in the sunlight. I caught someone’s warm, strong, dark shoulder.
paras.uz: To'satdan o'zimni yolg'iz his qildim. I-330 endi men bilan emas edi. U qanday va qayerga g'oyib bo'lganini bilmayman. Atrofimda faqat quyosh nurida ipakdek yaltirayotgan tuklari bilan o'shalar bor edi. Kimningdir iliq, kuchli, qoramtir yelkasini ushladim.

paras.en: “Listen, please, in the name of the Well-Doer, could you tell me where she went? A while, a minute ago she.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Quloq soling, iltimos, Homiy nomi bilan, u qayerga ketganini ayta olasizmi? Hozirgina, bir daqiqa oldin u...»

paras.en: Long-haired, austere eyebrows turned to me.
paras.uz: Uzun tukli, qattiqqo'l qoshlar menga o'girildi.

paras.en: “Sh⁠ ⁠… sh⁠ ⁠… silence!” He made a sign with his head towards the centre where there stood the yellow, skull-like stone.
paras.uz: «Tss... tss... jim!» U boshi bilan markazga, sariq, bosh suyagiga o'xshash tosh turgan joyga ishora qildi.

paras.en: There above the heads of all I saw her. The sun beat straight into my eyes, and because of that she seemed coal-black, standing out on the blue cloth of the sky⁠—a coal-black silhouette on a blue background. A little higher the clouds were floating. And it seemed that not the clouds but the rock itself, and she herself upon that rock, and the crowd and the clearing⁠—all were silently floating like a ship, and the earth was light and glided away from under the feet.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U yerda hammaning boshi uzra men uni ko'rdim. Quyosh to'g'ri ko'zlarimga urilardi va shuning uchun u ko'mirdek qora bo'lib, osmonning moviy matosida ajralib turgandek tuyulardi — moviy fonda ko'mirdek qora siluet. Biroz yuqorida bulutlar suzardi. Va go'yo bulutlar emas, balki qoyaning o'zi va u qoya ustidagi uning o'zi, olomon va o'tloq — hammasi kemadek jimgina suzayotgandek, yer esa yengil va oyoqlar ostidan sirpanib ketayotgandek tuyulardi...

paras.en: “Brothers!” (It was she.) “Brothers, you all know that there inside the Wall, in the City, they are building the Integral. And you know also that the day has come for us to destroy that Wall and all other walls, so that the green wind may blow all over the earth, from end to end. But the Integral is going to take these walls up into the heights to the thousands of other worlds which every evening whisper to us with their lights through the black leaves of night.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Birodarlar! (Bu u edi.) Birodarlar, hammangiz bilasizki, u yerda, Devor ichida, Shaharda ular Integralni qurishyapti. Va yana bilasizki, o'sha Devorni va boshqa barcha devorlarni vayron qilish kuni keldi, toki yashil shamol butun yer yuzi bo'ylab, bir chetidan ikkinchi chetigacha esa olsin. Lekin Integral bu devorlarni balandlikka, har kecha tunning qora barglari orqali bizga o'z chiroqlari bilan shivirlaydigan minglab boshqa dunyolarga olib ketmoqchi...»

paras.en: Waves and foam and wind were beating the rock:
paras.uz: To'lqinlar, ko'pik va shamol qoyaga urilardi:

paras.en: “Down with the Integral! Down!”
paras.uz: «Integral yo'qolsin! Yo'qolsin!»

paras.en: “No, brothers, not ‘down.’ The Integral must be ours. And it shall be ours. On the day when it first sets sail into the sky, we shall be on board. For the Builder of the Integral is with us. He left the walls, he came with me here in order to be with us. Long live the Builder!”
paras.uz: «Yo'q, birodarlar, "yo'qolsin" emas. Integral bizniki bo'lishi kerak. Va u bizniki bo'ladi. U birinchi marta osmonga suzib ketadigan kuni biz bortda bo'lamiz. Chunki Integralning Quruvchisi biz bilan. U devorlarni tark etdi, biz bilan bo'lish uchun men bilan bu yerga keldi. Quruvchi yashasin!»

paras.en: A second⁠—and I was somewhere above everything. Under me: heads, heads, heads, wide open yelling mouths, arms rising and falling.⁠ ⁠… There was something strange and intoxicating in it all. I felt myself above everybody; I was⁠—I⁠—a separate world; I ceased to be the usual item; I became unity.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Bir soniya — va men qayerdadir hamma narsaning ustida edim. Ostimda: boshlar, boshlar, boshlar, keng ochilgan baqirayotgan og'izlar, ko'tarilib-tushayotgan qo'llar... Bularning hammasida nimadir g'alati va mast qiluvchi narsa bor edi. Men o'zimni hammadan yuqorida his qildim; men edim — men — alohida dunyo; odatdagi qo'shiluvchi bo'lishdan to'xtadim; birlikka aylandim...

paras.en: Again I was below, near the rock, my body happy, shaken and rumpled, as after an embrace of love. Sunlight, voices, and from above⁠—the smile of I-330. A golden-haired woman, her whole body silky-golden and diffusing an odor of different herbs, was near by. She held a cup, apparently made of wood. She drank a little from it with her red lips and then offered the cup to me. I closed my eyes and with avidity I drank the sweet cold prickly sparks, pouring them down on the fire which burned within me.
paras.uz: Yana pastda, qoya yonida edim, tanam baxtiyor, silkingan va g'ijimlangan, xuddi sevgi quchog'idan keyingidek. Quyosh nuri, ovozlar va yuqoridan — I-330 ning tabassumi. Yonimda butun tanasi ipakdek oltinrang bo'lgan va turli o'tlar hidini taratayotgan oltin sochli ayol bor edi. U, aftidan, yog'ochdan yasalgan kosa ushlab turardi. U qizil lablari bilan undan ozgina ichib, keyin kosani menga uzatdi. Men ko'zlarimni yumib, ochko'zlik bilan shirin, sovuq, sanchuvchi uchqunlarni ichdim va ularni ichimda yonayotgan olov ustiga quydim.

paras.en: Soon afterward my blood and the whole world began to circulate a thousand times faster; the earth seemed to be flying, light as down. And within me everything was simple, light and clear. Only then I noticed on the rock the familiar, enormous letters: M E P H I, and for some reason the inscription seemed to me necessary. It seemed to be a simple thread binding everything together. A rather rough picture hewn in the rock; this too, seemed comprehensible; it represented a youth with wings and with a transparent body, and in the place ordinarily occupied by the heart⁠—a blinding, red, blazing coal. Again, I understood that coal, or no, I felt it as I felt without hearing every word of I-330 (she continued to speak from above, from the rock), and I felt that all of them breathed one breath and that they were all ready to fly somewhere like the birds over the Wall.
paras.uz: Ko'p o'tmay qonim va butun dunyo ming marta tezroq aylana boshladi; yer paryoqdek yengil uchayotgandek tuyuldi. Ichimda esa hamma narsa oddiy, yengil va aniq edi. Faqat shundagina qoyada tanish, ulkan harflarni payqadim: M E F I va negadir yozuv menga zarur bo'lib tuyuldi. U hamma narsani bir-biriga bog'lab turadigan oddiy ipdek tuyuldi. Qoyaga o'yib ishlangan ancha qo'pol rasm; bu ham tushunarli tuyuldi; unda qanotli va shaffof tanali yigit tasvirlangan edi va odatda yurak egallaydigan joyda — ko'zni qamashtiruvchi, qizil, yonayotgan cho'g'. Yana men o'sha cho'g'ni tushundim, yoki yo'q, I-330 ning har bir so'zini eshitmasdan his qilganim kabi uni his qildim (u yuqoridan, qoyadan gapirishda davom etardi) va ularning hammasi bitta nafas bilan nafas olayotganini va hammasi Devor ustidagi qushlar kabi qayergadir uchishga tayyor ekanini his qildim.

paras.en: From behind, from the confusion of breathing bodies⁠—a loud voice:
paras.uz: Orqadan, nafas olayotgan tanalarning chalkashligidan — baland ovoz:

paras.en: “But this is folly!”
paras.uz: «Lekin bu telbalik-ku!»

paras.en: It seems to me it was I, yes, I am certain it was I, who then jumped on the rock; from there I saw the sun, heads, a green sea on a blue background, and I cried:
paras.uz: Menimcha, bu men edim, ha, aminmanki, bu men edim, o'shanda qoyaga sakrab chiqqan; u yerdan quyoshni, boshlarni, moviy fondagi yashil dengizni ko'rdim va qichqirdim:

paras.en: “Yes, yes, precisely. All must become insane; we must become insane as soon as possible! We must; I know it.”
paras.uz: «Ha, ha, aynan. Hamma telba bo'lishi kerak; biz iloji boricha tezroq telba bo'lishimiz kerak! Kerak; men buni bilaman».

paras.en: I-330 was at my side. Her smile⁠—two dark lines from the angles of her mouth directed upward.⁠ ⁠… And within me a blazing coal. It was momentary, light, a little painful, beautiful.⁠ ⁠… And later⁠—only stray fragments that remained sticking in me.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: I-330 yonimda edi. Uning tabassumi — og'zining burchaklaridan yuqoriga yo'nalgan ikki qorong'i chiziq... Ichimda esa yonayotgan cho'g'. Bu bir lahzalik, yengil, biroz og'riqli, go'zal edi... Keyin esa — menda yopishib qolgan faqat tarqoq parchalar...

paras.en: … Very low and slowly a bird was moving. I saw it was living, like me. It was turning its head now to the right and then to the left like a human being, and its round black eyes screwed themselves into me.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: ...Juda past va sekin bir qush harakatlanardi. Men uning ham men kabi tirik ekanini ko'rdim. U boshini goh o'ngga, goh chapga odamdek burardi va uning dumaloq qora ko'zlari menga burab kirardi...

paras.en: … Then: a human back glistening with fur the color of ancient ivory;⁠—a mosquito crawling on that back, a mosquito with tiny transparent wings. The back twitched to chase the mosquito away; it twitched again.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: ...Keyin: qadimiy fil suyagi rangidagi tuk bilan yaltirayotgan inson orqasi; — o'sha orqada kichkina shaffof qanotli chivin emaklab yurardi. Chivinni haydash uchun orqa pirpiradi; yana pirpiradi...

paras.en: … And yet another thing: a shadow from the leaves, a woven, net-like shadow. Some lay in that shadow, chewing something, something similar to the legendary food of the ancients, a long yellow fruit and a piece of something dark. They put some of it in my hand, and it seemed droll to me for I did not know whether I might eat it or not.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: ...Va yana bir narsa: barglardan tushgan soya, to'qilgan, to'rsimon soya. Ba'zilar o'sha soyada yotib, nimanidir chaynashardi, qadimgilarning afsonaviy taomiga o'xshash narsani, uzun sariq meva va qandaydir qora narsaning bir bo'lagini. Uning bir qismini qo'limga qo'yishdi va bu menga kulgili tuyuldi, chunki uni yeyishim mumkinmi yoki yo'qmi, bilmasdim...

paras.en: … And again: a crowd, heads, legs, arms, mouths, faces appearing for a second and disappearing like bursting bubbles. For a second appeared (or perhaps it was only an hallucination?) the transparent, flying wing-ears.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: ...Va yana: olomon, boshlar, oyoqlar, qo'llar, og'izlar, bir soniyaga paydo bo'lib, yorilayotgan pufakchalardek g'oyib bo'layotgan yuzlar. Bir soniyaga (yoki bu faqat gallyutsinatsiyamidi?) shaffof, uchayotgan qanot-quloqlar paydo bo'ldi...

paras.en: With all my might I pressed the hand of I-330. She turned to me.
paras.uz: Butun kuchim bilan I-330 ning qo'lini siqdim. U menga o'girildi.

paras.en: “What is the matter?”
paras.uz: «Nima bo'ldi?»

paras.en: “He is here! I thought, I⁠—”
paras.uz: «U shu yerda! Men o'yladim, men —»

paras.en: “Who?”
paras.uz: «Kim?»

paras.en: “S-, a second ago, in the crowd.”
paras.uz: «S-, bir soniya oldin, olomon ichida».

paras.en: The ends of the thin coal-black, brows moved to the temples⁠—a smile like a sharp triangle. I could not see clearly why she smiled. How could she smile?
paras.uz: Ingichka ko'mirdek qora qoshlarning uchlari chakkalarga qarab qimirladi — o'tkir uchburchakdek tabassum. U nega jilmayganini aniq tushuna olmadim. Qanday qilib u jilmaya oldi?

paras.en: “But you understand, I-330, don’t you, you understand what it means if he, or one of them is here?”
paras.uz: «Lekin siz tushunasiz-ku, I-330, agar u yoki ulardan biri shu yerda bo'lsa, bu nimani anglatishini tushunasiz-ku?»

paras.en: “You are funny! How could it ever enter the heads of those within the Wall that we are here? Remember; take yourself. Did you ever think it was possible? They are busy hunting us there⁠—let them! You are delirious!”
paras.uz: «Siz kulgilisiz! Devor ichidagilarning boshiga biz shu yerda ekanimiz qanday kelishi mumkin? Eslang; o'zingizni oling. Siz hech qachon bu mumkin deb o'ylaganmidingiz? Ular u yerda bizni ovlash bilan band — mayli! Siz alahsirayapsiz!»

paras.en: Her smile was light and cheerful and I too, was smiling; the earth was drunken, cheerful, light, floating.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Uning tabassumi yengil va quvnoq edi va men ham jilmayardim; yer mast, quvnoq, yengil, suzib yurardi...

gloss.ex: …ng there in the corridors, they somehow had blasted and destroyed the Green Wall, and from behind it everything rushed in and splashed over our city which until…
The trees ran apart. A bright clearing. In the clearing, people, or perhaps to be more exact, beings. Now comes the most…
… Then: a human back glistening with fur the color of ancient ivory;⁠—a mosquito crawling on that back, a mosquito with tiny tr…
“Brothers!” (It was she.) “Brothers, you all know that there inside the Wall, in the City,…
“But this is folly!”

quiz.q: Who lives beyond the Green Wall?
quiz.why_uz: Ular Ikki Yuz Yillik Urushdan keyin o'rmonga ketgan odamlar avlodi.

quiz.q: What do the Mephi plan to do with the Integral?
quiz.why_uz: «Integral bizniki bo'lishi kerak» — deydi I-330.

chapters.recap_uz: I-330 D-503 ni yer osti yo'li orqali Yashil Devor ortiga olib chiqadi. U yerda tukli odamlar va Mefilar yig'ilgan; I-330 Integralni egallashni e'lon qiladi.

chapters.title: Both of them — Entropy and energy — The opaque part of the body
chapters.title_uz: Ikkalasi ham — Entropiya va energiya — Tananing shaffof bo'lmagan qismi

paras.en: If your world is similar to the world of the ancients, then you may easily imagine that one day you suddenly come upon a sixth or a seventh continent, upon some Atlantis, and you find there unheard of cities, labyrinths, people flying through the air without the aid of wings or aeros, stones lifted into the air by the power of a gaze⁠—in brief, imagine that you see things that cannot come to your mind even if you suffer from dream-sickness. That is how I feel now. For you must understand that no one has ever gone beyond the Green Wall since the Two Hundred Years’ War, as I already have told you.
paras.uz: Agar sizning dunyongiz qadimgilarning dunyosiga o'xshash bo'lsa, unda bir kun to'satdan oltinchi yoki yettinchi qit'aga, qandaydir Atlantidaga duch kelib, u yerda misli ko'rilmagan shaharlarni, labirintlarni, qanot yoki aerolarsiz havoda uchayotgan odamlarni, nigoh kuchi bilan havoga ko'tarilgan toshlarni topganingizni — qisqasi, hatto tush ko'rish kasalligidan aziyat chekkaningizda ham xayolingizga kelmaydigan narsalarni ko'rganingizni osongina tasavvur qilishingiz mumkin. Men hozir o'zimni shunday his qilyapman. Chunki tushunishingiz kerak, sizga aytganimdek, Ikki Yuz Yillik Urushdan beri hech kim Yashil Devor ortiga chiqmagan.

paras.en: I know that it is my duty to you, my unknown friends, to give more details about that unsuspected strange world which opened to me yesterday. But for the time being I am unable to return to that subject. Everything is so novel, so novel it is like a rainstorm, and I am not big enough to collect it all. I spread out the folds of my unif, my palms⁠—and yet pailfuls splash past me and only drops can reach these pages.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Bilamanki, sizga, noma'lum do'stlarim, kecha menga ochilgan o'sha kutilmagan g'alati dunyo haqida batafsilroq so'zlab berish burchimdir. Lekin hozircha bu mavzuga qayta olmayman. Hamma narsa shunchalik yangi, shunchalik yangiki, u jala kabi, men esa hammasini yig'ib olish uchun yetarlicha katta emasman. Yunifamning etaklarini, kaftlarimni yoyaman — lekin chelak-chelak suv yonimdan sachrab o'tib ketadi va bu sahifalarga faqat tomchilar yetib keladi...

paras.en: At first I heard behind me, behind the door, a loud voice. I recognized her voice, the voice of I-330, tense, metallic⁠—and another one, almost inflexible, like a wooden ruler, the voice of U-. Then the door came open with a crack and both of them shot into the room. Shot is the right word.
paras.uz: Avval orqamda, eshik ortida baland ovozni eshitdim. Men uning ovozini, I-330 ning tarang, metall ovozini tanidim — va boshqasini, deyarli egilmaydigan, yog'och chizg'ichdek, Yu- ning ovozini. Keyin eshik qarsillab ochildi va ikkalasi xonaga otilib kirdi. Otilib — to'g'ri so'z.

paras.en: I-330 put her hand on the back of my armchair and smiled over her shoulder but only with her teeth, at U-. I should not care to stand before such a smile.
paras.uz: I-330 qo'lini kreslomning suyanchig'iga qo'ydi va yelkasi osha Yu- ga faqat tishlari bilan jilmaydi. Men bunday tabassum oldida turishni xohlamagan bo'lardim.

paras.en: “Listen,” she said to me, “this woman seems to have made it her business to guard you from me like a little child. Is it with your permission?”
paras.uz: «Quloq soling, — dedi u menga, — bu ayol sizni mendan kichkina boladek qo'riqlashni o'z ishi qilib olganga o'xshaydi. Bu sizning ruxsatingiz bilanmi?»

paras.en: “But he is a child. Yes! That is why he does not notice that you⁠ ⁠… that it is only in order.⁠ ⁠… That all this is only a foul game! Yes! And it is my duty.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Lekin u bola-ku. Ha! Shuning uchun u payqamaydi, siz... faqat ... uchun... Bularning hammasi faqat jirkanch o'yin! Ha! Va mening burchim...»

paras.en: For a second (in the mirror) the broken, trembling line of brows. I leaped, controlling with difficulty the other self within me, the one with the hairy fists; with difficulty, pushing every word through my teeth, I cried straight into her face, into her very gills:
paras.uz: Bir soniyaga (ko'zguda) qoshlarning singan, titroq chizig'i. Men sakrab turdim, ichimdagi boshqa o'zimni, tukli mushtlisini zo'rg'a jilovlab; zo'rg'a, har bir so'zni tishlarim orasidan itarib chiqarib, to'g'ri uning yuziga, aynan jabralariga qichqirdim:

paras.en: “Get out of here at once! Out! At once!”
paras.uz: «Darhol bu yerdan chiqib keting! Chiqing! Darhol!»

paras.en: The gills swelled at first into brick-red lumps, then fell and became gray. She opened her mouth to say something but without a word she slammed it shut and went out.
paras.uz: Jabralar avval g'isht rang bo'rtiqlarga aylanib shishdi, keyin tushib, kulrang bo'lib qoldi. U nimadir demoqchi bo'lib og'zini ochdi, lekin bir so'z demay, og'zini qarsillatib yopdi va chiqib ketdi.

paras.en: I threw myself towards I-330.
paras.uz: Men I-330 ga qarab o'zimni otdim.

paras.en: “Never, never will I forgive myself! She dared! You⁠ ⁠… but you don’t think, do you, that you, that she.⁠ ⁠… This is all because she wants to register on me but I.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Hech qachon, hech qachon o'zimni kechirmayman! U jur'at etdi! Siz... lekin siz o'ylamaysiz-ku, siz, u... Bularning hammasi u meni o'z nomiga yozdirmoqchi bo'lgani uchun, lekin men...»

paras.en: “Fortunately she will not have time for that now. Besides, even a thousand like her.⁠ ⁠… I don’t care.⁠ ⁠… I know you will not believe that thousand but only me. For after all that happened yesterday, I am all yours, all, to the very end, as you wanted it. I am in your hands; you can now at any moment.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Baxtimizga, endi uning bunga vaqti bo'lmaydi. Bundan tashqari, hatto u kabi mingtasi bo'lsa ham... Menga baribir... Bilaman, siz o'sha mingtasiga emas, faqat menga ishonasiz. Chunki kecha bo'lib o'tgan hamma narsadan keyin men butunlay sizniman, butunlay, oxirigacha, siz xohlaganingizdek. Men sizning qo'lingizdaman; siz endi istalgan lahzada...»

paras.en: “What, ‘at any moment?’ ” (But at once I understood what. My blood rushed to my ears and cheeks.) “Don’t speak about that, you must never speak about that! The other I, my former self⁠ ⁠… but now.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Nima, "istalgan lahzada"?» (Lekin men nimani nazarda tutganini darhol tushundim. Qonim quloqlarim va yonoqlarimga yugurdi.) «Bu haqda gapirmang, bu haqda hech qachon gapirmasligingiz kerak! Boshqa men, avvalgi o'zim... lekin endi...»

paras.en: “How do I know? Man is like a novel: up to the last page one does not know what the end will be. It would not be worth reading otherwise.”
paras.uz: «Qayerdan bilay? Inson romanga o'xshaydi: oxirgi sahifagacha oxiri qanday bo'lishini bilmaysiz. Aks holda uni o'qishga arzimasdi».

paras.en: She was stroking my head. I could not see her face but I could tell by her voice that she was looking somewhere very far into the distance; she hooked herself to that cloud which was floating silently, slowly, no one knows where to.
paras.uz: U boshimni silardi. Men uning yuzini ko'ra olmasdim, lekin ovozidan u qayergadir juda uzoqqa qarayotganini bila olardim; u jimgina, sekin, hech kim bilmaydigan joyga suzib borayotgan o'sha bulutga ilinib olgan edi.

paras.en: Suddenly she pushed me away with her hand, firmly but tenderly.
paras.uz: To'satdan u meni qo'li bilan qat'iy, lekin muloyim itarib yubordi.

paras.en: “Listen. I came to tell you that perhaps we are now⁠ ⁠… our last days.⁠ ⁠… You know, don’t you, that all Auditoriums are to be closed after tonight?”
paras.uz: «Quloq soling. Men sizga, ehtimol, biz endi... oxirgi kunlarimiz... ekanini aytish uchun keldim... Bilasiz-ku, bugun kechqurundan keyin barcha Auditoriyalar yopiladi?»

paras.en: “Closed?”
paras.uz: «Yopiladi?»

paras.en: “Yes. I passed by and saw that in all Auditoriums preparations are going on: tables; medics all in white.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Ha. Yonidan o'tayotib, barcha Auditoriyalarda tayyorgarlik ketayotganini ko'rdim: stollar; oppoq kiyingan tibbiyot xodimlari...»

paras.en: “But what does it all mean?”
paras.uz: «Lekin bularning hammasi nimani anglatadi?»

paras.en: “I don’t know. Nobody knows as yet. That is the worst of it. I only feel the current is on, the spark is jumping, and if not today, then tomorrow.⁠ ⁠… Yet perhaps they will not have time.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Bilmayman. Hozircha hech kim bilmaydi. Eng yomoni shu. Faqat tok ulanganini, uchqun sakrayotganini his qilyapman va bugun bo'lmasa, ertaga... Lekin balki ularning vaqti yetmas...»

paras.en: For a long while I have ceased to understand who are they and who we. I do not understand what I want; do I want them to have or not to have enough time? One thing is clear to me: I-330 is now on the very edge, on the very edge, and in one second more.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Ancha vaqtdan beri «ular» kim, «biz» kim ekanini tushunmay qo'ydim. Nimani istashimni tushunmayman; ularning vaqti yetishini istaymanmi yoki yetmasligini? Menga bir narsa aniq: I-330 hozir eng chekkada, eng chekkada va yana bir soniyadan keyin...

paras.en: “But it is folly,” I said. “You, versus the United State! It is the same as if you should cover the muzzle of a gun with your hands and expect that way to prevent the shot.⁠ ⁠… It is absolute folly!”
paras.uz: «Lekin bu telbalik, — dedim men. — Siz, Yagona Davlatga qarshi! Bu qurolning og'zini qo'llaringiz bilan yopib, shu yo'l bilan o'qning oldini olishni kutganingiz bilan barobar... Bu mutlaq telbalik!»

paras.en: A smile.
paras.uz: Tabassum.

paras.en: “ ‘We must all go insane⁠—as soon as possible go insane.’ It was yesterday, do you remember?”
paras.uz: «"Hammamiz telba bo'lishimiz kerak — iloji boricha tezroq telba bo'lishimiz kerak". Bu kecha edi, esingizdami?»

paras.en: Yes, she was right; I had even written it down. Consequently it really took place. In silence I looked into her face. At that moment the dark cross was especially distinct.
paras.uz: Ha, u haq edi; men buni hatto yozib ham qo'ygan edim. Demak, bu haqiqatan ham bo'lgan. Jimgina uning yuziga qaradim. O'sha lahzada qorong'i xoch ayniqsa aniq edi.

paras.en: “I-, dear, before it is too late.⁠ ⁠… If you want⁠ ⁠… I’ll leave everything, I’ll forget everything, and we’ll go there beyond the Wall, to them.⁠ ⁠… I do not even know who they are.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «I-, azizim, juda kech bo'lmasdan oldin... Agar xohlasangiz... Men hamma narsani tashlab, hamma narsani unutaman va biz u yerga, Devor ortiga, ularning oldiga ketamiz... Men hatto ular kimligini ham bilmayman...»

paras.en: She shook her head. Through the dark windows of her eyes I saw within her a flaming oven, sparks, tongues of flame and above them a heap of dry, tarry wood. It was clear to me that it was too late, my words could be of no avail.
paras.uz: U boshini chayqadi. Uning ko'zlarining qorong'i derazalari orqali ichida yonayotgan pechni, uchqunlarni, olov tillarini va ularning ustida quruq, smolali o'tinlar uyumini ko'rdim. Menga aniq ediki, juda kech, so'zlarim hech qanday foyda bera olmaydi.

paras.en: She stood up. She would soon leave. Perhaps these were the last days, or the last minutes.⁠ ⁠… I grasped her hand.
paras.uz: U o'rnidan turdi. U tez orada ketadi. Balki bu oxirgi kunlar, yoki oxirgi daqiqalardir... Men uning qo'lini ushlab oldim.

paras.en: “No, stay a little while longer⁠ ⁠… for the sake⁠ ⁠… for the sake.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Yo'q, yana ozgina qoling... ... uchun... ... uchun...»

paras.en: She slowly lifted my hand towards the light, my hairy paw which I detest. I wanted to withdraw it but she held it tightly.
paras.uz: U sekin qo'limni, men jirkanadigan tukli panjamni yorug'likka qarab ko'tardi. Men uni tortib olmoqchi bo'ldim, lekin u mahkam ushlab turdi.

paras.en: “Your hand.⁠ ⁠… You undoubtedly don’t know and very few do know, that women from here occasionally used to fall in love with them. Probably there are in you a few drops of that blood of the sun and the woods. Perhaps that is why I.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Sizning qo'lingiz... Siz shubhasiz bilmaysiz va juda kam odam biladi, bu yerdagi ayollar ba'zan ularni sevib qolishgan. Ehtimol, sizda o'sha quyosh va o'rmon qonidan bir necha tomchi bordir. Balki shuning uchun men...»

paras.en: Silence. It was so strange that because of that silence, because of an emptiness, of nothing, my heart should beat so wildly. I cried.
paras.uz: Sukunat. Shunchalik g'alati ediki, o'sha sukunat tufayli, bo'shliq, hech narsa tufayli yuragim shunchalik yovvoyi urishi kerak edi. Men qichqirdim:

paras.en: “Ah, you shall not go yet! You shall not go until you tell me about them⁠ ⁠… for you love⁠ ⁠… them, and I do not know even who they are, nor where they come from.”
paras.uz: «Oh, siz hali ketmaysiz! Menga ular haqida aytib bermaguningizcha ketmaysiz... chunki siz ularni... sevasiz, men esa ular kimligini ham, qayerdan kelganini ham bilmayman».

paras.en: “Who are they? The half we have lost. H2 and O, two halves; but in order to get water, H2O, creeks, seas, waterfalls, storms, it is necessary that those two halves be united.”
paras.uz: «Ular kim? Biz yo'qotgan yarmimiz. H2 va O, ikki yarim; lekin suv, H2O, soylar, dengizlar, sharsharalar, bo'ronlar hosil qilish uchun o'sha ikki yarim birlashishi kerak».

paras.en: I distinctly remember every movement of hers. I remember she picked up a glass triangle from my table and while talking she pressed its sharp edge against her cheek; a white scar would appear; then it would fill again and become pink and disappear. And it is strange that I cannot remember her words, especially the beginning of the story. I remember only different images and colors. At first, I remember, she told me about the Two Hundred Years’ War. Red color.⁠ ⁠… On the green of the grass, on the dark clay, on the pale blue of the snow⁠—everywhere red ditches that would not become dry. Then yellow; yellow grass burned by the sun, yellow naked wild-men and wild dogs side by side near swollen cadavers of dogs or perhaps of men. All this, certainly beyond the Walls, for the City was already the victor and it possessed already our present-day petroleum food. And at night⁠ ⁠… down from the sky⁠ ⁠… heavy black folds. The folds would swing over the woods, the villages⁠—blackish-red slow columns of smoke. A dull moaning; endless strings of people driven into the City to be saved by force and to be whipped into happiness.
paras.uz: Uning har bir harakatini aniq eslayman. Esimda, u stolimdan shisha uchburchakni olib, gapirayotib uning o'tkir qirrasini yonog'iga bosardi; oq chandiq paydo bo'lardi; keyin u yana to'lib, pushti bo'lib, g'oyib bo'lardi. Va g'alati tomoni shundaki, uning so'zlarini, ayniqsa hikoyaning boshini eslay olmayman. Faqat turli tasvirlar va ranglarni eslayman. Avval, esimda, u menga Ikki Yuz Yillik Urush haqida gapirib berdi. Qizil rang... O'tning yashilligida, qorong'i loyda, qorning och moviyligida — hamma joyda qurimaydigan qizil ariqlar. Keyin sariq; quyoshda kuygan sariq o't, shishib ketgan it, balki odam murdalari yonida yonma-yon sariq yalang'och yovvoyi odamlar va yovvoyi itlar. Bularning hammasi, albatta, Devorlar ortida, chunki Shahar allaqachon g'olib edi va u allaqachon bizning hozirgi neft ovqatimizga ega edi. Tunda esa... osmondan pastga... og'ir qora burmalar. Burmalar o'rmonlar, qishloqlar ustida tebranardi — qoramtir-qizil sekin tutun ustunlari. Bo'g'iq ingrash; kuch bilan qutqarilish va qamchi bilan baxtga haydalish uchun Shaharga haydalayotgan odamlarning cheksiz qatorlari.

paras.en: “… You knew almost all this.”
paras.uz: «...Siz bularning deyarli hammasini bilardingiz».

paras.en: “Yes, almost.”
paras.uz: «Ha, deyarli».

paras.en: “But you did not know and only a few did, that a small part of them remained together and stayed to live beyond the Wall. Being naked, they went into the woods. They learned there from the trees, beasts, birds, flowers and sun. Hair soon grew over their bodies, but under that hair they preserved their warm red blood. With you it was worse; numbers covered your bodies; numbers crawled over you like lice. One ought to strip you of everything, and naked you ought to be driven into the woods. You ought to learn how to tremble with fear, with joy, with wild anger, with cold; you should pray to fire! And we Mephi, we want.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Lekin siz bilmasdingiz va faqat ozchilik bilardiki, ularning kichkina bir qismi birga qolib, Devor ortida yashash uchun qolgan. Yalang'och holda ular o'rmonlarga ketishgan. Ular u yerda daraxtlardan, hayvonlardan, qushlardan, gullardan va quyoshdan o'rganishgan. Tez orada tanalarini tuk qoplagan, lekin o'sha tuk ostida ular o'zlarining iliq qizil qonini saqlab qolishgan. Sizda esa yomonroq bo'ldi; tanalaringizni raqamlar qopladi; raqamlar sizning ustingizda bitlardek o'rmalardi. Sizdan hamma narsani yechib olib, yalang'och holda o'rmonlarga haydash kerak. Siz qo'rquvdan, quvonchdan, yovvoyi g'azabdan, sovuqdan titrashni o'rganishingiz kerak; siz olovga sig'inishingiz kerak! Biz, Mefilar esa, istaymiz...»

paras.en: “Oh, wait a minute! ‘Mephi,’ what does it mean!”
paras.uz: «Oh, bir daqiqa to'xtang! "Mefi" nimani anglatadi!»

paras.en: “Mephi? It is from Mephisto. You remember, there on the rock, the figure of the youth? Or, no. I shall explain it to you in your own language and you will understand better: there are two forces in the world, entropy and energy. One leads into blessed quietude, to happy equilibrium, the other to the destruction of equilibrium, to torturingly perpetual motion. Our, or rather your ancestors, the Christians, worshipped entropy like a God. But we are not Christians, we.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Mefi? Bu Mefistodan. Esingizdami, u yerda, qoyada, yigitning qiyofasi? Yoki yo'q. Sizga o'z tilingizda tushuntiraman va yaxshiroq tushunasiz: dunyoda ikki kuch bor — entropiya va energiya. Biri muborak sokinlikka, baxtli muvozanatga olib boradi, ikkinchisi muvozanatning buzilishiga, qiynoqli abadiy harakatga. Bizning, aniqrog'i sizning ajdodlaringiz, nasroniylar, entropiyaga Xudoga sig'ingandek sig'inishgan. Lekin biz nasroniy emasmiz, biz...»

paras.en: At that moment a slight whisper was suddenly heard, a knock at the door, and in rushed that flattened man with the forehead low over his eyes, who several times had brought me notes from I-330. He ran straight to us, stopped, panting like an air-pump, and could say not a word, as he must have been running at top speed.
paras.uz: O'sha lahzada to'satdan yengil shivirlash eshitildi, eshik taqilladi va bir necha marta menga I-330 dan yozuvlar olib kelgan, peshonasi ko'zlari ustiga past tushgan o'sha yassi odam otilib kirdi. U to'g'ri bizga yugurib kelib, to'xtadi, havo nasosidek hansirab, bir so'z ham ayta olmadi, chunki u eng yuqori tezlikda yugurgan bo'lsa kerak.

paras.en: “But tell me! What has happened?” I-330 grasped him by the hand.
paras.uz: «Ayting-chi! Nima bo'ldi?» I-330 uning qo'lidan ushladi.

paras.en: “They are coming here⁠—” panted the air-pump, “with guards.⁠ ⁠… And with them that what’s-his-name, the hunchback.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Ular bu yerga kelishyapti, — hansiradi havo nasosi, — soqchilar bilan... Va ular bilan o'sha, nima edi, munkillagan...»
«S- mi?»

paras.en: “Yes. They are in the house by this time. They’ll soon be here. Quick, quick!”
paras.uz: «Ha. Ular hozir uyda. Tez orada shu yerda bo'lishadi. Tezroq, tezroq!»

paras.en: “Nonsense, we have time!” I-330 was laughing, cheerful sparks in her eyes. It was either absurd, senseless courage, or else there was something I did not yet understand.
paras.uz: «Bema'nilik, vaqtimiz bor!» I-330 kulardi, ko'zlarida quvnoq uchqunlar. Bu yo bema'ni, ma'nosiz jasorat edi, yoki men hali tushunmagan nimadir bor edi.

paras.en: “I-, dear, for the sake of the Well-Doer! You must understand that this.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «I-, azizim, Homiy haqi! Tushunishingiz kerak, bu...»

paras.en: “For the sake of the Well-Doer!” The sharp, triangle-smile.
paras.uz: «Homiy haqi!» O'tkir uchburchak-tabassum.

paras.en: “Well⁠ ⁠… well, for my sake, I implore you!”
paras.uz: «Xo'sh... xo'sh, men uchun, yolvoraman!»

paras.en: “Oh, yes, I wanted to talk to you about some other matters.⁠ ⁠… Well, never mind.⁠ ⁠… We’ll talk about them tomorrow.”
paras.uz: «Oh, ha, siz bilan boshqa ba'zi masalalar haqida gaplashmoqchi edim... Xo'p, mayli... Ular haqida ertaga gaplashamiz».

paras.en: And cheerfully (yes cheerfully) she nodded to me; the other came out for a second from under his forehead’s awning and nodded also. I was alone.
paras.uz: Va quvnoq (ha, quvnoq) menga bosh irg'adi; ikkinchisi bir soniyaga peshonasining soyaboni ostidan chiqib, u ham bosh irg'adi. Men yolg'iz qoldim.

paras.en: Quick! To my desk! I opened this manuscript, took the pen so that they should find me at this work which is for the benefit of the United State. Suddenly I felt every hair on my head living, separated, moving: “What if they should read, even one page of these most recently written?”
paras.uz: Tezroq! Stolimga! Bu qo'lyozmani ochdim, qalamni oldim, toki ular meni Yagona Davlat manfaati uchun qilinayotgan shu ish ustida topishsin. To'satdan boshimdagi har bir soch tolasi tirik, alohida, qimirlayotganini his qildim: «Agar ular eng oxirgi yozilgan sahifalardan hatto bittasini o'qishsa-chi?»

paras.en: Motionless I sat at the table but everything around me seemed to be moving, as if the less than microscopic movements of the atoms suddenly were magnified millions of times, and I saw the walls trembling, my pen trembling and the letters swinging and fusing together. “To hide them! But where?” Glass all around. “To burn them?” But they would notice the fire through the corridor and in the neighboring room. Besides I felt unable, I felt too weak, to destroy this torturing and perhaps dearest piece of my own self.⁠ ⁠…
