paras.uz: Men stol yonida qimirlamay o'tirardim, lekin atrofimdagi hamma narsa harakatlanayotgandek tuyulardi, go'yo atomlarning mikroskopikdan ham kichik harakatlari to'satdan millionlab marta kattalashtirilgandek, va men devorlar titrayotganini, qalamim titrayotganini va harflar tebranib, bir-biriga qo'shilib ketayotganini ko'rdim. «Ularni yashirish! Lekin qayerga?» Atrofda shisha. «Ularni yoqib yuborish?» Lekin ular olovni yo'lak orqali va qo'shni xonada payqab qolishadi. Bundan tashqari, o'zimning bu qiynoqli va ehtimol eng aziz parchamni yo'q qilishga o'zimni qodir emas, juda zaif his qildim...

paras.en: Voices from a distance (from the corridor) and steps. I had only time to snatch a handful of pages and put them under me, and then as if soldered to the armchair, every atom of which was quivering, I remained sitting, while the floor under my feet rolled like the deck of a ship, up and down.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Uzoqdan (yo'lakdan) ovozlar va qadamlar. Bir hovuch sahifani yulqib olib, ostimga qo'yishga zo'rg'a ulgurdim va keyin go'yo har bir atomi titrayotgan kreslo bilan kavsharlangandek o'tirib qoldim, oyoqlarim ostidagi pol esa kema palubasidek yuqori-past chayqalardi...

paras.en: All shrunk together and hidden under the awning of my own forehead like that messenger, I watched them stealthily; they were going from room to room, beginning at the right end of the corridor. Nearer⁠ ⁠… nearer.⁠ ⁠… I saw that some sat in their rooms, torpid like me; others would jump up and open their doors wide⁠—lucky ones! If only I too, could.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Butunlay qisqarib, o'sha xabarchi kabi o'z peshonamning soyaboni ostiga yashirinib, ularni yashirincha kuzatdim; ular yo'lakning o'ng chetidan boshlab xonadan xonaga o'tib kelishardi. Yaqinroq... yaqinroq... Ko'rdimki, ba'zilar xonalarida men kabi karaxt o'tirishardi; boshqalar sakrab turib, eshiklarini keng ochishardi — baxtlilar! Qaniydi men ham...

paras.en: “The Well-Doer is the most perfect fumigation humanity needs, consequently no peristalsis in the organism of the United State could.⁠ ⁠…” I was writing this nonsense, pressing my trembling pen hard, and lower and lower my head bent over the table, and within me some sort of crazy forge.⁠ ⁠… With my back I was listening⁠ ⁠… and I heard the click of the doorknob.⁠ ⁠… A current of fresh air.⁠ ⁠… My armchair was dancing a mad dance.⁠ ⁠… Only then, and even then with difficulty, I tore myself away from the page, turned my head in the direction of the newcomers (how difficult it is to play a foul game!). In front of all was S-, morose, silent, swiftly drilling with his eyes deep shafts within me, within my armchair and within the pages which were twitching in my hands. Then for a second⁠—familiar, everyday faces at the door; one of them separated itself from the rest with its bulging, pinkish-brown gills.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: «Homiy insoniyatga kerak bo'lgan eng mukammal dezinfeksiya, demak, Yagona Davlat organizmidagi hech qanday peristaltika...» Men titroq qalamimni qattiq bosib, bu bema'nilikni yozardim va boshim stol ustiga tobora pastroq egilardi, ichimda esa qandaydir telba temirchilik ustaxonasi... Orqam bilan quloq solardim... va eshik tutqichining chiqillashini eshitdim... Toza havo oqimi... Kreslom telba raqsga tushardi... Faqat shundagina, shunda ham qiyinchilik bilan, o'zimni sahifadan uzib, boshimni yangi kelganlar tomonga burdim (jirkanch o'yin o'ynash qanchalik qiyin!). Hammaning oldida S- edi, ma'yus, jim, ko'zlari bilan ichimga, kreslomga va qo'llarimda pirpirayotgan sahifalarga tez chuqur shaxtalar burg'ilardi. Keyin bir soniyaga — eshikda tanish, kundalik yuzlar; ulardan biri bo'rtib chiqqan, pushtiroq-jigarrang jabralari bilan qolganlardan ajralib chiqdi...

paras.en: At once I recalled everything that happened in the same room half an hour ago and it was clear to me that they would presently.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Shu zahoti yarim soat oldin xuddi shu xonada bo'lib o'tgan hamma narsani esladim va menga aniq ediki, ular hozir...

paras.en: All my being was shriveling and pulsating in that fortunately opaque part of my body with which I was covering the manuscript. U- came up to S-, gently plucked his sleeve and said in a low voice:
paras.uz: Butun vujudim qo'lyozmani yopib turgan tanamning o'sha, baxtimga, shaffof bo'lmagan qismida burishib, urib turardi. Yu- S- ning oldiga kelib, muloyimgina uning yengidan tortdi va past ovozda dedi:

paras.en: “This is D-503, the builder of the Integral. You have probably heard of him. He is always like that, at his desk; does not spare himself at all!”
paras.uz: «Bu D-503, Integral quruvchisi. Siz u haqida eshitgan bo'lsangiz kerak. U doimo shunday, stolida; o'zini umuman ayamaydi!»

paras.en: … And I thought!⁠ ⁠… What a dear, wonderful woman!⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: ...Men esa o'ylabman!.. Qanday aziz, ajoyib ayol!..

paras.en: S- slid up to me, bent over my shoulder toward the table. I covered the lines I had written with my elbow but he shouted severely:
paras.uz: S- menga sirg'alib keldi, yelkam osha stolga egildi. Yozgan satrlarimni tirsagim bilan yopdim, lekin u qattiq qichqirdi:

paras.en: “Show us at once what you have there, please!”
paras.uz: «U yerda nima borligini darhol ko'rsating, iltimos!»

paras.en: Dying with shame, I held out the sheet of paper. He read it over, and I noticed a tiny smile jump out of his eyes, jump down his face and slightly wagging its tail, perch upon the right angle of his mouth.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Uyatdan o'layozib, qog'oz varag'ini uzatdim. U uni o'qib chiqdi va men uning ko'zlaridan kichkina tabassum sakrab chiqqanini, yuzidan pastga sakrab tushib, dumini biroz likillatib, og'zining o'ng burchagiga qo'nganini payqadim...

paras.en: “Somewhat ambiguous, yet.⁠ ⁠… Well, you may continue; we shall not disturb you any more.”
paras.uz: «Biroz ikki ma'noli, lekin... Xo'p, davom etishingiz mumkin; boshqa sizni bezovta qilmaymiz».

paras.en: He went splashing towards the door as if in a ditch of water. And with every step of his I felt coming back to me my legs, my arms, my fingers⁠—my soul again distributed itself evenly over my whole body; I breathed.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U go'yo suvli ariqda ketayotgandek shalpillab eshikka qarab yurdi. Va uning har bir qadami bilan menga oyoqlarim, qo'llarim, barmoqlarim qaytib kelayotganini his qildim — ruhim yana butun tanamga bir tekis taqsimlandi; men nafas oldim...

paras.en: The last thing: U- lingered in my room to come back to me and say in my very ear in a whisper: “It is lucky for you that I.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Oxirgi narsa: Yu- xonamda biroz qolib, menga qaytib keldi va aynan qulog'imga shivirlab dedi: «Baxtingiz bor ekan, men...»

paras.en: I did not understand. What did she mean by that? The same evening I learned that they led away three Numbers, although nobody speaks out loud about that, or about anything that happened. This ostensible silence is due to the educational influence of the Guardians who are ever present among us. Conversations deal chiefly with the quick fall of the barometer and the forthcoming change in the weather.
paras.uz: Men tushunmadim. U bu bilan nima demoqchi edi? O'sha kuni kechqurun bildimki, ular uchta Raqamni olib ketishibdi, garchi bu haqda ham, bo'lib o'tgan hech narsa haqida ham hech kim ovoz chiqarib gapirmasa ham. Bu ko'rinishdagi sukunat doimo oramizda bo'lgan Qo'riqchilarning tarbiyaviy ta'siri tufaylidir. Suhbatlar asosan barometrning tez tushishi va yaqinlashib kelayotgan ob-havo o'zgarishi haqida bo'ladi.

…ill understand better: there are two forces in the world, entropy and energy. One leads into blessed quietude, to happy equilibrium, the other to the destructio…

“Mephi? It is from Mephisto. You remember, there on the rock, the figure of the youth? Or, no. I shall explai…
Quick! To my desk! I opened this manuscript, took the pen so that they should find me at this work which is for the benefit…

quiz.q: What do the two halves H₂ and O represent for I-330?
o: The people inside and beyond the Wall
quiz.why_uz: Ikki yarim birlashsagina «suv» — hayot bo'ladi.

quiz.why_uz: Yu- uni ishchan Raqam deb maqtaydi.

chapters.recap_uz: I-330 D-503 ga Mefilar haqida tushuntiradi: entropiya va energiya. Qo'riqchilar tintuv o'tkazadi; Yu- D-503 ni himoya qilib, qo'lyozmasini «Davlat uchun ish» deb aytadi.

chapters.title: Threads on the face — Sprouts — An unnatural compression

paras.en: It is strange: the barometer continues to fall yet there is no wind. There is quiet. Above, the storm which we do not yet hear has begun. The clouds are rushing with a terrific speed. There are few of them as yet; separate fragments; it is as if there above us an unknown city were being destroyed and pieces of walls and towers were rushing down, coming nearer and nearer with terrific speed, but it will take some days of rushing through the blue infinite before they reach the bottom, that is us, below. And below there is silence.
paras.uz: G'alati: barometr tushishda davom etyapti, lekin shamol yo'q. Sokinlik. Tepada biz hali eshitmayotgan bo'ron boshlangan. Bulutlar dahshatli tezlikda yugurmoqda. Ular hozircha kam; alohida parchalar; go'yo u yerda, tepamizda noma'lum bir shahar vayron bo'layotgandek va devorlar va minoralarning bo'laklari dahshatli tezlik bilan tobora yaqinlashib, pastga otilayotgandek, lekin ular tubga, ya'ni bizga, pastga yetib kelishi uchun moviy cheksizlik bo'ylab bir necha kun yugurishiga to'g'ri keladi. Pastda esa sukunat.

paras.en: There are thin, incomprehensible, almost invisible threads in the air; every autumn they are brought here from beyond the Wall. They float slowly, and suddenly you feel something foreign and invisible on your face; you want to brush it off, but no, you cannot rid yourself of it. You feel it especially near the Green Wall, where I was this morning. I-330 made an appointment with me to meet her in the Ancient House in that “Apartment” of ours.
paras.uz: Havoda ingichka, tushunarsiz, deyarli ko'rinmas iplar bor; har kuzda ular bu yerga Devor ortidan uchib keladi. Ular sekin suzadi va to'satdan yuzingizda nimadir begona va ko'rinmas narsani his qilasiz; uni artib tashlamoqchi bo'lasiz, lekin yo'q, undan qutula olmaysiz. Buni ayniqsa Yashil Devor yonida, bugun ertalab men bo'lgan joyda his qilasiz. I-330 men bilan Qadimiy Uyda, o'sha bizning «Kvartira»mizda uchrashishni kelishgan edi.

paras.en: I was not far from the rust-red, opaque mass of the Ancient House, when I heard behind me short hasty steps and rapid breathing. I turned around and saw O-90 trying to catch up to me. She seemed strangely and perfectly rounded. Her arms and breast, her whole body, so familiar to me, was rounded out, stretching her unif. It seemed as though it would soon tear the thin cloth and come out into the sun, into the light. I think that there in the green debris, in springtime, the unseen sprouts try thus to tear their way through the ground in order to emit their branches and leaves and to bloom.
paras.uz: Qadimiy Uyning zang-qizil, shaffof bo'lmagan massasidan uzoq bo'lmagan joyda orqamda qisqa, shoshqin qadamlar va tez nafas olishni eshitdim. O'girilib, O-90 menga yetib olishga urinayotganini ko'rdim. U g'alati va mukammal yumaloqlashgandek edi. Uning qo'llari va ko'kragi, menga shunchalik tanish butun tanasi yumaloqlashib, yunifasini tarang tortib turardi. Go'yo u tez orada yupqa matoni yirtib, quyoshga, yorug'likka chiqadigandek tuyulardi. Menimcha, u yerda, yashil vayronalarda bahorda ko'rinmas nihollar shoxlari va barglarini chiqarish va gullash uchun yerni xuddi shunday yorib chiqishga urinadi.

paras.en: For a few seconds she shone into my face with her blue eyes in silence.
paras.uz: Bir necha soniya u moviy ko'zlari bilan jimgina yuzimga nur sochib turdi.

paras.en: “I saw you on the Day of Unanimity.”
paras.uz: «Men sizni Bir Ovozlilik Kunida ko'rdim».

paras.en: “I saw you, too.” I at once remembered; below, in a narrow passage she had stood, pressing herself to the wall, protecting her abdomen with her arms, and automatically I glanced now at her abdomen which rounded the unif. She must have noticed, for she became pink, and with a rosy smile:
paras.uz: «Men ham sizni ko'rdim». Darhol esladim; pastda, tor yo'lakda u devorga qisilib, qorinini qo'llari bilan himoya qilib turgan edi va avtomatik ravishda endi uning yunifani yumaloqlashtirib turgan qorniga qaradim. U buni payqagan bo'lsa kerak, chunki pushti tusga kirdi va pushti tabassum bilan dedi:

paras.en: “I am so happy⁠ ⁠… so happy! I am so full of⁠ ⁠… you understand, I am⁠ ⁠… I walk and I hear nothing around me.⁠ ⁠… And all the while I listen within, within me.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Men shunchalik baxtliman... shunchalik baxtliman! Men shunchalik to'laman... tushunyapsizmi, men... Men yuraman va atrofimda hech narsani eshitmayman... Va doimo ichimga, ichimga quloq solaman...»

paras.en: I was silent. Something foreign was shadowing my face and I was unable to rid myself of it. Suddenly, all shining, light blue, she caught my hand; I felt her lips upon it.⁠ ⁠… It was for the first time in my life.⁠ ⁠… It was some ancient caress as yet unknown to me.⁠ ⁠… And I was so ashamed and it pained me so much that I swiftly, I think even roughly, pulled my hand away.
paras.uz: Men jim edim. Nimadir begona narsa yuzimga soya solib turardi va undan qutula olmasdim. To'satdan, butunlay nur sochib, och moviy bo'lib, u qo'limni ushlab oldi; men uning lablarini qo'limda his qildim... Bu hayotimda birinchi marta edi... Bu menga hali noma'lum bo'lgan qandaydir qadimiy erkalash edi... Va men shunchalik uyaldim va bu menga shunchalik og'riq berdiki, qo'limni tez, menimcha hatto qo'pol tortib oldim.

paras.en: “Listen, you are crazy, it seems.⁠ ⁠… And anyway you⁠ ⁠… what are you happy about? Is it possible that you forget what is ahead of you? If not now, then within a month or two.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Quloq soling, siz aqldan ozgansiz shekilli... Va baribir siz... nimadan baxtlisiz? Nahotki oldingizda nima kutayotganini unutgan bo'lsangiz? Hozir bo'lmasa, bir-ikki oydan keyin...»

paras.en: Her light went out, her roundness sagged and shrank. And in my heart an unpleasant, even a painful compression, mixed with pity. Our heart is nothing else than an ideal pump: a compression, i.e., a shrinking at the moment of pumping, is a technical absurdity. Hence it is clear how essentially absurd, unnatural and pathological are all these “loves” and “pities,” etc., etc., which create that compression.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Uning nuri o'chdi, yumaloqligi cho'kib, qisqardi. Yuragimda esa achinish bilan aralashgan yoqimsiz, hatto og'riqli siqilish. Bizning yuragimiz ideal nasosdan boshqa narsa emas: siqilish, ya'ni nasos ishlayotgan paytda qisqarish — texnik bema'nilik. Bundan ko'rinib turibdiki, o'sha siqilishni keltirib chiqaradigan bu «sevgi»lar va «achinish»lar va hokazo, va hokazolarning hammasi mohiyatan qanchalik bema'ni, g'ayritabiiy va patologik...

paras.en: Silence. To the left the cloudy green glass of the Wall. And just ahead the dark red mass. Those two colors combined, gave me as a resultant what I thought was a splendid idea.
paras.uz: Sukunat. Chap tomonda Devorning xira yashil shishasi. To'g'ri oldinda esa to'q qizil massa. O'sha ikki rang birgalikda menga natija sifatida ajoyib bo'lib tuyulgan bir g'oyani berdi.

paras.en: “Wait! I know how to save you! I shall save you from.⁠ ⁠… To see one’s own child for a few moments only and then be sent to death! No! You shall be able to bring it up! You shall watch it and see it grow in your arms, and ripen like a fruit.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «To'xtang! Sizni qanday qutqarishni bilaman! Sizni ... dan qutqaraman... O'z bolangizni faqat bir necha lahza ko'rib, keyin o'limga jo'natilish! Yo'q! Siz uni tarbiyalay olasiz! Siz uni kuzatib, qo'llaringizda o'sib, mevadek pishib yetilayotganini ko'rasiz...»

paras.en: Her body quivered and she seemed to have chained herself to me.
paras.uz: Uning tanasi titradi va go'yo o'zini menga zanjir bilan bog'lab qo'ygandek bo'ldi.

paras.en: “Do you remember that woman, I-330? That⁠ ⁠… of⁠ ⁠… of long ago?⁠ ⁠… Who during that walk?⁠ ⁠… Well, she is now right here, in the Ancient House. Let us go to her and I assure you that I shall arrange matters at once.”
paras.uz: «O'sha ayol, I-330 esingizdami? O'sha... ancha... ancha oldingi?.. Sayr paytida kim?.. Xo'sh, u hozir shu yerda, Qadimiy Uyda. Keling, uning oldiga boraylik va ishontirib aytamanki, men hamma ishni darhol hal qilaman».

paras.en: I already pictured us, I-330 and I, leading O-90 through the corridors⁠ ⁠… then how she would be brought amidst flowers, grass, and leaves.⁠ ⁠… But O-90 stepped back, the little horns of her rosy crescent trembling and bending downward.
paras.uz: Men allaqachon I-330 va men O-90 ni yo'laklar bo'ylab boshlab borayotganimizni... keyin uni gullar, o't va barglar orasiga qanday olib kelishlarini tasavvur qilib bo'lgandim... Lekin O-90 orqaga chekindi, pushti yarim oyining kichkina shoxlari titrab, pastga egildi.

paras.en: “Is she that same one?” she asked.
paras.uz: «U o'shami?» — so'radi u.

paras.en: “That is.⁠ ⁠…” I was confused for some reason. “Yes, of course⁠ ⁠… that very same.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Ya'ni...» Negadir esankirab qoldim. «Ha, albatta... aynan o'sha...»

paras.en: “And you want me to go to her, to ask her⁠ ⁠… to.⁠ ⁠… Don’t you ever dare to say another word about it!”
paras.uz: «Va siz mening uning oldiga borib, undan... so'rashimni istaysizmi... Bu haqda boshqa bir og'iz so'z aytishga hech qachon jur'at etmang!»

paras.en: Leaning over, she walked away.⁠ ⁠… Then as if she remembered something, she turned around and cried:
paras.uz: Engashib, u yurib ketdi... Keyin go'yo nimanidir eslagandek, o'girilib, qichqirdi:

paras.en: “I shall die; be it so! And it is none of your business⁠ ⁠… what do you care?”
paras.uz: «Men o'laman; mayli! Va bu sizning ishingiz emas... sizga nima?»

paras.en: Silence. From above pieces of blue towers and walls were falling downward with terrific speed⁠ ⁠… they will have perhaps hours or days to fly through the infinite.⁠ ⁠… Unseen threads were slowly floating through the air, planting themselves upon my face, and it was impossible to brush them off, impossible to rid myself of them.
paras.uz: Sukunat. Tepadan moviy minoralar va devorlarning bo'laklari dahshatli tezlik bilan pastga tushardi... ularga cheksizlik bo'ylab uchish uchun balki soatlar yoki kunlar kerak bo'lar... Ko'rinmas iplar havoda sekin suzib, yuzimga qo'nardi va ularni artib tashlash imkonsiz, ulardan qutulish imkonsiz edi.

paras.en: I walked slowly toward the Ancient House and in my heart I felt that absurd, tormenting compression.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men sekin Qadimiy Uy tomon yurdim va yuragimda o'sha bema'ni, qiynoqli siqilishni his qildim...

She does not want help from I-330

chapters.title: The last number — Galileo’s mistake — Would it not be better?
chapters.title_uz: So'nggi son — Galileyning xatosi — Yaxshiroq bo'lmasmidi?

paras.en: Here is my conversation with I-330, which took place in the Ancient House yesterday in the midst of loud noise, among colors which stifled the logical course of my thoughts, red, green, bronze, saffron-yellow, orange colors.⁠ ⁠… And all the while under the motionless marble smile of that snub-nosed ancient poet.
paras.uz: Mana kecha Qadimiy Uyda baland shovqin orasida, fikrlarimning mantiqiy oqimini bo'g'ib qo'yadigan ranglar — qizil, yashil, bronza, za'faron-sariq, to'q sariq ranglar orasida I-330 bilan bo'lgan suhbatim... Va doimo o'sha puchuq burunli qadimiy shoirning qimirlamas marmar tabassumi ostida.

paras.en: I shall reproduce the conversation word by word, for it seems to me that it may have an enormous and decisive importance for the fate of the United State⁠—more than that, for the fate of the universe. Besides, reading it, you my unknown readers, may find some justification for me. I-330, without preliminaries, at once threw everything upon my head:
paras.uz: Suhbatni so'zma-so'z keltiraman, chunki menimcha u Yagona Davlat taqdiri uchun — bundan ham ko'proq, koinot taqdiri uchun ulkan va hal qiluvchi ahamiyatga ega bo'lishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, uni o'qib, siz, noma'lum o'quvchilarim, men uchun qandaydir oqlov topishingiz mumkin. I-330 hech qanday muqaddimasiz darhol hamma narsani boshimga yog'dirdi:

paras.en: “I know that the day after tomorrow the first trial trip of the Integral is to take place. On that day we shall take possession of it.”
paras.uz: «Bilaman, indinga Integralning birinchi sinov parvozi bo'lib o'tadi. O'sha kuni biz uni egallab olamiz».

paras.en: “What! Day after tomorrow?”
paras.uz: «Nima! Indingami?»

paras.en: “Yes. Sit down and don’t be upset. We cannot afford to lose a minute. Among the hundreds who were arrested yesterday there are twenty Mephis. To let pass two or three days means that they will perish.”
paras.uz: «Ha. O'tiring va xafa bo'lmang. Biz bir daqiqani ham yo'qotishga haqqimiz yo'q. Kecha hibsga olingan yuzlab odamlar orasida yigirmata Mefi bor. Ikki-uch kun o'tkazib yuborish — ularning halok bo'lishi demakdir».

paras.en: I was silent.
paras.uz: Men jim qoldim.

paras.en: “As observers on the trial trip they will send electricians, mechanicians, physicians, meteorologists, etc.⁠ ⁠… At twelve sharp, you must remember this, when the bell rings for dinner we shall remain in the passage, lock them all up in the dining hall, and the Integral will be ours. You realize that it is most necessary, happen what may! The Integral in our hands will be a tool that will help to put an end to everything at once without pain.⁠ ⁠… Their aeros?⁠ ⁠… Bah! They would be insignificant mosquitos against a buzzard. And then, if it proves inevitable, we may direct the tubes of the motors downward and by their work alone.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Sinov parvoziga kuzatuvchi sifatida elektriklar, mexaniklar, shifokorlar, meteorologlar va hokazolarni yuborishadi... Aynan o'n ikkida, buni yodda tuting, tushlik uchun qo'ng'iroq chalinganda biz yo'lakda qolamiz, hammasini ovqatxonaga qamab qo'yamiz va Integral bizniki bo'ladi. Tushunasizki, nima bo'lmasin, bu juda zarur! Bizning qo'limizdagi Integral hamma narsaga birdaniga og'riqsiz chek qo'yishga yordam beradigan qurol bo'ladi... Ularning aerolarimi?.. Bah! Ular kalxatga qarshi arzimas chivinlar bo'lardi. Keyin, agar muqarrar bo'lib chiqsa, dvigatellar quvurlarini pastga qaratib, faqat ularning ishi bilan...»

paras.en: I jumped up.
paras.uz: Men sakrab turdim.

paras.en: “It is inconceivable! It is absurd! Is it not clear to you that what you are contriving is a revolution?”
paras.uz: «Bu aqlga sig'maydi! Bu bema'nilik! Siz o'ylab topayotgan narsa inqilob ekani sizga aniq emasmi?»

paras.en: “Yes, a revolution. Why is it absurd?”
paras.uz: «Ha, inqilob. Nega bu bema'nilik?»

paras.en: “Absurd? because a revolution is impossible! Because our (I speak for myself and for you), our revolution was the last one. No other revolutions may occur. Everybody knows that.”
paras.uz: «Bema'nilik? Chunki inqilob mumkin emas! Chunki bizning (men o'zim va siz uchun gapiryapman), bizning inqilobimiz oxirgisi edi. Boshqa inqiloblar bo'lishi mumkin emas. Buni hamma biladi».

paras.en: A mocking, sharp triangle of brows.
paras.uz: Qoshlarning masxaraomuz, o'tkir uchburchagi.

paras.en: “My dear, you are a mathematician, are you not? More than that, a philosopher-mathematician? Well then, name the last number!”
paras.uz: «Azizim, siz matematiksiz-ku, shunday emasmi? Bundan ham ko'proq, faylasuf-matematiksiz? Unday bo'lsa, oxirgi sonni ayting!»

paras.en: “What is⁠ ⁠… I⁠ ⁠… I cannot understand, which last?”
paras.uz: «Nima... men... tushuna olmayapman, qaysi oxirgi?»

paras.en: “The last one, the highest, the largest.”
paras.uz: «Oxirgisi, eng yuqorisi, eng kattasi».

paras.en: “But I-330, it is absurd! Since the number of numbers is infinite, how can there be a last one?”
paras.uz: «Lekin I-330, bu bema'nilik! Sonlarning soni cheksiz ekan, qanday qilib oxirgisi bo'lishi mumkin?»

paras.en: “And why then do you think there is a last revolution? There is no last revolution, their number is infinite.⁠ ⁠… The ‘last one’ is a children’s story. Children are afraid of the infinite, and it is necessary that children should not be frightened, so that they may sleep through the night.”
paras.uz: «Unda nega oxirgi inqilob bor deb o'ylaysiz? Oxirgi inqilob yo'q, ularning soni cheksiz... "Oxirgisi" — bolalar ertagi. Bolalar cheksizlikdan qo'rqishadi va bolalarni qo'rqitmaslik kerak, toki ular tun bo'yi uxlay olsin».

paras.en: “But what is the use, what is the use of it all? For the sake of the Well-Doer! What is the use since all are happy already?”
paras.uz: «Lekin bularning hammasidan nima foyda, nima foyda? Homiy haqi! Hamma allaqachon baxtli ekan, nima foyda?»

paras.en: “All right! Even suppose that is so. What further?”
paras.uz: «Mayli! Hatto shunday deb faraz qilaylik. Keyin-chi?»

paras.en: “How funny! A purely childish question. You tell something to children, come to the very end, yet they will invariably ask you, ‘what further?’ and ‘what for?’ ”
paras.uz: «Qanday kulgili! Sof bolalarcha savol. Bolalarga nimadir aytib berasiz, eng oxiriga yetasiz, lekin ular baribir sizdan: "keyin-chi?" va "nima uchun?" deb so'rashadi».

paras.en: “Children are the only courageous philosophers. And courageous philosophers are invariably children. One ought always to ask like children, ‘what further’?”
paras.uz: «Bolalar — yagona jasur faylasuflar. Jasur faylasuflar esa doimo bolalardir. Har doim bolalardek: "keyin-chi?" deb so'rash kerak».

paras.en: “Nothing further! Period. In the whole world evenly, everywhere, there is distributed.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Keyin hech narsa! Nuqta. Butun dunyoda bir tekis, hamma joyda taqsimlangan...»

paras.en: “Ah, ‘evenly!’ ‘Everywhere!’ That is the point, entropy! Psychological entropy. Don’t you as a mathematician know that only differences (only differences!), in temperature, only thermic contrasts make for life? And if all over the world there are evenly warm or evenly cold bodies, they must be pushed off!⁠ ⁠… in order to get flame, explosions! And we shall push!⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Ah, "bir tekis"! "Hamma joyda"! Gap shunda, entropiya! Psixologik entropiya. Siz matematik sifatida bilmaysizmi, faqat farqlar (faqat farqlar!), haroratdagi farqlar, faqat issiqlik kontrastlari hayotni yaratadi? Va agar butun dunyoda bir xil iliq yoki bir xil sovuq jismlar bo'lsa, ularni turtib yuborish kerak!.. olov, portlashlar olish uchun! Va biz turtib yuboramiz!..»

paras.en: “But I-330, please realize that our ancestors during the Two Hundred Years’ War did exactly that!”
paras.uz: «Lekin I-330, iltimos, tushuning, ajdodlarimiz Ikki Yuz Yillik Urush paytida aynan shunday qilishgan!»

paras.en: “Oh, they were right! A thousand times right! They did one wrong thing, however; later they began to believe that they were the last number, a number that does not exist in nature. Their mistake was the mistake of Galileo; he was right in that the earth revolves about the sun but he did not know that our whole solar system revolves about some other centre, he did not know that the real (not relative) orbit of the earth is not a naive circle.”
paras.uz: «Oh, ular haq edi! Ming marta haq! Biroq, ular bitta noto'g'ri ish qilishdi; keyinroq ular o'zlarini oxirgi son, tabiatda mavjud bo'lmagan son deb ishona boshlashdi. Ularning xatosi Galileyning xatosi edi; u yer quyosh atrofida aylanishida haq edi, lekin u butun quyosh tizimimiz qandaydir boshqa markaz atrofida aylanishini bilmasdi, yerning haqiqiy (nisbiy emas) orbitasi sodda doira emasligini bilmasdi».

paras.en: “And you, the Mephi?”
paras.uz: «Siz-chi, Mefilar?»

paras.en: “We? For the time being we know that there is no last number. We may forget that some day. Of course, we shall certainly forget it when we grow old, as everything inevitably grows old. Then we shall inevitably fall like autumn leaves from the trees, like you the day-after-tomorrow.⁠ ⁠… No, no dear, not you personally. You are with us, are you not? You are with us?”
paras.uz: «Bizmi? Hozircha biz oxirgi son yo'qligini bilamiz. Biz buni bir kun kelib unutishimiz mumkin. Albatta, qariganimizda, albatta unutamiz, chunki hamma narsa muqarrar ravishda qariydi. Keyin biz muqarrar ravishda daraxtlardan kuzgi barglardek to'kilamiz, xuddi siz indinga... Yo'q, yo'q, azizim, shaxsan siz emas. Siz biz bilansiz-ku, shunday emasmi? Siz biz bilansizmi?»

paras.en: Flaming, stormy, sparkling! I never before had seen her in such a state. She embraced me with her whole self; I disappeared.
paras.uz: Alangali, bo'ronli, uchqunlanuvchi! Men uni hech qachon bunday holatda ko'rmagandim. U meni butun vujudi bilan quchoqladi; men g'oyib bo'ldim.

paras.en: Her last word, looking steadily, deeply into my eyes:
paras.uz: Ko'zlarimga qat'iy, chuqur qarab aytgan oxirgi so'zi:

paras.en: “Then, do not forget: at twelve o’clock sharp.”
paras.uz: «Demak, unutmang: aynan soat o'n ikkida».

paras.en: And I answered:
paras.uz: Men esa javob berdim:

paras.en: “Yes, I remember.”
paras.uz: «Ha, eslayman».

paras.en: She left. I was alone amidst a rebellious, multi-voiced commotion of blue, red, green, saffron-yellow and orange.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U ketdi. Men moviy, qizil, yashil, za'faron-sariq va to'q sariqning isyonkor, ko'p ovozli g'ala-g'ovuri orasida yolg'iz qoldim...

paras.en: Yes, at twelve!⁠ ⁠… Suddenly a feeling of something foreign on my face, of something implanted, that could not be brushed off. Suddenly, yesterday morning, and U- and all she shouted into the face of I-330! Why, how absurd!
paras.uz: Ha, o'n ikkida!.. To'satdan yuzimda nimadir begona narsa, artib bo'lmaydigan nimadir yopishib qolgandek tuyg'u. To'satdan kecha ertalab, Yu- va uning I-330 ning yuziga qichqirgan hamma narsasi! Nega, qanday bema'nilik!

paras.en: I hastened to get out of the house and home, home! Somewhere behind me I heard the chattering of birds beyond the Wall. And ahead of me in the setting sun the balls of cupolas made of red, crystallized fire, enormous flaming cubes⁠—houses, and the sharp point of the Accumulating Tower high in the sky like a paralyzed streak of lightning. And all this, all this impeccable, most geometric beauty, shall I, I myself, with my hands⁠ ⁠… ? Is there no way out? No path? No trail?
paras.uz: Uydan chiqib, uyga, uyga shoshildim! Qayerdadir orqamda Devor ortidagi qushlarning chug'urlashini eshitdim. Oldimda esa botayotgan quyoshda qizil, kristallangan olovdan yasalgan gumbaz sharlari, ulkan alangali kublar — uylar va osmonda falajlangan chaqmoq chizig'idek baland Jamg'arma Minorasining o'tkir uchi. Va bularning hammasini, bu benuqson, eng geometrik go'zallikning hammasini men, men o'zim, o'z qo'llarim bilan...? Chiqish yo'li yo'qmi? Yo'l yo'qmi? So'qmoq yo'qmi?

paras.en: I passed by an auditorium (I do not recall its number). Inside, the benches were stacked along the walls. In the middle, tables covered with snow-white glass sheets, with pink stains of sunny blood on the white.⁠ ⁠… There was foreshadowed in all that some unknown and therefore alarming tomorrow. It is unnatural for a thinking and seeing human being to live among irregularities, unknowns, X’s. If suddenly your eyes were covered with a bandage and you were let go to feel around, to stumble, ever aware that somewhere very close to you there is the borderline, one step only and nothing but a compressed, smothered piece of flesh will be left of you.⁠ ⁠… I now feel somewhat like that.
paras.uz: Bir auditoriya yonidan o'tdim (raqamini eslay olmayman). Ichkarida skameykalar devorlar bo'ylab taxlangan edi. O'rtada qordek oq shisha varaqlar bilan qoplangan stollar, oq ustida quyoshli qonning pushti dog'lari... Bularning hammasida qandaydir noma'lum va shuning uchun xavotirli ertangi kun bashorat qilinardi. Fikrlaydigan va ko'radigan inson uchun nomuntazamliklar, noma'lumlar, X lar orasida yashash g'ayritabiiy. Agar to'satdan ko'zlaringizni bog'lab qo'yib, sizni paypaslab yurish, qoqilish uchun qo'yib yuborishsa, qayerdadir juda yaqinda chegara chizig'i borligini, faqat bir qadam va sizdan siqilgan, ezilgan go'sht bo'lagidan boshqa hech narsa qolmasligini doimo bilib tursangiz... Men hozir o'zimni taxminan shunday his qilyapman.

paras.en: … And what if without waiting for anything I should⁠ ⁠… just head down.⁠ ⁠… Would it not be the only right thing to do? To disentangle everything at once?
paras.uz: ...Agar hech narsani kutmay men... shunchaki boshim bilan pastga... Bu qilinadigan yagona to'g'ri ish bo'lmasmidi? Hamma narsani birdaniga yechib tashlash?

quiz.q: What is I-330's argument against a 'last revolution'?
quiz.why_uz: Sonlar cheksiz bo'lgani kabi inqiloblar ham cheksiz.

quiz.q: When will the Mephi seize the Integral?
o: At twelve during the dinner bell
quiz.why_uz: Tushlik qo'ng'irog'ida hammani ovqatxonaga qamashadi.

chapters.recap_uz: I-330 Integral sinov parvozida uni egallash rejasini aytadi. D-503 «oxirgi inqilob» bo'lgan deydi; I-330 oxirgi son yo'qligi kabi oxirgi inqilob ham yo'q deb javob beradi.

chapters.title: The great operation — I forgave everything — The collision of trains
chapters.title_uz: Buyuk operatsiya — Men hammasini kechirdim — Poyezdlar to'qnashuvi

paras.en: Saved! At the very last moment, when it seemed that there was nothing to hold to, that it was the end!⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Najot topdim! Eng so'nggi lahzada, ushlab turadigan hech narsa yo'qdek, bu oxiri bo'lib tuyulganda!..

paras.en: It was as if you already ascended the steps towards the threatening machine of the Well-Doer, or as if the great glass Bell with a heavy thud already covered you, and for the last time in life you looked at the blue sky to swallow it with your eyes⁠ ⁠… when suddenly, it was only a dream! The sun is pink and cheerful and the wall⁠ ⁠… what happiness to be able to touch the cold wall! And the pillow! To delight endlessly in the little cavity formed by your own head in the white pillow!⁠ ⁠… This is approximately what I felt, when I read the State Journal this morning. It has been all a terrible dream and this dream is over. And I was so feeble, so unfaithful, that I thought of selfish, voluntary death! I am ashamed now to reread the last lines of yesterday. But let them remain as a memory of that incredible might-have-happened, which will not happen! On the front page of the State Journal the following gleamed:
paras.uz: Bu go'yo siz allaqachon Homiyning dahshatli mashinasi tomon zinapoyalardan ko'tarilayotgandek, yoki buyuk shisha Qo'ng'iroq allaqachon og'ir gursillab sizni yopib qo'ygandek va siz hayotingizda oxirgi marta moviy osmonni ko'zlaringiz bilan yutib yuborish uchun unga qarayotgandek bo'lgan edi... to'satdan bu faqat tush ekan! Quyosh pushti va quvnoq, devor esa... sovuq devorga tega olish qanday baxt! Va yostiq! Oq yostiqda o'z boshingiz hosil qilgan kichkina chuqurchadan cheksiz zavqlanish!.. Bugun ertalab Davlat Gazetasini o'qiganimda taxminan shuni his qildim. Bularning hammasi dahshatli tush edi va bu tush tugadi. Men esa shunchalik zaif, shunchalik bevafo edimki, xudbinona, ixtiyoriy o'lim haqida o'yladim! Endi kechagi oxirgi satrlarni qayta o'qishdan uyalaman. Lekin ular bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan, lekin bo'lmaydigan o'sha aql bovar qilmas narsaning xotirasi sifatida qolaversin! Davlat Gazetasining birinchi sahifasida quyidagilar yaltirab turardi:

paras.en: “Rejoice!
paras.uz: «Quvoninglar!

paras.en: “For from now on we are perfect!
paras.uz: «Chunki bundan buyon biz mukammalmiz!

paras.en: “Before today your own creation, engines, were more perfect than you.
paras.uz: «Bugungacha sizning o'z ijodingiz — mashinalar sizdan mukammalroq edi.

paras.en: “Why?
paras.uz: «Nega?

paras.en: “For every spark from a dynamo⁠—is a spark of pure reason; each motion of a piston⁠—a pure syllogism. Is it not true that the same faultless reason is within you?
paras.uz: «Chunki dinamodan chiqqan har bir uchqun — sof aql uchquni; porshenning har bir harakati — sof sillogizm. Axir sizning ichingizda ham xuddi shu benuqson aql bor emasmi?

paras.en: “The philosophy of the cranes, presses, and pumps is finished and clear like a circle. But is your philosophy less circular? The beauty of a mechanism lies in its immutable, precise rhythm, like that of a pendulum. But have you not become as precise as a pendulum, you who are brought up on the system of Taylor?
paras.uz: «Kranlar, presslar va nasoslarning falsafasi doiradek tugallangan va aniq. Lekin sizning falsafangiz kamroq doiraviymi? Mexanizmning go'zalligi uning mayatnikdek o'zgarmas, aniq ritmida. Lekin Teylor tizimida tarbiyalangan siz mayatnikdek aniq bo'lib qolmadingizmi?

paras.en: “Yes, but there is one difference:
paras.uz: «Ha, lekin bitta farq bor:

paras.en: “Mechanisms have no fancy
paras.uz: «Mexanizmlarda fantaziya yo'q

paras.en: “Did you ever notice a pump cylinder during its work show upon its face a wide, distant, sensuously-dreaming smile? Did you ever hear cranes restlessly toss about and sigh at night, during the hours designed for rest?
paras.uz: «Siz hech qachon ishlayotgan nasos silindrining yuzida keng, uzoq, shahvoniy-xayolparast tabassumni ko'rganmisiz? Siz hech qachon dam olish uchun belgilangan soatlarda, tunda kranlar bezovta to'lg'anib, xo'rsinayotganini eshitganmisiz?

paras.en: “No!
paras.uz: «Yo'q!

paras.en: “Yet on your faces (you may well blush with shame!), the Guardians have seen more and more frequently those smiles and they have heard your sighs. And (you should hide your eyes for shame!) the historians of the United State all tendered their resignations so as to be relieved from having to record such shameful occurrences.
paras.uz: «Lekin sizning yuzlaringizda (uyatdan qizarsangiz arziydi!) Qo'riqchilar bu tabassumlarni tobora tez-tez ko'rishyapti va xo'rsinishlaringizni eshitishyapti. Va (uyatdan ko'zlaringizni yashirsangiz arziydi!) Yagona Davlat tarixchilari bunday sharmandali voqealarni qayd etishdan ozod bo'lish uchun hammalari iste'foga chiqish haqida ariza berishdi.

paras.en: “It is not your fault; you are ill. And the name of your illness is
paras.uz: «Bu sizning aybingiz emas; siz kasalsiz. Va kasalligingizning nomi —

paras.en: “Fancy
paras.uz: «Fantaziya

paras.en: “It is a worm that gnaws black wrinkles on one’s forehead. It is a fever that drives one to run farther and farther, albeit ‘farther’ may begin where happiness ends. It is the last barricade on our road to happiness.
paras.uz: «Bu peshonada qora ajinlarni kemiradigan qurt. Bu odamni tobora uzoqroqqa yugurishga majbur qiladigan isitma, garchi «uzoqroq» baxt tugagan joyda boshlanishi mumkin bo'lsa ham. Bu baxt sari yo'limizdagi oxirgi to'siq.

paras.en: “Rejoice! This Barricade Has Been Blasted at Last! The Road is Open!
paras.uz: «Quvoninglar! Bu to'siq nihoyat portlatildi! Yo'l ochiq!

paras.en: “The latest discovery of our State science is that there is a centre for fancy⁠—a miserable little nervous knot in the lower region of the frontal lobe of the brain. A triple treatment of this knot with X-rays will cure you of fancy⁠—
paras.uz: «Davlat ilmimizning eng so'nggi kashfiyoti shundaki, fantaziya markazi mavjud — miyaning peshona bo'lagining pastki qismidagi ayanchli kichkina asab tuguni. Bu tugunni rentgen nurlari bilan uch marta ishlov berish sizni fantaziyadan davolaydi —

paras.en: “Forever!
paras.uz: «Abadiy!

paras.en: “You are perfect; you are mechanized; the road to hundred percent happiness is open! Hasten then all of you, young and old, hasten to undergo the great Operation! Hasten to the auditoriums where the great Operation is being performed! Long live the Great Operation! Long live the United State! Long live the Well-Doer.”
paras.uz: «Siz mukammalsiz; siz mexanizatsiyalashgansiz; yuz foizli baxtga yo'l ochiq! Shoshilinglar, hammangiz, yoshu qari, Buyuk Operatsiyadan o'tishga shoshilinglar! Buyuk Operatsiya o'tkazilayotgan auditoriyalarga shoshilinglar! Buyuk Operatsiya yashasin! Yagona Davlat yashasin! Homiy yashasin!»

paras.en: You, had you read all this not in my records which look like an ancient strange novel, had you like me held in your trembling hands the newspaper, smelling of typographic ink⁠ ⁠… if you knew as I do, that all this is most certain reality, if not the reality of today, then that of tomorrow⁠—would you not feel the very things I feel? Would not your head whirl as mine does? Would there not run over your back and arms those strange, sweet, icy needles? Would you not feel that you were a giant, an Atlas?⁠—that if only you stood up and straightened out you would reach the ceiling with your head?
paras.uz: Siz, agar bularning hammasini qadimiy g'alati romanga o'xshash mening qaydlarimda emas, balki men kabi titroq qo'llaringizda tipografiya bo'yog'i hidi kelayotgan gazetani ushlab o'qiganingizda... agar men kabi bularning hammasi eng aniq haqiqat, bugungi bo'lmasa ham, ertangi haqiqat ekanini bilganingizda — men his qilayotgan narsalarni his qilmasmidingiz? Boshingiz menikidek aylanib ketmasmidi? Orqangiz va qo'llaringiz bo'ylab o'sha g'alati, shirin, muzdek ignalar yugurmasmidi? O'zingizni dev, Atlant deb his qilmasmidingiz? — faqat o'rningizdan turib, qaddingizni rostlasangiz, boshingiz shiftga yetadigandek?

paras.en: I snatched the telephone receiver.
paras.uz: Telefon go'shagini yulqib oldim.

paras.en: “I-330. Yes.⁠ ⁠… Yes. Yes⁠ ⁠… 330!” And then, swallowing my own words I shouted, “Are you at home? Yes? Have you read? You are reading now? Is it not, is it not stupendous?”
paras.uz: «I-330. Ha... Ha. Ha... 330!» Keyin o'z so'zlarimni yutib, qichqirdim: «Uydamisiz? Ha? O'qidingizmi? Hozir o'qiyapsizmi? Bu, bu ajoyib emasmi?»

paras.en: “Yes.⁠ ⁠…” A long, dark silence. The wires buzzed almost imperceptibly. She was thinking.
paras.uz: «Ha...» Uzoq, qorong'i sukunat. Simlar deyarli sezilmas g'uvillardi. U o'ylardi.

paras.en: “I must see you today without fail. Yes, in my room, after sixteen, without fail!”
paras.uz: «Bugun sizni albatta ko'rishim kerak. Ha, mening xonamda, o'n oltidan keyin, albatta!»

paras.en: Dear⁠ ⁠… she is such a dear!⁠ ⁠… “Without fail!” I was smiling and I could not stop, I felt I should carry that smile with me into the street like a light above my head.
paras.uz: Aziz... u shunchalik aziz!.. «Albatta!» Men jilmayardim va to'xtay olmasdim, o'sha tabassumni ko'chaga boshim ustidagi chiroqdek olib chiqishimni his qildim.

paras.en: Outside the wind ran over me, whirling, whistling, whipping, but I felt even more cheerful. “All right, go on, go on moaning and groaning! The Walls cannot be torn down.” Flying leaden clouds broke over my head⁠ ⁠… well let them! They could not eclipse the sun! We chained it to the zenith like so many Joshuas, sons of Nuns!
paras.uz: Tashqarida shamol aylanib, hushtak chalib, qamchilab ustimdan yugurib o'tdi, lekin men o'zimni yanada quvnoqroq his qildim. «Mayli, davom et, ingrayver, nola qilaver! Devorlarni buzib bo'lmaydi». Uchayotgan qo'rg'oshindek bulutlar boshim ustida yorilardi... mayli! Ular quyoshni to'sa olmaydi! Biz uni Nun o'g'li Yoshualardek zenitga zanjirband qilganmiz!

paras.en: At the corner a group of Joshuas, sons of Nuns, were standing with their foreheads pasted to the glass of the wall. Inside, on a dazzling white table already a Number lay. One could see two naked soles diverging from under the sheet in a yellow angle.⁠ ⁠… White medics bent over his head⁠—a white hand, a stretched-out hand holding a syringe filled with something.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Muyulishda bir guruh Nun o'g'li Yoshualar peshonalarini devor shishasiga yopishtirib turishardi. Ichkarida, ko'zni qamashtiruvchi oq stolda allaqachon bir Raqam yotardi. Choyshab ostidan sariq burchak bo'lib tarqalgan ikki yalang'och tovonni ko'rish mumkin edi... Oq tibbiyot xodimlari uning boshi ustiga egilgan edi — oq qo'l, nimadir bilan to'ldirilgan shpritsni ushlagan cho'zilgan qo'l...

paras.en: “And you, what are you waiting for?” I asked nobody in particular, or rather all of them.
paras.uz: «Siz-chi, nimani kutyapsiz?» — so'radim hech kimdan, aniqrog'i, hammasidan.

paras.en: “And you?” Someone’s round head turned to me.
paras.uz: «Siz-chi?» Kimningdir dumaloq boshi menga o'girildi.

paras.en: “I? Oh, afterward! I must first.⁠ ⁠…” Somewhat confused, I left the place. I really had to see I-330 first. But why first? I could not explain to myself.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: «Menmi? Oh, keyinroq! Men avval...» Biroz esankirab, u yerdan ketdim. Men haqiqatan ham avval I-330 ni ko'rishim kerak edi. Lekin nega avval? O'zimga tushuntira olmasdim...

paras.en: The docks. The Integral, bluish like ice, was glistening and sparkling. The engine was caressingly grumbling, repeating some one word, as if it were my word, a familiar one. I bent down and stroked the long, cold tube of the motor. “Dear! What a dear tube! Tomorrow it will come to life, tomorrow for the first time it will tremble with burning, flaming streams in its bowels.”
paras.uz: Stapel. Muzdek ko'kimtir Integral yaltirab, uchqunlanardi. Dvigatel erkalab g'o'ldirardi, qandaydir bir so'zni takrorlardi, go'yo bu mening so'zim, tanish so'z edi. Men egilib, motorning uzun, sovuq quvurini siladim. «Aziz! Qanday aziz quvur! Ertaga u jonlanadi, ertaga birinchi marta qornida yonayotgan, alangali oqimlar bilan titraydi».

paras.en: With what eyes would I have looked at the glass monster had everything remained as it was yesterday? If I knew that tomorrow at twelve I should betray it, yes, betray.⁠ ⁠… Someone behind cautiously touched my elbow. I turned around. The plate-like, flat face of the Second Builder.
paras.uz: Agar hamma narsa kechagidek qolganida, men bu shisha mahluqqa qanday ko'zlar bilan qaragan bo'lardim? Agar ertaga o'n ikkida unga xiyonat qilishimni bilganimda, ha, xiyonat... Orqadan kimdir ehtiyotkorlik bilan tirsagimga tegdi. O'girildim. Ikkinchi Quruvchining likopchadek, yassi yuzi.

paras.en: “Do you know already?” he asked.
paras.uz: «Allaqachon bilasizmi?» — so'radi u.

paras.en: “What? About the Operation? Yes. How everything, everything⁠ ⁠… suddenly.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Nimani? Operatsiya haqidami? Ha. Hamma narsa, hamma narsa qanday... to'satdan...»

paras.en: “No, not that. The trial flight is put off until day-after-tomorrow⁠—on account of that Operation. They rushed us for nothing; we hurried.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Yo'q, u emas. Sinov parvozi indinga qoldirildi — o'sha Operatsiya tufayli. Bizni bekorga shoshirishdi; biz shoshildik...»

paras.en: “On account of that Operation!” Funny, limited man. He could see no farther than his own platter! If only he knew that but for the Operation tomorrow at twelve he would be locked-up in a glass cage, would be tossing about, trying to climb the walls!
paras.uz: «O'sha Operatsiya tufayli!» Kulgili, cheklangan odam. U o'z likopchasidan narini ko'ra olmasdi! Qaniydi u bilsa, agar Operatsiya bo'lmaganida ertaga o'n ikkida u shisha qafasga qamalib, u yoqdan bu yoqqa uloqib, devorlarga tirmashishga urinib yotgan bo'lardi!

paras.en: At twelve-thirty when I came into my room I saw U-. She was sitting at my table, firm, straight, bone-like, resting her right cheek on her hand. She must have waited for a long while because when she brusquely rose to meet me there remained on her cheek five white imprints of her fingers.
paras.uz: O'n ikki o'ttizda xonamga kirganimda Yu- ni ko'rdim. U mening stolim yonida, qattiq, to'g'ri, suyakdek bo'lib, o'ng yonog'ini qo'liga tirab o'tirardi. U uzoq kutgan bo'lsa kerak, chunki meni kutib olish uchun keskin o'rnidan turganida yonog'ida barmoqlarining beshta oq izi qoldi.

paras.en: For a second that terrible morning came back to me; she beside I-330, indignant. But for a second only. All was at once washed off by the sun of today, as it happens sometimes when you enter your room on a bright day and absentmindedly turn on the light, the bulb shines but it is out of place, droll, unnecessary.
paras.uz: Bir soniyaga o'sha dahshatli tong menga qaytib keldi; u I-330 yonida, g'azablangan. Lekin faqat bir soniyaga. Hammasi birdaniga bugungi quyosh bilan yuvilib ketdi, xuddi ba'zan yorqin kunda xonangizga kirib, beixtiyor chiroqni yoqqaningizdagidek, lampochka yonadi, lekin u o'rinsiz, kulgili, keraksiz.

paras.en: Without hesitation I held out my hand to her; I forgave her everything. She firmly grasped both my hands and pressed them till they hurt. Her cheeks quivering and hanging down like ancient precious ornaments, she said with emotion:
paras.uz: Ikkilanmay unga qo'limni uzatdim; men uni hamma narsa uchun kechirdim. U ikkala qo'limni mahkam ushlab, og'rigunicha siqdi. Yonoqlari qadimiy qimmatbaho bezaklardek titrab, osilib, u hayajon bilan dedi:

paras.en: “I was waiting.⁠ ⁠… I want only one moment.⁠ ⁠… I only wanted to say⁠ ⁠… how happy, how joyous I am for you! You realize of course, that tomorrow or day-after-tomorrow you will be healthy again, as if born anew.”
paras.uz: «Men kutayotgandim... Faqat bir lahza istayman... Faqat aytmoqchi edim... siz uchun qanchalik baxtliman, qanchalik quvonchliman! Tushunasiz albatta, ertaga yoki indinga siz yana sog'lom bo'lasiz, go'yo qaytadan tug'ilgandek».

paras.en: I noticed my papers on the table; the last two pages of my record of yesterday; they were in the place where I left them the night before. If only she knew what I wrote there! Although I did not care after all. Now it was only history; it was the ridiculously far off distance like an image through a reversed opera-glass.
paras.uz: Stolda qog'ozlarimni payqadim; kechagi qaydimning oxirgi ikki sahifasi; ular kecha kechqurun qoldirgan joyimda edi. Qaniydi u yerda nima yozganimni bilsa! Garchi oxir-oqibat menga baribir bo'lsa ham. Endi bu faqat tarix edi; bu teskari qaratilgan teatr durbinidagi tasvirdek kulgili darajada uzoq masofa edi.

paras.en: “Yes,” I said, “a while ago, while passing through the avenue, I saw a man walking ahead of me. His shadow stretched along the pavement and think of it! his shadow was luminous! I think, more than that, I am absolutely certain that tomorrow all shadows will disappear. Not a shadow from any person or anything! The sun will be shining through everything.”
paras.uz: «Ha, — dedim men, — biroz oldin prospektdan o'tayotib, oldimda ketayotgan bir odamni ko'rdim. Uning soyasi trotuar bo'ylab cho'zilgan edi va o'ylab ko'ring! uning soyasi nurli edi! Menimcha, bundan ham ko'proq, mutlaqo aminmanki, ertaga barcha soyalar yo'qoladi. Hech bir odamdan yoki hech bir narsadan soya bo'lmaydi! Quyosh hamma narsa orqali porlaydi».

paras.en: She, gently and earnestly:
paras.uz: U muloyim va jiddiy:

paras.en: “You are a dreamer! I should not allow my children in school to talk that way.”
paras.uz: «Siz xayolparastsiz! Men maktabdagi bolalarimga bunday gapirishga ruxsat bermagan bo'lardim».

paras.en: She told me something about the children; that they were all led in one herd to the Operation; that it was necessary to bind them afterward with ropes; and that one must love pitilessly, “yes, pitilessly,” and that she thought she might finally decide to.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U menga bolalar haqida nimadir aytib berdi; ularning hammasini bir poda qilib Operatsiyaga olib borishgani; keyin ularni arqonlar bilan bog'lash kerak bo'lgani; va shafqatsizlarcha sevish kerakligi, «ha, shafqatsizlarcha», va u nihoyat qaror qilishi mumkin deb o'ylashi...

paras.en: She smoothed out the grayish-blue fold of the unif that fell between her knees, swiftly pasted her smiles all over me and went out.
paras.uz: U tizzalari orasiga tushgan yunifaning kulrang-ko'k burmasini tekisladi, tezda tabassumlarini butun vujudimga yopishtirdi va chiqib ketdi.

paras.en: Fortunately the sun did not stop today. The sun was running. It was already sixteen o’clock.⁠ ⁠… I was knocking at the door, my heart was knocking.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Baxtimga, quyosh bugun to'xtamadi. Quyosh yugurardi. Allaqachon soat o'n olti edi... Men eshikni taqillatardim, yuragim taqillardi...

paras.en: “Come in!”
paras.uz: «Kiring!»

paras.en: I threw myself upon the floor near her chair, to embrace her limbs, to lift my head upward and look into her eyes, first into one then into the other, and in each of them to see the reflection of myself in wonderful captivity.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men o'zimni uning kursisi yonidagi polga otdim, oyoqlarini quchoqlash, boshimni yuqoriga ko'tarib, ko'zlariga, avval biriga, keyin ikkinchisiga qarash va har birida ajoyib asirlikdagi o'z aksimni ko'rish uchun...

paras.en: There beyond the wall it looked stormy, there the clouds were leaden⁠—let them be! My head was overcrowded with impetuous words, and I was speaking aloud, and flying with the sun I knew not where.⁠ ⁠… No, now we know where we are flying; planets were following me, planets sparkling with flame and populated with fiery, singing flowers and mute planets, blue ones where rational stones were unified into one organized society, and planets which like our own earth had reached already the apex of one hundred percent happiness.
paras.uz: U yerda, devor ortida bo'ronli ko'rinardi, u yerda bulutlar qo'rg'oshindek edi — mayli! Boshim shiddatli so'zlarga to'lib-toshgan edi va men ovoz chiqarib gapirardim va quyosh bilan qayergadir, bilmagan joyimga uchardim... Yo'q, endi qayerga uchayotganimizni bilamiz; sayyoralar mening ortimdan ergashardi, alanga bilan uchqunlanayotgan va otashin, kuylayotgan gullar yashaydigan sayyoralar va soqov sayyoralar, aqlli toshlar bitta uyushgan jamiyatga birlashgan moviy sayyoralar va bizning yerimiz kabi allaqachon yuz foizli baxtning cho'qqisiga erishgan sayyoralar.

paras.en: Suddenly from above:
paras.uz: To'satdan yuqoridan:

paras.en: “And don’t you think that at the apex are, precisely, stones unified into an organized society?” The triangle grew sharper and sharper, darker and darker.
paras.uz: «Va cho'qqida aynan uyushgan jamiyatga birlashgan toshlar bor deb o'ylamaysizmi?» Uchburchak tobora o'tkirlashib, tobora qoraydi.

paras.en: “Happiness⁠ ⁠… well?⁠ ⁠… Desires are tortures, are they not? It is clear therefore, that happiness is where there are no longer any desires, not a single desire any more. What an error, what an absurd prejudice it was, that formerly we would mark happiness with the sign ‘plus’! No, absolute happiness must be marked ‘minus,’⁠—divine minus!”
paras.uz: «Baxt... xo'sh?.. Istaklar qiynoq-ku, shunday emasmi? Demak, aniqki, baxt endi hech qanday istak, bironta ham istak qolmagan joyda. Ilgari baxtni "plyus" belgisi bilan belgilaganimiz qanday xato, qanday bema'ni xurofot edi! Yo'q, mutlaq baxt "minus" bilan belgilanishi kerak — ilohiy minus!»

paras.en: I remember I stammered unintelligibly:
paras.uz: Esimda, men tushunarsiz duduqlandim:

paras.en: “Absolute zero!⁠—minus 273° C.”
paras.uz: «Mutlaq nol! — minus 273° C».

paras.en: “Minus 273°⁠—exactly! A somewhat cool temperature. But does it not prove that we are at the summit?”
paras.uz: «Minus 273° — aynan! Biroz salqin harorat. Lekin bu bizning cho'qqida ekanimizni isbotlamaydimi?»

paras.en: As before she seemed somehow to speak for me and through me, developing to the end my own thoughts. But there was something so morbid in her tone that I could not refrain⁠ ⁠… with an effort I drew out a “No.”
paras.uz: Avvalgidek u go'yo qandaydir men uchun va men orqali gapirardi, mening fikrlarimni oxirigacha rivojlantirardi. Lekin uning ohangida shunchalik kasalmand nimadir bor ediki, o'zimni tiya olmadim... kuch bilan «Yo'q»ni chiqardim.

paras.en: “No,” I said. “You, you are mocking.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Yo'q, — dedim men. — Siz, siz masxara qilyapsiz...»

paras.en: She burst out laughing loudly, too loudly. Swiftly, in a second, she laughed herself to some unseen edge, stumbled and fell over.⁠ ⁠… Silence.
paras.uz: U baland, haddan tashqari baland kulib yubordi. Tez, bir soniyada u kulib qandaydir ko'rinmas chetga yetdi, qoqilib, yiqildi... Sukunat.

paras.en: She stood up, put her hands upon my shoulders and looked into me for a long while. Then she pulled me toward her and everything seemed to have disappeared save her sharp, hot lips.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U o'rnidan turib, qo'llarini yelkalarimga qo'ydi va uzoq vaqt menga tikilib qoldi. Keyin meni o'ziga tortdi va uning o'tkir, issiq lablaridan boshqa hamma narsa g'oyib bo'lgandek tuyuldi...

paras.en: “Goodbye.”
paras.uz: «Xayr».

paras.en: The words came from afar, from above, and reached me not at once, only after a minute, perhaps two minutes later.
paras.uz: So'zlar uzoqdan, yuqoridan keldi va menga darhol emas, faqat bir daqiqadan, balki ikki daqiqadan keyin yetib keldi.

paras.en: “Why⁠ ⁠… why ‘goodbye’?”
paras.uz: «Nega... nega "xayr"?»

paras.en: “You have been ill, have you not? Because of me you have committed crimes. Has not all this tormented you? And now you have the Operation to look forward to. You will be cured of me. And that means⁠—goodbye.”
paras.uz: «Siz kasal edingiz-ku, shunday emasmi? Men tufayli jinoyatlar qildingiz. Bularning hammasi sizni qiynamadimi? Endi esa sizni Operatsiya kutyapti. Siz mendan davolanasiz. Bu esa — xayr degani».

paras.en: “No!” I cried.
paras.uz: «Yo'q!» — qichqirdim men.

paras.en: A pitilessly sharp black triangle on a white background.
paras.uz: Oq fonda shafqatsizlarcha o'tkir qora uchburchak.

paras.en: “What? Do you mean that you don’t want happiness?”
paras.uz: «Nima? Siz baxtni istamaysiz demoqchimisiz?»

paras.en: My head was breaking into pieces; two logical trains collided and crawled upon each other, rattling and smothering.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Boshim parcha-parcha bo'lib ketayotgan edi; ikki mantiqiy poyezd to'qnashib, bir-birining ustiga taraqlab, bo'g'ilib o'rmaladi...

paras.en: “Well, I am waiting. You must choose; the Operation and hundred percent happiness, or.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Xo'sh, kutyapman. Siz tanlashingiz kerak; Operatsiya va yuz foizli baxt, yoki...»

paras.en: “I cannot⁠ ⁠… without you.⁠ ⁠… I must not⁠ ⁠… without you.⁠ ⁠…” I said, or perhaps I only thought, I am not sure which, but I-330 heard.
paras.uz: «Men qila olmayman... sizsiz... Menga mumkin emas... sizsiz...» — dedim, yoki balki faqat o'yladim, qaysi biri ekanini aniq bilmayman, lekin I-330 eshitdi.

paras.en: “Yes, I know,” she said. Then, her hands still on my shoulders and her eyes not letting my eyes go, “Then⁠ ⁠… until tomorrow. Tomorrow at twelve. You remember?”
paras.uz: «Ha, bilaman», — dedi u. Keyin qo'llari hali ham yelkalarimda va ko'zlari ko'zlarimni qo'yib yubormay: «Unda... ertagacha. Ertaga o'n ikkida. Esingizdami?»

paras.en: “No, it was postponed for a day. Day-after-tomorrow!”
paras.uz: «Yo'q, bir kunga qoldirildi. Indinga!»

paras.en: “So much the better for us. At twelve, day-after-tomorrow!”
paras.uz: «Biz uchun shunisi yaxshiroq. Indinga, o'n ikkida!»

paras.en: I walked alone in the dusky street. The wind was whirling, carrying, driving me like a piece of paper; fragments of the leaden sky were soaring, soaring⁠—they had to soar through the infinite for another day or two.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men g'ira-shira ko'chada yolg'iz yurdim. Shamol aylanib, meni qog'oz parchasidek olib ketar, haydar edi; qo'rg'oshindek osmon parchalari uchardi, uchardi — ular cheksizlik bo'ylab yana bir-ikki kun uchishlari kerak edi...

paras.en: Unifs of Numbers were brushing my sides⁠—yet I was walking alone. It was clear to me that all were saved but that there was no salvation for me. For I do not want salvation.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Raqamlarning yunifalari yonlarimga tegib o'tardi — lekin men yolg'iz yurardim. Menga aniq ediki, hamma najot topdi, lekin men uchun najot yo'q. Chunki men najotni istamayman...

gloss.ex: …is open! Hasten then all of you, young and old, hasten to undergo the great Operation! Hasten to the auditoriums where the great Operation is being performed! L…

…f the frontal lobe of the brain. A triple treatment of this knot with X-rays will cure you of fancy⁠—
