quiz.q: What does the Great Operation remove?
quiz.why_uz: Fantaziya markazi rentgen bilan yo'q qilinadi.

quiz.q: Why is the trial flight postponed?
quiz.why_uz: Ikkinchi Quruvchi Operatsiya tufayli deydi.

chapters.recap_uz: Gazeta Buyuk Operatsiya — fantaziyani olib tashlashni e'lon qiladi. D-503 xursand bo'ladi, lekin I-330 bilan xayrlashish chog'ida baxt o'rniga uni tanlaydi.

chapters.title: I do not believe — Tractors — A little human splinter
chapters.title_uz: Ishonmayman — Traktorlar — Insondan qolgan kichik payraxa

paras.en: Do you believe that you will die? Oh, yes, “Man is mortal. I am a man, consequently.⁠ ⁠…” No, not that; I know that; you know it. But I ask: has it ever happened that you actually believed it? Believed definitely, believed not with your reason but with your body, that you actually felt that some day those fingers which now hold this page, will become yellow, icy?⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: O'lishingizga ishonasizmi? Oh, ha, «Inson o'likdir. Men insonman, demak...» Yo'q, bu emas; men buni bilaman; siz buni bilasiz. Lekin men so'rayapman: hech qachon bunga haqiqatan ishonganmisiz? Qat'iy ishonganmisiz, aqlingiz bilan emas, tanangiz bilan ishonganmisiz, hozir bu sahifani ushlab turgan o'sha barmoqlar bir kun kelib sarg'ayib, muzdek bo'lib qolishini haqiqatan his qilganmisiz?..

paras.en: No, of course you cannot believe this. That is why you have not jumped from the tenth floor to the pavement before now, that is why you eat, turn over these pages, shave, smile, write.
paras.uz: Yo'q, albatta, bunga ishona olmaysiz. Shuning uchun siz hozirgacha o'ninchi qavatdan trotuarga sakramagansiz, shuning uchun ovqatlanasiz, bu sahifalarni varaqlaysiz, soqol olasiz, jilmayasiz, yozasiz.

paras.en: This very thing, yes, exactly this is alive in me today. I know that that small black hand on the clock will slide down here towards midnight, then again it will start to ascend, and it will cross some last border and the improbable tomorrow will have arrived. I know it, but somehow I do not believe it, or perhaps I think that twenty-four hours are twenty-four years. Therefore I am still able to act, to hurry, to answer questions, to climb the rope-ladder to the Integral. I am still able to feel how the latter is shaking the surface of the water, and I still understand that I must grasp the railing, and I am still able to feel the cold glass in my hand. I see the transparent, living cranes, bending their long necks, carefully feeding the Integral with the terrible explosive food which the motors need. I still see below on the river the blue veins and knots of water swollen by the wind.⁠ ⁠… Yet all this seems very distant from me, foreign, flat⁠—like a draught on a sheet of paper. And it seems to me strange, when the flat, draught-like face of the Second Builder, suddenly asks:
paras.uz: Aynan shu narsa, ha, aynan shu bugun menda tirik. Bilamanki, soatdagi o'sha kichkina qora mil bu yerda yarim tunga qarab sirpanib tushadi, keyin yana ko'tarila boshlaydi va qandaydir oxirgi chegarani kesib o'tadi va aql bovar qilmas ertangi kun keladi. Men buni bilaman, lekin negadir bunga ishonmayman, yoki balki yigirma to'rt soatni yigirma to'rt yil deb o'ylayman. Shuning uchun men hali ham harakat qila olaman, shosha olaman, savollarga javob bera olaman, Integralga arqon narvon bo'ylab ko'tarila olaman. Men hali ham u suv yuzasini qanday chayqatayotganini his qila olaman va hali ham panjarani ushlashim kerakligini tushunaman va hali ham qo'limda sovuq shishani his qila olaman. Men uzun bo'yinlarini egib, Integralni motorlarga kerak bo'lgan dahshatli portlovchi ozuqa bilan ehtiyotkorlik bilan oziqlantirayotgan shaffof, tirik kranlarni ko'raman. Men hali ham pastda, daryoda shamol shishirgan suvning moviy tomirlari va tugunlarini ko'raman... Lekin bularning hammasi mendan juda uzoq, begona, yassi — qog'oz varag'idagi chizmadek tuyuladi. Va Ikkinchi Quruvchining yassi, chizmadek yuzi to'satdan so'raganda menga g'alati tuyuladi:

paras.en: “Well, then. How much fuel for the motors shall we load on? If we count on three, or say three and a half hours.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Xo'sh, unday bo'lsa. Motorlar uchun qancha yoqilg'i yuklaymiz? Agar uch, aytaylik, uch yarim soatga hisoblasak...»

paras.en: I see before me, over a draught, my hand with the counter and the logarithmic dial at the figure 15.
paras.uz: Oldimda, chizma ustida, hisoblagich va logarifmik shkala ushlagan qo'limni 15 raqamida ko'raman.

paras.en: “Fifteen tons. But you’d better take⁠ ⁠… yes, better take a thousand.”
paras.uz: «O'n besh tonna. Lekin yaxshisi... ha, yaxshisi ming oling».

paras.en: I said that because I know that tomorrow.⁠ ⁠… I noticed that my hands and the dial began to tremble.
paras.uz: Buni men ertaga... ekanini bilganim uchun aytdim. Qo'llarim va shkala titray boshlaganini payqadim.

paras.en: “A thousand! What do you need such a lot for? That would last a week! No, more than a week!”
paras.uz: «Ming! Sizga shuncha ko'p nima uchun kerak? Bu bir haftaga yetadi! Yo'q, bir haftadan ham ko'proqqa!»

paras.en: “Well, nobody knows.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Xo'sh, hech kim bilmaydi...»

paras.en: I do know.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men bilaman...

paras.en: The wind whistled, the air seemed to be stuffed to the limit with something invisible. I had difficulty in breathing, difficulty in walking, and with difficulty, slowly but without stopping for a second the hand of the Accumulating Tower was crawling, at the end of the avenue. The peak of the Tower reached into the very clouds;⁠—dull, blue, groaning in a subdued way, sucking electricity from the clouds. The tubes of the Musical Tower resounded.
paras.uz: Shamol hushtak chalardi, havo go'yo qandaydir ko'rinmas narsa bilan chegarasigacha to'ldirilgandek edi. Men qiyinchilik bilan nafas olardim, qiyinchilik bilan yurardim va qiyinchilik bilan, sekin, lekin bir soniya ham to'xtamay, prospekt oxirida Jamg'arma Minorasining mili o'rmalab borardi. Minora cho'qqisi bulutlarning o'zigacha yetardi; — xira, moviy, bo'g'iq ingrab, bulutlardan elektr so'rardi. Musiqa Minorasining quvurlari jaranglardi.

paras.en: As always⁠—four abreast. But the rows did not seem as firm as usual; they were swinging, bending more and more, perhaps because of the wind. There! They seemed to have stumbled upon something at the corner, and they drew back and stopped, congealed, a close mass, a clot, breathing rapidly; at once all had stretched their necks like geese.
paras.uz: Har doimgidek — to'rttadan qator bo'lib. Lekin qatorlar odatdagidek mustahkam ko'rinmasdi; ular tebranar, tobora ko'proq egilardi, balki shamol tufaylidir. Mana! Ular muyulishda nimagadir qoqilgandek bo'ldi va orqaga chekinib to'xtadi, qotib qoldi, zich massa, laxta, tez nafas olib; birdaniga hamma g'ozlardek bo'ynini cho'zdi.

paras.en: “Look! No look, look⁠—there, quick!”
paras.uz: «Qarang! Yo'q, qarang, qarang — u yerda, tezroq!»

paras.en: “They? Are those they?”
paras.uz: «Ular? Ular o'shalarmi?»

paras.en: “Ah, never! Never! I’d rather put my head straight into the Machine.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Oh, hech qachon! Hech qachon! Yaxshisi boshimni to'g'ri Mashinaga tiqaman...»

paras.en: “Silence! Are you crazy?”
paras.uz: «Jim! Aqldan ozdingizmi?»

paras.en: On the corner the doors of the auditorium were ajar, a heavy column of about fifty people⁠—. The word “people” is not the right one. These were heavy-wheeled automatons bound in iron and moved by an invisible mechanism. Not people but a sort of human-like tractor. Over their heads, floating in the air⁠—a white banner with a golden sun embroidered on it, and the rays of the sun: “We are the first! We have already been operated upon! Follow us, all of you!”
paras.uz: Muyulishda auditoriya eshiklari qiya ochiq edi, ellik kishiga yaqin og'ir kolonna —. «Kishi» so'zi to'g'ri emas. Bular temir bilan bog'langan va ko'rinmas mexanizm harakatga keltiradigan og'ir g'ildirakli avtomatlar edi. Odamlar emas, qandaydir odamsimon traktorlar. Ularning boshlari ustida havoda suzib — ustiga oltin quyosh kashta qilingan oq bayroq va quyosh nurlari: «Biz birinchimiz! Bizga allaqachon operatsiya qilingan! Hammangiz bizning ortimizdan yuring!»

paras.en: They slowly, unhesitatingly mowed through the crowd, and it was clear that if they had had in their way a wall, a tree, a house, they would have moved on with no more hesitation through wall, tree or house. In the middle of the avenue they fused and stretched out into a chain, arm in arm, their faces turned towards us. And we, a human clot, tense, the hair pricking our heads, we waited. Our necks were stretched out goose-fashion. Clouds. The wind whistled. Suddenly the wings of the chain from right and left bent quickly around us, and faster, faster, like a heavy engine descending a hill, they closed the ring and pulled us toward the yawning doors and inside.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Ular sekin, ikkilanmay olomonni o'rib o'tishdi va aniq ediki, agar yo'llarida devor, daraxt, uy bo'lganida ular devor, daraxt yoki uy orqali ham bundan ortiq ikkilanmay harakatlanishgan bo'lardi. Prospektning o'rtasida ular qo'shilib, qo'ltiqlashib, yuzlarini bizga qaratib zanjir bo'lib cho'zilishdi. Biz esa, inson laxtasi, tarang, sochlarimiz tikka turib, kutdik. Bo'ynimiz g'ozlardek cho'zilgan edi. Bulutlar. Shamol hushtak chalardi. To'satdan zanjirning qanotlari o'ngdan va chapdan atrofimizda tez egildi va tezroq, tezroq, xuddi tepadan tushayotgan og'ir mashinadek, ular halqani yopib, bizni og'zini ochib turgan eshiklarga va ichkariga tortib ketishdi...

paras.en: Somebody’s piercing cry: “They are driving us in! Run!”
paras.uz: Kimningdir o'tkir qichqirig'i: «Ular bizni haydab kirityapti! Qochinglar!»

paras.en: All ran. Close to the wall there still was an open living gate of human beings. Everybody dashed through it, heads forward. Their heads became sharp wedges, so with their ribs, shoulders, hips.⁠ ⁠… Like a stream of water compressed in a firehose they spurted out in the form of a fan⁠—and all around me stamping feet, raised arms, unifs.⁠ ⁠… The double-curved S- with his transparent wing-ears appeared for a moment close before my eyes; he disappeared as suddenly; I was alone among arms and legs appearing for a second and disappearing. I was running.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Hamma yugurdi. Devor yonida hali odamlardan iborat ochiq tirik darvoza bor edi. Hamma boshini oldinga qilib undan otilib o'tdi. Ularning boshlari o'tkir ponalarga aylandi, qovurg'alari, yelkalari, sonlari ham... O't o'chirish shlangida siqilgan suv oqimidek ular yelpig'ich shaklida otilib chiqishdi — va atrofimda tepayotgan oyoqlar, ko'tarilgan qo'llar, yunifalar... Shaffof qanot-quloqli ikki marta egilgan S- bir lahzaga ko'zlarim oldida paydo bo'ldi; u xuddi shunday to'satdan g'oyib bo'ldi; men bir soniyaga paydo bo'lib, g'oyib bo'layotgan qo'llar va oyoqlar orasida yolg'iz edim. Men yugurardim...

paras.en: I dashed to the entrance of a house to stop for a breath, my back close to the door⁠—and immediately, like a splinter borne by the wind, a human being was thrown towards me.
paras.uz: Nafas rostlash uchun to'xtash maqsadida bir uyning kirish joyiga otildim, orqamni eshikka yopishtirdim — va shu zahoti, shamol uchirgan cho'pdek, menga qarab bir inson otildi.

paras.en: “All the while I⁠ ⁠… I have been following you. I do not want⁠ ⁠… do you see? I do not want⁠ ⁠… I am ready to.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Doimo men... men sizning ortingizdan yurdim. Men istamayman... ko'ryapsizmi? Men istamayman... Men tayyorman...»

paras.en: Small round hands on my sleeves, round dark blue eyes⁠—it was O-90. She just slipped along my body like a unif which, its hanger broken, slips along the wall to fall upon the floor. Like a little bundle she crumpled below me on the cold doorstep, and I stood over her, stroking her head, her face⁠—my hands were wet. I felt as if I were very big and she very small, a small part of myself. I felt something quite different from what I feel towards I-330. I think that the ancients must have had similar feelings towards their private children.
paras.uz: Yenglarimda kichkina dumaloq qo'llar, dumaloq to'q moviy ko'zlar — bu O-90 edi. U ilgichi singan yunifadek devor bo'ylab sirg'alib polga tushgandek, tanam bo'ylab sirg'alib tushdi. U kichkina tugundek sovuq ostonada oyoqlarim ostida g'ujanak bo'lib qoldi va men uning ustida turib, boshini, yuzini silardim — qo'llarim ho'l edi. Men o'zimni juda katta, uni esa juda kichkina, o'zimning kichkina bir qismimdek his qildim. Men I-330 ga nisbatan his qiladigan narsamdan butunlay boshqacha narsani his qildim. Menimcha, qadimgilar o'zlarining xususiy bolalariga nisbatan shunga o'xshash tuyg'ularga ega bo'lishgan bo'lsa kerak.

paras.en: Below, passing through her hands with which she was covering her face, a voice came to me:
paras.uz: Pastdan, u yuzini yopib turgan qo'llari orqali o'tib, menga ovoz keldi:

paras.en: “Every night I⁠ ⁠… I cannot! If they cure me.⁠ ⁠… Every night I sit in the darkness alone and think of him, and of what he will look like when I.⁠ ⁠… If cured I should have nothing to live with⁠—do you understand me? You must⁠ ⁠… you must.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Har kecha men... Men qila olmayman! Agar meni davolashsa... Har kecha qorong'ida yolg'iz o'tirib, u haqida va men... bo'lganimda u qanday ko'rinishi haqida o'ylayman... Davolansam, men bilan yashaydigan hech narsa qolmaydi — tushunyapsizmi? Siz kerak... siz kerak...»

paras.en: An absurd feeling yet it was there; I really must! Absurd, because this “duty” of mine was nothing but another crime. Absurd, because white and black cannot be one, duty and crime cannot coincide. Or perhaps there is no black and white in life, but everything depends upon the first logical premise? If the premise is that I unlawfully gave her a child.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Bema'ni tuyg'u, lekin u bor edi; men haqiqatan ham kerak edi! Bema'ni, chunki bu mening «burchim» yana bir jinoyatdan boshqa narsa emas edi. Bema'ni, chunki oq va qora bir bo'la olmaydi, burch va jinoyat bir-biriga to'g'ri kela olmaydi. Yoki balki hayotda oq va qora yo'qdir, balki hamma narsa birinchi mantiqiy asosga bog'liqdir? Agar asos shu bo'lsa — men unga qonunsiz bola berganman...

paras.en: “It is all right, but don’t, only don’t⁠ ⁠…” I said. “Of course I understand.⁠ ⁠… I must take you to I-330, as I once offered to, so that she.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Hammasi joyida, lekin qo'ying, faqat qo'ying...» — dedim men. «Albatta, tushunaman... Men sizni bir paytlar taklif qilganimdek I-330 ning oldiga olib borishim kerak, toki u...»

paras.en: “Yes.” (This in a low voice, without uncovering her face.)
paras.uz: «Ha». (Bu past ovozda, yuzini ochmasdan.)

paras.en: I helped her rise. Silently we went along the darkening street, each busy with his own thoughts, or perhaps with the same thought.⁠ ⁠… We walked between silent leaden houses, through the tense, whipping branches of the wind.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men unga turishga yordam berdim. Jimgina qorong'ilashayotgan ko'cha bo'ylab yurdik, har birimiz o'z fikrlari bilan, yoki balki bir xil fikr bilan band edik... Biz jim qo'rg'oshindek uylar orasidan, shamolning tarang, qamchilovchi shoxlari orqali yurdik...

paras.en: Through the whistling of the wind all at once I heard, as if splashing through ditches, the familiar footsteps coming from some unseen point. At the corner I turned around, and among the clouds, flying upside-down reflected in the dim glass of the pavement I saw S-. Instantly my arms became foreign, swinging out of time, and I began to tell O-90 in a low voice that tomorrow, yes tomorrow, was the day of the first flight of the Integral, and that it was to be something that never happened before in all history, great, miraculous.
paras.uz: Shamolning hushtagi orqali birdaniga, go'yo ariqlardan shalpillayotgandek, qandaydir ko'rinmas nuqtadan kelayotgan tanish qadamlarni eshitdim. Muyulishda o'girildim va bulutlar orasida, trotuarning xira shishasida teskari aks etib uchib kelayotgan S- ni ko'rdim. Bir zumda qo'llarim begona bo'lib, taktdan chiqib silkina boshladi va men O-90 ga past ovozda ertaga, ha, ertaga Integralning birinchi parvozi kuni ekanini va bu butun tarixda hech qachon bo'lmagan buyuk, mo''jizaviy narsa bo'lishini aytib bera boshladim.

paras.en: “Think of it! For the first time in life to find myself outside the limits of our city and see⁠—who knows what is beyond the Green Wall?”
paras.uz: «O'ylab ko'ring! Hayotda birinchi marta shahrimiz chegarasidan tashqarida bo'lish va ko'rish — Yashil Devor ortida nima borligini kim biladi?»

paras.en: O-90 looked at me extremely surprised, her blue eyes trying to penetrate mine; she looked at my senselessly swinging arms. But I did not let her say a word⁠—I kept talking, talking.⁠ ⁠… And within me, apart from what I was saying and audible only to myself a thought was feverishly buzzing and knocking. “Impossible! You must somehow⁠ ⁠… you must not lead him to I-330!”
paras.uz: O-90 menga nihoyatda hayron bo'lib qaradi, uning moviy ko'zlari menikiga kirib borishga urinardi; u mening ma'nosiz silkinayotgan qo'llarimga qaradi. Lekin men unga bir so'z ham aytishga imkon bermadim — gapirishda, gapirishda davom etdim... Ichimda esa, aytayotganlarimdan tashqari va faqat o'zimga eshitiladigan bir fikr isitmadek g'uvillab, taqillardi: «Imkonsiz! Siz qandaydir... siz uni I-330 ning oldiga boshlab bormasligingiz kerak!»

paras.en: Instead of turning to the right I turned to the left. The bridge submissively bent its back in a slavish way to all three of us, to me, to O-, to him behind. Lights were falling from the houses across the water, falling and breaking into thousands of sparks which danced feverishly, sprayed with the mad white foam of the water. The wind was moaning like a tensely stretched string of a double-basso somewhere not far away. Through this basso, behind, all the while.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: O'ngga burilish o'rniga chapga burildim. Ko'prik uchalamizga — menga, O- ga, orqadagi unga — qullarcha itoatkorlik bilan belini egdi. Uylardan chiroqlar suv osha tushib, isitmadek raqsga tushayotgan, suvning telba oq ko'pigi sachragan minglab uchqunlarga bo'linib sinardi. Shamol qayerdadir yaqinda kontrabasning tarang tortilgan torinidek ingrardi. Bu bas orqali, orqada, doimo...

paras.en: The house where I live. At the entrance O- stopped and began:
paras.uz: Men yashaydigan uy. Kirish joyida O- to'xtab, gap boshladi:

paras.en: “No! You promised, did you not, that.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Yo'q! Siz va'da bergan edingiz-ku, ...»

paras.en: I did not let her finish. Hastily I pushed her through the entrance and we found ourselves in the lobby. At the controller’s desk⁠—the familiar, hanging, excitedly quivering cheeks, a group of Numbers around. They were quarreling about something, heads bending over the banisters on the second floor; they were running downstairs one by one. But about that later. I at once drew O-90 into the opposite, unoccupied corner and sat down with my back to the wall. I saw a dark large-headed shadow gliding back and forth over the sidewalk. I took out my notebook. O-90 in her chair was slowly sinking as if she were evaporating from under her unif, as if her body were thawing, as if only her empty unif were left, and empty eyes taking one into the blue emptiness. In a tired voice:
paras.uz: Uning gapini tugatishiga qo'ymadim. Shoshilib uni kirish joyidan itarib kiritdim va biz vestibyulda bo'lib qoldik. Nazoratchi stolida — tanish, osilgan, hayajondan titrayotgan yonoqlar, atrofda bir guruh Raqamlar. Ular nima haqidadir janjallashardi, ikkinchi qavatdagi panjaralar osha boshlar egilgan; ular birin-ketin pastga yugurib tushishardi. Lekin bu haqda keyinroq. Men darhol O-90 ni qarama-qarshi, bo'sh burchakka tortdim va orqamni devorga qilib o'tirdim. Trotuar ustida u yoqdan bu yoqqa sirpanayotgan qorong'i, katta boshli soyani ko'rdim. Daftarchamni chiqardim. O-90 kursisida sekin cho'kib borardi, go'yo u yunifasi ostidan bug'lanib ketayotgandek, go'yo tanasi erib ketayotgandek, go'yo faqat uning bo'sh yunifasi va odamni moviy bo'shliqqa olib ketadigan bo'sh ko'zlari qolgandek. Charchagan ovozda:

paras.en: “Why did you bring me here? You lied to me?”
paras.uz: «Meni bu yerga nega olib keldingiz? Menga yolg'on gapirdingizmi?»

paras.en: “No, not so loud! Look here! Do you see? Through the wall?”
paras.uz: «Yo'q, bunchalik baland emas! Mana bu yoqqa qarang! Ko'ryapsizmi? Devor orqali?»

paras.en: “Yes, I see a shadow.”
paras.uz: «Ha, soyani ko'ryapman».

paras.en: “He is always following me.⁠ ⁠… I cannot.⁠ ⁠… Do you understand? I cannot therefore⁠ ⁠… I am going to write a few words to I-330. You take the note and go alone. I know he will remain here.”
paras.uz: «U doimo meni kuzatib yuradi... Men qila olmayman... Tushunyapsizmi? Shuning uchun men qila olmayman... Men I-330 ga bir necha so'z yozaman. Siz yozuvni olib, yolg'iz borasiz. Bilaman, u shu yerda qoladi».

paras.en: Her body began again to take form and to move beneath the unif; on her face a faint sunrise, dawn. I put the note between her cold fingers, pressed her hand firmly and for the last time looked into her blue eyes.
paras.uz: Uning tanasi yunifa ostida yana shakl olib, qimirlay boshladi; yuzida xira quyosh chiqishi, tong. Yozuvni uning sovuq barmoqlari orasiga qo'ydim, qo'lini mahkam siqdim va oxirgi marta uning moviy ko'zlariga qaradim.

paras.en: “Goodbye. Perhaps some day.⁠ ⁠…” She freed her hand. Slightly bending over she slowly moved away, made two steps, turned around quickly and again we were side by side. Her lips were moving; with her lips and with her eyes she repeated some inaudible word. What an unbearable smile! What suffering!
paras.uz: «Xayr. Balki bir kun kelib...» U qo'lini bo'shatdi. Biroz engashib, sekin uzoqlashdi, ikki qadam tashladi, tez o'girildi va yana biz yonma-yon edik. Uning lablari qimirlardi; lablari va ko'zlari bilan u qandaydir eshitilmas so'zni takrorlardi. Qanday chidab bo'lmas tabassum! Qanday azob!

paras.en: Then the bent-over human splinter went to the door; a bent-over little shadow beyond the wall; without turning around she went on faster, still faster.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Keyin engashgan kichkina inson cho'pi eshik tomon yurdi; devor ortida engashgan kichkina soya; orqasiga qaramay u tezroq, yana ham tezroq yurib ketdi...

paras.en: I went to U-’s desk. With emotion filling up her indignant gills she said to me:
paras.uz: Men Yu- ning stoli oldiga bordim. Hayajon g'azablangan jabralarini to'ldirib, u menga dedi:

paras.en: “They have all gone crazy! He, for instance, is trying to assure me that he himself saw a naked man covered with hair near the Ancient House.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Ularning hammasi aqldan ozgan! Masalan, u meni Qadimiy Uy yonida tuk bilan qoplangan yalang'och odamni o'zi ko'rganiga ishontirmoqchi...»

paras.en: A voice from the group of empty raised heads;
paras.uz: Bo'sh, ko'tarilgan boshlar guruhidan ovoz:

paras.en: “Yes. I repeat it, yes.”
paras.uz: «Ha. Takrorlayman, ha».

paras.en: “Well, what do you think of that? Oh, what a delirium!” The word “delirium” came out of her mouth so full of conviction, so unbending, that I asked myself: “Perhaps it really was nothing but delirium, all that has been going on around me of late?” I glanced at my hairy hand and I remembered: “There are, undoubtedly, some drops of that blood of the sun and woods in you. That is why perhaps you.⁠ ⁠…” No, fortunately it was not delirium; or no, unfortunately it was not delirium.
paras.uz: «Xo'sh, bunga nima deysiz? Oh, qanday alahsirash!» «Alahsirash» so'zi uning og'zidan shunchalik ishonch bilan, shunchalik qat'iy chiqdiki, o'zimdan so'radim: «Balki so'nggi paytlarda atrofimda bo'layotgan hamma narsa haqiqatan ham alahsirashdan boshqa narsa emasdir?» Tukli qo'limga qarab, esladim: «Sizda shubhasiz o'sha quyosh va o'rmon qonidan bir necha tomchi bor. Balki shuning uchun siz...» Yo'q, baxtimga, bu alahsirash emas edi; yoki yo'q, baxtimga qarshi, bu alahsirash emas edi.

gloss.ex: …moved by an invisible mechanism. Not people but a sort of human-like tractor. Over their heads, floating in the air⁠—a white banner with a golden sun embroider…
…stop for a breath, my back close to the door⁠—and immediately, like a splinter borne by the wind, a human being was thrown towards me.
“Well, then. How much fuel for the motors shall we load on? If we count on three, or say three and a half hours.…
“Fifteen tons. But you’d better take⁠ ⁠… yes, better take a thousand.”
“Well, what do you think of that? Oh, what a delirium!” The word “delirium” came out of her mouth so full of conviction, so unbending,…

quiz.q: How much fuel does D-503 order?
quiz.why_uz: U parvoz uzoq davom etishini biladi.

quiz.q: Why does D-503 not go with O-90 himself?
quiz.why_uz: S- ni I-330 ga olib bormaslik uchun.

chapters.recap_uz: Operatsiya qilinganlar «traktor»dek olomonni auditoriyaga haydaydi. O-90 D-503 ni topadi; u S- kuzatayotgani uchun O-90 ni yozuv bilan yolg'iz I-330 ga yuboradi.

chapters.title: This without a synopsis, hastily, the last
chapters.title_uz: Bu qayd qisqa mazmunsiz, shoshilib yozildi. So'nggisi

paras.en: The day.
paras.uz: Kun.

paras.en: Quick, to the newspaper! perhaps there.⁠ ⁠… I read the paper with my eyes (exactly; my eyes now are like a pen, or like a counting machine which you hold and feel in your hands like a tool, something foreign, an instrument). In the newspaper on the first page, in large print:
paras.uz: Tezroq, gazetaga! balki u yerda... Gazetani ko'zlarim bilan o'qiyman (aynan shunday; ko'zlarim endi qalamga yoki qo'lda ushlab, asbobdek, begona narsadek, qurol sifatida his qiladigan hisoblash mashinasiga o'xshaydi). Gazetada, birinchi sahifada, yirik harflar bilan:

paras.en: “The enemies of happiness are awake! Hold to your happiness with both hands. Tomorrow all work will stop and all the numbers are to come to be operated upon. Those who fail to come will be submitted to the machine of the well-doer.”
paras.uz: «Baxt dushmanlari uyg'oq! Baxtingizni ikki qo'llab ushlang. Ertaga barcha ishlar to'xtatiladi va barcha raqamlar operatsiya uchun kelishi kerak. Kelmaganlar Homiy mashinasiga topshiriladi».

paras.en: Tomorrow! How can there be, how can there be any tomorrow?
paras.uz: Ertaga! Qanday qilib, qanday qilib biror ertangi kun bo'lishi mumkin?

paras.en: Following my daily habit, I stretched out my arm (instrument!) to the bookshelf to put today’s paper with the rest in a cover ornamented with gold. While doing this: “What for? What does it matter? Never again shall I.⁠ ⁠… In this cover, never.⁠ ⁠…” And out of my hands, down to the floor it fell.
paras.uz: Kundalik odatimga ko'ra, bugungi gazetani oltin bilan bezatilgan muqovaga qolganlari bilan birga qo'yish uchun qo'limni (asbob!) kitob javoniga cho'zdim. Shunday qilayotib: «Nima uchun? Buning nima ahamiyati bor? Endi hech qachon men... Bu muqovaga hech qachon...» Va u qo'llarimdan polga tushib ketdi.

paras.en: I stood looking all around, over all my room; hastily I was taking away, feverishly putting into some unseen valise everything I regretted leaving here: my desk, my books, my chair. Upon that chair sat I-330 that day; I was below on the floor.⁠ ⁠… My bed.⁠ ⁠… Then for a minute or two I stood and waited for some miracle to happen; perhaps the telephone would ring, perhaps she would say that.⁠ ⁠… But no, no miracle.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men atrofga, butun xonamga qarab turdim; shoshilib, isitmadek bu yerda qoldirishga achinadigan hamma narsamni qandaydir ko'rinmas chamadonga solardim: stolimni, kitoblarimni, kursimni. O'sha kursida o'sha kuni I-330 o'tirgan edi; men pastda, polda edim... Karavotim... Keyin bir-ikki daqiqa turib, qandaydir mo''jiza yuz berishini kutdim; balki telefon jiringlar, balki u... deb aytar. Lekin yo'q, mo''jiza yo'q...

paras.en: I am leaving, going into the unknown. These are my last lines. Farewell you, my unknown beloved ones, with whom I have lived through so many pages, before whom I have bared my diseased soul, my whole self to the last broken little screw, to the last cracked spring.⁠ ⁠… I am going.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men ketyapman, noma'lumlikka ketyapman. Bular mening oxirgi satrlarim. Alvido, siz, noma'lum sevimlilarim, siz bilan shuncha sahifalarni birga yashadim, sizning oldingizda kasal ruhimni, butun vujudimni oxirgi singan vintchagacha, oxirgi yorilgan prujinagacha ochib tashladim... Men ketyapman...

chapters.recap_uz: Gazeta ertaga hamma operatsiya qilinishi kerakligini yozadi. D-503 qaydlari bilan xayrlashadi: «Men noma'lumlikka ketyapman».

chapters.title: The forgiven ones — A sunny night — A radio-walkyrie

paras.en: Oh, if only I actually had broken myself to pieces! If only I actually had found myself with her in some place beyond the Wall, among beasts showing their yellow tusks; if only I actually had never returned here! It would be a thousand, a million times easier! But now⁠—what? Now to go and choke that⁠—! But would it help? No, no, no! Take yourself in hand, D-503! Set into yourself the firm logical hub; at least for a short while weigh heavily with all your might on the lever, and like the ancient slave, turn the millstones of syllogisms until you have written down and understood everything that happened.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Oh, qaniydi men haqiqatan ham o'zimni parcha-parcha qilib sindirgan bo'lsam! Qaniydi men haqiqatan ham u bilan Devor ortidagi qandaydir joyda, sariq tishlarini ko'rsatayotgan hayvonlar orasida bo'lsam; qaniydi men haqiqatan ham bu yerga hech qachon qaytmagan bo'lsam! Bu ming, million marta osonroq bo'lardi! Lekin endi — nima? Endi borib o'sha —ni bo'g'ib o'ldirish! Lekin bu yordam berarmidi? Yo'q, yo'q, yo'q! O'zingni qo'lga ol, D-503! O'zingga mustahkam mantiqiy o'q o'rnat; hech bo'lmasa qisqa vaqt butun kuching bilan richagga og'ir bosib, qadimgi qul kabi sillogizmlar tegirmon toshlarini bo'lib o'tgan hamma narsani yozib, tushunib olmaguningcha aylantir...

paras.en: When I boarded the Integral, everybody was already there and everybody occupied his place; all the cells of the gigantic hive were filled. Through the glass of the decks⁠—tiny, ant-like people below, at the telegraph, dynamo, transformers, altimeters, ventilators, indicators, motor, pumps, tubes.⁠ ⁠… In the saloon people sitting over tables and instruments, probably those commissioned by the Scientific Bureau. Near them the Second Builder and his two aides. All three had their heads down between their shoulders like turtles, their faces gray, autumnal, rayless.
paras.uz: Integralga chiqqanimda hamma allaqachon u yerda edi va hamma o'z joyini egallagan edi; ulkan uyaning barcha kataklari to'lgan edi. Palubalar shishasi orqali — pastda, telegraf, dinamo, transformatorlar, altimetrlar, ventilyatorlar, ko'rsatkichlar, motor, nasoslar, quvurlar yonida chumolidek kichkina odamlar... Salonda stollar va asboblar ustida o'tirgan odamlar, ehtimol Ilmiy Byuro tomonidan yuborilganlar. Ular yonida Ikkinchi Quruvchi va uning ikki yordamchisi. Uchalasi ham toshbaqalardek boshlarini yelkalari orasiga tiqib olgan, yuzlari kulrang, kuzgi, nursiz edi.

paras.en: “Well?” I asked.
paras.uz: «Xo'sh?» — so'radim men.

paras.en: “Well, somewhat uncanny,” replied one of them smiling a gray rayless smile, “Perhaps we shall have to land in some unknown place. And, generally speaking, nobody knows.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Xo'sh, biroz g'alati, — javob berdi ulardan biri kulrang, nursiz tabassum bilan jilmayib. — Balki qandaydir noma'lum joyga qo'nishimizga to'g'ri kelar. Umuman olganda, hech kim bilmaydi...»

paras.en: I hardly could bear to look at them, when in an hour or so I was to throw them out with my own hands, to cast them out from the cozy figures of our Tables of Hours, forever to tear them away from the mother’s breast of the United State. They reminded me of the tragic figures of “The Three Forgiven Ones”⁠—a story known to all of our schoolchildren. It tells about three Numbers, who by way of experiment were exempted for a whole month from any work.3 “Go wherever you will, do what you will,” they were told. The unhappy three wandered the whole time about the place of their usual work and gazed within with hungry eyes. They would stop on the plazas and for hours busy themselves repeating the motions which they were used to making during certain hours of the day; it became a bodily necessity for them to do so. They would saw and plane the air; with unseen sledgehammers they would bang upon unseen stakes. Finally, on the tenth day they could bear it no longer; they took one another by the hand, entered the river, and to the accompaniment of the March they waded deeper and deeper until the water forever ended their sufferings.
paras.uz: Bir soatcha o'tib ularni o'z qo'llarim bilan uloqtirib tashlashim, Soatlar Jadvalimizning shinam raqamlaridan quvib chiqarishim, Yagona Davlatning ona ko'kragidan abadiy uzib olishim kerak bo'lganda, ularga qarashga zo'rg'a chiday olardim. Ular menga «Kechirilgan Uchlik»ning fojiali qiyofalarini eslatdi — bu barcha maktab o'quvchilarimizga ma'lum hikoya. Unda tajriba tariqasida butun bir oyga har qanday ishdan ozod qilingan uchta Raqam haqida so'z boradi. «Xohlagan joyingizga boring, xohlagan ishingizni qiling», — deyishgan ularga. Baxtsiz uchlik butun vaqt davomida odatdagi ish joylari atrofida kezib, ichkariga och ko'zlar bilan tikilishgan. Ular maydonlarda to'xtab, soatlab kunning ma'lum soatlarida qilishga o'rgangan harakatlarini takrorlash bilan mashg'ul bo'lishgan; bu ular uchun jismoniy ehtiyojga aylangan. Ular havoni arralashgan va randalashgan; ko'rinmas bolg'alar bilan ko'rinmas qoziqlarni urishgan. Nihoyat, o'ninchi kuni ular boshqa chiday olmay, qo'l ushlashib, daryoga kirishgan va Marsh sadosi ostida tobora chuqurroq kirib borishgan, toki suv ularning azoblariga abadiy chek qo'ygan.

paras.en: I repeat, it was hard for me to look at them, and I was anxious to leave them.
paras.uz: Takrorlayman, ularga qarash men uchun og'ir edi va men ulardan tezroq ketishni istardim.

paras.en: “I just want to take a glance into the engine-room, and then off!” I said.
paras.uz: «Men faqat mashina bo'limiga bir qarab olmoqchiman, keyin yo'lga!» — dedim men.

paras.en: They were asking me questions: What voltage should be used for the initial spark, how much ballast water was needed in the tank aft. As if a phonograph were somewhere within me, I was giving quick and precise answers but I, my inner self, was busy with its own thoughts.
paras.uz: Ular menga savollar berishardi: dastlabki uchqun uchun qanday kuchlanish ishlatilishi kerak, quyruqdagi bakka qancha ballast suv kerak. Go'yo ichimda qayerdadir fonograf bordek, men tez va aniq javoblar berardim, lekin men, ichki o'zim, o'z fikrlarim bilan band edim.

paras.en: In the narrow passage gray unifs were passing, gray faces and for a second, one face with its hair low over the forehead, eyes gazing from deep beneath it⁠—it was that same man. I understood: they had come and there was no escape from it for me; only minutes remained, a few dozens of minutes.⁠ ⁠… An infinitesimal, molecular quiver of my whole body. This did not cease to the very end⁠—it was as if an enormous motor were placed under the very foundation of my body which was so light that the walls, partitions, cables, beams, lights⁠—everything was quivering.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Tor yo'lakdan kulrang yunifalar, kulrang yuzlar o'tib borardi va bir soniyaga — sochlari peshonasiga past tushgan, ko'zlari uning ostidan chuqurdan tikilib turgan bir yuz — bu o'sha odam edi. Men tushundim: ular kelishgan va endi men uchun bundan qochib qutulish yo'q; faqat daqiqalar, bir necha o'n daqiqalar qoldi... Butun tanamning cheksiz kichik, molekulyar titrashi. Bu oxirigacha to'xtamadi — go'yo tanamning aynan poydevori ostiga ulkan motor o'rnatilgandek, tanam esa shunchalik yengil ediki, devorlar, to'siqlar, kabellar, to'sinlar, chiroqlar — hamma narsa titrardi...

paras.en: I did not yet know whether she was there. But I had no time.⁠ ⁠… They were calling me: quick! To the commander’s bridge; time to go⁠ ⁠… where?
paras.uz: Men hali u shu yerdami-yo'qmi, bilmasdim. Lekin vaqtim yo'q edi... Meni chaqirishardi: tezroq! Komandir ko'prigiga; ketish vaqti... qayerga?

paras.en: Gray, rayless faces. Below in the water⁠—tense blue veins. Heavy, cast-iron patches of sky. It was so difficult to lift my cast-iron hand and take up the receiver of the commander’s telephone!⁠ ⁠… “Up! Forty-five degrees!”
paras.uz: Kulrang, nursiz yuzlar. Pastda suvda — tarang moviy tomirlar. Osmonning og'ir, cho'yan yamoqlari. Cho'yan qo'limni ko'tarib, komandir telefonining go'shagini olish shunchalik qiyin edi!.. «Yuqoriga! Qirq besh daraja!»

paras.en: A heavy explosion⁠—a jerk⁠—a rabid greenish-white mountain of water aft⁠—the deck beneath my feet began to move, soft as rubber; and everything below, the whole life, forever.⁠ ⁠… For a second, falling deeper and deeper into a sort of funnel, becoming more and more compressed⁠—the icy-blue relief-map of the City, the round bubbles of cupolas, the lonely leaden finger of the Accumulating Tower.⁠ ⁠… Then instantaneously a cotton curtain of cloud.⁠ ⁠… We pierced it, and there was the sun and the blue sky! Seconds, minutes, miles⁠—the blue was hardening, fast filling with darkness; like drops of cold silver sweat appeared the stars.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Og'ir portlash — turtki — quyruqda quturgan yashilsimon-oq suv tog'i — oyoqlarim ostida paluba rezinadek yumshoq qimirlay boshladi; va pastdagi hamma narsa, butun hayot, abadiy... Bir soniyaga, qandaydir voronkaga tobora chuqurroq tushib, tobora siqilib — Shaharning muzdek-moviy relyef xaritasi, gumbazlarning dumaloq pufakchalari, Jamg'arma Minorasining yolg'iz qo'rg'oshin barmog'i... Keyin bir zumda bulutning paxtadek pardasi... Biz uni teshib o'tdik va mana quyosh va moviy osmon! Soniyalar, daqiqalar, millar — moviylik qotib, tez zulmatga to'lib borardi; sovuq kumush ter tomchilaridek yulduzlar paydo bo'ldi...

paras.en: A sad, unbearably bright, black, starry, sunny night.⁠ ⁠… As if one had become deaf, one still saw that the pipes were roaring, but one only saw, dead silence all about. The sun was mute. It was natural, of course. One might have expected it; we were beyond the terrestrial atmosphere. The transition was so quick, so sudden that everyone became timid and silent. Yet I⁠ ⁠… I thought I felt even easier under that fantastic, mute sun. I had bounded over the inevitable border, having left my body somewhere there below, and I was soaring bodiless to a new world, where everything was to be different, upside down.
paras.uz: G'amgin, chidab bo'lmas darajada yorqin, qora, yulduzli, quyoshli tun... Go'yo kar bo'lib qolgandek, quvurlar gumburlayotganini hali ham ko'rardingiz, lekin faqat ko'rardingiz, atrofda o'lik sukunat. Quyosh soqov edi. Bu, albatta, tabiiy edi. Buni kutish mumkin edi; biz yer atmosferasidan tashqarida edik. O'tish shunchalik tez, shunchalik to'satdan bo'ldiki, hamma tortinchoq va jim bo'lib qoldi. Lekin men... men o'sha fantastik, soqov quyosh ostida hatto o'zimni yengilroq his qilgandek bo'ldim. Men muqarrar chegaradan sakrab o'tgandim, tanamni qayerdadir u yerda, pastda qoldirib, hamma narsa boshqacha, teskari bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan yangi dunyoga tanasiz parvoz qilardim.

paras.en: “Keep the same course!” I shouted into the engine-room, or perhaps it was not I but a phonograph in me, and the same machine with a mechanical, hinge-like movement handed the commander’s trumpet to the Second Builder. All permeated by that most delicate, molecular quiver known only to me, I ran down the companionway, to seek.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: «Kursni saqlang!» — qichqirdim mashina bo'limiga, yoki balki bu men emas, ichimdagi fonograf edi va o'sha mashina mexanik, sharnirdek harakat bilan komandir ruporini Ikkinchi Quruvchiga uzatdi. Faqat menga ma'lum bo'lgan o'sha eng nozik, molekulyar titrashga butunlay singib, trap bo'ylab pastga yugurdim, izlash uchun...

paras.en: The door of the saloon.⁠ ⁠… An hour later it was to latch and lock itself.⁠ ⁠… At the door stood an unfamiliar Number. He was small, with a face like a hundred or a thousand others which are usually lost in a crowd, but his arms were exceptionally long⁠—they reached down to the knees as though by mistake they had been taken from another set of human organs and fastened to his shoulders.
paras.uz: Salon eshigi... Bir soatdan keyin u yopilib, qulflanishi kerak edi... Eshik oldida notanish bir Raqam turardi. U kichkina edi, yuzi odatda olomonda yo'qolib ketadigan yuzta yoki mingta boshqa yuzga o'xshardi, lekin uning qo'llari g'ayrioddiy uzun edi — ular tizzalarigacha yetardi, go'yo ular xato bilan boshqa inson a'zolari to'plamidan olinib, yelkalariga mahkamlangandek.

paras.en: The long arm stretched out and barred the way.
paras.uz: Uzun qo'l cho'zilib, yo'lni to'sdi.

paras.en: “Where do you want to go?”
paras.uz: «Qayerga bormoqchisiz?»

paras.en: It was clear that he was not aware I knew everything. All right! Perhaps it was necessary that it should be so. From above him, in a deliberately significant tone I said:
paras.uz: Aniq ediki, u men hamma narsani bilishimdan bexabar edi. Mayli! Balki shunday bo'lishi kerakdir. Uning tepasidan, qasddan ma'noli ohangda dedim:

paras.en: “I am the Builder of the Integral and I am directing the test flight. Do you understand?”
paras.uz: «Men Integral Quruvchisiman va sinov parvozini boshqaryapman. Tushunyapsizmi?»

paras.en: The arm drew away.
paras.uz: Qo'l chekindi.

paras.en: The saloon. Heads covered with bristles, gray iron bristles, and yellow heads, and bald, ripe heads were bent over the instruments and maps. Swiftly, with a glance, I gathered them in with my eyes, off I ran, back along the long passage, then through the hatch into the engine-room. There it was hot from the red tubes, overheated by the explosions; a constant roar⁠—the levers were dancing their desperate drunken dance, quivering ceaselessly with a barely noticeable quiver; the arrows on the dials.⁠ ⁠… There! At last! Near the tachometer, a notebook in his hand, was that man with the low forehead.
paras.uz: Salon. Cho'tkadek tuklar, kulrang temir tuklar bilan qoplangan boshlar, sariq boshlar va taqir, pishgan boshlar asboblar va xaritalar ustiga egilgan edi. Tez, bir nigoh bilan ularni ko'zlarim bilan yig'ib oldim, yugurib ketdim, uzun yo'lak bo'ylab orqaga, keyin lyuk orqali mashina bo'limiga. U yerda portlashlardan qizib ketgan qizil quvurlardan issiq edi; doimiy gumburlash — richaglar o'zlarining umidsiz mast raqsini o'ynardi, zo'rg'a seziladigan titroq bilan to'xtovsiz titrardi; siferblatlardagi millar... Mana! Nihoyat! Taxometr yonida, qo'lida daftarcha bilan o'sha past peshonali odam turardi.

paras.en: “Listen,” I shouted straight into his ear (because of the roar), “Is she here? Where is she?”
paras.uz: «Quloq soling, — qichqirdim to'g'ri uning qulog'iga (gumburlash tufayli). — U shu yerdami? U qayerda?»

paras.en: “She? There at the radio.”
paras.uz: «Umi? U yerda, radioda».

paras.en: I dashed over there. There were three of them, all with receiving helmets on. And she seemed a head taller than usual, wingy, sparkling, flying like an ancient walkyrie, and those bluish sparks from the radio seemed to emanate from her⁠—from her also that ethereal, lightning-like odor of ozone.
paras.uz: Men u yerga otildim. Ular uchta edi, hammasi qabul qiluvchi shlemlarda. U esa odatdagidan bir bosh balandroq, qanotli, uchqunlanuvchi, qadimiy valkiriyadek uchayotgandek ko'rinardi va radiodan chiqayotgan o'sha ko'kimtir uchqunlar undan taralayotgandek tuyulardi — undan o'sha efirdek, chaqmoqdek ozon hidi ham.

paras.en: “Someone⁠—well, you for instance,” I said to her, panting from having run, “I must send a message down to earth, to the docks. Come, I shall dictate it to you.”
paras.uz: «Kimdir — xo'sh, masalan, siz, — dedim unga, yugurganimdan hansirab, — men yerga, stapelga xabar yuborishim kerak. Yuring, sizga aytib turaman».

paras.en: Close to the apparatus there was a small boxlike cabin. We sat at the table side by side. I found her hand and pressed it hard.
paras.uz: Apparat yonida kichkina qutichadek kabina bor edi. Biz stol yonida yonma-yon o'tirdik. Uning qo'lini topib, qattiq siqdim.

paras.en: “Well, what is going to happen?”
paras.uz: «Xo'sh, nima bo'ladi?»

paras.en: “I don’t know. Do you realize how wonderful it is? To fly without knowing where⁠ ⁠… no matter where? It will soon be twelve o’clock and nobody knows what.⁠ ⁠… And when night.⁠ ⁠… Where shall you and I be tonight? Perhaps somewhere on the grass, on dry leaves.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Bilmayman. Bu qanchalik ajoyib ekanini anglayapsizmi? Qayerga ekanini bilmay uchish... qayerga bo'lsa ham? Tez orada soat o'n ikki bo'ladi va hech kim nima... bilmaydi... Va tun... Bugun kechasi siz va men qayerda bo'lamiz? Balki qayerdadir o't ustida, quruq barglar ustida...»

paras.en: Blue sparks emanated from her and the odor of lightning, and the vibration became more and more frequent within me.
paras.uz: Undan moviy uchqunlar va chaqmoq hidi taralardi va ichimdagi tebranish tobora tezlashardi.

paras.en: “Write down,” I said loudly, panting (from having run), “Time: eleven-twenty; speed 5800.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Yozing, — dedim baland ovozda, hansirab (yugurganimdan), — Vaqt: o'n bir yigirma; tezlik 5800...»

paras.en: “Last night she came to me with your note. I know⁠ ⁠… I know everything; don’t talk.⁠ ⁠… But the child is yours. I sent her over; she is already beyond the Wall. She will live.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Kecha kechqurun u sizning yozuvingiz bilan oldimga keldi. Bilaman... hamma narsani bilaman; gapirmang... Lekin bola sizniki. Men uni jo'natib yubordim; u allaqachon Devor ortida. U yashaydi...»

paras.en: I was back on the commander’s bridge, back in the delirious night with its black, starry sky and its dazzling sun. The hands of the clock on the table were slowly moving from minute to minute. Everything was permeated by a thin, hardly perceptible quivering (only I noticed it). For some reason a thought passed through my head: it would be better if all this took place not here but somewhere below, nearer to earth.
paras.uz: Men yana komandir ko'prigida edim, qora, yulduzli osmoni va ko'zni qamashtiruvchi quyoshi bilan yana alahsirash tunida. Stol ustidagi soat millari daqiqadan daqiqaga sekin siljirdi. Hamma narsa ingichka, zo'rg'a seziladigan titrash bilan sug'orilgan edi (buni faqat men payqardim). Negadir xayolimdan bir fikr o'tdi: bularning hammasi bu yerda emas, qayerdadir pastda, yerga yaqinroqda sodir bo'lsa yaxshiroq bo'lardi.

paras.en: “Stop!” I commanded.
paras.uz: «To'xta!» — buyurdim men.

paras.en: We kept moving by inertia, but more and more slowly. Now the Integral was caught for a second by an imperceptible little hair⁠—for a second it hung motionless, then the little hair broke and the Integral like a stone dashed downward with increasing speed. That way in silence, minutes, tens of minutes passed. My pulse was audible; the hand of the clock before my eyes came closer and closer to twelve. It was clear to me I was a stone; I-330 the earth; and the stone was under irresistible compulsion to fall downward, to strike the earth and break into small particles. What if⁠ ⁠… ? Already the hard blue smoke of the clouds appeared below.⁠ ⁠… What if⁠ ⁠… ? But the phonograph within me with a hinge-like motion and precision took the telephone and commanded: “Low speed!” The stone ceased falling. Only the four lower tubes were growling, two ahead and two aft, only enough to hold the Integral motionless, and the Integral, only slightly trembling, stopped in the air as if anchored, about one kilometer from the earth.
paras.uz: Biz inersiya bilan harakatlanishda davom etdik, lekin tobora sekinroq. Mana Integral bir soniyaga sezilmas kichkina tukka ilinib qoldi — bir soniyaga qimirlamay osilib turdi, keyin kichkina tuk uzildi va Integral toshdek ortib borayotgan tezlik bilan pastga otildi. Shu tariqa jimgina daqiqalar, o'n daqiqalar o'tdi. Pulsim eshitilardi; ko'zlarim oldidagi soat mili o'n ikkiga tobora yaqinlashardi. Menga aniq edi, men tosh edim; I-330 — yer; va tosh pastga tushishga, yerga urilishga va mayda zarrachalarga bo'linishga qarshi turib bo'lmas majburiyat ostida edi. Agar...? Pastda allaqachon bulutlarning qattiq moviy tutuni paydo bo'ldi... Agar...? Lekin ichimdagi fonograf sharnirdek harakat va aniqlik bilan telefonni olib, buyurdi: «Kichik tezlik!» Tosh tushishdan to'xtadi. Faqat to'rtta pastki quvur g'uvillardi, ikkitasi oldinda va ikkitasi orqada, Integralni qimirlatmay ushlab turishga yetarlicha, xolos, va Integral, faqat biroz titrab, yerdan taxminan bir kilometr balandlikda go'yo langar tashlagandek havoda to'xtadi.

paras.en: Everybody came out on deck, (it was shortly before twelve, before the sounding of the dinner-gong) and leaned over the glass railing; hastily, in huge gulps, they swallowed the unknown world which lay below, beyond the Green Wall. Amber, blue, green, the autumnal woods, prairies, a lake. At the edge of a little blue saucer, some lone yellow debris, a threatening, dried-out yellow finger⁠—it must have been the tower of an ancient “church” saved by a miracle.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Hamma palubaga chiqdi (o'n ikkiga oz qolgan edi, tushlik gongi chalinishidan oldin) va shisha panjaraga engashdi; shoshilib, katta qultumlar bilan pastda, Yashil Devor ortida yotgan noma'lum dunyoni yutishardi. Qahrabo, moviy, yashil, kuzgi o'rmonlar, dashtlar, ko'l. Kichkina moviy likopcha chetida qandaydir yolg'iz sariq vayrona, tahdidli, qurigan sariq barmoq — bu mo''jiza bilan saqlanib qolgan qadimiy «cherkov» minorasi bo'lsa kerak...

paras.en: “Look, there! Look! There to the right!”
paras.uz: «Qarang, u yerda! Qarang! U yerda, o'ngda!»

paras.en: There (over the green desert) a brown blot was rapidly moving. I held a telescope in my hands and automatically I brought it to my eyes: the grass reaching their chests, a herd of brown horses was galloping, and on their back⁠—they, black, white, and dark.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U yerda (yashil cho'l ustida) jigarrang dog' tez harakatlanardi. Qo'limda teleskop bor edi va avtomatik ravishda uni ko'zlarimga olib keldim: ko'kraklarigacha yetadigan o't, jigarrang otlar podasi chopib borardi va ularning ustida — ular, qora, oq va qoramtir...

paras.en: Behind me:
paras.uz: Orqamda:

paras.en: “I assure you, I saw a face!”
paras.uz: «Ishontirib aytaman, men yuzni ko'rdim!»

paras.en: “Go away! Tell it to someone else!”
paras.uz: «Qo'ying! Buni boshqa birovga aytib bering!»

paras.en: “Well, look for yourself! Here is the telescope.”
paras.uz: «Xo'sh, o'zingiz qarang! Mana teleskop».

paras.en: They had already disappeared. Endless green desert, and in that desert, dominating it completely and dominating me, and everybody⁠—the piercing vibrations of the gong; dinner time, one minute to twelve.
paras.uz: Ular allaqachon g'oyib bo'lishgan edi. Cheksiz yashil cho'l va o'sha cho'lda, uni butunlay egallab, meni va hammani egallab — gongning teshib o'tuvchi tebranishlari; tushlik vaqti, o'n ikkiga bir daqiqa.

paras.en: For a second the little world around me became incoherent, dispersed. Someone’s brass badge fell to the floor. It mattered little. Soon it was under my heel. A voice: “And I tell you, it was a face!” A black square, the open door of the main saloon. White teeth pressed together, smiling.⁠ ⁠… And at that moment, when the clock began slowly, holding its breath between beats, to strike, and when the front rows began to move towards the dining saloon, the rectangle of the door was suddenly crossed by the two familiar, unnaturally long arms:
paras.uz: Bir soniyaga atrofimdagi kichkina dunyo bog'liqsiz, tarqoq bo'lib qoldi. Kimningdir mis nishoni polga tushib ketdi. Buning ahamiyati kam edi. Tez orada u mening tovonim ostida edi. Ovoz: «Men sizga aytyapman, bu yuz edi!» Qora to'rtburchak, asosiy salonning ochiq eshigi. Bir-biriga qisilgan, jilmayayotgan oq tishlar... Va o'sha lahzada, soat zarbalar orasida nafasini ichiga yutib, sekin bong ura boshlaganda va oldingi qatorlar ovqatxona saloni tomon harakatlana boshlaganda, eshikning to'g'ri to'rtburchagini to'satdan ikkita tanish, g'ayritabiiy uzun qo'l kesib o'tdi:

paras.en: “Stop!”
paras.uz: «To'xtang!»

paras.en: Someone’s fingers sank piercing into my palm. It was I-330. She was beside me.
paras.uz: Kimningdir barmoqlari kaftimga teshib kirdi. Bu I-330 edi. U yonimda edi.

paras.en: “Who is it, do you know him?”
paras.uz: «Kim u, uni taniysizmi?»

paras.en: “Is he not⁠ ⁠… is he not?⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «U emasmi... u emasmi?..»

paras.en: He was already lifted upon somebody’s shoulders. Above a hundred other faces, his face like hundreds, like thousands of other faces yet unique among the rest.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U allaqachon kimningdir yelkalariga ko'tarilgan edi. Yuzta boshqa yuz ustida, uning yuzi yuzlab, minglab boshqa yuzlarga o'xshash, lekin qolganlar orasida yagona...

paras.en: “In the name of the Guardians! You, to whom I talk, they hear me, every one of them hears me⁠—I talk to you: we know! We don’t know your numbers yet but we know everything else. The Integral shall not be yours! The test flight will be carried out to the end and you yourselves, you will not dare to make another move! You with your own hands will help to go on with the test and afterward⁠ ⁠… well, I have finished!”
paras.uz: «Qo'riqchilar nomi bilan! Siz, men gapirayotganlar, ular meni eshitadi, ularning har biri meni eshitadi — men sizga gapiryapman: biz bilamiz! Biz hali raqamlaringizni bilmaymiz, lekin qolgan hamma narsani bilamiz. Integral sizniki bo'lmaydi! Sinov parvozi oxirigacha o'tkaziladi va sizlar o'zingiz boshqa bironta harakat qilishga jur'at etmaysiz! Sizlar o'z qo'llaringiz bilan sinovni davom ettirishga yordam berasiz, keyin esa... xo'sh, men tugatdim!»

paras.en: Silence. The glass plates under my feet seemed soft, cotton-like. My feet too⁠—soft, cotton-like. Beside me⁠—she with a dead-white smile, angry blue sparks. Through her teeth to me:
paras.uz: Sukunat. Oyoqlarim ostidagi shisha plitalar yumshoq, paxtadek tuyuldi. Oyoqlarim ham — yumshoq, paxtadek. Yonimda — u, o'likdek oq tabassum, g'azabli moviy uchqunlar. Tishlari orasidan menga:

paras.en: “Ah! It is your work! You did your ‘duty’! Well.⁠ ⁠…” She tore her hand from mine; the walkyrie helmet with indignant wings was soon to be seen some distance in front of me. I was alone, torpid, silent. Like everyone else I followed into the dining saloon.
paras.uz: «Ah! Bu sizning ishingiz! Siz o'z "burchingiz"ni bajardingiz! Xo'sh...» U qo'lini mening qo'limdan yulib oldi; g'azablangan qanotli valkiriya shlemi tez orada oldimda bir oz masofada ko'rindi. Men yolg'iz, karaxt, jim qoldim. Hamma qatori ovqatxona saloniga ergashdim.

paras.en: But it was not I, not I! I told nobody, save these white, mute pages.⁠ ⁠… I cried this to her within me, inaudibly, desperately, loudly. She was across the table, directly opposite me and not once did she even touch me with her gaze. Beside her, someone’s ripe, yellow, bald head. I heard (it was I-330’s voice):
paras.uz: Lekin bu men emas edim, men emas! Men hech kimga aytmagandim, bu oq, soqov sahifalardan boshqa... Men buni unga ichimda, eshitilmas, umidsiz, baland qichqirdim. U stol ortida, to'g'ri ro'paramda edi va bir marta ham nigohi bilan menga tegmadi. Uning yonida kimningdir pishgan, sariq, taqir boshi. Men eshitdim (bu I-330 ning ovozi edi):

paras.en: “ ‘Nobility’ of character! But my dear professor, even a superficial etymological analysis of the word shows that it is a superstition, a remnant of the ancient feudal epoch. We.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Xarakterning "olijanobligi"! Lekin aziz professorim, bu so'zning hatto yuzaki etimologik tahlili ham uning xurofot, qadimiy feodal davrning qoldig'i ekanini ko'rsatadi. Biz esa...»

paras.en: I felt I was growing pale⁠—and that they would soon notice it. But the phonograph within me performed the prescribed fifty chewing movements for every bite. I locked myself into myself as though into an opaque house; I threw up a heap of rocks before my door and lowered the window-blinds.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Rangim oqarib borayotganini — va ular buni tez orada payqashini his qildim. Lekin ichimdagi fonograf har bir luqma uchun belgilangan ellikta chaynash harakatini bajardi. Men o'zimni o'zimga, go'yo shaffof bo'lmagan uyga qamab oldim; eshigim oldiga toshlar uyumini uyib, deraza pardalarini tushirdim...

paras.en: Afterward, again the telephone of the commander was in my hands and again we made the flight with icy, supreme anxiety through the clouds into the icy, starry, sunny night. Minutes, hours passed.⁠ ⁠… Apparently all that time the logical motor within me was working feverishly at full speed. For suddenly somewhere at a distant point of the dark blue space I saw my desk, and the gill-like cheeks of U- over it and the forgotten pages of my records! It became clear to me; nobody but she⁠ ⁠… everything was clear to me!
paras.uz: Keyin yana komandir telefoni qo'llarimda edi va yana biz muzdek, oliy xavotir bilan bulutlar orqali muzdek, yulduzli, quyoshli tunga parvoz qildik. Daqiqalar, soatlar o'tdi... Aftidan, shu vaqt davomida ichimdagi mantiqiy motor to'liq tezlikda isitmadek ishlagan. Chunki to'satdan qorong'i moviy fazoning qayerdadir uzoq nuqtasida stolimni, uning ustida Yu- ning jabrasimon yonoqlarini va qaydlarimning unutilgan sahifalarini ko'rdim! Menga ayon bo'ldi; undan boshqa hech kim... hamma narsa menga ayon bo'ldi!

paras.en: If only I could reach the radio-room soon⁠ ⁠… winglike helmets, the odor of blue lightnings⁠ ⁠… I remember telling her something in a low voice and I remember how she looked through me and how her voice seemed to come from a distance:
paras.uz: Qaniydi radio xonasiga tezroq yetib borsam... qanotdek shlemlar, moviy chaqmoqlar hidi... Esimda, unga past ovozda nimadir dedim va esimda, u men orqali qanday qaradi va uning ovozi go'yo uzoqdan kelayotgandek tuyuldi:

paras.en: “I am busy. I am receiving a message from below. You may dictate yours to her.”
paras.uz: «Men bandman. Pastdan xabar qabul qilyapman. O'zingiznikini unga aytib yozdiring».

paras.en: The small, boxlike little cabin.⁠ ⁠… I thought for a second and then dictated in a firm voice:
paras.uz: Kichkina, qutichadek kabina... Bir soniya o'ylab, keyin qat'iy ovozda aytib yozdirdim:

paras.en: “Time 14:40. Going down. Motors stopped. The end of all.”
paras.uz: «Vaqt 14:40. Pastga tushyapmiz. Motorlar to'xtatildi. Hamma narsaning oxiri».

paras.en: The commander’s bridge. The machine-heart of the Integral stopped; we were falling; my heart could not catch up and would remain behind and rise higher and higher into my throat.⁠ ⁠… Clouds.⁠ ⁠… And then a distant green spot⁠—everything green, more and more distinct, running like a storm towards us. “Soon the end.”
paras.uz: Komandir ko'prigi. Integralning mashina-yuragi to'xtadi; biz tushib borardik; yuragim yetib ulgurmay, orqada qolib, tomog'imga tobora yuqoriroq ko'tarilardi... Bulutlar... Keyin uzoqda yashil dog' — hamma narsa yashil, tobora aniqroq, bo'rondek bizga qarab yugurib kelardi. «Tez orada oxiri».

paras.en: The porcelain-like white distorted face of the Second Builder! It was he who struck me with all his strength; I hurt my head on something; and through the approaching darkness while falling I heard:
paras.uz: Ikkinchi Quruvchining chinnidek oq, buzilgan yuzi! Bu u edi, meni butun kuchi bilan urgan; boshimni nimagadir urib oldim; va yaqinlashib kelayotgan zulmat orqali yiqilayotib eshitdim:

paras.en: “Full speed⁠—aft!”
paras.uz: «To'liq tezlik — orqaga!»

paras.en: A brusque jolt upward.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Keskin turtki yuqoriga...

gloss.ex: …ed a head taller than usual, wingy, sparkling, flying like an ancient walkyrie, and those bluish sparks from the radio seemed to emanate from her⁠—from her also…
…he United State. They reminded me of the tragic figures of “The Three Forgiven Ones”⁠—a story known to all of our schoolchildren. It tells about three Numbers,…
…was there. But I had no time.⁠ ⁠… They were calling me: quick! To the commander’s bridge; time to go⁠ ⁠… where?
“Ah! It is your work! You did your ‘duty’! Well.⁠ ⁠…” She tore her hand from mine; the walkyrie helmet with indignant wings wa…
We kept moving by inertia, but more and more slowly. Now the Integral was caught for a second by an impercep…

quiz.q: Who told the Guardians about the plan?
quiz.why_uz: D-503 keyin Yu- uning qaydlarini o'qiganini anglaydi.

quiz.q: What does D-503 try to do at the end?
quiz.why_uz: U motorlarni to'xtatib, Integralni yerga yo'naltiradi.

chapters.recap_uz: Integral uchadi, lekin Qo'riqchilar reja haqida bilib qoladi. I-330 D-503 ni xoin deb o'ylaydi. D-503 Integralni yerga urib halok qilmoqchi bo'ladi, Ikkinchi Quruvchi to'xtatadi.

chapters.title: In a ring — A carrot — A murder

paras.en: I did not sleep all night. The whole night but one thought.⁠ ⁠… As a result of yesterday’s mishap my head is tightly bandaged⁠—it seems to me not a bandage but a ring, a pitiless ring of glass-iron, riveted about my head. And I am busy with the same thought, always the same thought in my riveted circle: to kill U-. To kill U- and then go to her and say: “Now do you believe?” What is most disquieting is that to kill is dirty, primitive. To break her head with something⁠—the thought of it gives me a peculiar sensation of something disgustingly sweet in my mouth, and I am unable to swallow my saliva; I am always spitting into my handkerchief, yet my mouth feels dry.
paras.uz: Tun bo'yi uxlamadim. Butun tun faqat bitta fikr... Kechagi baxtsiz hodisa natijasida boshim mahkam bog'langan — menga bu bint emas, halqa, boshim atrofiga parchinlangan shisha-temirdan yasalgan shafqatsiz halqa bo'lib tuyuladi. Va men parchinlangan doiramda bir xil fikr, doimo bir xil fikr bilan bandman: Yu- ni o'ldirish. Yu- ni o'ldirib, keyin uning oldiga borib: «Endi ishonasizmi?» deyish. Eng bezovta qiladigani shuki, o'ldirish — iflos, ibtidoiy. Uning boshini biror narsa bilan yorish — bu fikr og'zimda qandaydir jirkanch shirin narsa bordek g'alati tuyg'u beradi va so'lagimni yuta olmayman; doimo ro'molchamga tupuraman, lekin og'zim quruq.

paras.en: I had in my closet a heavy piston-rod which cracked during the casting and which I brought home in order to find out the cause of the cracking with a microscope. I made my manuscript into a tube (let her read me to the last letter!), pushed the broken piston into that tube and went downstairs. The stairway seemed endless, the steps disgustingly slippery, liquid. I had to wipe off moisture from my mouth very frequently. Downstairs⁠ ⁠… my heart dropped. I took out the piston and went to the controller’s table, but she was not there; instead an empty, icy desk with inkblots. I remembered that today all work was stopped; everybody was to go to be operated upon. Hence there was no need for her to stay here. There was nobody to be registered.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Javonimda quyish paytida yorilib ketgan og'ir porshen shtogi bor edi, men uni yorilish sababini mikroskop bilan aniqlash uchun uyga olib kelgandim. Qo'lyozmamni naycha qilib o'radim (mayli, u meni oxirgi harfigacha o'qisin!), singan porshenni o'sha naychaga tiqib, pastga tushdim. Zinapoya cheksizdek, zinalar jirkanch sirpanchiq, suyuq tuyulardi. Og'zimdagi namlikni juda tez-tez artishga to'g'ri kelardi. Pastda... yuragim tushib ketdi. Porshenni chiqarib, nazoratchi stoliga bordim, lekin u yo'q edi; o'rniga siyoh dog'li bo'sh, muzdek stol. Bugun barcha ishlar to'xtatilganini esladim; hamma operatsiyaga borishi kerak edi. Demak, uning bu yerda qolishiga hojat yo'q edi. Ro'yxatga oladigan hech kim yo'q edi...

paras.en: The street. It was windy. The sky seemed to be composed of soaring panels of cast-iron. And exactly as it seemed for one moment yesterday, the whole world was broken up into separate, sharp, independent fragments, and each of these fragments was falling at full speed; each would stop for a second, hang before me in the air and disappear without trace. It was as if the black, precise letters on this page should suddenly move apart and begin to jump hither and thither in fright, so that there was not a word on the page, only nonsensical “ap,” “jum,” “wor.” The crowd seemed just as nonsensical, dispersed (not in rows), going forward, backward, diagonally, transversely.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Ko'cha. Shamolli edi. Osmon uchayotgan cho'yan panellardan iboratdek tuyulardi. Va xuddi kecha bir lahzaga tuyulgandek, butun dunyo alohida, o'tkir, mustaqil parchalarga bo'lingan edi va bu parchalarning har biri to'liq tezlikda tushardi; har biri bir soniyaga to'xtab, oldimda havoda osilib turardi va izsiz g'oyib bo'lardi. Go'yo bu sahifadagi qora, aniq harflar to'satdan bir-biridan ajralib, qo'rquvdan u yoqqa-bu yoqqa sakray boshlagandek, toki sahifada bironta so'z qolmay, faqat ma'nosiz «sak», «qo'r», «so'» qolgandek. Olomon ham xuddi shunday ma'nosiz, tarqoq (qatorlarda emas), oldinga, orqaga, diagonal, ko'ndalang harakatlanardi...

paras.en: Then nobody. For a second while I was dashing at full speed, suddenly stopping, I saw on the second floor in the glass cage hanging in the air⁠—a man and a woman⁠—a kiss; she standing with her whole body bent backward brokenly: “This is for the last time, forever.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Keyin hech kim. Bir soniyaga, to'liq tezlikda yugurib ketayotib, to'satdan to'xtab, ikkinchi qavatda havoda osilib turgan shisha qafasda ko'rdim — erkak va ayol — o'pich; ayol butun tanasi bilan singandek orqaga egilib turibdi: «Bu oxirgi marta, abadiy...»

paras.en: At a corner a thorny, moving bush of heads. Above the heads, separate, floating in the air, a banner: “Down with the machines! Down with the Operation!” And (distinct from my own self) I thought: “Is it possible that each one of us bears such a pain, that it can be removed only with his heart.⁠ ⁠… That something must be done to each one, before he.⁠ ⁠…” For a second everything disappeared for me from the world, except my beast-like hand with the heavy cast-iron package it held.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Muyulishda boshlarning tikanli, qimirlayotgan butasi. Boshlar ustida, alohida, havoda suzib, bayroq: «Mashinalar yo'qolsin! Operatsiya yo'qolsin!» Va men (o'zimdan alohida) o'yladim: «Nahotki har birimiz shunday og'riqni ko'tarib yursak, uni faqat yuragi bilan birga olib tashlash mumkin... Har biriga nimadir qilish kerak, u ... dan oldin...» Bir soniyaga dunyodan men uchun hamma narsa g'oyib bo'ldi, qo'limdagi og'ir cho'yan tugunni ushlab turgan hayvonnamo qo'limdan boshqa...

paras.en: A boy appeared. He was running, a shadow under his lower lip. The lower lip turned out like the cuff of a rolled-up sleeve. His face was distorted; he wept loudly; he was running away from somebody. Stamping of feet was heard behind him.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Bir bola paydo bo'ldi. U yugurardi, pastki labi ostida soya. Pastki labi shimarilgan yengning manjetidek qayrilgan edi. Yuzi buzilgan; u baland ovozda yig'lardi; u kimdandir qochib ketayotgan edi. Uning orqasidan oyoqlarning tepishi eshitilardi...

paras.en: The boy reminded me: “U- must be in school. I must hurry!” I ran to the nearest opening of the Underground Railway. At the entrance someone passed me and said, “Not running. No trains today⁠ ⁠… there!” I descended. A sort of general delirium was reigning. The glitter of cut-crystal suns; the platform packed closely with heads. An empty, torpid train.
paras.uz: Bola menga eslatdi: «Yu- maktabda bo'lsa kerak. Shoshilishim kerak!» Yer osti temir yo'lining eng yaqin kirish joyiga yugurdim. Kirish joyida kimdir yonimdan o'tib, dedi: «Qatnamayapti. Bugun poyezdlar yo'q... u yerda!» Men pastga tushdim. Qandaydir umumiy alahsirash hukm surardi. Qirrali billur quyoshlarning yaltirashi; boshlar bilan zich to'lgan platforma. Bo'sh, karaxt poyezd.

paras.en: In the silence⁠—a voice. I could not see her but I knew, I knew that intense, living, flexible, whip-like, flogging voice! I felt there that sharp triangle of brows drawn to the temples.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Sukunatda — ovoz. Men uni ko'ra olmasdim, lekin bilardim, men o'sha tarang, tirik, egiluvchan, qamchidek, savalovchi ovozni bilardim! U yerda chakkalarga tortilgan qoshlarning o'sha o'tkir uchburchagini his qildim...

paras.en: “Let me! Let me reach her! I must!⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Qo'yib yuboring! Unga yetib olishimga qo'yib yuboring! Men kerak!..»

paras.en: Someone’s tentacles caught my arm, my shoulders. I was nailed. In the silence I heard:
paras.uz: Kimningdir paypaslagichlari qo'limni, yelkalarimni ushlab oldi. Men mixlanib qoldim. Sukunatda eshitdim:

paras.en: “No. Go up to them. There they will cure you; there they will overfeed you with that leavened happiness. Satiated, you will slumber peacefully, organized, keeping time and snoring sweetly. Is it possible that you do not yet hear that great symphony of snoring? Foolish people! Don’t you realize that they want to liberate you from these gnawing, worm-like, torturing question marks? And you remain standing here and listening to me? Quick! Up! To the Great Operation! What is your concern, if I remain here alone? What does it matter to you if I want to struggle, hopelessly struggle? So much the better! What does it matter to you that I do not want others to desire for me? I want to desire for myself. If I desire the impossible.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Yo'q. Ularning oldiga, yuqoriga boringlar. U yerda sizlarni davolashadi; u yerda sizlarni o'sha achitilgan baxt bilan to'yintirib boqishadi. To'yib, sizlar xotirjam, uyushgan holda, taktni saqlab va shirin xurrak otib mudraysizlar. Nahotki sizlar hali o'sha buyuk xurrak simfoniyasini eshitmayotgan bo'lsangiz? Ahmoq odamlar! Ular sizlarni bu kemiruvchi, qurtdek, qiynoqli so'roq belgilaridan ozod qilmoqchi ekanini anglamayapsizlarmi? Sizlar esa shu yerda turib, menga quloq solyapsizlarmi? Tezroq! Yuqoriga! Buyuk Operatsiyaga! Men bu yerda yolg'iz qolsam, sizlarga nima? Men kurashmoqchi bo'lsam, umidsiz kurashmoqchi bo'lsam, sizlarga nima? Shunisi yaxshiroq! Men boshqalar men uchun istashini xohlamasam, sizlarga nima? Men o'zim uchun istashni xohlayman. Agar men imkonsiz narsani istasam...»

paras.en: Another voice, slow, heavy:
paras.uz: Boshqa ovoz, sekin, og'ir:

paras.en: “Ah, the impossible! Which means to run after your stupid fancies; those fancies would whirl from under your very noses like a tail. No, we shall catch that tail, and then.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Ah, imkonsiz narsa! Ya'ni ahmoqona fantaziyalaringiz ortidan yugurish; o'sha fantaziyalar burningiz ostidan dumdek aylanib qochib ketaveradi. Yo'q, biz o'sha dumni ushlab olamiz, keyin esa...»

paras.en: “And then⁠—swallow it and fall snoring; a new tail will become necessary. They say the ancients had a certain animal which they called ‘Ass.’ In order to make it go forward they would attach a carrot to a bow held in front of its nose, so that it could not reach it.⁠ ⁠… If it had caught and swallowed it.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Keyin esa — uni yutib, xurrak otib yiqilasiz; yangi dum kerak bo'lib qoladi. Aytishlaricha, qadimgilarda "Eshak" deb ataladigan qandaydir hayvon bo'lgan ekan. Uni oldinga yurishga majbur qilish uchun ular burni oldida ushlab turilgan yoyga sabzi bog'lashgan, toki u unga yeta olmasin... Agar u uni ushlab, yutib yuborganida...»

paras.en: The tentacles suddenly let me go; I threw myself towards the place she was speaking from; but at that very moment everything was brought to confusion. Shouts from behind: “They are coming here! Coming here!” The lights twinkled and went out⁠—someone cut the cable⁠—and everything was like a lava of cries, groaning, heads, fingers.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Paypaslagichlar to'satdan meni qo'yib yubordi; men u gapirayotgan joyga o'zimni otdim; lekin aynan o'sha lahzada hamma narsa sarosimaga tushdi. Orqadan qichqiriqlar: «Ular bu yerga kelishyapti! Bu yerga kelishyapti!» Chiroqlar miltillab, o'chdi — kimdir kabelni kesdi — va hamma narsa qichqiriqlar, ingrashlar, boshlar, barmoqlardan iborat lavaga o'xshab qoldi...

paras.en: I do not know how long we were rolled about that way in the underground tube. I only remember that steps were felt, dusk appeared, becoming brighter and brighter, and again we were in the street, dispersing fan-wise in different directions.
paras.uz: Yer osti quvurida qancha vaqt shu tariqa dumalab yurganimizni bilmayman. Faqat zinapoyalar sezilganini, g'ira-shira yorug'lik paydo bo'lib, tobora yorishib borganini va biz yana ko'chada, turli tomonlarga yelpig'ichdek tarqalib ketayotganimizni eslayman.

paras.en: Again I was alone. Wind. Gray, low twilight crawling over my head. In the damp glass of the sidewalk, somewhere very deep, there were light topsy-turvy walls and figures moving along, feet upward. And that terribly heavy package in my hands pulled me down into that depth to the bottom.
paras.uz: Yana yolg'iz qoldim. Shamol. Boshim ustida o'rmalab borayotgan kulrang, past g'ira-shiralik. Trotuarning nam shishasida, qayerdadir juda chuqurda, yorug' teskari devorlar va oyoqlari yuqoriga qaragan holda harakatlanayotgan qiyofalar bor edi. Qo'llarimdagi o'sha dahshatli og'ir tugun esa meni o'sha chuqurlikka, tubga tortardi.

paras.en: At the desk again. U- was not yet there; her room was dark and empty. I went up to my room and turned on the light. My temples tightly bound by the iron ring were pulsating. I paced and paced, always in the same circle: my table, the white package on the table, the bed, my table, the white package on the table.⁠ ⁠… In the room to my left the curtains were lowered. To my right: the knotty bald head over a book, the enormous parabolic forehead. Wrinkles on the forehead like a series of yellow, illegible lines. At times our eyes met and then I felt that those lines were about me.
paras.uz: Yana stol oldida. Yu- hali yo'q edi; uning xonasi qorong'i va bo'sh edi. Xonamga chiqib, chiroqni yoqdim. Temir halqa bilan mahkam bog'langan chakkalarim urib turardi. Men yurdim va yurdim, doimo bir xil doirada: stolim, stol ustidagi oq tugun, karavot, stolim, stol ustidagi oq tugun... Chap tomondagi xonada pardalar tushirilgan edi. O'ng tomonda: kitob ustidagi do'mboqli taqir bosh, ulkan parabolik peshona. Peshonadagi ajinlar bir qator sariq, o'qib bo'lmas satrlardek. Ba'zan ko'zlarimiz uchrashardi va shunda o'sha satrlar men haqimda ekanini his qilardim.

paras.en: … It happened at twenty-one o’clock exactly. U- came in on her own initiative. I remember that my breathing was so loud that I could hear it and that I wanted to breathe less noisily but was unable to.
paras.uz: ...Bu aynan yigirma birda sodir bo'ldi. Yu- o'z tashabbusi bilan kirib keldi. Esimda, nafasim shunchalik baland ediki, uni eshita olardim va kamroq shovqin bilan nafas olmoqchi edim, lekin qila olmasdim.

paras.en: She sat down and arranged the fold of her unif on her knees. The pinkish-brown gills were waving.
paras.uz: U o'tirdi va tizzalaridagi yunifa burmasini to'g'riladi. Pushtiroq-jigarrang jabralar tebranardi.

paras.en: “Oh, dear, is it true that you are wounded? I just learned about it, and at once I ran.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Oh, azizim, yaralangansiz degani rostmi? Hozirgina bildim va darhol yugurdim...»

paras.en: The piston was before me on the table. I jumped up, breathing even louder. She heard, and stopped halfway through a word and rose. Already I had located the place on her head; something disgustingly sweet was in my mouth.⁠ ⁠… My handkerchief! I could not find it. I spat on the floor.
paras.uz: Porshen oldimda stol ustida edi. Men sakrab turdim, yanada balandroq nafas olib. U eshitdi va so'zning yarmida to'xtab, o'rnidan turdi. Men allaqachon uning boshidagi joyni belgilab olgandim; og'zimda nimadir jirkanch shirin narsa bor edi... Ro'molcham! Uni topa olmadim. Polga tupurdim.

paras.en: The fellow with the yellow fixed wrinkles which think of me! It was necessary that he should not see. It would be even more disgusting if he could.⁠ ⁠… I pressed the button. (I had no right to do that, but who cared about rights then?) The curtains fell.
paras.uz: Men haqimda o'ylaydigan sariq, qotib qolgan ajinli o'sha odam! U ko'rmasligi kerak edi. Agar u ko'ra olsa, bu yanada jirkanchroq bo'lardi... Tugmani bosdim. (Menga bunday qilishga huquq yo'q edi, lekin o'shanda huquqlar haqida kim qayg'urardi?) Pardalar tushdi.

paras.en: Evidently she felt and understood what was coming for she rushed to the door. But I was quicker than she and I locked the door with the key, breathing loudly and not taking my eyes for a second away from that place on her head.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Aftidan, u nima bo'layotganini his qilib, tushundi, chunki eshik tomon otildi. Lekin men undan tezroq edim va eshikni kalit bilan qulfladim, baland nafas olib va ko'zlarimni bir soniyaga ham uning boshidagi o'sha joydan uzmay...

paras.en: “You⁠ ⁠… you are mad! How dare you.⁠ ⁠…” She moved backward towards the bed, put her trembling hands between her knees.⁠ ⁠… Like a tense spring, holding her firmly with my gaze, I slowly stretched out my arm towards the table (only one arm could move), and I snatched the piston.
paras.uz: «Siz... siz aqldan ozgansiz! Qanday jur'at etasiz...» U karavotga qarab orqaga chekindi, titroq qo'llarini tizzalari orasiga qo'ydi... Tarang prujinadek, uni nigohim bilan mahkam ushlab, sekin qo'limni stolga qarab cho'zdim (faqat bitta qo'lim qimirlay olardi) va porshenni yulqib oldim.

paras.en: “I implore you! One day⁠—only one day! Tomorrow I shall go and attend to the formalities.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Yolvoraman! Bir kun — faqat bir kun! Ertaga borib rasmiyatchiliklarni hal qilaman...»

paras.en: What was she talking about? I swung my arm.⁠ ⁠… And I consider I killed her. Yes, you my unknown readers, you have the right to call me murderer. I know that I should have dealt the blow on her head had she not screamed:
paras.uz: U nima haqida gapirayotgan edi? Men qo'limni silkitdim... Va men uni o'ldirdim deb hisoblayman. Ha, siz, noma'lum o'quvchilarim, meni qotil deb atashga haqqingiz bor. Bilamanki, agar u qichqirmaganida, zarbani uning boshiga tushirgan bo'lardim:

paras.en: “For⁠ ⁠… for the sake⁠ ⁠… I agree.⁠ ⁠… I⁠ ⁠… one moment.⁠ ⁠…” With trembling hands she tore off her unif;⁠—a large, yellow, drooping body, she fell upon the bed.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: «...uchun... ...haqi... Men roziman... Men... bir lahza...» Titroq qo'llari bilan u yunifasini yirtib yechdi; — katta, sariq, osilgan tana, u karavotga yiqildi...

paras.en: Then I understood; she thought that I pulled the curtains⁠ ⁠… in order to⁠ ⁠… that I wanted.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Shunda tushundim; u men pardalarni... uchun tortdim... men istadim... deb o'ylagan edi...

paras.en: This was so unexpected and so stupid that I burst out laughing. Immediately the tense spring within me broke and my hand weakened and the piston fell to the floor.
paras.uz: Bu shunchalik kutilmagan va shunchalik ahmoqona ediki, kulib yubordim. Shu zahoti ichimdagi tarang prujina uzildi va qo'lim bo'shashdi va porshen polga tushib ketdi.

paras.en: Here I learned from personal experience that laughter is the most terrible of weapons; you can kill anything with laughter, even murder. I sat at my table and laughed desperately; I saw no way out of that absurd situation. I don’t know what would have been the end if things had run their natural course, for suddenly a new factor in the arithmetical chain: the telephone rang.
paras.uz: Shu yerda shaxsiy tajribamdan bildimki, kulgi — eng dahshatli qurol; kulgi bilan hamma narsani, hatto qotillikni ham o'ldirish mumkin. Men stolim yonida o'tirib, umidsiz kuldim; bu bema'ni vaziyatdan chiqish yo'lini ko'rmasdim. Agar ishlar tabiiy yo'nalishida davom etganida, oxiri nima bilan tugashini bilmayman, chunki to'satdan arifmetik zanjirda yangi omil paydo bo'ldi: telefon jiringladi.

paras.en: I hurried, grasped the receiver. Perhaps she⁠ ⁠… I heard an unfamiliar voice:
paras.uz: Shoshilib, go'shakni ushladim. Balki u... Notanish ovozni eshitdim:

paras.en: “Wait a minute.”
paras.uz: «Bir daqiqa kuting».
