paras.en: Annoying, infinite buzzing. Heavy steps from afar, nearer and louder like cast-iron, and.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Zerikarli, cheksiz g'uvillash. Uzoqdan og'ir qadamlar, cho'yandek tobora yaqinroq va balandroq, va...

paras.en: “D-503? The Well-Doer speaking. Come at once to me.”
paras.uz: «D-503? Homiy gapiryapti. Darhol oldimga keling».

paras.en: Ding! He hung up the receiver. Ding! like a key in a keyhole.
paras.uz: Ding! U go'shakni qo'ydi. Ding! xuddi qulf teshigidagi kalitdek.

paras.en: U- was still in bed, eyes closed, gills apart in the form of a smile. I picked up her clothes, threw them on her and said through clenched teeth:
paras.uz: Yu- hali ham karavotda, ko'zlari yumuq, jabralari tabassum shaklida ajralgan holda yotardi. Men uning kiyimlarini yig'ib, ustiga tashladim va qisilgan tishlarim orasidan dedim:

paras.en: “Well. Quick! Quick!”
paras.uz: «Xo'sh. Tezroq! Tezroq!»

paras.en: She raised her body on her elbow, her breasts hanging down to one side, eyes round. She became a figure of wax.
paras.uz: U tanasini tirsagiga tirab ko'tardi, ko'kraklari bir tomonga osilgan, ko'zlari dumaloq. U mumdan yasalgan haykalga aylandi.

paras.en: “What?”
paras.uz: «Nima?»

paras.en: “Get dressed, that is what!”
paras.uz: «Kiyining, mana nima!»

paras.en: Face distorted, she firmly snatched her clothes and said in a flat voice, “Turn away.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Yuzi buzilib, u kiyimlarini mahkam yulqib oldi va yassi ovozda dedi: «O'giriling...»

paras.en: I turned away, pressed my forehead against the glass. Light, figures, sparks, were trembling in the black, wet mirror.⁠ ⁠… No, all this was I, myself⁠—within me.⁠ ⁠… What did he call me for? Is it possible that he knows already about her, about me, about everything?
paras.uz: Men o'girilib, peshonamni shishaga bosdim. Qora, nam ko'zguda yorug'lik, qiyofalar, uchqunlar titrardi... Yo'q, bularning hammasi men edim, o'zim — ichimda... U meni nima uchun chaqirdi? Nahotki u allaqachon u haqida, men haqimda, hamma narsa haqida bilsa?

paras.en: U-, already dressed, was at the door. I made a step toward her and pressed her hand as hard as though I hoped to squeeze out of it drop by drop what I needed.
paras.uz: Yu- allaqachon kiyinib, eshik oldida edi. Men unga qarab bir qadam tashlab, qo'lini go'yo undan menga kerak bo'lgan narsani tomchilab siqib chiqarishga umid qilgandek qattiq siqdim.

paras.en: “Listen.⁠ ⁠… Her name, you know whom I am talking of⁠—did you report her name? No? Tell the truth, I must.⁠ ⁠… I care not what happens, but tell the truth!”
paras.uz: «Quloq soling... Uning ismi, kim haqida gapirayotganimni bilasiz — uning ismini xabar qildingizmi? Yo'qmi? Rostini ayting, men kerak... Nima bo'lishi menga baribir, lekin rostini ayting!»

paras.en: “No.”
paras.uz: «Yo'q».

paras.en: “No? But why not, since you.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Yo'qmi? Lekin nega, axir siz...»

paras.en: Her lower lip turned out like the lip of that boy and her face⁠ ⁠… tears were running down her cheeks.
paras.uz: Uning pastki labi o'sha bolaning labidek qayrildi va yuzi... ko'z yoshlari yonoqlaridan oqardi.

paras.en: “Because I⁠ ⁠… I was afraid that if I did you might⁠ ⁠… you would stop lov⁠—Oh, I cannot, I could not!”
paras.uz: «Chunki men... men qo'rqdim, agar xabar qilsam, siz... meni sevmay qo'yasiz... Oh, qila olmayman, qila olmadim!»

paras.en: I understood. It was the truth. Absurd, ridiculous, human truth. I opened the door.
paras.uz: Men tushundim. Bu haqiqat edi. Bema'ni, kulgili, insoniy haqiqat. Men eshikni ochdim.

gloss.ex: I had in my closet a heavy piston-rod which cracked during the casting and which I brought home in order to find out…
…they called ‘Ass.’ In order to make it go forward they would attach a carrot to a bow held in front of its nose, so that it could not reach it.⁠ ⁠… If it had ca…
…illed her. Yes, you my unknown readers, you have the right to call me murderer. I know that I should have dealt the blow on her head had she not screamed:
Here I learned from personal experience that laughter is the most terrible of weapons; you can kill anything with laughter, even murder…
…ndaged⁠—it seems to me not a bandage but a ring, a pitiless ring of glass-iron, riveted about my head. And I am busy with the same thought, always the same thou…

quiz.q: Why does D-503 want to kill U-?
quiz.why_uz: U Yu- ni xoin deb o'ylaydi.

quiz.q: Did U- report I-330?
quiz.why_uz: U D-503 ni yo'qotishdan qo'rqqani uchun xabar qilmagan.

chapters.recap_uz: Boshi bog'langan D-503 Yu- ni o'ldirmoqchi bo'ladi. Yu- buni noto'g'ri tushunadi; D-503 kulib yuboradi. Homiy uni chaqiradi; Yu- I-330 ni xabar qilmaganini aytadi.

chapters.title: Empty pages — The Christian god — About my mother
chapters.title_uz: Bo'sh sahifalar — Nasroniylarning xudosi — Onam haqida

paras.en: It is very strange that a kind of empty white page should be left in my head. How I walked there, how I waited (I remember I had to wait), I know nothing about it; I remember not a sound, not a face, not a gesture, as if all communicating wires between me and the world were cut.
paras.uz: Juda g'alati, boshimda qandaydir bo'sh oq sahifa qolib ketishi kerak ekan. U yerga qanday borganimni, qanday kutganimni (esimda, kutishimga to'g'ri kelgan edi) hech narsa bilmayman; bironta tovushni, bironta yuzni, bironta imo-ishorani eslay olmayman, go'yo men bilan dunyo orasidagi barcha aloqa simlari kesib tashlangandek.

paras.en: When I came to, I found myself standing before Him; I feared to raise my eyes⁠—I saw only His enormous cast-iron hands upon His knees. Those hands weighed upon Him, bending His knees with their weight. He was slowly moving His fingers. His face was somewhere above as if in fog. And, only because His voice came to my ear from such a height, it did not roar like thunder, it did not deafen me but appeared to be an ordinary human voice.
paras.uz: O'zimga kelganimda O'zining oldida turganimni ko'rdim; ko'zlarimni ko'tarishdan qo'rqardim — faqat Uning tizzalari ustidagi ulkan cho'yan qo'llarini ko'rdim. O'sha qo'llar Uning ustiga og'irlik qilib, og'irligi bilan tizzalarini bukardi. U sekin barmoqlarini qimirlatardi. Uning yuzi qayerdadir yuqorida, go'yo tumanda edi. Va faqat Uning ovozi qulog'imga shunday balandlikdan kelgani uchungina u momaqaldiroqdek gumburlamas, meni kar qilmas, oddiy inson ovozidek tuyulardi.

paras.en: “Then you too, you the Builder of the Integral! You, whose lot it was to become the greatest of all conquistadores! You whose name was to have been at the head of a glorious, new chapter of the history of the United State! You.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Demak, siz ham, siz, Integral Quruvchisi! Barcha konkistadorlarning eng buyugi bo'lish qismat bo'lgan siz! Ismingiz Yagona Davlat tarixining shonli, yangi bobining boshida turishi kerak bo'lgan siz! Siz...»

paras.en: Blood ran to my head, to my cheeks⁠—and here again a white page; only the pulsation in my temples and the heavy voice from above; but I remember not a word. Only when He became silent I came to and noticed how His hand moved heavily like a thousand pounds, and crawled slowly⁠—a finger threatened me.
paras.uz: Qon boshimga, yonoqlarimga yugurdi — va bu yerda yana oq sahifa; faqat chakkalarimdagi urish va yuqoridan og'ir ovoz; lekin bironta so'zni eslay olmayman. Faqat U jim bo'lgandagina o'zimga keldim va Uning qo'li ming puddek og'ir qimirlaganini va sekin o'rmalaganini payqadim — bir barmoq menga do'q qildi.

paras.en: “Well! Why are you silent? Is it true, or not? Executioner? So!”
paras.uz: «Xo'sh! Nega jimsiz? Bu rostmi yoki yo'qmi? Jallod? Shundaymi!»

paras.en: “So,” I repeated submissively. And then I clearly heard every word of His.
paras.uz: «Shunday», — itoatkorona takrorladim men. Va keyin Uning har bir so'zini aniq eshitdim.

paras.en: “Well then? Do you think I am afraid of the word! Did you ever try to take off its shell and look into its inner meaning? I shall tell you.⁠ ⁠… Remember a blue hill, a crowd, a cross? Some up on the hill, sprinkled with blood, are busy nailing a body to the cross; others below, sprinkled with tears, are gazing upward. Does it not seem to you that the part which those above must play is the more difficult, the most important part? If it were not for them, how could that magnificent tragedy ever have been staged? True, they were hissed by the dark crowd but for that the author of the tragedy, God, should have remunerated them the more liberally, should he not? And the Christian, most clement God himself, who burnt on a slow fire all the infidels, is he not an executioner? Was the number of those burned by the Christians less than the number of burned Christians? Yet (you must understand this!), yet this God was for centuries glorified as the God of love! Absurd? Oh, no. Just the contrary. It is rather a patent for the imperishable wisdom of man, written in blood. Even at the time when he still was wild and hairy man knew that real, algebraic love for humanity must inevitably be inhuman, and that the inevitable mark of truth is cruelty, just as the inevitable mark of fire is its property of causing the sensation of burning. Could you show me a fire that would not hurt? Well, prove now your point! Proceed! Argue!”
paras.uz: «Xo'sh, unday bo'lsa? Siz meni bu so'zdan qo'rqadi deb o'ylaysizmi! Siz hech qachon uning po'chog'ini olib tashlab, ichki ma'nosiga qarashga uringanmisiz? Men sizga aytaman... Moviy tepalikni, olomonni, xochni eslang? Ba'zilar tepada, qonga belangan holda, tanani xochga mixlash bilan band; boshqalar pastda, ko'z yoshlariga belangan holda, yuqoriga tikilishmoqda. Sizga tepadagilar o'ynashi kerak bo'lgan rol qiyinroq, eng muhim rol bo'lib tuyulmaydimi? Agar ular bo'lmaganida, o'sha ulug'vor tragediya qanday sahnalashtirilgan bo'lardi? To'g'ri, qorong'i olomon ularni hushtak bilan kutib oldi, lekin buning uchun tragediya muallifi — Xudo ularni yanada saxiyroq taqdirlashi kerak edi, shunday emasmi? Va barcha kofirlarni sekin olovda yoqqan eng rahmdil nasroniy Xudoning o'zi jallod emasmi? Nasroniylar yoqqanlar soni yoqilgan nasroniylar sonidan kam bo'lganmi? Lekin (buni tushunishingiz kerak!), lekin bu Xudo asrlar davomida sevgi Xudosi sifatida ulug'langan! Bema'nilikmi? Oh, yo'q. Aksincha. Bu ko'proq insonning yemirilmas donoligiga qon bilan yozilgan patent. Hatto u hali yovvoyi va tukli bo'lgan paytda ham inson insoniyatga bo'lgan haqiqiy, algebraik sevgi muqarrar ravishda g'ayriinsoniy bo'lishi kerakligini va haqiqatning muqarrar belgisi shafqatsizlik ekanini bilgan, xuddi olovning muqarrar belgisi kuydirish tuyg'usini keltirib chiqarish xususiyati bo'lgani kabi. Menga og'ritmaydigan olovni ko'rsata olasizmi? Xo'sh, endi o'z fikringizni isbotlang! Davom eting! Bahslashing!»

paras.en: How could I argue? How could I argue when those thoughts were once mine, though I was never able to dress them in such a splendid, tempered armor. I remained silent.
paras.uz: Qanday bahslasha olardim? Bu fikrlar bir paytlar meniki bo'lgan bo'lsa, garchi men ularni hech qachon bunday ajoyib, toblangan sovutga kiyintira olmagan bo'lsam ham, qanday bahslasha olardim. Men jim qoldim.

paras.en: “If your silence is intended to mean that you agree with me, then let us talk as adults do after the children have gone to bed; let us talk to the logical end. I ask: what was it that man from his diaper age dreamed of, tormented himself for, prayed for? He longed for that day when someone would tell him what happiness is and then would chain him to it. What else are we doing now? The ancient dream about a paradise.⁠ ⁠… Remember: there in paradise they know no desires any more, no pity, no love; there they are all⁠—blessed. An operation has been performed upon their centre of fancy; that is why they are blessed, angels, servants of God.⁠ ⁠… And now, at the very moment when we have caught up with that dream, when we hold it like this”: (He clenched his hand so, that if he had held a stone in it sap would have run out!) “At the moment when all that was left for us was to adorn our prize and distribute it amongst all in equal pieces, at that very moment you, you.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Agar sizning jimligingiz men bilan rozi ekaningizni anglatsa, unda keling, bolalar uxlagandan keyin kattalar gaplashgandek gaplashaylik; mantiqiy oxirigacha gaplashaylik. Men so'rayman: inson yo'rgak yoshidan beri nimani orzu qilgan, nima uchun o'zini qiynagan, nima uchun ibodat qilgan? U kimdir unga baxt nima ekanini aytib, keyin uni unga zanjirband qiladigan kunni orzu qilgan. Biz hozir yana nima qilyapmiz? Jannat haqidagi qadimiy orzu... Eslang: u yerda, jannatda ular endi istaklarni, achinishni, sevgini bilishmaydi; u yerda ularning hammasi — saodatmand. Ularning fantaziya markaziga operatsiya qilingan; shuning uchun ular saodatmand, farishtalar, Xudoning qullari... Va endi, aynan biz o'sha orzuga yetib olgan, uni mana bunday ushlab turgan lahzada», (U qo'lini shunday qisdiki, agar unda tosh bo'lganida, undan sharbat oqib chiqardi!) «bizga faqat o'ljamizni bezatib, uni hammaga teng bo'laklarga taqsimlash qolgan lahzada, aynan o'sha lahzada siz, siz...»

paras.en: The cast-iron roar was suddenly broken off. I was as red as a piece of iron on an anvil, under the moulding sledgehammer. This seemed to have stopped for a second, hanging in air, and I waited, waited⁠ ⁠… until suddenly:
paras.uz: Cho'yan gumburlash to'satdan uzildi. Men sandon ustida, quyuvchi bolg'a ostidagi temir bo'lagidek qizarib ketgandim. Bolg'a bir soniyaga havoda osilib to'xtab qolgandek bo'ldi va men kutdim, kutdim... to'satdan:

paras.en: “How old are you?”
paras.uz: «Necha yoshdasiz?»

paras.en: “Thirty-two.”
paras.uz: «O'ttiz ikkida».

paras.en: “Just double the age, and as simple as at sixteen! Listen. Is it possible that it really never occurred to you that they (we do not yet know their names but I am certain you will disclose them to us), that they were interested in you only as the Builder of the Integral? only in order to be able through the use of you⁠—”
paras.uz: «Aynan ikki baravar yosh va o'n oltidagidek sodda! Quloq soling. Nahotki sizning boshingizga hech qachon ular (biz hali ularning ismlarini bilmaymiz, lekin aminmanki, siz ularni bizga ochib berasiz), ular sizga faqat Integral Quruvchisi sifatida qiziqishgani kelmagan bo'lsa? faqat siz orqali —»

paras.en: “Don’t! Don’t!” I cried. But it was like protecting yourself with your hands and crying to a bullet: you may still be hearing your own “don’t” but the bullet meanwhile has burned you through, and writhing with pain, you are prostrated on the ground.
paras.uz: «Qo'ying! Qo'ying!» — qichqirdim men. Lekin bu qo'llaring bilan o'zingni himoya qilib, o'qqa qichqirganga o'xshardi: siz hali ham o'zingizning «qo'ying»ingizni eshitayotgan bo'lishingiz mumkin, lekin o'q bu orada sizni kuydirib teshib o'tgan va siz og'riqdan to'lg'anib, yerga yiqilasiz.

paras.en: Yes, yes; the Builder of the Integral.⁠ ⁠… Yes, yes.⁠ ⁠… At once there came back to me the angry face of U- with twitching, brick-red gills, on that morning when both of them.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Ha, ha; Integral Quruvchisi... Ha, ha... Shu zahoti menga o'sha tongdagi, ikkalasi... bo'lgan tongdagi pirpirayotgan, g'isht rang jabrali Yu- ning g'azabli yuzi qaytib keldi...

paras.en: I remember now, clearly, how I raised my eyes and laughed. A Socrates-like, bald-headed man was sitting before me; and small drops of sweat dotted the bald surface of his cranium.
paras.uz: Endi aniq eslayman, qanday qilib ko'zlarimni ko'tarib, kulib yubordim. Oldimda Sokratga o'xshash, taqir boshli odam o'tirardi; va uning bosh suyagining taqir yuzasini mayda ter tomchilari nuqtalab turardi.

paras.en: How simple, how magnificently trivial everything was! How simple! Almost to the point of being ridiculous. Laughter was choking me and bursting forth in puffs; I covered my mouth with my hand and rushed wildly out.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Hamma narsa qanchalik oddiy, qanchalik ulug'vor darajada arzimas edi! Qanchalik oddiy! Deyarli kulgili darajada. Kulgi meni bo'g'ib, puflab otilib chiqardi; og'zimni qo'lim bilan yopib, yovvoyi otilib chiqib ketdim...

paras.en: Steps. Wind. Damp, leaping fragments of lights and faces.⁠ ⁠… And while running: “No! Only to see her! To see her once more!”
paras.uz: Zinapoyalar. Shamol. Nam, sakrayotgan chiroqlar va yuzlar parchalari... Va yugurayotib: «Yo'q! Faqat uni ko'rish! Uni yana bir marta ko'rish!»

paras.en: Here again, an empty white page. All I remember is feet; not people, just feet; hundreds of feet, confusedly stamping feet, falling from somewhere on the pavement; a heavy rain of feet.⁠ ⁠… And some cheerful, daring voice, and a shout that was probably for me: “Hey, hey! Come here! Come along with us!”
paras.uz: Bu yerda yana bo'sh oq sahifa. Eslagan narsam faqat oyoqlar; odamlar emas, faqat oyoqlar; yuzlab oyoqlar, chalkash tepayotgan oyoqlar, qayerdandir trotuarga tushayotgan; oyoqlarning og'ir yomg'iri... Va qandaydir quvnoq, dadil ovoz va ehtimol menga qaratilgan qichqiriq: «Hoy, hoy! Bu yoqqa keling! Biz bilan yuring!»

paras.en: Afterward⁠—a deserted square heavily overloaded with tense wind. In the middle of the square a dim, heavy threatening mass⁠—the Machine of the Well-Doer; and a seemingly unexpected image arose within me in response to the sight of the Machine: a snow-white pillow and on the pillow a head thrown back, and half-closed eyes and a sharp, sweet line of teeth.⁠ ⁠… All this seemed so absurdly, so terribly connected with the Machine. I know how this connection has come about but I do not yet want to see it nor to say it aloud⁠—I don’t want to! I do not!
paras.uz: Keyin — tarang shamol bilan og'ir yuklangan huvillagan maydon. Maydonning o'rtasida xira, og'ir, tahdidli massa — Homiy Mashinasi; va Mashinani ko'rishga javoban ichimda go'yo kutilmagan bir tasvir paydo bo'ldi: qordek oq yostiq va yostiqda orqaga tashlangan bosh, yarim yumuq ko'zlar va tishlarning o'tkir, shirin chizig'i... Bularning hammasi Mashina bilan shunchalik bema'ni, shunchalik dahshatli bog'liq tuyuldi. Bu bog'liqlik qanday paydo bo'lganini bilaman, lekin hali uni ko'rishni ham, ovoz chiqarib aytishni ham istamayman — istamayman! Istamayman!

paras.en: I closed my eyes, sat down on the steps which lead upwards to the Machine. I must have been running for my face was wet. From somewhere very far away cries were coming. But nobody heard them; nobody heard me crying: “Save me from it⁠—save me!”
paras.uz: Ko'zlarimni yumib, Mashinaga yuqoriga olib boradigan zinapoyalarga o'tirdim. Men yugurgan bo'lsam kerak, chunki yuzim ho'l edi. Qayerdandir juda uzoqdan qichqiriqlar kelardi. Lekin ularni hech kim eshitmadi; mening: «Meni bundan qutqaring — qutqaring!» deb qichqirayotganimni hech kim eshitmadi.

paras.en: If only I had a mother as the ancients had⁠—my mother, mine, for whom I should be not the Builder of the Integral and not D-530, not a molecule of the United State but merely a living human piece, a piece of herself, a trampled, smothered, a cast-off piece.⁠ ⁠… And though I were driving the nails into the cross or being nailed to it (perhaps it is the same), she would hear what no one else could hear; her old grown-together wrinkled lips.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Qaniydi qadimgilardagidek onam bo'lsa — mening onam, meniki, uning uchun men Integral Quruvchisi ham, D-503 ham, Yagona Davlatning molekulasi ham emas, balki shunchaki tirik inson bo'lagi, uning o'zining bir bo'lagi, oyoq osti qilingan, bo'g'ilgan, tashlab yuborilgan bo'lak bo'lsam... Va men xochga mixlarni qoqayotgan bo'lsam ham yoki unga mixlanayotgan bo'lsam ham (balki bu bir xildir), u hech kim eshita olmaydigan narsani eshitardi; uning keksa, bitishgan, ajinli lablari...

gloss.ex: “Well! Why are you silent? Is it true, or not? Executioner? So!”
…inner meaning? I shall tell you.⁠ ⁠… Remember a blue hill, a crowd, a cross? Some up on the hill, sprinkled with blood, are busy nailing a body to the cross; ot…
…of the Integral! You, whose lot it was to become the greatest of all conquistadores! You whose name was to have been at the head of a glorious, new chapter of…
If only I had a mother as the ancients had⁠—my mother, mine, for whom I should be not the Builder of the I…
…hain him to it. What else are we doing now? The ancient dream about a paradise.⁠ ⁠… Remember: there in paradise they know no desires any more, no pity, no love;…

quiz.q: What does the Well-Doer claim I-330 wanted from D-503?
quiz.why_uz: Bu D-503 uchun eng og'ir zarba.

quiz.q: How old is D-503?
quiz.why_uz: U o'ttiz ikki yoshda.

chapters.recap_uz: D-503 Homiy oldida. Homiy sevgi shafqatsiz bo'lishi kerak deydi va I-330 unga faqat Integral uchun kerak bo'lganini aytadi. D-503 Mashina yonida onasini qo'msaydi.

chapters.title: Infusorian — Doomsday — Her room

paras.en: This morning while we were in the refectory, my neighbor to my left whispered to me in a frightened tone:
paras.uz: Bugun ertalab biz ovqatxonada bo'lganimizda, chap tomonimdagi qo'shnim menga qo'rqib shivirladi:

paras.en: “But why don’t you eat? Don’t you see, they are looking at you!”
paras.uz: «Lekin nega yemayapsiz? Ko'rmayapsizmi, ular sizga qarab turishibdi!»

paras.en: I had to pluck up all my strength to show a smile. I felt it⁠—like a crack in my face; I smiled and the borders of the crack drew apart wider and wider; it was quite painful.
paras.uz: Jilmayishni ko'rsatish uchun butun kuchimni yig'ishimga to'g'ri keldi. Men uni his qildim — yuzimdagi yoriqdek; men jilmaydim va yoriqning chetlari tobora kengroq ajralib bordi; bu juda og'riqli edi.

paras.en: What followed was this: no sooner had I lifted the small cube of paste upon my fork, than my fork jerked from my hand and tinkled against the plate, and at once the tables, the walls, the plates, the air even, trembled and rang; and outside too, an enormous, iron, round roar reaching the sky⁠—floating over heads and houses it died away in the distance in small, hardly perceptible circles like those upon water.
paras.uz: Keyin bo'lgan voqea shunday: vilkamga kichkina pasta kubigini ilib ko'tarishim bilan vilka qo'limdan siltanib, likopchaga jaranglab tushdi va shu zahoti stollar, devorlar, likopchalar, hatto havo ham titrab, jaranglab ketdi; tashqarida ham osmongacha yetadigan ulkan, temir, dumaloq gumburlash — boshlar va uylar ustidan suzib, u uzoqda suvdagidek kichkina, zo'rg'a seziladigan doiralar bo'lib so'nib ketdi.

paras.en: I saw faces instantaneously grow faded and bleached; I saw mouths filled with food suddenly motionless and forks hanging in air. Then everything became confused, jumped off the centuries-old tracks, everybody jumped up from his place (without singing the Hymn!) and confusedly, in disorder, hastily finishing chewing, choking, grasping one another.⁠ ⁠… They were asking: “What? What happened? What?⁠ ⁠…” And the disorderly fragments of the Machine which was once perfect and great, fell down in all directions⁠—down the elevators, down the stairs.⁠ ⁠… Stamping of feet.⁠ ⁠… Pieces of words like pieces of torn letters carried by the wind.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Yuzlar bir zumda so'lib, oqarib ketganini ko'rdim; ovqatga to'la og'izlar to'satdan qimirlamay qolganini va vilkalar havoda osilib turganini ko'rdim. Keyin hamma narsa chalkashib ketdi, asrlik relslardan sakrab chiqdi, hamma o'z joyidan sakrab turdi (Madhiyani kuylamasdan!) va chalkash, tartibsiz, shoshilib chaynashni tugatib, bo'g'ilib, bir-birini ushlab... Ular so'rashardi: «Nima? Nima bo'ldi? Nima?..» Va bir paytlar mukammal va buyuk bo'lgan Mashinaning tartibsiz parchalari har tomonga — liftlardan pastga, zinapoyalardan pastga tushib ketdi... Oyoqlarning tepishi... Shamol uchirib ketayotgan yirtilgan xat bo'laklaridek so'z bo'laklari...

paras.en: The same outpour from the neighboring houses. A minute later the avenue seemed like a drop of water under a microscope: the infusoria locked up in the transparent, glass-like drop of water were tossing around, to the sides, up and down.
paras.uz: Qo'shni uylardan ham xuddi shunday oqim. Bir daqiqadan keyin prospekt mikroskop ostidagi suv tomchisiga o'xshab qoldi: shaffof, shishadek suv tomchisiga qamalgan infuzoriyalar u yoqqa-bu yoqqa, yuqori-pastga uloqib yurardi.

paras.en: “Ah!” Someone’s triumphant voice. I saw the back of a neck and a finger pointing to the sky. I remember very distinctly a yellow-pinkish nail and under the nail a crescent crawling out as if from under the horizon. The finger was like a compass; all eyes were raised to the sky.
paras.uz: «Ah!» Kimningdir g'alabali ovozi. Men ensa va osmonga ishora qilayotgan barmoqni ko'rdim. Sariq-pushtiroq tirnoqni va tirnoq ostida go'yo ufq ostidan o'rmalab chiqayotgan yarim oyni juda aniq eslayman. Barmoq kompasdek edi; barcha ko'zlar osmonga ko'tarildi.

paras.en: There, running away from an invisible pursuit, masses of cloud were rushing upon each other; and colored by the clouds the aeros of the Guardians, with their tubes like antennae, were floating. And farther to the west⁠—something like.⁠ ⁠… At first nobody could understand what it was, even I, who knew (unfortunately) more than the others. It was like a great hive of black aeros swarming somewhere at an extraordinary height⁠—they looked like hardly noticeable, swiftly moving points.⁠ ⁠… Nearer and nearer.⁠ ⁠… Hoarse, guttural sounds began to reach the earth and finally we saw birds just over our heads! They filled the sky with their sharp, black, descending triangles. The stormy wind drove them down and they began to land on the cupolas, on the roofs, poles and balconies.
paras.uz: U yerda, ko'rinmas ta'qibdan qochib, bulut massalari bir-birining ustiga yopirilib borardi; va bulutlar rangiga bo'yalgan Qo'riqchilarning aerolari, mo'ylovlardek naychalari bilan suzib yurardi. Yana g'arbroqda esa — nimadir... Avvaliga hech kim bu nima ekanini tushuna olmadi, hatto boshqalardan ko'proq bilgan (afsuski) men ham. Bu qayerdadir g'ayrioddiy balandlikda g'uj-g'uj aylanib yurgan qora aerolarning ulkan uyasiga o'xshardi — ular zo'rg'a seziladigan, tez harakatlanayotgan nuqtalardek ko'rinardi... Yaqinroq va yaqinroq... Yerga xirillagan, tomoq tovushlari yeta boshladi va nihoyat biz boshimiz ustida qushlarni ko'rdik! Ular osmonni o'zlarining o'tkir, qora, pastga tushayotgan uchburchaklari bilan to'ldirdi. Bo'ronli shamol ularni pastga haydadi va ular gumbazlarga, tomlarga, ustunlarga va balkonlarga qo'na boshladi.

paras.en: “Ah⁠—ah!” and the triumphant back of the neck turned, and I saw that man with the protruding forehead but it seemed that the title, so to speak, was all that was left of him: he seemed to have crawled out from under his forehead and on his face, around the eyes and lips, bunches of rays were growing. Through the noise of the wind and wings and cawing, he cried to me:
paras.uz: «Ah — ah!» va g'alabali ensa o'girildi va men o'sha bo'rtiq peshonali odamni ko'rdim, lekin go'yo undan faqat, aytaylik, sarlavha qolgandek edi: u go'yo peshonasi ostidan o'rmalab chiqqandek edi va yuzida, ko'zlari va lablari atrofida nur dastalari o'sib chiqardi. Shamol, qanotlar va qag'illash shovqini orqali u menga qichqirdi:

paras.en: “Do you realize? Do you realize! They have blown up the Wall! The Wall has been blown up! Do you understand?”
paras.uz: «Anglayapsizmi? Anglayapsizmi! Ular Devorni portlatishdi! Devor portlatildi! Tushunyapsizmi?»

paras.en: Somewhere in the background, figures with their heads drawn in were hastily rushing by, and into the houses. In the middle of the pavement a mass of those who had been already operated upon; they moved towards the west.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Qayerdadir orqa fonda boshlarini ichiga tortgan qiyofalar shoshilib o'tib, uylarga kirib ketishardi. Trotuarning o'rtasida allaqachon operatsiya qilinganlarning massasi; ular g'arbga qarab harakatlanardi...

paras.en: … Hairy bunches of rays around the lips and eyes.⁠ ⁠… I grasped his hands:
paras.uz: ...Lablar va ko'zlar atrofida tukli nur dastalari... Men uning qo'llarini ushladim:

paras.en: “Tell me. Where is she? Where is I-330? There? Beyond the Wall or⁠ ⁠… ? I must.⁠ ⁠… Do you hear me? At once.⁠ ⁠… I cannot.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Ayting-chi. U qayerda? I-330 qayerda? U yerdami? Devor ortidami yoki...? Men kerak... Eshityapsizmi? Darhol... Men qila olmayman...»

paras.en: “Here!” he shouted in a happy, drunken voice, showing strong yellow teeth, “here in town, and she is acting! Oh, we are doing great work!”
paras.uz: «Shu yerda! — qichqirdi u baxtiyor, mast ovozda, kuchli sariq tishlarini ko'rsatib. — Shu yerda, shaharda va u harakat qilyapti! Oh, biz buyuk ish qilyapmiz!»

paras.en: Who are those “we”? Who am I?
paras.uz: O'sha «biz» kimlar? Men kimman?

paras.en: There were about fifty around him. Like him, they seemed to have crawled out from under their foreheads. They were loud, cheerful, strong-toothed, swallowing the stormy wind. With their simple, not at all terrible-looking electrocutors (where did they get them?) they started to the west, towards the operated ones, encircling them, keeping parallel to forty-eighth avenue.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Uning atrofida ellikka yaqin odam bor edi. U kabi ular ham go'yo peshonalari ostidan o'rmalab chiqqandek edi. Ular baland ovozli, quvnoq, kuchli tishli bo'lib, bo'ronli shamolni yutishardi. O'zlarining oddiy, umuman dahshatli ko'rinmaydigan elektr qurollari bilan (ularni qayerdan olishgan?) ular g'arbga, operatsiya qilinganlarga qarab yo'lga tushishdi, ularni o'rab olib, qirq sakkizinchi prospektga parallel yurishdi...

paras.en: Stumbling against the tightly-drawn ropes woven by the wind, I was running to her. What for? I did not know. I was stumbling.⁠ ⁠… Empty streets.⁠ ⁠… The city seemed foreign, wild, filled with the ceaseless, triumphant, hubbub of birds. It seemed like the end of the world, Doomsday.
paras.uz: Shamol to'qigan tarang tortilgan arqonlarga qoqilib, men uning oldiga yugurardim. Nima uchun? Bilmasdim. Qoqilardim... Bo'm-bo'sh ko'chalar... Shahar begona, yovvoyi, qushlarning to'xtovsiz, g'alabali g'ala-g'ovuriga to'la tuyulardi. Bu dunyoning oxiri, Qiyomat kuniga o'xshardi.

paras.en: Through the glass of the walls in quite a few houses (this cut into my mind) I saw male and female Numbers in shameless embraces⁠—without curtains lowered, without pink checks, in the middle of the day!⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Ancha ko'p uylarda devorlar shishasi orqali (bu miyamga kesib kirdi) erkak va ayol Raqamlarni uyatsiz quchoqlashganini ko'rdim — pardalarni tushirmasdan, pushti chiptalarsiz, kunning o'rtasida!..

paras.en: The house⁠—her house; the door ajar. The lobby, the control desk, all was empty. The elevator had stopped in the middle of its shaft. I ran panting up the endless stairs. The corridor. Like the spokes of a wheel figures on the doors dashed past my eyes; 320, 326, 330⁠—I-330! Through the glass wall everything in her room was seen to be upside down, confused, creased. The table overturned, its legs in the air like a beast. The bed was absurdly placed away from the wall, obliquely. Strewn over the floor⁠—fallen, trodden petals of the pink checks.
paras.uz: Uy — uning uyi; eshik qiya ochiq. Vestibyul, nazorat stoli, hammasi bo'm-bo'sh edi. Lift shaxtasining o'rtasida to'xtab qolgan edi. Men hansirab cheksiz zinapoyalardan yuqoriga yugurdim. Yo'lak. G'ildirak kegaylaridek eshiklardagi raqamlar ko'zlarim oldidan o'tib ketdi; 320, 326, 330 — I-330! Shisha devor orqali uning xonasidagi hamma narsa ag'darilgan, chalkash, g'ijimlangan ko'rinardi. Stol ag'darilgan, oyoqlari hayvondek havoda. Karavot devordan uzoqroqqa, qiyshiq, bema'ni qo'yilgan edi. Polga sochilgan — pushti chiptalarning tushib qolgan, oyoq osti qilingan gulbarglari.

paras.en: I bent over and picked up one, two, three of them; all bore the name D-503. I was on all of them, drops of myself, of my molten, poured-out self. And that was all⁠—that was left.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Egilib, ulardan birini, ikkitasini, uchtasini oldim; hammasida D-503 ismi bor edi. Men hammasida edim, o'zimning, erigan, quyib tashlangan o'zimning tomchilari. Va bu hammasi edi — qolgan narsa...

paras.en: Somehow I felt they should not lie there on the floor and be trodden upon. I gathered a handful of them, put them on the table and carefully smoothed them out, glanced at them and⁠ ⁠… laughed aloud! I never knew it before but now I know, and you too, know, that laughter may be of different colors. It is but a distant echo of an explosion within us; it may be the echo of a holiday, red, blue and golden fireworks, or at times it may represent pieces of human flesh exploded into the air.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Negadir ular u yerda polda yotib, oyoq osti qilinmasligi kerakdek his qildim. Ulardan bir hovuchini yig'ib, stolga qo'ydim va ehtiyotkorlik bilan tekisladim, ularga qaradim va... ovoz chiqarib kulib yubordim! Men buni ilgari hech qachon bilmagandim, lekin endi bilaman va siz ham bilasizki, kulgi turli rangda bo'lishi mumkin. U ichimizdagi portlashning uzoq aks-sadosi, xolos; u bayramning aks-sadosi, qizil, moviy va oltin feyerverklar bo'lishi mumkin, yoki ba'zan havoga portlatib yuborilgan inson go'shti bo'laklarini ifodalashi mumkin...

paras.en: I noticed an unfamiliar name on some of the pink checks. I do not remember the figures but I do remember the letter⁠—F. I brushed the stubs from the table to the floor, stepped on them, on myself, stamped on them with my heels⁠—and went out.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Ba'zi pushti chiptalarda notanish ismni payqadim. Raqamlarni eslay olmayman, lekin harfni eslayman — F. Talonlarni stoldan polga supurib tashladim, ularning ustiga, o'zimning ustimga bosdim, tovonlarim bilan tepkiladim — va chiqib ketdim...

paras.en: I sat in the corridor on the windowsill in front of her door and waited long and stupidly. An old man appeared. His face was like a pierced, empty bladder with folds; from beneath the puncture something transparent was still slowly dripping. Slowly, vaguely I realized⁠—tears. And only when the old man was quite far off I came to and exclaimed:
paras.uz: Men yo'lakda, uning eshigi ro'parasidagi deraza tokchasida o'tirib, uzoq va ahmoqona kutdim. Bir chol paydo bo'ldi. Uning yuzi teshilgan, burmali bo'sh pufakka o'xshardi; teshik ostidan nimadir shaffof narsa hali ham sekin tomardi. Sekin, noaniq angladim — ko'z yoshlar. Va faqat chol ancha uzoqlashgandagina o'zimga kelib, xitob qildim:

paras.en: “Please⁠ ⁠… listen.⁠ ⁠… Do you know⁠ ⁠… Number I-330?”
paras.uz: «Iltimos... quloq soling... Bilasizmi... I-330 raqamini?»

paras.en: The old man turned around, waved his hand in despair and stumbled farther away.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Chol o'girilib, umidsiz qo'l siltadi va qoqilib-suqilib uzoqlashib ketdi...

paras.en: I returned home at dusk. On the west side the sky was twitching every second in a pale blue electric convulsion:⁠—a subdued, heavy roar was proceeding from that direction. The roofs were covered with black charred sticks⁠—birds.
paras.uz: G'ira-shirada uyga qaytdim. G'arb tomonda osmon har soniyada xira moviy elektr talvasasida pirpirardi: — o'sha tomondan bo'g'iq, og'ir gumburlash kelardi. Tomlar qora kuygan cho'plar — qushlar bilan qoplangan edi.

paras.en: I lay down; and instantly like a heavy beast sleep came and stifled me.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men yotdim; va bir zumda og'ir hayvondek uyqu kelib, meni bo'g'ib oldi...

gloss.ex: …later the avenue seemed like a drop of water under a microscope: the infusoria locked up in the transparent, glass-like drop of water were tossing around, to t…
…ss, triumphant, hubbub of birds. It seemed like the end of the world, Doomsday.
“Do you realize? Do you realize! They have blown up the Wall! The Wall has been blown up! Do you understand?”
…… Hoarse, guttural sounds began to reach the earth and finally we saw birds just over our heads! They filled the sky with their sharp, black, descending triangl…
…… Hoarse, guttural sounds began to reach the earth and finally we saw birds just over our heads! They filled the sky with their sharp, black, descending triangl…

quiz.q: What has happened to the Green Wall?
quiz.why_uz: Devor portlatiladi va qushlar shaharga kiradi.

quiz.q: What does D-503 find in I-330's room?
o: Pink tickets with his name and one with 'F'
quiz.why_uz: F harfi uni yana rashkga soladi.

chapters.recap_uz: Yashil Devor portlatiladi, shaharga qushlar kirib keladi. Isyon boshlanadi. D-503 I-330 ning bo'm-bo'sh xonasini va «F» harfli chiptalarni topadi.

chapters.title: I don’t know what title — Perhaps the whole synopsis may be called a cast-off cigarette-butt
chapters.title_uz: Qanday sarlavha qo'yishni bilmayman. Balki bu qisqa mazmunni tashlandiq sigaret qoldig'i desa bo'lar

paras.en: I awoke. A bright glare painful to look at. I half closed my eyes. My head seemed filled with some caustic blue smoke. Everything was enveloped in fog and through the fog:
paras.uz: Uyg'ondim. Qarash og'riqli bo'lgan yorqin nur. Ko'zlarimni yarim yumdim. Boshim qandaydir achchiq moviy tutun bilan to'lgandek tuyulardi. Hamma narsa tumanga o'ralgan edi va tuman orqali:

paras.en: “But I did not turn on the light⁠ ⁠… then how is it.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Lekin men chiroqni yoqmagandim... unda qanday qilib...»

paras.en: I jumped up. At the table, leaning her chin on her hand and smiling, was I-330, looking at me.
paras.uz: Men sakrab turdim. Stol yonida, iyagini qo'liga tirab, jilmayib, I-330 menga qarab o'tirardi.

paras.en: She was at the very table at which I am now writing. Those ten or fifteen minutes are already behind me, cruelly twisted into a very firm spring. Yet it seems to me that the door closed after her only a second ago and that I could still overtake her and grasp her hand⁠—and that she might laugh out and say.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U men hozir yozayotgan aynan shu stol yonida edi. O'sha o'n yoki o'n besh daqiqa allaqachon ortimda, shafqatsizlarcha juda mahkam prujinaga burab qo'yilgan. Lekin menga eshik uning orqasidan faqat bir soniya oldin yopilgandek va men hali ham unga yetib olib, qo'lini ushlay olishim mumkindek — va u kulib yuborib, ... deyishi mumkindek tuyuladi.

paras.en: I-330 was at the table. I rushed towards her.
paras.uz: I-330 stol yonida edi. Men unga qarab otildim.

paras.en: “You? You! I have been.⁠ ⁠… I saw your room.⁠ ⁠… I thought you.⁠ ⁠…” But midway I hurt myself upon the sharp, motionless spears of her eyelashes and I stopped. I remembered: she looked at me in the same way before⁠—in the Integral. It was urgent to tell her everything in one second and in such a way that she should believe⁠—or she would never.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: «Siz? Siz! Men... Men xonangizni ko'rdim... Men sizni... deb o'yladim...» Lekin yarim yo'lda kipriklarining o'tkir, qimirlamas nayzalariga urilib, to'xtadim. Esladim: u menga avval ham xuddi shunday qaragan edi — Integralda. Unga hamma narsani bir soniyada va u ishonadigan qilib aytish zarur edi — aks holda u hech qachon...

paras.en: “Listen, I-330, I must.⁠ ⁠… I must⁠ ⁠… everything! No, no, one moment⁠—let me have a glass of water first.”
paras.uz: «Quloq soling, I-330, men kerak... Men kerak... hamma narsani! Yo'q, yo'q, bir lahza — avval bir stakan suv ichay».

paras.en: My mouth was as dry as though it were lined with blotting paper. I poured a glass of water but I could not.⁠ ⁠… I put the glass back upon the table, and with both hands firmly grasped the carafe.
paras.uz: Og'zim go'yo siyoh qog'ozi bilan qoplangandek quruq edi. Bir stakan suv quydim, lekin qila olmadim... Stakanni stolga qaytarib qo'ydim va ikki qo'lim bilan grafinni mahkam ushladim.

paras.en: Now I noticed that the blue smoke was from a cigarette. She brought the cigarette to her lips and with avidity she drew in and swallowed the smoke as I did water; then she said:
paras.uz: Endi moviy tutun sigaretdan ekanini payqadim. U sigaretni lablariga olib borib, men suvni ichgandek ochko'zlik bilan tutunni tortib yutdi; keyin dedi:

paras.en: “Don’t. Be silent. Don’t you see it matters little? I came anyway. They are waiting for me below.⁠ ⁠… Do you want these minutes which are our last⁠ ⁠… ?”
paras.uz: «Kerak emas. Jim bo'ling. Ko'rmayapsizmi, buning ahamiyati kam? Men baribir keldim. Meni pastda kutishyapti... Siz bizning oxirgi bo'lgan bu daqiqalarni... istaysizmi?»

paras.en: Abruptly she threw the cigarette on the floor and bent backwards over the side of the chair to reach the button in the wall (it was quite difficult to do so), and I remember how the chair swayed slightly, how two of its legs were lifted. Then the curtains fell.
paras.uz: U keskin sigaretni polga tashladi va devordagi tugmaga yetish uchun kursining yon tomoni osha orqaga egildi (buni qilish ancha qiyin edi) va esimda, kursi qanday biroz chayqalganini, uning ikki oyog'i qanday ko'tarilganini. Keyin pardalar tushdi.

paras.en: She came close to me and embraced me. Her knees, through her dress, were like a slow, gentle, warm, enveloping and permeating poison.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U menga yaqin kelib, meni quchoqladi. Uning tizzalari ko'ylagi orqali sekin, muloyim, iliq, o'rab oluvchi va singib boruvchi zahardek edi...

paras.en: Suddenly (it happens at times) you plunge into sweet, warm sleep⁠—when all at once, as if something pricks you, you tremble and your eyes are again widely open. So it was now; there on the floor in her room were the pink checks stamped with traces of footsteps, one of them bore the letter F and some figures.⁠ ⁠… Plus and minus fused within my mind into one lump.⁠ ⁠… I could not say even now what sort of a feeling it was but I crushed her so that she cried out with pain.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: To'satdan (bu ba'zan bo'ladi) shirin, iliq uyquga cho'kasiz — birdaniga go'yo nimadir sanchgandek, titrab ketasiz va ko'zlaringiz yana keng ochiladi. Hozir ham shunday bo'ldi; u yerda, uning xonasidagi polda oyoq izlari tushgan pushti chiptalar, ulardan birida F harfi va qandaydir raqamlar bor edi... Plyus va minus xayolimda bitta bo'lakka qo'shilib ketdi... Hozir ham bu qanday tuyg'u ekanini ayta olmayman, lekin men uni shunday ezdimki, u og'riqdan qichqirib yubordi...

paras.en: One more minute out of these ten or fifteen; her head thrown back, lying on the bright white pillow, her eyes half closed, a sharp, sweet line of teeth.⁠ ⁠… And all this reminded me in an irresistible, absurd, torturing way about something forbidden, something not permissible at that moment. More tenderly, more cruelly, I pressed her to myself, more bright grew the blue traces of my fingers.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Bu o'n yoki o'n besh daqiqadan yana bir daqiqa; uning boshi orqaga tashlangan, yorqin oq yostiqda yotibdi, ko'zlari yarim yumuq, tishlarining o'tkir, shirin chizig'i... Va bularning hammasi menga qarshi turib bo'lmas, bema'ni, qiynoqli tarzda nimadir taqiqlangan, o'sha lahzada mumkin bo'lmagan narsani eslatardi. Yanada mayinroq, yanada shafqatsizroq men uni o'zimga bosdim, barmoqlarimning moviy izlari tobora yorqinlashdi...

paras.en: She said, without opening her eyes (I noticed this), “They say you went to see the Well-Doer yesterday, is it true?”
paras.uz: U ko'zlarini ochmay dedi (men buni payqadim): «Aytishlaricha, kecha Homiyning oldiga borgan ekansiz, rostmi?»

paras.en: “Yes.”
paras.uz: «Ha».

paras.en: Then her eyes opened widely and with delight I looked at her and saw that her face grew quickly paler and paler, that it effaced itself, disappearing⁠—only the eyes remained.
paras.uz: Shunda uning ko'zlari keng ochildi va men zavq bilan unga qarab, uning yuzi tez oqarib, oqarib borayotganini, o'chib, g'oyib bo'layotganini ko'rdim — faqat ko'zlar qoldi.

paras.en: I told her everything. Only for some reason, what I don’t know⁠—(no, it is not true, I know the reason) I was silent about one thing: His assertion at the end that they needed me only in order.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Men unga hamma narsani aytib berdim. Faqat negadir, nimaligini bilmayman — (yo'q, bu rost emas, sababini bilaman) bir narsa haqida jim qoldim: Uning oxirida aytgan, ularga men faqat ... uchun kerakligim haqidagi da'vosi haqida...

paras.en: Like the image on a photographic plate in a developing fluid, her face gradually reappeared; the cheeks, the white line of teeth, the lips. She stood up and went to the mirror-door of the closet. My mouth was dry again. I poured water but it was revolting to drink it; I put the glass back on the table and asked:
paras.uz: Ochiltiruvchi suyuqlikdagi fotoplastinkadagi tasvirdek, uning yuzi asta-sekin yana paydo bo'ldi; yonoqlar, tishlarning oq chizig'i, lablar. U o'rnidan turib, javonning ko'zguli eshigi oldiga bordi. Og'zim yana qurib qoldi. Suv quydim, lekin uni ichish jirkanch edi; stakanni stolga qaytarib qo'yib, so'radim:

paras.en: “Did you come to see me because you wanted to inquire⁠ ⁠… ?”
paras.uz: «Siz mening oldimga ... ni surishtirmoqchi bo'lganingiz uchun keldingizmi?»

paras.en: A sharp, mocking triangle of brows drawn to the temples looked at me from the mirror. She turned around to say something but said nothing.
paras.uz: Ko'zgudan menga chakkalarga tortilgan qoshlarning o'tkir, masxaraomuz uchburchagi qaradi. U nimadir demoqchi bo'lib o'girildi, lekin hech narsa demadi.

paras.en: It was not necessary; I knew.
paras.uz: Bunga hojat yo'q edi; men bilardim.

paras.en: To bid her goodbye, I moved my foreign limbs, struck the chair with them. It fell upside down, dead, like the table in her room. Her lips were cold⁠ ⁠… just as cold was once the floor, here, near my bed.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U bilan xayrlashish uchun begona a'zolarimni qimirlatdim, ular bilan kursiga urilib ketdim. U teskari, o'likdek, uning xonasidagi stoldek ag'darilib tushdi. Uning lablari sovuq edi... xuddi bir paytlar bu yerda, karavotim yonidagi pol shunday sovuq bo'lgandek...

paras.en: When she left I sat down on the floor, bent over the cigarette-butt.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U ketgach, polga o'tirib, sigaret qoldig'i ustiga egildim...

paras.en: I cannot write any more⁠—I no longer want to!
paras.uz: Boshqa yoza olmayman — endi istamayman!

gloss.ex: Now I noticed that the blue smoke was from a cigarette. She brought the cigarette to her lips and with avidity she drew in and swallowe…
…are waiting for me below.⁠ ⁠… Do you want these minutes which are our last⁠ ⁠… ?”
…. I half closed my eyes. My head seemed filled with some caustic blue smoke. Everything was enveloped in fog and through the fog:
…her dress, were like a slow, gentle, warm, enveloping and permeating poison.⁠ ⁠…
To bid her goodbye, I moved my foreign limbs, struck the chair with them. It fell upside down, dead,…

quiz.q: What does I-330 ask D-503?
quiz.why_uz: «Kecha Homiyning oldiga borganmisiz?»

quiz.q: What does D-503 hide from her?
o: The Well-Doer's claim that she used him
quiz.why_uz: U bu haqda jim qoladi.

chapters.recap_uz: I-330 oxirgi marta D-503 ning oldiga keladi. U Homiy bilan uchrashuvni so'raydi; D-503 hamma narsani aytadi, faqat bittasini emas. I-330 indamay ketadi.

chapters.title: The end

paras.en: All this was like the last crystal of salt thrown into a saturated solution; quickly, needle-like crystals began to appear, to grow more substantial and solid. It was clear to me; the decision was made and tomorrow morning I shall do it! It amounts to suicide but perhaps then I shall be reborn. For only what is killed can be reborn.
paras.uz: Bularning hammasi to'yingan eritmaga tashlangan oxirgi tuz kristaliga o'xshardi; tez orada ignasimon kristallar paydo bo'lib, tobora mustahkamroq va qattiqroq bo'lib o'sa boshladi. Menga aniq edi; qaror qabul qilindi va ertaga ertalab men buni qilaman! Bu o'z joniga qasd qilish bilan barobar, lekin balki shunda men qayta tug'ilarman. Chunki faqat o'ldirilgan narsagina qayta tug'ilishi mumkin.

paras.en: Every second the sky twitched in convulsion there in the west. My head was burning and pulsating inside; I was up all night and I fell asleep only at about seven o’clock in the morning when the darkness of the night was already dispelled and becoming gray and when the roofs crowded with birds became visible.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Har soniyada u yerda, g'arbda osmon talvasada pirpirardi. Boshim yonib, ichida urib turardi; men tun bo'yi bedor edim va faqat ertalab soat yettilarda, tun zulmati allaqachon tarqalib, kulranglasha boshlaganda va qushlar bilan to'lgan tomlar ko'rina boshlaganda uxlab qoldim...

paras.en: I woke up; ten o’clock. Evidently the bell did not ring today. On the table⁠—left from yesterday⁠—there stood the glass of water. I gulped the water down with avidity and I ran; I had to do it quickly, as quickly as possible.
paras.uz: Uyg'ondim; soat o'n. Aftidan, bugun qo'ng'iroq chalinmagan. Stolda — kechadan qolgan — bir stakan suv turardi. Suvni ochko'zlik bilan simirib, yugurdim; buni tez, iloji boricha tez qilishim kerak edi.

paras.en: The sky was deserted, blue, all eaten up by the storm. Sharp corners of shadows.⁠ ⁠… Everything seemed to be cut out of blue autumnal air⁠—thin, dangerous to touch; it seemed so brittle, ready to disperse into glass dust. Within me something similar; I ought not to think; it was dangerous to think, for.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Osmon huvillagan, moviy, butunlay bo'ron yeb qo'ygandek edi. Soyalarning o'tkir burchaklari... Hamma narsa moviy kuzgi havodan qirqib olingandek — yupqa, tegish xavfli; u shunchalik mo'rt, shisha changiga tarqalib ketishga tayyordek tuyulardi. Ichimda ham shunga o'xshash narsa; men o'ylamasligim kerak edi; o'ylash xavfli edi, chunki...

paras.en: And I did not think, perhaps I did not even see properly; I only registered impressions. There on the pavement, thrown from somewhere, branches were strewn; their leaves were green, amber and cherry-red. Above, crossing each other, birds and aeros were tossing about. Here below heads, open mouths, hands waving branches.⁠ ⁠… All this must have been shouting, buzzing, chirping.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Va men o'ylamadim, balki hatto to'g'ri ko'rmadim ham; faqat taassurotlarni qayd etdim. U yerda trotuarda qayerdandir otilgan shoxlar sochilib yotardi; ularning barglari yashil, qahrabo va olcha-qizil edi. Tepada, bir-birini kesib o'tib, qushlar va aerolar uloqib yurardi. Bu yerda, pastda boshlar, ochiq og'izlar, shox silkitayotgan qo'llar... Bularning hammasi qichqirayotgan, g'uvillayotgan, chug'urlayotgan bo'lsa kerak...

paras.en: Then⁠—streets empty as if swept by a plague. I remember I stumbled over something disgustingly soft, yielding yet motionless. I bent down⁠—a corpse. It was lying flat, the legs apart. The face.⁠ ⁠… I recognized the thick negro lips which even now seemed to sprinkle with laughter. His eyes, firmly screwed in, laughed into my face. One second.⁠ ⁠… I stepped over him and ran. I could no longer.⁠ ⁠… I had to have everything done as soon as possible, or else I felt I would break, I would break in two like an overloaded sail.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Keyin — go'yo vabo supurib ketgandek bo'm-bo'sh ko'chalar. Esimda, nimadir jirkanch yumshoq, egiluvchan, lekin qimirlamaydigan narsaga qoqildim. Egildim — murda. U yassi yotardi, oyoqlari ochilgan. Yuzi... Men hozir ham go'yo kulgi bilan sachrayotgan qalin negr lablarini tanidim. Uning mahkam qisilgan ko'zlari yuzimga kulardi. Bir soniya... Men uning ustidan hatlab o'tib, yugurdim. Men endi... qila olmasdim... Hamma narsani iloji boricha tezroq qilishim kerak edi, aks holda o'zimni sinib ketadigandek, ortiqcha yuklangan yelkandek ikkiga bo'linib ketadigandek his qilardim...

paras.en: Luckily it was not more than twenty steps away; I already saw the sign with the golden letters: “The Bureau of Guardians.” At the door I stopped for a moment to gulp down as much air as I could and stepped in.
paras.uz: Baxtimga, yigirma qadamdan ko'p emas edi; men allaqachon oltin harfli lavhani ko'rdim: «Qo'riqchilar Idorasi». Eshik oldida bir lahza to'xtab, iloji boricha ko'proq havo yutib oldim va ichkariga kirdim.

paras.en: Inside, in the corridor stood an endless chain of numbers, holding small sheets of paper and heavy notebooks. They moved slowly, advancing a step or two and stopping again. I began to be tossed about along the chain, my head was breaking to pieces; I pulled them by the sleeves, I implored them as a sick man implores to be given something that would even at the price of sharpest pain end everything, forever.
paras.uz: Ichkarida, yo'lakda kichkina qog'oz varaqlari va og'ir daftarlar ushlagan raqamlarning cheksiz zanjiri turardi. Ular sekin harakatlanib, bir-ikki qadam oldinga siljib, yana to'xtashardi. Men zanjir bo'ylab u yoqdan bu yoqqa uloqila boshladim, boshim parcha-parcha bo'lib ketayotgan edi; ularni yenglaridan tortardim, xuddi kasal odam eng o'tkir og'riq evaziga bo'lsa ham hamma narsaga abadiy chek qo'yadigan biror narsa berishlarini yolvorib so'ragandek yolvorardim.

paras.en: A woman with a belt tightly clasped around her waist over the unif and with two distinctly protruding squatty hemispheres tossing about as if she had eyes on them, chuckled at me:
paras.uz: Yunifasi ustidan beliga kamarni mahkam bog'lagan va go'yo ularda ko'zlari bordek u yoqdan bu yoqqa tebranayotgan ikkita aniq bo'rtib chiqqan pakana yarim shari bor bir ayol menga qarab kuldi:

paras.en: “He has a bellyache! Show him to the room second door to the right!”
paras.uz: «Uning qorni og'riyapti! Uni o'ng tomondagi ikkinchi eshikka kuzatib qo'yinglar!»

paras.en: Everybody laughed, and because of that laughter something rose in my throat; I felt I should either scream or⁠ ⁠… or.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Hamma kuldi va o'sha kulgi tufayli tomog'imga nimadir tiqildi; men yo qichqirishim yoki... yoki... kerakligini his qildim...

paras.en: Suddenly from behind someone touched my elbow. I turned around. Transparent wing-ears! But they were not pink as usual; they were purplish red; his Adam’s apple was tossing about as though ready to tear the covering.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: To'satdan orqadan kimdir tirsagimga tegdi. O'girildim. Shaffof qanot-quloqlar! Lekin ular odatdagidek pushti emas edi; ular to'q qizil edi; uning kekirdagi go'yo qoplamani yirtishga tayyordek u yoqdan bu yoqqa sakrardi...

paras.en: Quickly boring into me: “What are you here for?”
paras.uz: Tezda menga burg'ilab: «Bu yerda nima qilyapsiz?»

paras.en: I seized him.
paras.uz: Men uni ushlab oldim.

paras.en: “Quickly! Please! Quickly!⁠ ⁠… into your office.⁠ ⁠… I must tell everything⁠ ⁠… right away.⁠ ⁠… I am glad that you.⁠ ⁠… It may be terrible that it should be you to whom.⁠ ⁠… But it is well, it is well.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Tezroq! Iltimos! Tezroq!.. xonangizga... Men hamma narsani aytishim kerak... hoziroq... Xursandmanki, siz... Bu dahshatli bo'lishi mumkin, kimga... siz bo'lishi... Lekin bu yaxshi, bu yaxshi...»

paras.en: He too, knew her; this made it even more tormenting for me. But perhaps he too, would tremble when he should hear.⁠ ⁠… And we would both be killing.⁠ ⁠… And I would not be alone at that, my supreme second.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U ham uni bilardi; bu men uchun yanada qiynoqliroq edi. Lekin balki u ham eshitganda titrab ketar... Va ikkalamiz ham o'ldirgan bo'lardik... Va men o'sha, oliy soniyamda yolg'iz bo'lmasdim...

paras.en: The door closed with a slam. I remember a piece of paper was caught beneath the door and it rustled on the floor when the door closed. And then a strange airless silence covered us as if a glass bell were put over us. If only he had uttered a single, most insignificant word, no matter what, I should have told him everything at once. But he was silent. So keyed up that I heard a noise in my ears, I said without looking at him:
paras.uz: Eshik qarsillab yopildi. Esimda, eshik ostiga bir parcha qog'oz qisilib qolgan edi va eshik yopilganda u polda shitirladi. Keyin go'yo ustimizga shisha qo'ng'iroq yopilgandek, bizni g'alati, havosiz sukunat qopladi. Agar u bironta, eng arzimas so'z, nima bo'lsa ham, aytganida, men unga darhol hamma narsani aytib bergan bo'lardim. Lekin u jim edi. Quloqlarimda shovqin eshitiladigan darajada taranglashib, unga qaramay dedim:

paras.en: “I think I always hated her from the very beginning.⁠ ⁠… I struggled.⁠ ⁠… Or, no, no, don’t believe me; I could have but I did not want to save myself; I wanted to perish; this was dearer to me than anything else⁠ ⁠… and even now, even this minute, when I know already everything.⁠ ⁠… Do you know that I was summoned to the Well-Doer?”
paras.uz: «Menimcha, men undan boshidanoq doimo nafratlanganman... Men kurashdim... Yoki yo'q, yo'q, menga ishonmang; men qila olardim, lekin o'zimni qutqarishni istamadim; halok bo'lishni istardim; bu men uchun hamma narsadan azizroq edi... va hatto hozir ham, hatto shu daqiqada, men allaqachon hamma narsani bilganimda... Bilasizmi, meni Homiyning oldiga chaqirishgan edi?»

paras.en: “Yes, I do.”
paras.uz: «Ha, bilaman».

paras.en: “But what he told me! Please realize that it was equivalent to⁠ ⁠… it was as if someone should remove the floor from under you this minute, and you and all here on the desk, the papers, the ink⁠ ⁠… the ink would splash out and cover everything with blots.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Lekin U menga nima dedi! Iltimos, anglang, bu go'yo... go'yo kimdir hozir oyog'ingiz ostidan polni olib qo'ygandek, va siz va bu yerda stol ustidagi hamma narsa, qog'ozlar, siyoh... siyoh sachrab, hamma narsani dog'lar bilan qoplagandek...»

paras.en: “What else? What further? Hurry up, others are waiting!”
paras.uz: «Yana nima? Keyin-chi? Tezroq, boshqalar kutyapti!»

paras.en: Then stumbling, muttering, I told him everything that is recorded in these pages.⁠ ⁠… About my real self, and about my hairy self, and about my hands⁠ ⁠… yes⁠ ⁠… exactly that was the beginning. And how I would not do my duty then, and how I lied to myself, and how she obtained false certificates for me, and how I grew worse and worse, every day, and about the long corridors underground, and there beyond the Wall.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Shunda qoqilib, g'o'ldirab, unga bu sahifalarda yozilgan hamma narsani aytib berdim... Haqiqiy o'zim haqida, tukli o'zim haqida va qo'llarim haqida... ha... aynan shu boshlanish edi. Va o'shanda qanday qilib burchimni bajarmaganim, qanday qilib o'zimga yolg'on gapirganim, u menga qanday qilib soxta guvohnomalar olib bergani, men qanday qilib har kuni tobora yomonlashib borganim haqida, yer ostidagi uzun yo'laklar va u yerda, Devor ortida haqida...

paras.en: All this I threw out in formless pieces and lumps. I would stutter and fail to find words. The lips double-curved in a smile would prompt me with the word I needed and I would nod gratefully: “Yes, yes!”.⁠ ⁠… Suddenly, what was it? He was talking for me and I only listened and nodded: “Yes, yes,” and then, “Yes, exactly so,⁠ ⁠… yes, yes.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: Bularning hammasini shaklsiz parchalar va bo'laklar qilib otib tashladim. Duduqlanardim va so'z topa olmasdim. Tabassumda ikki marta egilgan lablar menga kerakli so'zni aytib yuborardi va men minnatdorlik bilan bosh irg'ardim: «Ha, ha!»... To'satdan, bu nima edi? U men uchun gapirardi va men faqat tinglab, bosh irg'ardim: «Ha, ha», keyin esa: «Ha, aynan shunday... ha, ha...»

paras.en: I felt cold around my mouth as though it were wet with ether, and I asked with difficulty:
paras.uz: Og'zim atrofida go'yo efir bilan ho'llangandek sovuqni his qildim va qiyinchilik bilan so'radim:

paras.en: “But how is it.⁠ ⁠… You could not learn anywhere.⁠ ⁠…”
paras.uz: «Lekin qanday qilib... Siz hech qayerdan bila olmasdingiz...»

paras.en: He smiled a smile growing more and more curved; then:
paras.uz: U tobora egilib borayotgan tabassum bilan jilmaydi; keyin:

paras.en: “But I see that you do want to conceal from me something. For example, you enumerated everything you saw beyond the Wall but you failed to mention one thing. You deny it? But don’t you remember that once, just in passing, just for a second you saw me there? Yes, yes me!”
paras.uz: «Lekin ko'ryapmanki, siz mendan nimanidir yashirmoqchisiz. Masalan, siz Devor ortida ko'rgan hamma narsani sanab o'tdingiz, lekin bitta narsani aytishni unutdingiz. Inkor qilasizmi? Lekin esingizda yo'qmi, bir marta, shunchaki o'tib ketayotib, bir soniyaga meni u yerda ko'rgandingiz? Ha, ha, meni!»

paras.en: Silence.
paras.uz: Sukunat.

paras.en: Suddenly, like a flash of lightning, it became shamelessly clear to me: he⁠—he too⁠—. And all myself, my torment, all that I brought here, crushed by the burden, plucking up my last strength as if performing a great feat, all appeared to me only funny⁠—like the ancient anecdote about Abraham and Isaac; Abraham all in a cold sweat, with the knife already raised over his son, over himself⁠—and suddenly a voice from above: “Never mind.⁠ ⁠… I was only joking.”
paras.uz: To'satdan, chaqmoq chaqnaganidek, menga uyatsiz darajada ayon bo'ldi: u — u ham —. Va men o'zim, mening azobim, yuk ostida ezilib, go'yo buyuk jasorat ko'rsatayotgandek so'nggi kuchimni yig'ib bu yerga olib kelgan hamma narsam menga faqat kulgili bo'lib tuyuldi — Ibrohim va Ishoq haqidagi qadimiy latifadek; Ibrohim butunlay sovuq terga botgan, pichoq allaqachon o'g'li ustida, o'zi ustida ko'tarilgan — va to'satdan yuqoridan ovoz: «Qo'yaver... Men shunchaki hazillashdim».

paras.en: Without taking my eyes from the smile which grew more and more curved, I put my hands on the edge of the desk and slowly, very slowly pushed myself with my chair away from him. Then instantly gathering myself into my own hands, I dashed madly out, past loud voices, past steps and mouths.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Ko'zlarimni tobora egilib borayotgan tabassumdan uzmay, qo'llarimni stol chetiga qo'ydim va sekin, juda sekin kursim bilan birga o'zimni undan nari itardim. Keyin bir zumda o'zimni o'z qo'llarimga yig'ib olib, baland ovozlar, qadamlar va og'izlar yonidan telbalarcha otilib chiqdim...

paras.en: I do not remember how I got into one of the public restrooms at a station of the Underground Railway. Above, everything was perishing; the greatest civilization, the most rational in human history was crumbling⁠—but here, by some irony everything remained as before, beautiful. The walls shone; water murmured cosily and like the water⁠—the unseen, transparent music.⁠ ⁠… Only think of it! All this is doomed; all this will be covered with grass, some day; only myths will remain.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Yer osti temir yo'li stansiyasidagi jamoat hojatxonalaridan biriga qanday kirib qolganimni eslay olmayman. Tepada hamma narsa halok bo'layotgan edi; insoniyat tarixidagi eng buyuk, eng aqlli tsivilizatsiya qulab tushayotgan edi — lekin bu yerda qandaydir kinoya bilan hamma narsa avvalgidek, go'zal qolgan edi. Devorlar yaltirardi; suv shinam shildirardi va suv kabi — ko'rinmas, shaffof musiqa... Faqat o'ylab ko'ring! Bularning hammasi halokatga mahkum; bularning hammasini bir kun kelib o't bosadi; faqat afsonalar qoladi...

paras.en: I moaned aloud. At the same instant I felt someone gently patting my knee. It was from the left; it was my neighbor who occupied a seat on my left⁠—an enormous forehead, a bald parabola, yellow unintelligible lines of wrinkles on his forehead, those lines about me.
paras.uz: Men ovoz chiqarib ingradim. Xuddi shu lahzada kimdir tizzamni muloyimgina silayotganini his qildim. Bu chap tomondan edi; bu chap tomonimdagi o'rindiqni egallagan qo'shnim edi — ulkan peshona, taqir parabola, peshonasida ajinlarning sariq tushunarsiz chiziqlari, men haqimdagi o'sha chiziqlar.

paras.en: “I understand you. I understand completely,” he said. “Yet you must calm yourself. You must. It will return. It will inevitably return. It is only important that everybody should learn of my discovery. You are the first to whom I talk about it. I have calculated that there is no infinity! No!”
paras.uz: «Men sizni tushunaman. To'liq tushunaman, — dedi u. — Lekin siz o'zingizni tinchlantirishingiz kerak. Kerak. U qaytadi. U muqarrar ravishda qaytadi. Faqat hamma mening kashfiyotimdan xabar topishi muhim. Siz bu haqda gapirayotgan birinchi odamsiz. Men hisobladimki, cheksizlik yo'q! Yo'q!»

paras.en: I looked at him wildly.
paras.uz: Men unga yovvoyi qaradim.

paras.en: “Yes, yes, I tell you so. There is no infinity. If the universe is infinite, then the average density of matter must equal zero, but as it is not zero, we know, consequently the universe is finite; it is spherical in form and the square of its radius⁠—R2⁠—is equal to the average density multiplied by.⁠ ⁠… The only thing left is to calculate the numerical coefficient and then.⁠ ⁠… Do you realize what it means? It means that everything is final, everything is simple.⁠ ⁠… But you, my honored sir, you disturb me, you prevent my finishing my calculations by your yelling!”
paras.uz: «Ha, ha, sizga shunday deyapman. Cheksizlik yo'q. Agar koinot cheksiz bo'lsa, unda materiyaning o'rtacha zichligi nolga teng bo'lishi kerak, lekin u nol emas, biz bilamiz, demak, koinot chekli; u sharsimon shaklda va uning radiusining kvadrati — R² — o'rtacha zichlikka ko'paytirilgan... ga teng. Faqat sonli koeffitsientni hisoblash qoldi, keyin esa... Bu nimani anglatishini anglayapsizmi? Bu hamma narsa chekli, hamma narsa oddiy ekanini anglatadi... Lekin siz, hurmatli janobim, siz meni bezovta qilyapsiz, baqirishingiz bilan hisob-kitoblarimni tugatishimga xalaqit beryapsiz!»

paras.en: I do not know which shattered me more, his discovery, or his positiveness at that apocalyptic hour. I only then noticed that he had a notebook in his hands and a logarithmic dial. I understood then that even if everything was perishing it was my duty (before you, my unknown and beloved) to leave these records in a finished form.
paras.uz: Meni qaysi biri ko'proq larzaga soldi — uning kashfiyotimi yoki o'sha apokaliptik soatdagi qat'iyligimi, bilmayman. Faqat shundagina uning qo'llarida daftarcha va logarifmik shkala borligini payqadim. Shunda tushundimki, hatto hamma narsa halok bo'layotgan bo'lsa ham, (sizning oldingizda, noma'lum va sevimlilarim) bu qaydlarni tugallangan shaklda qoldirish mening burchim.

paras.en: I asked him to give me some paper, and here in the restroom to the accompaniment of the quiet music, transparent like water, I wrote down these last lines.
paras.uz: Undan menga ozgina qog'oz berishini so'radim va shu yerda, hojatxonada, suvdek shaffof sokin musiqa sadosi ostida bu oxirgi satrlarni yozdim.

paras.en: I was about to put down a period as the ancients would put a cross over the caves into which they used to throw their dead, when all of a sudden my pencil trembled and fell from between my fingers.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: Qadimgilar o'liklarini tashlagan g'orlar ustiga xoch qo'ygandek, nuqta qo'ymoqchi edim, to'satdan qalamim titrab, barmoqlarim orasidan tushib ketdi...

paras.en: “Listen!” (I pulled my neighbor). “Yes, listen, I say. There where your finite universe ends, what is there? What?”
paras.uz: «Quloq soling! (Men qo'shnimni tortdim.) Ha, quloq soling, deyapman. Sizning chekli koinotingiz tugagan joyda nima bor? Nima?»

paras.en: He had no time to answer. From above, down the steps, stamping.⁠ ⁠…
paras.uz: U javob berishga ulgurmadi. Tepadan, zinapoyalardan pastga, oyoq tovushlari...

chapters.recap_uz: D-503 Qo'riqchilar Idorasiga borib, hamma narsani aytadi. S- ham Mefi ekanini anglaydi. Hojatxonada qo'shnisi koinot chekli deb kashfiyot qiladi.

chapters.title: Facts — The bell — I am certain

paras.en: Daylight. It is clear. The barometer⁠—760 mm. It is possible that I, D-503, really wrote these⁠—pages? Is it possible that I ever felt, or imagined I felt all this?
paras.uz: Kunduz. Havo ochiq. Barometr — 760 millimetr. Bu sahifalarni rostdan ham men, D-503, yozgan bo'lishim mumkinmi? Nahot bularning barini qachondir his qilgan yoki his qildim deb tasavvur etgan bo'lsam?

paras.en: The handwriting is mine. And what follows is all in my handwriting. Fortunately only the handwriting. No more delirium, no absurd metaphors, no feelings⁠—only facts. For I am healthy, perfectly, absolutely healthy.⁠ ⁠… I am smiling; I cannot help smiling; a splinter has been taken out of my head and I feel so light, so empty! To be more exact, not empty, but there is nothing foreign, nothing that prevents me from smiling. (Smiling is the normal state for a normal human being).
paras.uz: Dastxat meniki. Quyida yozilganlar ham mening dastxatim bilan. Baxtimga, faqat dastxat. Endi alahlash ham, bema'ni tashbehlar ham, his-tuyg'ular ham yo'q. Faqat faktlar. Chunki men sog'lomman, bus-butun, mutlaqo sog'lomman… Tabassum qilyapman. Tabassum qilmay turolmayman. Boshimdan bir zirapchani olib tashlashdi, o'zimni shunchalik yengil, shunchalik bo'sh his qilyapman! Aniqrog'i, bo'sh emas. Ichimda begona hech narsa yo'q, tabassum qilishimga hech narsa xalaqit bermaydi. (Tabassum — normal odamning normal holati.)

paras.en: The facts are as follows: That evening my neighbor who discovered the finiteness of the universe, and I, and all others who did not have a certificate showing that we had been operated on, all of us were taken to the nearest auditorium. (For some reason the number of the auditorium, 112, seemed familiar to me). There they tied us to the tables and performed the great operation. Next day, I, D-503, appeared before the Well-Doer and told him everything known to me about the enemies of happiness. Why before it seemed hard for me to go, I cannot understand. The only explanation seems to be my illness⁠—my soul.
paras.uz: Faktlar quyidagicha. O'sha oqshom koinotning chekli ekanini kashf etgan qo'shnimni ham, meni ham, operatsiyadan o'tganlik guvohnomasi yo'q boshqalarni ham eng yaqin auditoriyaga olib ketishdi. (Negadir auditoriyaning raqami, 112, menga tanish tuyuldi.) U yerda bizni stollarga bog'lab, buyuk operatsiyani o'tkazishdi. Ertasi kuni men, D-503, Homiy huzuriga bordim va baxt dushmanlari haqida bilganlarimning barini aytib berdim. Nega ilgari u yerga borish menga og'ir tuyulganini tushunolmayman. Buning yagona izohi kasalligim — ruhim bo'lsa kerak.

paras.en: The same evening, sitting at the same table with Him, with the Well-Doer, I saw for the first time in my life the famous Gas Chamber. They brought in that woman. She was to testify in my presence. That woman remained stubbornly silent and smiling. I noticed that she had sharp and very white teeth which were very pretty.
paras.uz: O'sha oqshom U bilan, Homiy bilan bir stolda o'tirib, mashhur Gaz kamerasini umrimda birinchi bor ko'rdim. O'sha ayolni olib kirishdi. U mening huzurimda ko'rsatma berishi kerak edi. Ayol o'jarlik bilan sukut saqlab, tabassum qilardi. Uning o'tkir, juda oppoq tishlarini payqadim. Chiroyli tishlar ekan.

paras.en: Then she was brought under the Bell. Her face became very white and as her eyes were large and dark⁠—all was very pretty. When they began pumping the air from under the Bell she threw her head back and half closed her eyes; her lips were pressed together. This reminded me of something. She looked at me, holding the arms of the chair firmly. She continued to look until her eyes closed. Then she was taken out and brought to by means of electrodes and again put under the Bell. The procedure was repeated three times, yet she did not utter a word.
paras.uz: Keyin uni Qo'ng'iroq ostiga olib kirishdi. Yuzlari oqarib ketdi. Katta qora ko'zlari bilan hammasi juda chiroyli ko'rinardi. Qo'ng'iroq ostidan havoni so'rib olishni boshlashganda, u boshini orqaga tashlab, ko'zlarini yarim yumdi. Lablari bir-biriga qattiq jipslashgan edi. Bu menga nimanidir eslatdi. U kursining tirsaklarini mahkam changallab menga qaradi. Ko'zlari yumilguncha qarab turdi. So'ng uni olib chiqishdi, elektrodlar yordamida hushiga keltirishdi va yana Qo'ng'iroq ostiga qo'yishdi. Buni uch marta takrorlashdi. U bir og'iz ham gapirmadi.

paras.en: The others who were brought in with that woman, proved to be more honest; many of them began to speak after the first trial. Tomorrow they will all ascend the steps to the Machine of the Well-Doer. No postponement is possible for there still is chaos, groaning, cadavers, beasts in the western section, and to our regret there are still quantities of Numbers who betrayed Reason.
paras.uz: O'sha ayol bilan birga olib kelinganlar halolroq chiqdi. Ko'pchiligi birinchi sinovdayoq gapira boshladi. Ertaga ularning bari Homiy Mashinasining zinapoyalaridan ko'tariladi. Buni ortga surib bo'lmaydi. G'arbiy qismda hanuz tartibsizlik, ingroq, jasadlar, yovvoyi hayvonlar bor. Afsuski, Aqlga xiyonat qilgan Raqamlar ham hali ko'p.

paras.en: But on the transverse avenue Forty, we succeeded in establishing a temporary Wall of high voltage waves. And I hope we win. More than that; I am certain we shall win. For Reason must win.
paras.uz: Ammo Qirqinchi ko'ndalang prospektda yuqori kuchlanishli to'lqinlardan vaqtinchalik Devor tiklashga muvaffaq bo'ldik. Men g'alaba qozonishimizga umid qilaman. Undan ham ortig'i, g'alaba qozonishimizga aminman. Negaki Aql g'alaba qilishi shart.
